cards.name: The Silicon Valley Tech Bro
cards.effect: Start with +3 Capital. Immune to privacy scandals.
cards.flavorText: Move fast, break things, and then hire a lobbyist to fix the regulations.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Jargon: Using buzzwords as verbs (Disrupt, Pivot, Synergy).

cards.name: The Hollywood Elite
cards.flavorText: I'm not just acting; I'm raising awareness. Have you seen my documentary?
cards.learningGoal: Virtuous Phrasing: (Raising awareness, Speaking my truth, Using my platform).

cards.name: The Central Valley Farmer
cards.effect: Water-based attacks have no effect on you.
cards.flavorText: You folks up in the Bay wouldn't last a day without our almonds.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Idioms: (Salt of the earth, Put food on the table, Work the land).

cards.name: The Gateway Cities Mayor
cards.effect: +1 Capital per turn from local retail taxes.
cards.flavorText: From Bellflower to Lakewood, we are the hardworking suburban backbone of this state!
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Rhetoric: Identifying community foundations (Backbone, Hardworking, Gateway).

cards.name: Strategic Redistricting
cards.effect: Reshuffle coalition weights among all active states.
cards.flavorText: Why let the voters decide who the representative is? We'll decide who the voters are!

cards.name: The Deep Throat Leak
cards.effect: Reveal 3 random cards from the opponent's hand.
cards.flavorText: Meet me in the parking garage. I have the documents that will end your career.

cards.name: The Executive Clemency
cards.effect: Clear all scandal damage-over-time effects from your campaign.
cards.flavorText: I've decided that the legal proceedings were an unfair witch hunt. You're free to go.

cards.name: ID Requirement Law
cards.effect: Reduce opponent's demographic approval by 15% across all regions.
cards.flavorText: We're just ensuring election integrity. It's a shame if some people can't find their passports.

cards.name: The Westwood Academic
cards.flavorText: According to my bioengineering research at UCLA, this policy is fundamentally flawed.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Register: (Fundamentally flawed, Empirical evidence, Peer-reviewed).

cards.name: The Coastal NIMBY
cards.effect: Block any housing or infrastructure card.
cards.flavorText: I love affordable housing! Just... not in my specific zip code. It ruins the neighborhood character.
cards.learningGoal: Conditional Support: (I support it but, Neighborhood character, Preserving views).

cards.name: The Aerospace Executive
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support when playing Tech or Military cards.
cards.flavorText: We're not just building rockets for SpaceX; we're building California's future.
cards.learningGoal: Visionary Language: Inspiring future-tense statements (Frontier, Innovation, Pushing boundaries).

cards.name: The Progressive YIMBY
cards.flavorText: Build more housing! Upzone everything! Abolish single-family zoning!
cards.learningGoal: Urgent Imperatives: Short, demanding action verbs (Abolish, Upzone, Mandate).

cards.name: The Recall Petition
cards.effect: Force opponent to discard half their hand.
cards.flavorText: If we get 1.5 million signatures at the grocery store, you're out of a job.
cards.learningGoal: Direct Threats: Conditional phrasing (If we get X, then Y happens).

cards.name: CEQA Lawsuit
cards.effect: Stop opponent's Infrastructure card and drain 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We found a rare species of dirt near your proposed train station. See you in court for the next decade.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Delay: (Litigation, Environmental impact report, Injunction).

cards.name: Hypocritical Dinner Party
cards.flavorText: You mandated masks for everyone, but got caught eating at a 3-star Michelin restaurant with lobbyists?
cards.learningGoal: Accusatory Contrast: Highlighting hypocrisy (Mandated for us, Rules for thee).

cards.name: Tech Exodus
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Capital as donors flee to Austin.
cards.flavorText: Taxes are too high. I'm moving my headquarters to Texas. Don't text me.
cards.learningGoal: Ultimatum Phrasing: Expressing finality (Relocating, Greener pastures, Bottom line).

cards.name: Rolling Blackouts
cards.effect: All active buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: Please turn off your AC between 4 PM and 9 PM to save the grid. Yes, even in September.
cards.learningGoal: Scarcity Commands: (Conserve energy, Unprecedented demand, Rolling outages).

cards.name: Drought Restrictions
cards.effect: Opponent cannot generate Capital next turn.
cards.flavorText: You watered your lawn on a Tuesday?! That's a $500 fine and public shaming.
cards.learningGoal: Punitive Language: (Violation of ordinance, Mandatory restrictions, Fined).

cards.name: Wildfire Smoke
cards.effect: Opponent must skip their turn due to hazardous AQI.
cards.flavorText: The sky is orange today. Stay indoors, run your air purifiers, and don't vote.
cards.learningGoal: Apocalyptic Tone: Warning vocab (Hazardous, Unprecedented, Evacuation zone).

cards.name: PCH Traffic Jam
cards.flavorText: I'm stuck on the PCH behind a landslide and a rogue surfer. I'll be 3 hours late.
cards.learningGoal: Exaggerated Frustration: Commuter complaints (Bumper to bumper, Gridlock, Standstill).

cards.name: State of Emergency
cards.effect: Gain +5 Support instantly, but lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: I am deploying the National Guard to deal with... well, everything.
cards.learningGoal: Authoritative Action: (Deploying resources, Executive order, Emergency declaration).

cards.name: High-Speed Rail Funding
cards.effect: Gain immediate Support, but lose it in 2 turns when it's delayed.
cards.flavorText: It will connect LA to SF in 2 hours! Expected completion date: 2085.
cards.learningGoal: Over-promising: Corporate/gov timeline words (Revolutionary infrastructure, Phased rollout).

cards.name: Avocado Toast Subsidy
cards.flavorText: We must protect the sacred right to affordable weekend brunch!
cards.learningGoal: Satirical Priorities: Elevating trivial things (Sacred right, Fundamental necessity).

cards.name: Prop 13 Defense
cards.flavorText: Don't you dare touch my property taxes! I bought this house in 1978 for $40,000!
cards.learningGoal: Entitlement Defensiveness: (Vested rights, Fixed income, Don't you dare touch).

cards.name: The Hollywood Fundraiser
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital from a celebrity gala.
cards.flavorText: George Clooney and I agree: the middle class needs our help. Now, try the caviar.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Disconnect: Juxtaposing wealth with populism (Gala, Philanthropy, The working man).

cards.name: Surfing Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Look, I'm just a chill, regular guy shredding these gnarly waves of legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Surfer Slang Integration: (Gnarly, Shredding, Catching waves, Dude).

cards.name: Earthquake Panic
cards.effect: Both players discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: Was that a 5.2 or just a heavy truck? Better restock the emergency kit either way.
cards.learningGoal: Anxious Speculation: (Magnitude, Aftershock, Fault line, Preparedness).

cards.name: Pharmacy Tech Empathy
cards.flavorText: After 5 years working the pharmacy counter in Lakewood, I truly understand everyday healthcare struggles.
cards.learningGoal: Empathetic Connection: Relatable working-class terms (Everyday struggles, Frontline, Copay).

cards.name: Dispensary Ribbon Cutting
cards.flavorText: Legalization has brought immense tax revenue and very chill vibes to our city.
cards.learningGoal: Progressive Economics: (Tax revenue, Regulated market, Destigmatize).

cards.name: Plastic Straw Ban
cards.effect: Opponent is annoyed and loses 1 Support.
cards.flavorText: Save the sea turtles! Just ignore the paper straw dissolving into your iced coffee.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Environmentalism: (Sustainability, Eco-friendly, Single-use plastics).

cards.name: The Atmospheric River
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We went from a severe drought to being entirely underwater in exactly four days.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Weather Vocabulary: (Atmospheric river, Deluge, Flash flood warnings).

cards.name: Bear in the Backyard
cards.effect: Randomly discard 1 card from either player.
cards.flavorText: A black bear is in the jacuzzi again. Call animal control or just let him chill?
cards.learningGoal: Absurdist Reality: Dealing with nature (Encroachment, Wildlife corridor, Nuisance).

cards.name: Silicon Valley Donors
cards.effect: Steady stream of +1 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: We will fund your campaign if you promise not to classify our gig workers as employees.
cards.learningGoal: Conditional Funding: (Gig economy, Independent contractors, Fostering innovation).

cards.name: Environmental Lobby
cards.effect: Steady stream of +1 Support per turn.
cards.flavorText: If it has a carbon footprint, we want it taxed, banned, or heavily regulated.
cards.learningGoal: Eco-Jargon: (Carbon footprint, Emissions targets, Heavily regulated).

cards.name: The Surfer Vote
cards.flavorText: The waves are good today, so voter turnout might be a little low, man.
cards.learningGoal: Laid-back Phrasing: (Voter turnout, Chill out, Good vibes, Swell).

cards.name: Hollywood Unions
cards.flavorText: If you cross the picket line, you'll never work in this town again.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Solidarity: (Picket line, Scab, Strike authorization, Collective bargaining).

cards.name: Central Valley Agribusiness
cards.effect: Generates +2 Capital but costs 1 Support per turn.
cards.flavorText: We need more water rights, or the almond prices are going through the roof.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Economics: (Water rights, Subsidies, Crop yields, Supply chain).

cards.name: NIMBY Homeowners Association
cards.flavorText: We have hired a lawyer to ensure the new bike lane does not reduce street parking.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-local Grievance: (HOA restrictions, Property values, Traffic impact study).

cards.name: The In-N-Out Burger Run
cards.flavorText: Nothing shows I'm a man of the people like ordering a Double-Double Animal Style on the campaign trail.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Shorthand: Using local brand knowledge (Animal Style, Secret menu, Campaign trail).

cards.name: Bear Flag Revolt
cards.translation: Revuelta de la Bandera del Oso
cards.flavorText: We are the 5th largest economy in the world! We don't need Washington!
cards.learningGoal: Secessionist Rhetoric: (5th largest economy, Sovereign, State's rights).

cards.name: Gig Worker Proposition
cards.flavorText: Are they employees? Are they contractors? Let the voters decide with a confusing ballot measure!
cards.learningGoal: Ambiguous Legal Phrasing: (Ballot measure, Reclassification, Proposition).

cards.name: The Tech Apology Tour
cards.flavorText: We take your data privacy very seriously, which is why we only leaked it twice this year.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Non-Apology: (Take very seriously, Unforeseen glitch, Moving forward).

cards.name: Smog Alert
cards.flavorText: The mountains have completely disappeared. Please avoid breathing today.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Warnings: (Air Quality Index, Visibility, Inversion layer, Smog).

cards.name: Influencer Endorsement
cards.flavorText: Hey guys, use my promo code VOTE4ME for 10% off your income taxes!
cards.learningGoal: Social Media Slang: (Promo code, Smash that like button, Paid partnership).

cards.name: Yoga Retreat
cards.flavorText: I'm focusing on my mindfulness and manifesting positive polling numbers.
cards.learningGoal: Wellness Jargon: (Mindfulness, Manifesting, Centered, Good energy).

cards.name: Kombucha on Tap
cards.flavorText: Our campaign office has a cold brew keg and organic kombucha. We're very grassroots.
cards.learningGoal: Startup Perks: (Organic, On tap, Grassroots movement, Open-concept).

cards.name: Homelessness Task Force
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support now, lose it later.
cards.flavorText: We formed a committee to study the feasibility of writing a report on the issue.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Inaction: (Task force, Feasibility study, Blue-ribbon panel).

cards.name: Recall the Recaller
cards.effect: Reverse a Recall Petition back onto the opponent.
cards.flavorText: You're recalling me? No, I'm launching a counter-recall against your recall!
cards.learningGoal: Absurd Procedural Escalation: (Counter-recall, Partisan witch hunt, Abuse of process).

cards.name: The Podcast Interview
cards.flavorText: I sat down for 3 hours with a comedian to explain my complex tax policy. It went okay.
cards.learningGoal: Casual Media Formats: (Long-form conversation, Nuance, Unfiltered platform).

cards.name: Rent Control Mandate
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from renters, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The rent is too damn high, and honestly, so is my blood pressure.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Populism: (Rent control, Cost of living crisis, Housing affordability).

cards.name: EV Mandate
cards.flavorText: By 2035, all cars must be electric. Please do not ask how the power grid will handle it.
cards.learningGoal: Futuristic Legislation: (Zero-emissions, Phasing out, Renewable transition).

cards.name: The Getty Gala
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: Tuxedos, champagne, and plotting the state's future amidst priceless Renaissance art.
cards.learningGoal: High Society Phrasing: (Exclusive, Philanthropy, Rubbing elbows, Black-tie).

cards.name: E-Scooter Menace
cards.effect: Opponent discards 1 card due to tripping.
cards.flavorText: Who left these electric scooters in the middle of the sidewalk?! My ankle is ruined.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Annoyances: (Micromobility, Sidewalk hazard, Clutter, Nuisance).

cards.name: State Tax Audit
cards.flavorText: The Franchise Tax Board would like a very long word about your offshore LLCs.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Intimidation: (Franchise Tax Board, Comprehensive audit, Offshore accounts).

cards.name: The Oil Baron
cards.effect: Start with +3 Capital. Immune to environmental attacks.
cards.flavorText: My granddaddy struck black gold, and I’m just making sure the state stays out of the way.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Vocabulary: (Black gold, Deregulation, Yield, Drilling).

cards.name: The Border Sheriff
cards.flavorText: We don't need Washington telling us how to secure our own backyard.
cards.learningGoal: Defensive Posturing: (Jurisdiction, Secure the perimeter, Outsiders).

cards.name: The Austin Transplant
cards.effect: Tech cards cost 1 less, but Rural cards cost 1 more.
cards.flavorText: I just moved my startup from San Francisco. Do you guys have oat milk here?
cards.learningGoal: Tech-Bro Outsider Phrasing: (Disruption, Vibe check, Scalability).

cards.name: High School Football Coach
cards.flavorText: Clear eyes, full hearts, lower property taxes!
cards.learningGoal: Inspirational Imperatives: (Leave it on the field, Give 110 percent, Team effort).

cards.name: The Mega-Church Pastor
cards.flavorText: The Good Lord wants this state to prosper, and He told me so on my private jet.
cards.learningGoal: Prosperity Gospel: (Blessed, Divine favor, Abundance, Flock).

cards.name: The Maverick
cards.effect: Immune to Faction debuffs. Unpredictable base.
cards.flavorText: I don't ride with the herd. I vote my conscience, even if it makes everyone mad.
cards.learningGoal: Independent Idioms: (Ride with the herd, Lone wolf, Buck the trend).

cards.name: The Secessionist
cards.flavorText: We were a Republic once, and we can be a Republic again.
cards.learningGoal: Sovereignty Rhetoric: (Republic, Secede, Independence, Federal overreach).

cards.name: Buc-ee's Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Nothing says I understand the working man like holding a giant bag of Beaver Nuggets.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Loyalty Shorthand: Using local cultural touchstones to imply relatability.

cards.name: Friday Night Lights
cards.flavorText: You can't buy this kind of community spirit. Go Panthers!
cards.learningGoal: Community Affirmation: (Hometown pride, Under the lights, Tradition).

cards.name: Barbecue Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Brisket takes 14 hours. Let's sit down, crack a Shiner, and make a deal.
cards.learningGoal: Patience Metaphors: (Low and slow, Hash it out, Smoke and mirrors).

cards.name: Fleeing to Cancun
cards.effect: Opponent loses 5 Support and skips a turn.
cards.flavorText: The state froze over, but luckily my family found a direct flight to the Riviera Maya.
cards.learningGoal: Tone-Deaf Rationalization: (Just being a good dad, Unfortunate timing).

cards.name: ERCOT Grid Failure
cards.effect: All Capital generation is disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We deregulated the grid for efficiency! Nobody expected it to actually get cold!
cards.learningGoal: Deflecting Blame: (Unprecedented weather event, Systemic anomaly).

cards.name: Winter Freeze
cards.flavorText: The pipes burst, the roads are iced, and the grocery shelves are empty. Stay home.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Vocabulary: (Boil water notice, Black ice, Rolling blackouts).

cards.name: Bluebonnet Photoshoot
cards.flavorText: Yes, I am sitting in a ditch on the side of I-35, but the lighting is fantastic.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Authenticity: (Scenic, Picturesque, Springtime tradition).

cards.name: Chili Cook-off Judge
cards.flavorText: This one has beans in it. Disqualified. I run a strict, constitutionally sound cook-off.
cards.learningGoal: Dogmatic Hyperbole: Applying serious legal words to trivial things (Disqualified, Unconstitutional).

cards.name: The Rodeo Grand Marshal
cards.flavorText: Hold onto your hats, folks! This campaign is about to be an eight-second ride!
cards.learningGoal: Equestrian/Rodeo Idioms: (Buckle up, Grab the bull by the horns).

cards.name: Tech Headquarters Relocation
cards.flavorText: We welcome our new Californian corporate overlords and their massive tax bases.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Opportunism: (Business-friendly climate, Tax incentives, Relocation).

cards.name: The Boca Chica Rocket Launch
cards.effect: Gain +6 Support (Flips to -6 if the rocket explodes).
cards.flavorText: We aren't just the Lone Star state anymore; we are the gateway to Mars!
cards.learningGoal: Visionary Grandiosity: (Interplanetary, Reaching for the stars, Launchpad).

cards.name: Don't Mess with Texas
cards.effect: Block any Attack card from an out-of-state issue.
cards.flavorText: You can keep your federal mandates in Washington. We handle our own business.
cards.learningGoal: Defiant Pushback: (Federal overreach, Overstepping bounds, Don't mess).

cards.name: Property Tax Lawsuit
cards.flavorText: Your county appraisal district has completely lost its mind. See you in court.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Aggression: (Appraisal, Valuation, Highway robbery).

cards.name: Suing the Federal Government
cards.flavorText: I've sued the federal government 47 times, and I'll do it 47 more.
cards.learningGoal: Litigious Phrasing: (Injunction, State's rights, Unconstitutional mandate).

cards.name: Border Stunt
cards.flavorText: I held a press conference in front of a boat, a wall, and a helicopter. Did you get the shot?
cards.learningGoal: Theatrical Toughness: (Show of force, Unprecedented security, Frontline).

cards.name: Gerrymandered Map
cards.effect: Opponent's Support is capped at 40 for the rest of the game.
cards.flavorText: Look closely: this congressional district is shaped exactly like a fajita.
cards.learningGoal: Spatial Manipulation: (Redistricting, Carving out, Safe seat).

cards.name: The Special Session
cards.effect: Force the game to continue even if someone hits 50 points.
cards.flavorText: I didn't get what I wanted, so nobody goes home for the summer. Back to work!
cards.learningGoal: Authoritative Extension: (Calling back, Overtime, Ram it through).

cards.name: Defunding the Cities
cards.effect: Drain Capital from a progressive opponent.
cards.flavorText: Austin is out of control. We are taking over their police budget from the Capitol.
cards.learningGoal: Preemption Vocabulary: (State preemption, Rogue municipalities, Reigning in).

cards.name: Open Carry Rally
cards.flavorText: An armed society is a polite society. Especially when I'm holding the microphone.
cards.learningGoal: Second Amendment Rhetoric: (God-given right, Self-defense, Shall not be infringed).

cards.name: The Filibuster
cards.effect: Talk for 13 hours. Opponent skips their next turn.
cards.flavorText: I am putting on my pink running shoes and I will not yield the floor.
cards.learningGoal: Endurance Language: (Yield the floor, Point of order, Stand my ground).

cards.name: Highway Expansion
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital but lose 1 Support from urban voters.
cards.flavorText: Adding 12 more lanes to the Katy Freeway will definitely fix the traffic this time.
cards.learningGoal: Sarcastic Optimism: (Induced demand, Bottleneck, Easing congestion).

cards.name: The Oil Boom
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The Permian Basin is pumping, and the state surplus is bigger than some countries!
cards.learningGoal: Economic Euphoria: (Surplus, Boomtown, Black gold, Gushing).

cards.name: Secession Threat
cards.effect: Freeze the board. Opponent loses 5 Support.
cards.flavorText: If Washington doesn't listen, maybe TEXIT is the only logical solution.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Ultimatums: (Last resort, Peaceful separation, Sovereign right).

cards.name: School Board Takeover
cards.effect: Discard all active Event cards on the board.
cards.flavorText: We are removing the superintendent and banning 400 books before lunch.
cards.learningGoal: Hostile Takeover Jargon: (Ouster, Curriculum overhaul, Back to basics).

cards.name: The Energy Lobby
cards.effect: Steady stream of +1 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: We provide the power, you provide the tax breaks. It's a beautiful friendship.
cards.learningGoal: Transactional Phrasing: (Quid pro quo, Keep the lights on, Industry partners).

cards.name: Big Oil Donors
cards.effect: Start your turn with +2 extra Capital.
cards.flavorText: Just sign this pipeline permit, and your reelection fund will be overflowing.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Persuasion: (Streamline permitting, Red tape, Campaign war chest).

cards.name: Austin Progressives
cards.flavorText: Keep Austin Weird, but also please build a light rail system we can actually use.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Liberalism: (Public transit, Weird, Keep it local).

cards.name: Rural Counties
cards.flavorText: Out here, we don't care about your think-pieces. We care about rain and roads.
cards.learningGoal: Pragmatic Stoicism: (Salt of the earth, Bread and butter issues, Out in the country).

cards.name: Houston Energy Execs
cards.flavorText: We survive hurricanes, floods, and federal regulations. Nothing stops the refineries.
cards.learningGoal: Resilience Vocabulary: (Weather the storm, Unstoppable force, Bottom line).

cards.name: The Valley Voters
cards.effect: Wildcard: Flip a coin. Gain either 3 Support or 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: South Texas is changing. You can't just play Tejano music and expect our vote anymore.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Nuance: (Taking for granted, Shifting tides, Earn the vote).

cards.name: Suburban Moms
cards.flavorText: Do not mess with the PTA. We control the minivan carpool and the ballot box.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Organizing: (Mobilize, Soccer moms, Grassroots network).

cards.name: The Agribusiness
cards.flavorText: Beef, cotton, and sorghum. We feed the nation, so keep the water rights flowing.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Dominance: (Yields, Livestock, Subsidies).

cards.name: Private Prison Contractors
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital per turn, but opponent gains +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: Crime is up! Good thing we just built three new facilities in the panhandle.
cards.learningGoal: Prison-Industrial Jargon: (Capacity, Incarceration rate, Public-private partnership).

cards.name: The Alamo Defenders
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support when playing defensive cards.
cards.flavorText: We will draw a line in the sand. Surrender is not in our vocabulary!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (Line in the sand, Remember, Last stand).

cards.name: Californians Fleeing Taxes
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital, but lose 2 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: Welcome to Texas! Now please stop voting for the things you just fled from.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Friction: (Transplants, Don't California my Texas, Voting habits).

cards.name: State Troopers
cards.effect: Block any Attack card costing 3 or less.
cards.flavorText: We are surging resources to the border, the highways, and the capital.
cards.learningGoal: Law Enforcement Speak: (Surge operations, Maintain order, Jurisdiction).

cards.name: Wind Farm Investors
cards.effect: Gain +1 Capital. Immune to ERCOT failure cards.
cards.flavorText: West Texas isn't just oil anymore. We have more turbines than any other state!
cards.learningGoal: Renewable Energy Boasting: (Diversifying the grid, Wind power, Turbines).

cards.name: The Talk Radio Host
cards.flavorText: I’m on AM radio from Amarillo to Corpus Christi, and I say this bill is a socialist plot!
cards.learningGoal: Hyperbolic Media: (Socialist plot, Waking up the masses, Coastal elites).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.flavorText: Oh, you think you can win this district? Well, bless your heart.
cards.learningGoal: Passive Aggression: Expressing pity while delivering a devastating insult.

cards.name: The Big Hair
cards.flavorText: The higher the hair, the closer to God. And the closer to the swing voters.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Sayings: (Higher the hair, Looking the part, Southern charm).

cards.name: Banning Books
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support among conservative bases.
cards.flavorText: We found a book about penguins that made us uncomfortable. It has been removed.
cards.learningGoal: Censorship Rhetoric: (Protecting the children, Inappropriate materials, Family values).

cards.name: The Lone Star
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: There’s a reason it’s the only star on the flag. We stand alone, and we stand tall.
cards.learningGoal: Exceptionalism: (Unrivaled, Stand alone, Peak pride).

cards.name: The Panhandle Populist
cards.flavorText: Up here in LA (Lower Alabama), we don't care what Miami thinks.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Identity: (Lower Alabama, Panhandle, Forgotten Coast).

cards.name: The Miami Power Broker
cards.flavorText: We run this city on cafecito, connections, and construction contracts.
cards.learningGoal: Transactional Jargon: (Connections, Contracts, Favors, Backroom deals).

cards.name: The Villages Retiree
cards.effect: Immune to attacks from younger demographics.
cards.flavorText: I drove my golf cart to the polls at 6 AM. Did your voters even wake up?
cards.learningGoal: Retiree Slang: (Snowbird, Fixed income, Early bird special).

cards.name: The Theme Park Lobbyist
cards.flavorText: We bring in 70 million tourists a year. Do not mess with the Mouse.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Ultimatum: (Economic engine, Tourist dollars, Entertainment district).

cards.name: Florida Man Candidate
cards.effect: Chaotic: Flip a coin every turn to gain 2 Capital or lose 2 Support.
cards.flavorText: Arrested for wrestling a gator at a Wendy's? That’s just free campaign press!
cards.learningGoal: Absurdist Reporting: (Allegedly, Viral sensation, Unprecedented behavior).

cards.name: The Condo Board Dictator
cards.flavorText: I have successfully banned fun, loud noises, and renters from this building.
cards.learningGoal: Authoritarian Micromanagement: (Bylaws, Violations, Fines, Assessments).

cards.name: Hurricane Press Conference
cards.flavorText: I put on my serious fleece jacket so you know this Category 4 storm is no joke.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Broadcast Tone: (Cone of uncertainty, Mandatory evacuation, Hunker down).

cards.name: Cafe Cubano Photo Op
cards.flavorText: A 3 PM colada at Versailles is mandatory for anyone running for statewide office.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Pandering: (Ventanita, Colada, Pastelito, Exile community).

cards.name: Publix Subs for Everyone!
cards.flavorText: Chicken tender subs are on sale, and so is my tax plan!
cards.learningGoal: Brand Loyalty: Using local supermarket devotion as a political tool.

cards.name: The 'Anti-Woke' Crusade
cards.effect: Drain 3 Support from a progressive opponent.
cards.flavorText: We will proudly ban any textbook that makes anyone feel slightly uncomfortable.
cards.learningGoal: Culture War Buzzwords: (Indoctrination, Parental rights, Ideology).

cards.name: Feud with a Cartoon Mouse
cards.flavorText: I don't care how many jobs they create, we are dissolving their special tax district!
cards.learningGoal: Retaliatory Legislation: (Special district, Corporate privilege, Dissolve).

cards.name: Red Tide Bloom
cards.effect: All Tourism buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The beaches smell like sulfur and dead fish. Campaigning is suspended until it clears.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Disaster Phrasing: (Algae bloom, Toxic, Respiratory irritation).

cards.name: Python Invasion
cards.flavorText: A 15-foot Burmese python ate your campaign manager's poodle. Take a turn to grieve.
cards.learningGoal: Invasive Species Panic: (Everglades, Eradication, Apex predator).

cards.name: Sunshine Law Request
cards.flavorText: Every text you sent on your state phone is public record, Senator. Let's read them.
cards.learningGoal: Transparency Jargon: (Public record, FOIA, Sunshine Law, Redacted).

cards.name: Property Insurance Crisis
cards.flavorText: Your premium just went up 400% and the provider went bankrupt. Good luck!
cards.learningGoal: Financial Despair: (Premiums, Insolvent, Dropped coverage, Deductible).

cards.name: It's Not the Heat...
cards.flavorText: ...It's the humidity. Sweating through my suit makes me look like I'm working hard.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Hyperbole: (Sweltering, Muggy, Heat index).

cards.name: Stand Your Ground
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: I felt politically threatened, so I am legally allowed to end your career.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Justification: (Imminent threat, Self-defense, Castle doctrine).

cards.name: Blame New York Transplants
cards.flavorText: Traffic is bad because of all these northern license plates moving here!
cards.learningGoal: Scapegoating: (Transplants, Pricing us out, Carpetbaggers).

cards.name: No State Income Tax
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We fund our government entirely on tourists buying overpriced sunscreen and tolls!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Boasting: (Business-friendly, Tax haven, Consumption tax).

cards.name: I-4 Traffic Jam
cards.flavorText: The Eye-Sore on I-4 is backed up to Daytona. Nobody is getting to Orlando today.
cards.learningGoal: Gridlock Frustration: (Rubbernecking, Standstill, Commuter hell).

cards.name: Expanding the Toll Roads
cards.flavorText: Just pay the SunPass toll. It's only $4.50 to go two miles, don't be cheap.
cards.learningGoal: Privatization Language: (Express lanes, Variable pricing, Transponder).

cards.name: Sinkhole Swallows Headquarters
cards.effect: Both players discard half their hand.
cards.flavorText: The limestone gave way and my campaign office is now a 40-foot crater.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Disaster: (Karst topography, Swallow hole, Instability).

cards.name: Frozen Falling Iguanas
cards.effect: Opponent loses 1 Capital due to a cold snap.
cards.flavorText: It hit 45 degrees. The reptiles are dropping from the palm trees. Stay indoors!
cards.learningGoal: Bizarre Weather Alerts: (Stunned, Cold snap, Falling iguanas).

cards.name: The Sugar Barons
cards.effect: Steady stream of +2 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: We control the water south of Lake Okeechobee, and we fund your PAC. Remember that.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Hegemony: (Subsidies, Runoff, PAC money, Agribusiness).

cards.name: Spring Break Chaos
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support, but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: Panama City Beach is at maximum capacity. We love the revenue, hate the noise.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Nuance: (Revenue stream, Rowdy, Curfew, High season).

cards.name: Space Coast Engineers
cards.effect: Tech cards cost 1 less to play.
cards.flavorText: Cape Canaveral is launching rockets every Tuesday. We are the future of orbital commerce.
cards.learningGoal: Aerospace Jargon: (Payload, Orbit, Launch window, Thrust).

cards.name: Cuban Exile Community
cards.effect: Grants immunity to any 'Socialist' labeled attacks.
cards.flavorText: Do not even think about using the word 'comrade' in Miami-Dade County.
cards.learningGoal: Anti-Communist Rhetoric: (Regime, Exile, Political prisoners, Freedom).

cards.name: Golf Cart Armada
cards.flavorText: A parade of 500 decorated golf carts is slowly blocking traffic in your honor.
cards.learningGoal: Retirement Subculture: (Master-planned community, Active adult, Recreation).

cards.name: Airboat Campaign Tour
cards.flavorText: Nothing says 'man of the swamps' like screaming over a 100-decibel fan motor.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Pandering: (Backwaters, Glades, Mud-bogging).

cards.name: Banning Books
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from conservative bases, lose 1 from moderates.
cards.flavorText: This math textbook contains suspicious themes. Pull it from the shelves!
cards.learningGoal: Censorship Rhetoric: (Inappropriate content, Vetting process, Objectionable).

cards.name: Re-zoning the Wetlands
cards.flavorText: Sure, it's an endangered panther habitat, but it would make a great strip mall.
cards.learningGoal: Development Jargon: (Zoning variance, Wetland mitigation, Paving over).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Recount
cards.effect: Force a recount: Flip a coin. Heads, opponent loses 4 Support. Tails, you lose 2.
cards.flavorText: We are looking at hanging chads, dimpled chads, and pregnant chads.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Anxiety: (Margin of error, Recount, Invalid ballots, Voter intent).

cards.name: Fake Tan Disaster
cards.flavorText: You sweated off your spray tan on live television. The memes are merciless.
cards.learningGoal: Vanity Fails: (Image management, Optics, Perspiration).

cards.name: Jet Ski Campaign Ad
cards.flavorText: Wearing a suit on a Yamaha WaveRunner is peak Florida political advertising.
cards.learningGoal: Action-Movie Campaigning: (Maverick, Unconventional, High-octane).

cards.name: The Mangrove Swamp
cards.flavorText: You’re bogged down in environmental impact studies and mosquito bites.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Quagmire: (Bogged down, Red tape, Stagnant).

cards.name: Busing Migrants Stunt
cards.effect: Gain +5 Support (Flips to -5 if it backfires).
cards.flavorText: Chartering a flight to Martha's Vineyard to make a point on cable news.
cards.learningGoal: Theatrical Escalation: (Political stunt, Media circus, Border policy).

cards.name: Golf Course Backroom Deal
cards.translation: Trato en el Campo de Golf
cards.flavorText: Mar-a-Lago or Doral? Doesn't matter, the deal was struck on the 14th hole.
cards.learningGoal: Exclusive Networking: (Clubhouse, Membership, Handshake deal).

cards.name: Falsifying Hurricane Data
cards.effect: Heal 3 Support, but risk a scandal later.
cards.flavorText: If we draw a circle on the weather map with a Sharpie, the storm misses us completely!
cards.learningGoal: Reality Distortion: (Alternative facts, Altered map, Unofficial forecast).

cards.name: The 592nd Strip Mall
cards.flavorText: Just what we needed: another vape shop, nail salon, and Publix anchored plaza.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Sprawl: (Commercial real estate, Anchored plaza, Overdevelopment).

cards.name: Mosquito Fleet
cards.flavorText: The state bird is the mosquito. They have swarmed your opponent's outdoor rally.
cards.learningGoal: Pesky Interruptions: (Swarm, Repellent, Bloodsuckers).

cards.name: The 'Don't Say...' Bill
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We are legislating exactly what words can and cannot be spoken in a classroom.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Gag Orders: (Restriction, Curriculum limits, Taboo).

cards.name: Beach Renourishment
cards.effect: Gain immediate Support, but lose it when the next storm hits.
cards.flavorText: We pumped 3 million tons of sand onto the beach! (It will wash away by Tuesday).
cards.learningGoal: Futile Efforts: (Erosion, Dredging, Sisyphean task).

cards.name: HOA Violation
cards.flavorText: Your campaign signs are exactly 1 inch too tall. Prepare for a lien on your house.
cards.learningGoal: Petty Bureaucracy: (Covenants, Restrictions, Lien, Architectural review).

cards.name: Fleeing to Tallahassee
cards.flavorText: I'm going to the state capital where the local press can't afford to follow me.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Evasion: (Out of town, State business, Up in Tally).

cards.name: Claiming 'Executive Privilege'
cards.flavorText: I cannot release those emails because they are... uh... privileged. Yes, that's it.
cards.learningGoal: Stalling Tactics: (Redacted, Shielded, Executive privilege).

cards.name: Snowbird Migration
cards.flavorText: It's November. Two million retirees just arrived from Ohio to change the electorate.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Shifts: (Seasonal residents, Migration, Peak season).

cards.name: The State Supreme Court
cards.effect: Your cards cannot be blocked for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: I appointed half the judges on the bench. My legislation is bulletproof.
cards.learningGoal: Judicial Overreach: (Appointees, Rubber stamp, Legal immunity).

cards.name: State of Emergency
cards.effect: Freeze the board. Opponent loses 4 Support.
cards.flavorText: A hurricane is coming, so I am legally the supreme commander of this peninsula.
cards.learningGoal: Absolute Power: (Executive order, Suspension of rules, Dictate).

cards.name: The Albany Machine Boss
cards.flavorText: We don't need a public debate. The three of us will decide the budget in my office.
cards.learningGoal: Oligarchic Phrasing: (Consensus, Closed doors, Power broker, Rubber stamp).

cards.name: The Wall Street Mayor
cards.effect: Start with +3 Capital. Faction attacks cost 1 more against you.
cards.flavorText: I run this city like a multi-billion dollar enterprise, because it is one.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Governance: (Synergy, Bottom line, Return on investment).

cards.name: The DSA Insurgent
cards.flavorText: We are coming for the billionaire class, and we are organizing on the subway.
cards.learningGoal: Populist Verbs: (Organizing, Dismantling, Redistributing, Mobilizing).

cards.name: The Upstate Farmer
cards.effect: Immune to attacks from NYC-based cards.
cards.flavorText: There is a whole massive state north of the Bronx, if the Governor ever cared to look.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resentment: (Neglected, Upstate vs. Downstate, Heart of the state).

cards.name: The Staten Island Secessionist
cards.flavorText: We pay the tolls, we take the trash, and we get nothing. Let us secede!
cards.learningGoal: Separatist Rhetoric: (Secede, Disenfranchised, Unfair burden).

cards.name: Three Men in a Room
cards.effect: Swap hands with your opponent and steal 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The Governor, the Assembly Speaker, and the Senate Leader are deciding your fate over cold bagels.
cards.learningGoal: Opaque Process: (Lack of transparency, In the dark, Finalizing).

cards.name: The MTA Meltdown
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We apologize for the unavoidable delay due to signal problems at West 4th Street.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Apologies: (Unavoidable delay, Signal malfunction, Bear with us).

cards.name: Congestion Pricing Toll
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 2 Support from Suburbanites.
cards.flavorText: If you want to drive a massive SUV into Manhattan below 60th Street, you’re going to pay for it.
cards.learningGoal: Punitive Policy: (Disincentivize, Toll zone, Gridlock).

cards.name: Tabloid Front Page
cards.flavorText: The New York Post just photoshopped your head onto a giant rat. There is no coming back from this.
cards.learningGoal: Sensationalist Phrasing: (Scandalous, Excoriated, Humiliating).

cards.name: Pizza Rat Viral Video
cards.effect: Opponent skips their turn distracted by the internet.
cards.flavorText: Nobody cares about your housing policy, Senator. A rat is carrying a slice of pepperoni down the stairs.
cards.learningGoal: Absurdist Deflection: (Viral sensation, Captivating, Trivial).

cards.name: The Summer Friday
cards.flavorText: It's 2 PM on a Friday in July. The office is empty. Try passing that bill on Monday.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Leisure: (Checked out, Out of office, Summer hours).

cards.name: Fuhgeddaboudit
cards.flavorText: You think a little parking ticket scandal is gonna take me down? Fuhgeddaboudit.
cards.learningGoal: Dismissive Bravado: Expressing total unconcern (Water off a duck's back, Irrelevant).

cards.name: The Hamptons Fundraiser
cards.flavorText: We are raising awareness for the working class while sipping $400 champagne in East Hampton.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Hypocrisy: (Philanthropy, Exorbitant, Raising awareness).

cards.name: Snowstorm in Buffalo
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: Seven feet of snow dropped overnight. The National Guard is digging out the polling stations.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Weather: (Lake effect, Whiteout, Paralyzed infrastructure).

cards.name: The Bodega Order Gaffe
cards.flavorText: You ordered a scooped, gluten-free bagel with lox on camera. The city has turned against you.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Sacrilege: Using food to judge character (Authenticity, Out of touch).

cards.name: SDNY Federal Probe
cards.effect: Opponent's Capital drops to 0 and their hand is revealed.
cards.flavorText: The Southern District of New York doesn't knock. They just take your hard drives.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Intimidation: (Subpoena, Federal indictment, Seized assets).

cards.name: I'm Walkin' Here!
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Watch where you're swinging that legislation, pal!
cards.learningGoal: Aggressive Defensiveness: (Stand your ground, Pushback, Confrontational).

cards.name: Appointing a Rat Czar
cards.flavorText: I am appointing a highly paid director of rodent mitigation. They will definitely fix the problem this time.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Bureaucracy: (Mitigation, Czar, Task force, Initiative).

cards.name: City vs. State Feud
cards.effect: Both players lose 2 Capital, but you draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: The Mayor and the Governor are holding competing press conferences on the same block.
cards.learningGoal: Petty Rivalry: (One-upping, Jurisdiction battle, Spat).

cards.name: Alternate Side Parking
cards.effect: Opponent's cards cost double this turn.
cards.flavorText: You have to sit in your car for 90 minutes so the street sweeper can pass. Progress halts.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Frustrations: (Compliance, Regulations, Gridlock).

cards.name: Broadway Endorsement
cards.flavorText: The cast of Hamilton just sang a remix of your tax proposal. The donors love it.
cards.learningGoal: Theatrical Praise: (Showstopping, Standing ovation, Critical acclaim).

cards.name: The Rent is Too Damn High
cards.flavorText: We are passing universal rent control. Landlords are crying, but the tenants are cheering.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Populism: (Price gouging, Affordability crisis, Tenant rights).

cards.name: Banning Giant Sodas
cards.flavorText: You can no longer legally purchase a 32-ounce sugary beverage. It is for your own good.
cards.learningGoal: Paternalistic Phrasing: (Public health mandate, For your own good, Regulating behavior).

cards.name: Fleeing to Florida
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Capital as donors change residency.
cards.flavorText: Taxes went up 1%, so the billionaires are officially moving their official residences to Boca Raton.
cards.learningGoal: Tax Flight: (Capital flight, Domicile, Favorable tax environment).

cards.name: Showtime on the Subway
cards.effect: Randomly swap 1 card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Watch the closing doors, and watch out for the guy doing backflips off the handrails.
cards.learningGoal: Unpredictable Distractions: (Acrobatics, Commuter hazard, Unsanctioned performance).

cards.name: The State Fair Butter Sculpture
cards.flavorText: Marvel at this 800-pound cow carved entirely out of locally sourced butter!
cards.learningGoal: Rural Pandering: (Agricultural heritage, Locally sourced, State pride).

cards.name: The Met Gala Dress
cards.flavorText: Wearing a bespoke designer gown to a billionaire's party to protest billionaires.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Irony: (Haute couture, Subversive, Sending a message).

cards.name: JCOPE Ethics Investigation
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: The state ethics commission is finally doing something. Hand over the receipts.
cards.learningGoal: Compliance Language: (Conflict of interest, Disclosures, Ethical breach).

cards.name: The Transit Workers Union
cards.effect: Blocks any Infrastructure attacks against you.
cards.flavorText: If you try to cut our pensions, the buses and trains don't leave the depot tomorrow.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Threats: (Strike authorization, Collective bargaining, Pension cuts).

cards.name: Wall Street Finance Bros
cards.flavorText: We packaged your campaign debt into a collateralized obligation. You're welcome.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Jargon: (Hedge fund, Liquidity, Derivatives, Yield).

cards.name: The Real Estate Board
cards.effect: Provides +3 Capital, but costs 1 Support per turn.
cards.flavorText: We will build the affordable housing, but we need a 35-year tax abatement first.
cards.learningGoal: Developer Speak: (Tax abatement, Luxury condos, Zoning variance).

cards.name: Bodega Owners Association
cards.flavorText: They supply the chopped cheese and the coffee. They are the true backbone of the city.
cards.learningGoal: Local Lifelines: (Corner store, Community staple, Essential workers).

cards.name: Brooklyn Hipsters
cards.effect: Tech and Arts cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: I only support artisanal, small-batch, locally sourced legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Pretentious Jargon: (Artisanal, Hyper-local, Curated, Gentrification).

cards.name: Long Island NIMBYs
cards.effect: Blocks any Housing or Transit cards played by opponent.
cards.flavorText: If you build that train line, city people might actually come to our beaches! Unacceptable!
cards.learningGoal: Exclusionary Phrasing: (Preserving character, Overcrowding, Property values).

cards.name: The Central Park Presser
cards.flavorText: Standing in front of some trees to make voters forget about the concrete jungle.
cards.learningGoal: Visual Optics: (Picturesque, Oasis, Urban renewal).

cards.name: Pothole Tire Damage
cards.flavorText: You hit a crater on the Brooklyn-Queens Expressway. Goodbye, suspension.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Crumbling, Deficient, Patchwork repairs).

cards.name: Trash Day in August
cards.effect: Opponent skips a turn due to the smell.
cards.flavorText: Mountains of black garbage bags baking in 95-degree heat. You can't even think straight.
cards.learningGoal: Sensory Overload: (Putrid, Sweltering, Sanitation crisis).

cards.name: Cross-Endorsement
cards.effect: Steal 1 Support generated by your opponent this turn.
cards.flavorText: The Working Families Party endorsed you, but the Conservative Party endorsed your opponent. It's confusing.
cards.learningGoal: Ballot Manipulation: (Third-party line, Fusion voting, Cross-endorsement).

cards.name: Calling in the National Guard
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from moderates, lose 2 from progressives.
cards.flavorText: I am deploying soldiers to check bags at Grand Central to make commuters feel 'safe.'
cards.learningGoal: Security Theater: (Militarization, Visible deterrent, Bag checks).

cards.name: The U.N. General Assembly
cards.effect: Both players cannot play cards costing more than 3.
cards.flavorText: The President is in town, so the East Side is entirely locked down by the Secret Service.
cards.learningGoal: Diplomatic Gridlock: (Motorcade, Barricade, Global summit).

cards.name: Charter School Battle
cards.flavorText: Are we funding the public schools or letting hedge funds run the charters? Fight!
cards.learningGoal: Educational Divides: (Vouchers, Public funding, Accountability).

cards.name: Empire State Building Lighting
cards.flavorText: We lit the building blue and orange. That counts as solving the problem, right?
cards.learningGoal: Symbolic Gestures: (Illuminated, Solidarity, Raising awareness).

cards.name: The Upstate Casino License
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but risk a scandal later.
cards.flavorText: We are revitalizing this dying factory town with a massive, windowless slot machine hall!
cards.learningGoal: Desperate Economics: (Revitalization, Revenue stream, Vice taxes).

cards.name: Tammany Hall Tactics
cards.effect: Look at opponent's hand and discard 1 card.
cards.flavorText: We count the votes, not the voters. Welcome to the old school.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Corruption: (Patronage, Ward boss, Rigging the system).

cards.name: Empire State of Mind
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: If you can make it here, you can make it anywhere. And I am making it!
cards.learningGoal: Unstoppable Ambition: (Unmatched resilience, Center of the universe).

cards.name: The Corner Slice
cards.flavorText: Folding a greasy slice of pizza on the street shows you haven't lost touch.
cards.learningGoal: Everyday Authenticity: (Fold the slice, Working class lunch, Staying grounded).

cards.name: Scaffolding Sidewalks
cards.flavorText: This construction scaffolding has been here since 2012. It acts as a perfect shield.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Blight: (Sidewalk shed, Code compliance, Eyesore).

cards.name: The High Line Walk
cards.flavorText: Taking a leisurely stroll above the traffic while discussing rezoning the West Side.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Planning: (Repurposed, Adaptive reuse, Gentrification engine).

cards.name: Yankees vs. Mets
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads, you gain 3 Support. Tails, you lose 2 Support.
cards.flavorText: You put on the wrong baseball hat in the wrong borough. The booing is deafening.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Tribalism: (Faux pas, Hometown loyalty, Die-hard fans).

cards.name: The Machine Alderman
cards.effect: Start with +3 Capital. Patronage cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: We don't want nobody nobody sent.
cards.learningGoal: Double Negatives: Understanding deliberate vernacular (Nobody sent, Ain't got nothing).

cards.name: The Indicted Governor
cards.effect: Immune to minor scandals, but vulnerable to The Feds.
cards.flavorText: I've got this Senate seat, and it's golden. I'm not just giving it up for nothing.
cards.learningGoal: Value Assessment: (Golden opportunity, Leverage, Quid pro quo).

cards.name: Lakefront Liberal
cards.flavorText: I completely support public housing, just as long as it doesn't block my view of Lake Michigan.
cards.learningGoal: Conditional Support: (As long as, With the caveat, Provided that).

cards.name: Downstate Secessionist
cards.flavorText: Chicago isn't Illinois! We want to split the state at I-80!
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resentment: (Alienated, Disconnected, The rest of the state).

cards.name: CTU Organizer
cards.flavorText: We will shut down the schools, the streets, and the city to get a fair contract.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Demands: (Fair contract, Picket line, Solidarity, Walkout).

cards.name: Collar County Moderate
cards.flavorText: I just want the Metra trains to run on time and my property taxes to stop doubling.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Priorities: (Commuter rail, Property values, Middle class).

cards.name: The Connected Contractor
cards.flavorText: I know a guy who knows a guy. We'll get the permit approved by Tuesday.
cards.learningGoal: Networking Jargon: (Connected, Grease the wheels, Expedite).

cards.name: The Legacy Candidate
cards.flavorText: My father was the Mayor, my grandfather was the Mayor. It's just my turn.
cards.learningGoal: Dynastic Phrasing: (Lineage, Inherited, Passing the torch, It's my turn).

cards.name: Selling the Senate Seat
cards.flavorText: You want the appointment? You have to raise a million dollars for my campaign.
cards.learningGoal: Extortion Rhetoric: (Pay to play, Appointment, Campaign contribution).

cards.name: Winter Parking Dibs
cards.flavorText: I dug this spot out for two hours. Move this lawn chair and you're dead.
cards.learningGoal: Territorial Claims: (Claiming a spot, Shoveled out, Unwritten rules).

cards.name: Pothole Season
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Capital to tire repairs.
cards.flavorText: There are only two seasons in Chicago: Winter and Construction.
cards.learningGoal: Cynical Resignation: Expressing inevitable annoyance (Blown tire, Suspension damage).

cards.name: Ketchup on a Hot Dog
cards.flavorText: You put ketchup on a dragged-through-the-garden dog? Get out of this city.
cards.learningGoal: Food Purism: (Sacrilege, Dragged through the garden, Authentic).

cards.name: A Shot of Malört
cards.effect: Opponent is stunned and discards 1 card.
cards.flavorText: It tastes like a pencil eraser and regret, but you have to drink it to prove you're from here.
cards.learningGoal: Sensory Descriptions: Using vivid, negative taste comparisons (Bitter, Regret, Astringent).

cards.name: CTA Red Line Delay
cards.flavorText: We are standing by due to unauthorized personnel on the tracks at Belmont.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Announcements: (Standing by, Unauthorized personnel, Medical emergency).

cards.name: St. Patrick's Day River Dye
cards.flavorText: We turned the river neon green! Ignore the environmental implications and drink up!
cards.learningGoal: Festive Deflection: (Tradition, Spectacle, Turning a blind eye).

cards.name: The Polar Vortex
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: It is negative 40 degrees with the wind chill. The lake is frozen solid.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Cold Vocabulary: (Wind chill, Frostbite, Sub-zero, Polar vortex).

cards.name: Subpoena Delivery
cards.flavorText: The FBI raided your ward office and took out 15 cardboard boxes of 'records.'
cards.learningGoal: Law Enforcement Phrasing: (Subpoena, Raid, Seized documents, Under investigation).

cards.name: The Chicago Outfit
cards.effect: Provides +2 Capital per turn, but costs 1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We don't use those words anymore. We are a legitimate sanitation enterprise.
cards.learningGoal: Mafia Euphemisms: (Legitimate business, Waste management, Omerta).

cards.name: Public Sector Unions
cards.flavorText: If you try to touch our pension guarantees, we will vote you into oblivion.
cards.learningGoal: Union Threats: (Pension guarantees, Collective bargaining, Unconstitutional).

cards.name: North Shore Billionaires
cards.flavorText: We will fund your Super PAC, provided you repeal the estate tax immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Elite Conditions: (Super PAC, Estate tax, Wealth preservation).

cards.name: The Soybean Lobby
cards.flavorText: We feed the world. Stop taxing our diesel fuel and let us farm.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Demands: (Commodities, Subsidies, Diesel tax).

cards.name: Property Tax Assessors
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: We arbitrarily decided your house is now worth $2 million. Pay up.
cards.learningGoal: Arbitrary Taxation: (Reassessment, Appeal process, Levy, Burden).

cards.name: Snowplow Drivers
cards.flavorText: The Department of Streets and Sanitation is the only thing keeping this city functioning.
cards.learningGoal: Essential Services: (Plowing the grid, Salting the roads, Overtime).

cards.name: Cubs Fans vs Sox Fans
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: You wore a South Side jersey on the North Side. The crowd is getting hostile.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Tribalism: (North Sider, South Sider, Bleacher bums).

cards.name: Gerrymandered Map
cards.flavorText: My district looks like a pair of earmuffs connected by a single highway.
cards.learningGoal: Spatial Manipulation: (Redistricting, Earmuff district, Incumbent protection).

cards.name: Patronage Job
cards.flavorText: My nephew needs a job. Make him the Deputy Director of Water Management.
cards.learningGoal: Nepotism Vocabulary: (Patronage, No-show job, Favoritism).

cards.name: TIF District Fund
cards.flavorText: Tax Increment Financing was meant for blighted areas, but we're building a luxury hotel.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Misdirection: (Blighted, Slush fund, Diverted taxes).

cards.name: Unfunded Pension Liability
cards.flavorText: The state owes $140 billion it doesn't have. The math is literally impossible.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Crisis: (Unfunded liability, Insolvency, Kicking the can).

cards.name: Dead People Voting
cards.flavorText: My grandfather hasn't missed an election since he passed away in 1982.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Fraud Jokes: (Voter roll, The graveyard vote, Chicago tradition).

cards.name: The Feds are Listening
cards.flavorText: Assume every phone call is being recorded by the Department of Justice.
cards.learningGoal: Paranoia Phrasing: (Bugged, Wiretap, Wearing a wire, Indictment).

cards.name: Parking Meter Privatization
cards.effect: Gain +5 Capital now, lose 1 Capital every turn forever.
cards.flavorText: We leased the streets to a foreign wealth fund until the year 2083. Oops.
cards.learningGoal: Short-term Thinking: (Lump sum, Privatization, Selling the future).

cards.name: Fleeing to Indiana
cards.flavorText: The taxes are too high, so I'm moving my factory to Gary, Indiana.
cards.learningGoal: Tax Flight: (Business climate, Relocating, Crossing state lines).

cards.name: State Fair Butter Cow
cards.flavorText: Look at this magnificent bovine sculpted entirely from 500 pounds of unsalted butter!
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Spectacle: (Sculpted, Magnificence, Unsalted).

cards.name: Property Tax Hike
cards.flavorText: Your property taxes are now higher than your mortgage. Have a nice day!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Pain: (Reassessment, Tax burden, Out-priced).

cards.name: Lame Duck Session
cards.flavorText: It's 2 AM on the last day of the session. Pass the 800-page bill before anyone reads it!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Chaos: (Midnight hour, Rammed through, Lame duck).

cards.name: The 'Chicago Way'
cards.effect: Your cards cannot be blocked for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: They pull a knife, you pull a gun. He sends one of yours to the hospital, you send one of his to the morgue.
cards.learningGoal: Cinematic Intimidation: Using iconic movie quotes as political strategy.

cards.name: Deep Dish Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Let's discuss this over a 3-pound pizza that takes 45 minutes to bake.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Patience: (Deep dish, Thick crust, Settle in).

cards.name: Tollway Expansion
cards.flavorText: We added a lane to the Jane Addams Tollway. It will be under construction until 2040.
cards.learningGoal: Perpetual Construction: (Lane expansion, Orange barrels, Tollway authority).

cards.name: The Bears Threaten to Leave
cards.flavorText: Build us a multi-billion dollar domed stadium, or we are moving to Arlington Heights!
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Extortion: (Leverage, Subsidy, Threatening to walk).

cards.name: Firing the Police Superintendent
cards.flavorText: Crime is up, so I am firing the top cop. It definitely wasn't my fault.
cards.learningGoal: Scapegoating: (Taking the fall, Reassignment, Change in leadership).

cards.name: The Federal Indictment
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The U.S. Attorney has unsealed a 42-count racketeering indictment. You're done.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Devastation: (Unsealed indictment, Racketeering, Bribery, Wire fraud).

cards.name: Pardon from the President
cards.flavorText: My sentence was commuted! I'm out of prison and starting a podcast!
cards.learningGoal: Redemption/Shamelessness: (Commuted, Pardoned, Second act).

cards.name: The Veto Override
cards.flavorText: The Governor vetoed it, but we have the votes to completely ignore him.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Dominance: (Supermajority, Override, Checks and balances).

cards.name: The City That Works
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Despite the corruption, the snow, and the taxes, this is still the greatest city in the world.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Pride: (Resilience, The City That Works, Broad shoulders).

cards.name: Aldermanic Prerogative
cards.flavorText: You can't build that apartment complex without my personal, unwritten approval.
cards.learningGoal: Unwritten Rules: (Prerogative, Veto power, Unilateral control).

cards.name: Giordano's vs Lou Malnati's
cards.flavorText: I publicly declared my favorite deep dish place. The other half of the city hates me now.
cards.learningGoal: Divisive Preferences: (Fierce loyalty, Culinary divide, Staking a claim).

cards.name: The Bean Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Taking a distorted selfie in front of a giant shiny bean to boost tourism.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Trap Phrasing: (Landmark, Reflective surface, Iconic).

cards.name: O'Hare Air Traffic
cards.flavorText: A slight drizzle has caused a 4-hour ground stop at O'Hare. Nobody is flying anywhere.
cards.learningGoal: Aviation Delays: (Ground stop, Air traffic control, Missed connection).

cards.name: The Secret Ward Meeting
cards.flavorText: The real decisions aren't made in City Hall. They're made in a cigar smoke-filled basement.
cards.learningGoal: Opaque Governance: (Smoke-filled room, Real power, Out of the public eye).

cards.name: Pension Holiday
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital now, lose 2 Capital per turn later.
cards.flavorText: We'll just skip our pension payment this year to balance the budget. Future generations will figure it out!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Irresponsibility: (Kicking the can, Balancing the books, Deferring payments).

cards.name: The Philly Ward Boss
cards.effect: Start with +3 Capital. Faction cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: I control the ballots in this ward. You want votes? You talk to me.
cards.learningGoal: Assertive Authority: (Control the ballot, Talk to me, Ward system).

cards.name: The Yinzer Union Rep
cards.flavorText: Yinz better support this strike, or we're shutting dahn the mills.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Dialect: Phonetic spelling of local accents (Yinz, Dahn, N'at).

cards.name: The Delco Centrist
cards.flavorText: I drive a minivan in Delaware County. My mood literally decides the Presidency.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Pragmatism: (Swing voter, Moderation, Bellwether).

cards.name: The Pennsyltucky Populist
cards.flavorText: Between Philly and Pittsburgh is the real Pennsylvania. And we are heavily armed.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Alienation: (Real America, Left behind, Heartland).

cards.name: The Ivy League Parachute
cards.flavorText: I just moved to Rittenhouse Square to save the working class with my MBA.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Savior Complex: (Ivy League, Top-down solutions, Think tank).

cards.name: Natural Gas Tycoon
cards.flavorText: Fracking is the lifeblood of this state! Just don't light your tap water on fire.
cards.learningGoal: Energy Jargon: (Fracking, Lifeblood, Extraction, Economic driver).

cards.name: The Rust Belt Mayor
cards.flavorText: Our steel days are over, but we are pivoting to tech! Please ignore the abandoned factories.
cards.learningGoal: Transitional Phrasing: (Pivoting, Revitalization, Economic transition).

cards.name: The Building Trades
cards.flavorText: We pour the concrete and rig the steel. Back us, or your project stalls.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Solidarity: (Prevailing wage, Picket line, Scabs).

cards.name: Wawa Loyalists
cards.flavorText: If you order a coffee at Dunkin' instead of Wawa, you're dead to us in Philly.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Devotion: Expressing rigid, unforgiving consumer loyalty.

cards.name: Sheetz Fanatics
cards.flavorText: Fried mac and cheese bites at 3 AM. It's a Western PA political necessity.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Regionalism: (Made to order, Midnight run).

cards.name: Broad Street Bullies
cards.effect: Opponent loses 1 Capital per turn from intimidation.
cards.flavorText: They greased the light poles, but we still climbed them. We fear no politician.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Hooliganism: (Greased poles, Riot, Intimidation).

cards.name: State College Tailgaters
cards.flavorText: 100,000 people in white t-shirts screaming. Tap into that energy.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Fervor: (Whiteout, Alma mater, Stadium atmosphere).

cards.name: Fracking Lobby
cards.flavorText: We brought jobs to the T. Don't regulate us out of existence.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Defense: (Regulation, Job creators, Overreach).

cards.name: Main Line Donors
cards.flavorText: We host the fundraisers with the good shrimp cocktail. Listen to our zoning complaints.
cards.learningGoal: Wealthy Grievances: (Zoning, Tax bracket, Exclusive).

cards.name: Swing State Ad Blitz
cards.effect: Clears the board of all Factions.
cards.flavorText: You cannot watch a YouTube video without seeing an attack ad. The public is exhausted.
cards.learningGoal: Media Saturation: (Attack ad, Airwaves, Exhausted electorate).

cards.name: The Cheesesteak Gaffe
cards.flavorText: You ordered a cheesesteak with Swiss cheese and lettuce on camera. Go back to California.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Authenticity, Faux pas, Whiz Wit).

cards.name: Fries on the Salad
cards.flavorText: Yes, I want french fries and coleslaw stuffed directly into my sandwich. I'm a man of the people.
cards.learningGoal: Working Class Pandering: (Hearty, No-nonsense, Blue-collar meal).

cards.name: Turnpike Toll Hike
cards.flavorText: It now costs $60 to drive across the state. Where does the money go? Nobody knows.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Frustration: (Toll hike, Black hole, Revenue stream).

cards.name: Pothole on I-76
cards.flavorText: You hit a crater on the Sure-Kill Expressway. Your axle is broken and you missed the debate.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Crater, Gridlock, Bumper-to-bumper).

cards.name: PPA Towing
cards.flavorText: You parked 14 feet from a stop sign. The PPA took your campaign bus.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Ruthlessness: (Impounded, Violation, Relentless).

cards.name: State Store Monopoly
cards.flavorText: Liquor from the state, wine from a grocery store, beer from a distributor. Makes total sense.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Regulations: (Monopoly, Bureaucracy, Loophole).

cards.name: Groundhog Day Prediction
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: A giant rodent saw its shadow, so my infrastructure bill is delayed six weeks.
cards.learningGoal: Superstitious Governance: (Prognostication, Winter shadow, Absurdity).

cards.name: Pronouncing Lancaster Wrong
cards.flavorText: It's LANK-is-ter, not Lan-CAST-er. You just alienated the entire Amish country.
cards.learningGoal: Shibboleths: Using pronunciation as an insider/outsider test.

cards.name: Scrapple Breakfast
cards.flavorText: I love eating every leftover part of the pig formed into a gray block! Vote for me!
cards.learningGoal: Performative Bravery: (Acquired taste, Authenticity test, Regional delicacy).

cards.name: Bridge Collapse
cards.flavorText: A 50-year-old bridge just fell into a ravine. Maybe we should pass that funding bill.
cards.learningGoal: Deferred Maintenance: (Crumbling, Deficient, Catastrophic failure).

cards.name: The Blue Route Jam
cards.flavorText: Traffic is stopped dead on the Blue Route. You're never making it to the Montco fundraiser.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Commute: (Bottleneck, Rush hour, Standstill).

cards.name: Hershey Park Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Taking photos with a giant anthropomorphic chocolate bar shows I care about family values.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Mascot Synergy: (Family friendly, Sweeten the deal, Amusement).

cards.name: 'Wooder' Ice Stand
cards.flavorText: Handing out cherry water ice in August is peak grassroots campaigning.
cards.learningGoal: Phonetic Spelling: Emphasizing accents in text (Wooder vs. Water).

cards.name: Fracking Ban Proposed
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support in cities, lose 4 in rural areas.
cards.flavorText: We must protect the water table! (And ignore the thousands of lost jobs).
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Trade-offs: (Water table, Job killer, Green energy).

cards.name: Mail-in Ballot Lawsuit
cards.effect: The game does not end at 50 points; play 1 more turn.
cards.flavorText: We need to count the naked ballots! See you in the Commonwealth Court.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Litigation: (Naked ballots, Canvassing, Postmark).

cards.name: Gritty's Endorsement
cards.effect: Opponent discards 2 cards in pure terror.
cards.flavorText: An orange, googly-eyed chaotic entity has endorsed your campaign. The streets rejoice.
cards.learningGoal: Meme Politics: (Chaotic good, Unhinged, Viral mascot).

cards.name: Liberty Bell Metaphor
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support now, lose it later.
cards.flavorText: Our state is like the Liberty Bell: enduring, loud, and fundamentally cracked.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Clichés: (Cradle of liberty, Enduring, Flawed).

cards.name: Deer Hunting Season
cards.flavorText: It's the Monday after Thanksgiving. Half the state is in the woods wearing orange.
cards.learningGoal: Sporting Traditions: (Buck season, Treestand, Out of office).

cards.name: Coal Mine Revival Promise
cards.flavorText: I promise to bring back the coal jobs! (I absolutely will not bring back the coal jobs).
cards.learningGoal: False Nostalgia: (Anthracite, Heritage, Dying industry).

cards.name: The Soda Tax
cards.flavorText: We are taxing your sugary drinks to pay for pre-K. Enjoy your $4 Diet Coke.
cards.learningGoal: Sin Taxes: (Regressive tax, Nanny state, Revenue generation).

cards.name: Centralia Mine Fire
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: An underground coal fire burning since 1962. It's a metaphor for our pension system.
cards.learningGoal: Endless Disasters: (Underground fire, Toxic fumes, Unsolvable).

cards.name: The Commonwealth Court
cards.flavorText: We appealed it to the state supreme court. It's tied up in litigation for a decade.
cards.learningGoal: Judicial Stalling: (Injunction, Commonwealth, Appellate).

cards.name: Mummers Parade
cards.effect: Swap your hand with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Thousands of people in feathers and sequins playing string bands. Pure political confusion.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Confusion: (String band, Revelry, Eccentric tradition).

cards.name: Amish Buggy Traffic
cards.flavorText: You're stuck behind a horse and buggy going 8 mph. Learn some patience.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Obstacles: (Patience, Anachronism, Slow lane).

cards.name: Tailgating the Steelers
cards.flavorText: Handing out terrible towels and drinking Iron City beer in the parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Fandom Pandering: (Terrible towel, Black and gold, Tailgate).

cards.name: Reading Terminal Market
cards.flavorText: Navigating the crowds to buy an Amish pretzel shows you have grit.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Hustle: (Bustling, Melting pot, Culinary diversity).

cards.name: Independent Legislature Map
cards.flavorText: We brought in an independent commission. The maps actually look like squares now!
cards.learningGoal: Anti-Corruption Phrasing: (Independent commission, Fair districts, Compact).

cards.name: Closing the State Hospitals
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support from rural voters.
cards.flavorText: You closed the only maternity ward within 50 miles. Have fun defending that.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Healthcare Crisis: (Consolidation, Access to care, Healthcare desert).

cards.name: Gettysburg Analogy
cards.flavorText: We are engaged in a great political civil war, testing whether this campaign can long endure.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Plagiarism: (Four score, Hallowed ground, Endure).

cards.name: The Suburb Shift
cards.flavorText: The Philadelphia suburbs flipped again. Your entire electoral strategy is ruined.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Destiny: (Flipping the suburbs, Bellwether, Realignment).

cards.name: Sinkhole in Center City
cards.flavorText: A water main broke and swallowed a Prius on Walnut Street.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Decay: (Sinkhole, Water main break, Infrastructure failure).

cards.name: The Turnpike Commission
cards.flavorText: We found an extra billion dollars in toll revenue. We're spending it on state police.
cards.learningGoal: Misappropriation: (Slush fund, Auditing, Reallocation).

cards.name: Campaigning at a Diner
cards.flavorText: Sitting in a vinyl booth drinking black coffee to show you understand inflation.
cards.learningGoal: Everyman Optics: (Diner tour, Heartland, Pocketbook issues).

cards.name: Keystone State Advantage
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the tipping point state. Whoever wins here wins the whole election.
cards.learningGoal: Decisive Rhetoric: (Keystone, Tipping point, Margin of victory).

cards.name: 'Jawn'
cards.flavorText: I'm going to veto that jawn before it even hits my desk.
cards.learningGoal: Slang Versatility: (Contextual slang, Placeholder noun, Local flavor).

cards.name: The Columbus Bureaucrat
cards.flavorText: We don't do flash here. We do committees, subcommittees, and forms in triplicate.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Jargon: (Subcommittee, Triplicate, Procedural norm).

cards.name: The Cleveland Union Boss
cards.flavorText: This city was built on steel and sweat. Do not cross a picket line in Cuyahoga County.
cards.learningGoal: Resilient Rhetoric: (Forged, Built on sweat, Holding the line).

cards.name: The Cincinnati Traditionalist
cards.flavorText: We look across the river to Kentucky and keep our traditions firmly intact.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Identity: (Border city, Traditionalist, Deep roots).

cards.name: The Appalachian Populist
cards.flavorText: Columbus forgot about us a long time ago. We rely on coal, timber, and each other.
cards.learningGoal: Alienation Vocabulary: (Left behind, Forgotten, Self-reliant).

cards.name: The Astronaut Alumnus
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support when playing Tech cards.
cards.flavorText: Why do so many astronauts come from Ohio? Because we really want to leave the planet.
cards.learningGoal: Deadpan Humor: Using rhetorical questions for comedic self-deprecation.

cards.name: The Football Coach
cards.flavorText: Football isn't life or death in this state. It's much more important than that.
cards.learningGoal: Hyperbolic Devotion: (Life or death, Gridiron, Unrivaled passion).

cards.name: Skyline Chili Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Eating a mountain of shredded cheese over chili-covered spaghetti proves I am a true Ohioan.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Specificity: (Cincinnati-style, 3-Way, Oyster crackers).

cards.name: The Ohio State Tailgate
cards.flavorText: 100,000 screaming fans wearing scarlet and gray. You simply cannot buy this kind of base.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Fervor: (Scarlet and gray, The Horseshoe, Fanaticism).

cards.name: O-H-I-O Chant
cards.flavorText: If you yell 'O-H' in a crowded room and nobody yells 'I-O' back, you are in the wrong state.
cards.learningGoal: Call and Response: Understanding interactive cultural shibboleths.

cards.name: Lake Erie Algae Bloom
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the North.
cards.flavorText: The lake looks like toxic pea soup again. Cancel the fishing tournament.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Crisis: (Algae bloom, Toxic runoff, Ecosystem).

cards.name: Snow Belt Blizzard
cards.flavorText: Cleveland got three feet of snow overnight. The turnpike is a parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Exaggeration: (Whiteout, Lake effect, Parking lot).

cards.name: The Intel Mega-Factory
cards.flavorText: We gave them a billion dollars in tax breaks to make microchips. Hopefully, it works out.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Welfare Phrasing: (Tax abatement, Mega-site, Silicon Heartland).

cards.name: Gerrymandered Map
cards.flavorText: My congressional district is a two-block-wide strip that stretches for 100 miles along the water.
cards.learningGoal: Spatial Manipulation: (Cracking and packing, Gerrymander, District lines).

cards.name: The State Fair Cornhole Tournament
cards.flavorText: I am settling this budget dispute by throwing beanbags into a wooden board.
cards.learningGoal: Folksy Conflict Resolution: (Cornhole, Beanbag toss, Settling the score).

cards.name: Cedar Point Rollercoaster
cards.effect: Both players discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: This campaign has more sudden drops and loops than the Millennium Force.
cards.learningGoal: Metaphorical Comparisons: Using rollercoasters to describe volatility.

cards.name: Auto Plant Closure
cards.flavorText: The assembly line is moving to Mexico. Your promises to the working class just vanished.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Despair: (Offshoring, Assembly line, Severance).

cards.name: Wright Brothers Dispute
cards.flavorText: North Carolina might have the beaches, but the airplane was invented in a Dayton bicycle shop!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defensiveness: (Birthplace of aviation, Claiming history, Disputed legacy).

cards.name: The Turnpike Toll
cards.flavorText: The best way to fund the state is to charge people driving from Pennsylvania to Indiana.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Taxation: (Toll plaza, Pass-through state, Revenue generation).

cards.name: Midwestern Ope!
cards.flavorText: Ope! Let me just sneak right past your attack ad and pass my own legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Vernacular Apologies: (Ope, Sneak right past ya, Midwestern nice).

cards.name: The Bellwether Shift
cards.flavorText: We used to pick the President every time. Now we just reliably vote for whoever is loudest.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Trend Vocabulary: (Bellwether, Shifting demographics, Reliable).

cards.name: Issue 1 Ballot Measure
cards.flavorText: We are bypassing the legislature and putting this directly into the state constitution!
cards.learningGoal: Direct Democracy: (Ballot initiative, Constitutional amendment, Bypassing).

cards.name: Toledo Water Crisis
cards.flavorText: Do not drink the tap water. Do not boil the tap water. Just buy bottled water.
cards.learningGoal: Public Utility Failure: (Boil advisory, Contamination, Unsafe to consume).

cards.name: The Rust Belt Diner
cards.flavorText: Drinking terrible black coffee at 6 AM in Youngstown to prove I understand inflation.
cards.learningGoal: Working Class Aesthetics: (Salt of the earth, Blue collar, Pocketbook issues).

cards.name: First Energy Scandal
cards.flavorText: A $60 million bribery scheme to bail out nuclear power plants. The FBI would like a word.
cards.learningGoal: Corruption Terminology: (Bribery scheme, Bailout, Federal probe, Wire fraud).

cards.name: The Mega-Church Endorsement
