cards.flavorText: The pastor implicitly endorsed you on the jumbo-tron. The congregation is mobilized.
cards.learningGoal: Evangelical Organizing: (Congregation, Implicit endorsement, Flock).

cards.name: The Fraternal Order of Police
cards.effect: Blocks any Attack card costing 3 or less.
cards.flavorText: We have the badge, the union, and the endorsement. Don't mess with law enforcement.
cards.learningGoal: Law and Order Phrasing: (Thin blue line, Endorsement, Fraternal).

cards.name: The Agribusiness Lobby
cards.flavorText: As long as you subsidize the soybeans, we will fund your reelection campaign.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Subsidies: (Commodities, Yield, Subsidize).

cards.name: The Steelworkers Union
cards.flavorText: We built this country. If you cut our pensions, the mills shut down tomorrow.
cards.learningGoal: Union Defiance: (Pension guarantees, Collective bargaining, Solidarity).

cards.name: Suburban Sprawl
cards.flavorText: The ring of suburbs around Columbus decides every statewide election.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Geography: (Exurbs, Sprawl, Swing districts).

cards.name: The Opioid Crisis
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: This isn't a talking point. It's a tragedy ravaging the river towns and the cities alike.
cards.learningGoal: Public Health Emergency: (Epidemic, Ravaging, Addiction crisis).

cards.name: The Mayor of Flavor Town
cards.flavorText: He was born in Columbus! A frosted-tips endorsement means diner credibility!
cards.learningGoal: Pop Culture Association: Leveraging hometown celebrities for clout.

cards.name: The Statehouse Protest
cards.effect: Opponent must skip their next turn.
cards.flavorText: 10,000 teachers are screaming in the rotunda. You literally cannot hear yourself think.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Disobedience: (Rotunda, Chanting, Mass mobilization).

cards.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
cards.flavorText: Taking a photo next to Prince's guitar to show I am hip, cool, and relevant to the youth.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Relevance: (Tourist trap, Relevancy, Trying too hard).

cards.name: The Cuyahoga River Fire
cards.flavorText: Your campaign is a bigger disaster than the time our river literally caught on fire.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Self-Deprecation: Owning past civic embarrassments.

cards.name: Pothole on I-71
cards.flavorText: The freeze-thaw cycle has turned the interstate into an active minefield.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Freeze-thaw cycle, Minefield, Deterioration).

cards.name: The Amish Vote
cards.flavorText: They don't use electricity, but they showed up in buggies to vote you out.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Surprises: (Anachronistic, Bloc voting, Turnout).

cards.name: Pro Football Hall of Fame
cards.flavorText: I am delivering a speech about teamwork while standing next to a bronze bust of John Madden.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Metaphors: (Teamwork, Fundamentals, Hall of Fame effort).

cards.name: The Rust Belt Pivot
cards.flavorText: We are going to teach the unemployed steelworkers how to code! It will be fine!
cards.learningGoal: Economic Naivete: (Retraining, Tech economy, Displaced workers).

cards.name: Crossing the Ohio River
cards.flavorText: I'm just going to lay low in Newport, Kentucky until this scandal blows over.
cards.learningGoal: Jurisdictional Evasion: (Crossing state lines, Laying low, Blowing over).

cards.name: The State Fair Butter Sculpture
cards.flavorText: I am shaking hands in front of a cow carved entirely out of unsalted butter.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Spectacle: (Dairy tribute, Unsalted, Grand champion).

cards.name: The Purple State Myth
cards.effect: Opponent's Grassroots cards have no effect.
cards.flavorText: We aren't a swing state anymore. Read the room, and read the rural counties.
cards.learningGoal: Political Realignment: (Red shift, Swing state, Reading the room).

cards.name: The Manufacturing Resurgence
cards.flavorText: I'm wearing a hard hat and holding giant scissors to open a plant that employs 12 people.
cards.learningGoal: Optics over Substance: (Ribbon cutting, Hard hat tour, Photo op).

cards.name: The Big Ten Rivalry
cards.flavorText: You were caught wearing a Michigan Wolverines hat. You are legally banished from Ohio.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Sports Tribalism: (That State Up North, Rivalry, Banishment).

cards.name: The Columbus Developer
cards.flavorText: If you approve this mixed-use apartment complex, the campaign checks will clear tomorrow.
cards.learningGoal: Zoning Quid Pro Quo: (Mixed-use, Variances, Campaign checks).

cards.name: The Wind Turbine Debate
cards.effect: Spend 1 Capital, gain 3 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: We want green energy! But please don't ruin my view of the lake from Sandusky.
cards.learningGoal: NIMBY Environmentalism: (Viewshed, Green energy, Aesthetic impact).

cards.name: The Polar Vortex
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: It is negative 20 degrees. The entire state has shut down. Go eat some chili.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Cold: (Polar vortex, Deep freeze, Sub-zero).

cards.name: The Wright-Patterson Base
cards.flavorText: Secured a massive defense contract for Dayton. The aerospace lobby sends its regards.
cards.learningGoal: Defense Spending: (Procurement, Defense contract, Aerospace).

cards.name: The Abandoned Mall
cards.effect: Both players lose 1 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: Rolling Acres Mall is empty and overgrown. A stark reminder of the retail apocalypse.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Apocalypse: (Blight, Overgrown, Economic transition).

cards.name: The Heart of It All
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the heart of it all. We decide the future, and we never let anyone forget it.
cards.learningGoal: State Pride: (Heartland, Decisive, Unforgettable).

cards.name: Pop vs. Soda
cards.flavorText: If you call it 'soda' instead of 'pop', I know you aren't from around here.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Linguistics: Using colloquial nouns as a purity test.

cards.name: The ITP Elite
cards.effect: Tech and Culture cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: I don't cross I-285 unless I'm going to the airport. Atlanta is the only Georgia I know.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Bubble: (City limits, Intown, Out of touch, Gentrified).

cards.name: The OTP Suburbanite
cards.flavorText: I want great schools, low taxes, and a subdivision with a very aggressive HOA.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Priorities: (Master-planned, Cul-de-sac, Commuter, Sprawl).

cards.name: The Peanut Farmer
cards.flavorText: From Plains to Valdosta, we feed the state while Atlanta makes all the noise.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Pride: (Salt of the earth, Cash crop, Heartland).

cards.name: The Hollywood Lobbyist
cards.flavorText: We are filming three Marvel movies and a zombie show right now. Do not touch our tax credits.
cards.learningGoal: Industry Leverage: (Tax incentive, Production hub, Relocation threat).

cards.name: The Mega-Pastor
cards.flavorText: When I speak on Sunday, 15,000 voters listen. And they vote exactly how I pray.
cards.learningGoal: Spiritual Influence: (Congregation, Pulpit, Tithing, Mobilization).

cards.name: The Transplant
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital, but Rural cards cost 1 more.
cards.flavorText: The housing is so cheap here! Wait, why is it 98 degrees with 100% humidity in September?
cards.learningGoal: Culture Shock: (Cost of living, Acclimation, Carpetbagger).

cards.name: January Runoff Election
cards.effect: The game does not end at 50 points; play 2 more turns.
cards.flavorText: Nobody reached 50%. Prepare for two more months of relentless, agonizing TV commercials.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Exhaustion: (Runoff, Threshold, Saturation, Fatigue).

cards.name: Waffle House 3 AM
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a bipartisan infrastructure bill over a pecan waffle and scattered hashbrowns.
cards.learningGoal: Late-Night Diplomacy: (Scattered, Smothered, Covered, Grassroots).

cards.name: Snowpocalypse
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: It snowed an inch and a half. Cars are abandoned on the highway. Society has collapsed.
cards.learningGoal: Disaster Hyperbole: (Gridlock, Paralyzed, State of emergency, Unprecedented).

cards.name: Handing Out Water
cards.flavorText: You gave a bottle of water to a voter standing in a 6-hour line. See you in court.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Technicalities: (Voter suppression, Election integrity, Loophole).

cards.name: Spaghetti Junction
cards.flavorText: You missed your exit. You are now stuck on a five-level concrete labyrinth for three hours.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Chaos: (Gridlock, Interchange, Bottleneck).

cards.name: The Masters Tournament
cards.flavorText: The real budget negotiations happen on the 18th green over a $1.50 pimento cheese sandwich.
cards.learningGoal: Exclusive Access: (Green jacket, Patron, Behind closed doors).

cards.name: Delta Airlines Hub
cards.flavorText: If you pass this bill, we might just reconsider keeping our global headquarters in Atlanta.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Extortion: (Hub, Leverage, Economic engine, Headquarters).

cards.name: Chick-fil-A Drive-Thru
cards.flavorText: My campaign is run with the speed, politeness, and precision of a dual-lane drive-thru.
cards.learningGoal: Operational Excellence: (My pleasure, Expedite, Efficiency).

cards.name: Dawg Nation
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from everywhere except Atlanta.
cards.flavorText: I wore a red and black tie and barked at a grown man. The rural counties love me.
cards.learningGoal: Rabid Fandom: (Tailgate, Between the hedges, Calling the Dawgs).

cards.name: MARTA Expansion Denied
cards.flavorText: We will block the train line to keep 'those people' out of our pristine suburban county.
cards.learningGoal: Coded NIMBYism: (Public transit, Property values, Preserving character).

cards.name: The Varsity Order
cards.flavorText: Eating a chili cheese dog and a Frosted Orange while shouting your order at the counter.
cards.learningGoal: Iconic Local Establishments: (Fast-paced, Institution, Ordering lingo).

cards.name: Pine Pollen Tsunami
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: Everything is coated in yellow powder. Your opponent is too congested to debate.
cards.learningGoal: Allergen Vocabulary: (Pollen count, Antihistamine, Coating, Bloom).

cards.name: Buckhead Secession
cards.effect: Drain 3 Capital from a city opponent.
cards.flavorText: Crime is too high! We are taking our tax bracket and forming our own city!
cards.learningGoal: Wealth Flight: (Secession, Tax base, De-annexation, Autonomy).

cards.name: Sweet Tea Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Let's sit on the veranda, drink something that is 80% sugar, and make a deal.
cards.learningGoal: Southern Hospitality: (Veranda, Charm, Disarming).

cards.name: Banning Books in Cobb
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 3 from moderates.
cards.flavorText: We found a book that mentioned equality. It has been immediately removed from the library.
cards.learningGoal: Culture War Rhetoric: (Inappropriate, Parental rights, Indoctrination).

cards.name: The Gnat Line
cards.effect: Opponent's Northern cards have no effect here.
cards.flavorText: Once you cross south of Macon, the gnats swarm your face and the politics get much redder.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Markers: (Fall line, Swarm, Deep South).

cards.name: Out-of-State Money
cards.flavorText: We received $50 million from California and New York to tell Georgians how to vote.
cards.learningGoal: Campaign Finance: (Outside influence, Dark money, War chest).

cards.name: Door-Knocking in August
cards.flavorText: It is 102 degrees. Your canvassers have melted onto the pavement. Progress halts.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Weather Endurance: (Sweltering, Canvassing, Heat exhaustion).

cards.name: The BeltLine Stroll
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: We paved over a railroad track! Now there are $8 lattes and $3,000 apartments everywhere!
cards.learningGoal: Urban Redevelopment: (Gentrification, Mixed-use, Displacement, Walkability).

cards.name: Yellow Fly Season
cards.flavorText: Campaigning in Savannah? The yellow flies bite right through your seersucker suit.
cards.learningGoal: Pesky Interruptions: (Biting insects, Swatting, Coastal plains).

cards.name: Shooting the Hooch
cards.flavorText: Floating down a freezing, slightly questionable river in an inner tube to show I'm relatable.
cards.learningGoal: Leisure Slang: (Inner tube, Rapids, Murky water).

cards.name: Atlanta Hip-Hop Moguls
cards.effect: Tech and Culture cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: The city is run by the music industry. If the rappers endorse you, the youth turn out.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Capital: (Endorsement, Influence, The culture, Turnout).

cards.name: Savannah Port Authority
cards.flavorText: We are dredging the river to fit bigger cargo ships. The economy flows through us.
cards.learningGoal: Supply Chain Jargon: (Dredging, Container ship, Logistics, Tonnage).

cards.name: Suburban Soccer Moms
cards.effect: Provides +2 Support, but leaves if you play an Extreme card.
cards.flavorText: We flipped the state in 2020. Ignore our PTA meetings at your own peril.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Tipping Points: (Soccer mom, Demographic shift, Tipping point).

cards.name: The Agribusiness Giants
cards.flavorText: We raise the chickens and grow the timber. Don't regulate our runoff water.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Dominance: (Poultry capital, Timberland, Runoff, Yield).

cards.name: Midtown Tech Bros
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital per turn, but opponent gains +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We moved here for the fintech jobs, and we are completely pricing out the locals.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Economy: (Fintech, Startup hub, Cost of living, Displacement).

cards.name: Blue Ridge Mountaineers
cards.flavorText: Up in the mountains, we don't care what the Gold Dome says. Leave us alone.
cards.learningGoal: Appalachian Independence: (Isolationist, Scenic, High country).

cards.name: The Carpet Capital
cards.flavorText: We make 90% of the world's carpet. You will wear a hard hat and you will smile.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Manufacturing: (Monopoly, Industrial base, Mill town).

cards.name: Sunday Alcohol Sales
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from moderates, lose 1 from conservatives.
cards.flavorText: Yes, you can finally buy a six-pack before the 1 PM Falcons kickoff. You're welcome.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Regulations: (Blue laws, Prohibition-era, Repeal, Compromise).

cards.name: The Atlanta Way
cards.effect: Your cards cannot be blocked for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The city too busy to hate. We solve our civil rights issues in corporate boardrooms.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Branding: (The Atlanta Way, Pragmatism, Corporate integration).

cards.name: Film Boycott Threat
cards.flavorText: You passed a controversial bill. The movie studios are threatening to film in Canada instead.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Blackmail: (Boycott, Capital flight, Optics).

cards.name: Boiled Peanuts Stand
cards.flavorText: Buying a soggy, salty bag of legumes from a guy in a pickup truck off Highway 441.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Cuisine: (Roadside stand, Acquired taste, Salty).

cards.name: The Gold Dome
cards.flavorText: We passed this legislation at 11:59 PM on Sine Die. Nobody knows what's in it.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Chaos: (Sine Die, Midnight hour, The Gold Dome, Rammed through).

cards.name: Braves Stadium Relocation
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, lose 2 Support from Atlanta.
cards.flavorText: We secretly moved the stadium to the suburbs and made the taxpayers buy the traffic lights!
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Subsidies: (Relocation, Taxpayer funded, Mixed-use development).

cards.name: The Swing State Pivot
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We aren't a red state anymore. We are the center of the political universe. Act like it.
cards.learningGoal: Political Realignment: (Swing state, Purple shift, Ground zero, Decisive).

cards.name: Sweet Auburn Stroll
cards.flavorText: Walking down MLK Jr. Drive to connect with the historic soul of the city.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Reverence: (Heritage, Civil rights movement, Legacy).

cards.name: Poll Closing Shenanigans
cards.flavorText: We moved the polling location to a police station 10 miles away and didn't tell anyone.
cards.learningGoal: Voter Suppression Tropes: (Disenfranchisement, Polling location, Confusion).

cards.name: The CDC Advisory
cards.flavorText: The Centers for Disease Control is literally down the street. Maybe listen to them?
cards.learningGoal: Scientific Authority: (Advisory, Mandate, Proximity, Public health).

cards.name: I-85 Bridge Collapse
cards.flavorText: Someone literally set a bridge on fire and it collapsed. Commuting is permanently canceled.
cards.learningGoal: Bizarre Disasters: (Combustible, Structural failure, State of emergency).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Oh, you think your little tax plan is going to work? Well, bless your heart.
cards.learningGoal: Passive-Aggressive Slang: Using extreme politeness to deliver a devastating insult.

cards.name: The Charlotte Banker
cards.flavorText: I don't care who wins the election, as long as the corporate tax rate stays at 2.5%.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Pragmatism: (Corporate rate, Bottom line, Neutrality).

cards.name: The Triangle Techie
cards.flavorText: I just moved to Cary from San Jose. Can we get some protected bike lanes around the software park?
cards.learningGoal: Urbanist Vocabulary: (Protected lanes, Tech hub, Relocation).

cards.name: The Appalachian Populist
cards.flavorText: Up in Asheville and Boone, we don't trust Raleigh, and we certainly don't trust Charlotte.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Suspicion: (Suspicion, Distrust of capital, Mountain autonomy).

cards.name: The Down East Farmer
cards.effect: Immune to attacks from city-based Factions.
cards.flavorText: We grow the tobacco, the sweet potatoes, and the hogs. Show some respect.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Heritage: (Cash crop, Down East, Agrarian).

cards.name: The Tobacco Road Alum
cards.flavorText: As a UNC graduate, I feel it is my civic duty to remind you that I am a UNC graduate.
cards.learningGoal: Pretentious Phrasing: (Civic duty, Alma mater, Humblebrag).

cards.name: C.A.R.Y. Transplant
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support, but lose 1 from locals.
cards.flavorText: Half of New Jersey just moved into a master-planned subdivision off I-40.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Shifts: (Relocated, Subdivision, Containment area).

cards.name: The Halfbacks
cards.flavorText: Retirees who moved to Florida, hated the heat, and moved halfway back to the NC mountains.
cards.learningGoal: Migration Slang: Using portmanteaus and regional nicknames (Halfbacks).

cards.name: Research Triangle Park
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from rural areas.
cards.flavorText: We put three universities together and built a massive forest full of pharmaceutical companies.
cards.learningGoal: Innovation Jargon: (Biotech, Synergistic hub, Research and development).

cards.name: Eastern BBQ Pandering
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support in the East, lose 1 in the West.
cards.flavorText: Whole hog, vinegar, and pepper. Anything with tomatoes in it is a culinary crime.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Purism: (Vinegar-based, Whole hog, Authenticity).

cards.name: Western BBQ Pandering
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support in the West, lose 1 in the East.
cards.flavorText: Pork shoulder with a sweet tomato-vinegar dip. This is the only true North Carolina barbecue.
cards.learningGoal: Fierce Tribalism: Expressing absolute, uncompromising dietary opinions.

cards.name: The Gerrymandered Map
cards.flavorText: This congressional district looks like a sprawling octopus trying to avoid a college campus.
cards.learningGoal: Redistricting Terminology: (Packing, Cracking, Partisan advantage, Octopus).

cards.name: HB2 Boycott Fallout
cards.flavorText: You passed a controversial social bill, so the NBA, PayPal, and Bruce Springsteen are boycotting the state.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Retaliation: (Boycott, Divestment, Corporate backlash).

cards.name: Hurricane Evacuation
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: I-40 East is completely shut down. The Outer Banks are officially closed. Stay safe.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Protocols: (Evacuation route, Storm surge, Landfall).

cards.name: Snow Panic
cards.flavorText: There is half an inch of snow on the ground. The schools are closed and the grocery stores are out of milk.
cards.learningGoal: Hyperbolic Panic: (Bread and milk, Paralyzed, State of emergency).

cards.name: Duke vs. UNC Game
cards.effect: Both players must discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: The entire state has stopped functioning for two hours. Do not attempt to pass legislation right now.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Paralysis: (Rivalry, Brought to a standstill, Bracketology).

cards.name: Cook Out Tray Run
cards.flavorText: A corn dog as a side for a quesadilla? Only at 2 AM after a contentious budget debate.
cards.learningGoal: Fast Food Euphoria: (Combo tray, Late night run, Caloric surplus).

cards.name: The Cheerwine Sugar Rush
cards.flavorText: Chugging a highly carbonated, cherry-flavored local soda to power through a filibuster.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Loyalty: (Regional soda, Sugar rush, Power through).

cards.name: First in Flight Feud
cards.flavorText: We don't care where the Wright Brothers were born. They flew it in Kitty Hawk! It's on our license plate!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Claiming: (First in flight, Origin dispute, Birthplace).

cards.name: Hog Farm Nuisance Lawsuit
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the East.
cards.flavorText: Your neighbor is a massive commercial swine operation. The smell is… substantial.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Nuisance: (Swine operation, Odor mitigation, Commercial farming).

cards.name: The Swine Waste Lagoon
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: A hurricane just flooded the hog lagoons into the river. Nobody wants to talk about it.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Disaster: (Lagoon, Runoff, Contamination, Toxic).

cards.name: Pollen Tsunami
cards.flavorText: A dense, yellow cloud of pine pollen has coated the entire state. We are all sneezing.
cards.learningGoal: Allergenic Despair: (Pollen count, Coated, Airborne).

cards.name: The Blue Ridge Parkway
cards.flavorText: The leaves are changing in October, which means traffic is moving at 12 miles per hour.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Frustration: (Leaf peepers, Bumper-to-bumper, Overlook).

cards.name: The Furniture Market
cards.flavorText: 80,000 interior designers just descended on High Point. You cannot book a hotel for 100 miles.
cards.learningGoal: Industry Conferences: (Showroom, Logistics nightmare, Capacity).

cards.name: Craft Brewery Boom
cards.flavorText: We have 40 different IPAs on tap, and our campaign office is in a repurposed warehouse.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Aesthetics: (Repurposed, Artisanal, Microbrewery).

cards.name: The Banking Lobby
cards.flavorText: We built a glittering skyline of skyscrapers. Please ignore the lack of affordable housing below them.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Dominance: (Skyline, Financial center, Disconnect).

cards.name: Military Base Voters
cards.flavorText: You do not win this state without supporting the massive military installations on the coast and sandhills.
cards.learningGoal: Defense Terminology: (Installation, Deployment, Armed forces).

cards.name: NC State Aggies
cards.effect: Tech and Ag cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: We actually build the bridges and farm the land while UNC and Duke argue about philosophy.
cards.learningGoal: Blue-Collar Academia: (Engineering, Agriculture, Pragmatism over prestige).

cards.name: The Outer Banks Mayor
cards.flavorText: We survive nor'easters, hurricanes, and tourists. Your political ads don't scare us.
cards.learningGoal: Coastal Resilience: (Barrier islands, Nor'easter, Weather-beaten).

cards.name: Moving the Lighthouse
cards.flavorText: Spending millions of dollars to slowly roll a historic brick lighthouse away from the eroding beach.
cards.learningGoal: Engineering Marvels: (Erosion, Relocation, Historic preservation).

cards.name: Veto Override
cards.flavorText: The Governor vetoed the bill, but the legislature has the votes to completely ignore him.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Dominance: (Veto override, Supermajority, Checks and balances).

cards.name: Midnight Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: Calling a surprise legislative vote at 11:30 PM on a Wednesday while the opposition is asleep.
cards.learningGoal: Procedural Shenanigans: (Midnight vote, Lack of notice, Fast-tracked).

cards.name: Stripping Executive Power
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: You lost the governor's race, so you passed a law stripping the office of all its powers before you leave.
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Hardball: (Lame duck, Stripping powers, Executive authority).

cards.name: The Purple State Pivot
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We vote for a Democratic Governor and a Republican Senator on the exact same ballot. Pure chaos.
cards.learningGoal: Ticket Splitting: (Toss-up, Split ticket, Unpredictable electorate).

cards.name: Sweet Tea Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: If the spoon doesn't stand straight up in the sugar, it's not sweet enough to negotiate over.
cards.learningGoal: Southern Hospitality: (Overly sweetened, Disarming, Porch diplomacy).

cards.name: Bojangles Breakfast
cards.flavorText: Passing out Cajun Filet Biscuits at the polling place. It's legally questionable but highly effective.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Bribery: (Cajun filet, Tailgate, Early morning turnout).

cards.name: The Unaffiliated Voter
cards.effect: Wildcard: Grants either +2 Capital or +2 Support randomly each turn.
cards.flavorText: They are the largest voting bloc in the state, and nobody has any idea what they actually want.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Uncertainty: (Unaffiliated, Swing voter, Polling margin).

cards.name: The Carolina Squat
cards.flavorText: Lifting the front of your truck 12 inches while dropping the back. It is now illegal, but still annoying.
cards.learningGoal: Automotive Subcultures: (Lift kit, Modification, Banned by law).

cards.name: Copperhead on Nextdoor
cards.flavorText: Someone posted a blurry photo of a harmless rat snake on the neighborhood app. Panic ensues.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Paranoia: (Hyper-vigilance, Misidentification, Nextdoor drama).

cards.name: Shucking Oysters
cards.flavorText: Standing around a plywood table in the cold, stabbing at steamed shellfish. True diplomacy.
cards.learningGoal: Communal Dining: (Oyster roast, Shucking, Coastal tradition).

cards.name: The State Fair Deep Fryer
cards.flavorText: I just ate a deep-fried Krispy Kreme cheeseburger. I have secured the swing voters, but I need an ambulance.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Excess: (Deep-fried, Gluttony, Stunt food).

cards.name: Moravian Cookie Diplomacy
cards.flavorText: Bribing the opposition with incredibly thin, highly spiced cookies from Old Salem.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Delicacies: (Wafer-thin, Spiced, Historic heritage).

cards.name: The Hollywood South
cards.flavorText: We gave a massive tax credit so a teen drama could film at the local high school.
cards.learningGoal: Film Incentives: (Tax credit, Production boom, Hollywood East).

cards.name: The I-77 Toll Lanes
cards.flavorText: You sold the interstate lanes to a foreign company for 50 years. The commuters are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Privatization Backlash: (Toll lanes, Public-private partnership, Commuter rage).

cards.name: Independent Redistricting Map
cards.flavorText: A map drawn by a non-partisan computer algorithm? The politicians are terrified.
cards.learningGoal: Good Governance: (Non-partisan, Algorithm, Fair representation).

cards.name: The Biltmore Estate
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: Hosting a fundraiser at America's largest private home. The optics are terrible, but the checks are huge.
cards.learningGoal: Ostentatious Wealth: (Gilded Age, Chateau, Tone-deaf optics).

cards.name: Fleeing to the Outer Banks
cards.flavorText: I'm taking a ferry to Ocracoke Island where the press literally cannot reach me.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Evasion: (Barrier island, Off the grid, Ferry access).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Oh, you thought you had the votes for that committee assignment? Bless your heart.
cards.learningGoal: Passive-Aggressive Slang: Using extreme politeness to deliver a devastating insult.

cards.name: The 'First in Freedom' Plate
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We signed the Mecklenburg Declaration before July 4th! We are the original rebels!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Boasting: (Declaration, Sovereignty, First in Freedom).

cards.name: Textile Mill Revival
cards.flavorText: I promise to bring the textile jobs back from overseas! (They are never coming back).
cards.learningGoal: False Nostalgia: (Textile mill, Offshoring, Hollow promises).

cards.name: The Tipping Point
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: If we win North Carolina, the math is over. Turn out the vote!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Math: (Tipping point, Electoral college, Margin of victory).

cards.name: The UAW Boss
cards.flavorText: We build the cars, we built the middle class, and we will shut the plants down if we have to.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Terminology: (Picket line, Collective bargaining, Strike authorization).

cards.name: The West Michigan Donor
cards.flavorText: We prefer quiet, conservative politics and slapping our family name on every hospital in Grand Rapids.
cards.learningGoal: Philanthropic Influence: (Endowment, Benefactor, Naming rights).

cards.name: The Yooper Populist
cards.flavorText: Lansing is a million miles away. We survive on pasties, deer hunting, and sheer willpower.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Isolation: (Off the grid, Self-reliant, Forgotten peninsula).

cards.name: The Macomb Swing Voter
cards.flavorText: I'm a blue-collar union worker who sometimes votes red. I literally decide who becomes President.
cards.learningGoal: Political Demographics: (Swing county, Bellwether, Blue-collar).

cards.name: The Detroit Mayor
cards.flavorText: Downtown is booming, the streetlights are finally on, and we are not going bankrupt again!
cards.learningGoal: Revitalization Rhetoric: (Renaissance, Comeback city, Bankruptcy recovery).

cards.name: The Auto Exec
cards.effect: Tech and Corporate cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: We are transitioning to electric vehicles, but we still need you to subsidize the battery plants.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Transition: (Subsidize, Pivot, Supply chain, EV transition).

cards.name: The Oakland Suburbanite
cards.flavorText: I just want my property values high and my commute down I-75 to be under an hour.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Priorities: (Property values, Commute, Bedroom community).

cards.name: Fix the Damn Roads!
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: You won the election on this slogan, but the orange barrels are still everywhere.
cards.learningGoal: Populist Slogans: Using blunt, profane imperatives to show urgency.

cards.name: Pothole Blowout
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Capital to suspension repairs.
cards.flavorText: Your campaign bus hit a crater on I-696. You are stranded until the tow truck arrives.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Blowout, Crater, Suspension damage).

cards.name: Mackinac Policy Conference
cards.flavorText: All the politicians and CEOs are drinking on an island with no cars to decide the state's future.
cards.learningGoal: Exclusive Networking: (Offsite, Policy conference, Schmoozing).

cards.name: Vernors Cure-All
cards.flavorText: You contracted a political scandal? Just drink some warm Vernors. It fixes everything.
cards.learningGoal: Folk Remedies: Using local brand loyalty as a metaphor for healing.

cards.name: Coney Island Meeting
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating the state budget over a chili dog smothered in mustard and diced onions.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Diplomacy: (Smothered, Institution, Historic rivalry).

cards.name: Lake Effect Blizzard
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: Lake Michigan just dumped 40 inches of snow on Kalamazoo. The campaign is frozen.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Weather: (Lake effect, Whiteout, Paralyzed).

cards.name: Ope! Squeeze Past Ya
cards.flavorText: Ope! Didn't mean to block your legislation there, just gonna sneak right past ya.
cards.learningGoal: Midwestern Vernacular: (Ope, Sneak past, Defusing tension with extreme politeness).

cards.name: The Hand Map
cards.flavorText: You pointed to a spot on your right palm to show a voter where you grew up. Total authenticity.
cards.learningGoal: Gestural Communication: Using physical geography shorthand.

cards.name: Auto Plant Strike
cards.flavorText: The workers have walked out. The supply chain is halted, and the optics are terrible for you.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Action: (Walkout, Supply chain disruption, Optics).

cards.name: Deer Camp
cards.flavorText: It's November 15th. Half the state is in the woods wearing blaze orange. Politics can wait.
cards.learningGoal: Sporting Traditions: (Opening day, Blaze orange, Out of office).

cards.name: The Michigan Left
cards.flavorText: To turn left, you must first drive past the intersection, make a U-turn, and then turn right. What?
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Design: (Counterintuitive, U-turn, Traffic engineering).

cards.name: Independent Redistricting
cards.flavorText: A group of random citizens drew the map. The politicians are terrified of competitive districts.
cards.learningGoal: Good Governance: (Non-partisan, Citizen-led, Competitive district).

cards.name: 10-Cent Bottle Return
cards.flavorText: Funding your grassroots campaign by returning 400 empty cans of Faygo to Meijer.
cards.learningGoal: Micro-Economics: (Bottle deposit, Grassroots, Scrounging).

cards.name: Going to Meijer's
cards.flavorText: You successfully pronounced the grocery store with a possessive 's'. The locals accept you.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Quirks: Understanding regional possessive additions to brand names.

cards.name: Line 5 Pipeline Dispute
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We have to shut down the oil pipe under the Great Lakes! (And deal with the energy fallout later).
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Trade-offs: (Pipeline, Ecological disaster, Energy independence).

cards.name: Big House Tailgate
cards.flavorText: 110,000 people in maize and blue are cheering. The alumni donors are opening their checkbooks.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Fervor: (The Big House, Alumni network, War chest).

cards.name: Couch Burning
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: Michigan State just won a huge game. The celebration has escalated to minor arson.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Hooliganism: (Escalation, Riotous celebration, Property damage).

cards.name: Sign Stealing Scandal
cards.effect: See opponent's hand and discard 1 card.
cards.flavorText: We illegally scouted your campaign strategy and wrote a 600-page manifesto about it.
cards.learningGoal: Paranoia and Espionage: (Scouting, Reconnaissance, Manifesto, Scandal).

cards.name: Faygo Shower
cards.effect: Swap your hand with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: You were endorsed by Insane Clown Posse. It is politically confusing but incredibly hyped.
cards.learningGoal: Subculture Integration: (Niche demographic, Chaotic energy, Viral moment).

cards.name: The Midwest Goodbye
cards.effect: Opponent skips a turn trying to leave.
cards.flavorText: You slapped your knees, said 'Welp,' but then stood in the doorway talking for another 45 minutes.
cards.learningGoal: Social Rituals: (Prolonged departure, Obligatory chatter, Lingering).

cards.name: Going Up North
cards.flavorText: Fleeing the humidity for a lake house in Traverse City. The fundraising dinners are lovely.
cards.learningGoal: Leisure Vocabulary: (Up North, Summer home, Escapism).

cards.name: Canadian Border Crossing
cards.flavorText: I'm just going to pop over to Windsor, Ontario until the press forgets about this.
cards.learningGoal: International Evasion: (Border crossing, Jurisdiction, Laying low).

cards.name: Lead Pipe Crisis
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital and 3 Support.
cards.flavorText: The water is contaminated, the trust is broken, and the lawsuits are flying. An utter tragedy.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Failure: (Contamination, Negligence, Public trust, Crisis).

cards.name: Zebra Mussels
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: These tiny mollusks are clogging up the municipal water intake. The budget is wrecked.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Threat: (Invasive species, Clogging, Ecosystem disruption).

cards.name: The Trolls
cards.flavorText: Anyone living below the Mackinac Bridge is a 'Troll.' Which is basically 95% of the state.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Derogatories: Using mythical creatures as geographic insults.

cards.name: Dutch Reform Influence
cards.effect: Provides +2 Support per turn from conservatives.
cards.flavorText: Very polite, very strict, and very organized. You don't win Ottawa County without them.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Demographics: (Organized, Pious, Bloc voting).

cards.name: EV Mega-Site
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but lose 1 Support from rural locals.
cards.flavorText: We secured a $2 billion electric vehicle battery plant! But the farmers hate the zoning changes.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Development: (Mega-site, Zoning variance, Tax incentive).

cards.name: Right-to-Work Repeal
cards.effect: Spend 2 Capital, gain 5 Support from unions.
cards.flavorText: We finally repealed the anti-union laws! The AFL-CIO is throwing a massive parade.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Legislation: (Right-to-work, Repeal, Union dues, Organized labor).

cards.name: State Police Escort
cards.flavorText: The Michigan State Police 'Bubble' is escorting your motorcade. No reporters can get close.
cards.learningGoal: Security Optics: (Motorcade, Escort, Keeping the press at bay).

cards.name: The Pasty Slander
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the U.P.
cards.flavorText: You ate a traditional Yooper meat pie with a fork and knife instead of your hands. Pathetic.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Utensil faux pas, Authenticity test, Working class food).

cards.name: Detroit Renaissance
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The skyline is growing, the train station is renovated, and the grit is paying off.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Renewal: (Revitalized, Renovated, Grit, Payoff).

cards.name: Asian Carp Threat
cards.flavorText: The invasive fish are nearing the Chicago locks! We must protect the Great Lakes ecosystem!
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Panic: (Impending threat, Invasive, Ecosystem collapse).

cards.name: Pure Michigan
cards.flavorText: Cue the acoustic guitar and Tim Allen's voiceover. Everyone feels intensely nostalgic.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Nostalgia: (Voiceover, Nostalgic, Majestic imagery, Tourism campaign).

cards.name: Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: You lost the election, so you rammed through 40 controversial bills in the middle of the night.
cards.learningGoal: Procedural Hardball: (Lame duck, Rammed through, Subverting the mandate).

cards.name: No-Fault Insurance Premium
cards.flavorText: Michigan has the highest car insurance rates in the country. Your voters are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Consumer Frustration: (Premiums, No-fault, Highway robbery).

cards.name: The Great Lakes Compact
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We hold 20% of the world's fresh water, and we aren't sharing it with the Southwest!
cards.learningGoal: Resource Protectionism: (Freshwater, Compact, Hoarding, Resource scarcity).

cards.name: Lions Super Bowl Bandwagon
cards.flavorText: After 60 years of misery, the Detroit Lions are actually good. The entire state is united in tears.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Redemption: (Bandwagon, Long-suffering, Shared trauma, Grit).

cards.name: The Chaldean Chamber
cards.flavorText: A highly successful, deeply connected entrepreneurial community in Macomb and Oakland counties.
cards.learningGoal: Immigrant Success: (Entrepreneurial, Chamber of Commerce, Deeply connected).

cards.name: Building Trades Union
cards.effect: Blocks any Infrastructure attacks against you.
cards.flavorText: You want to build that bridge? You better use our operators, or the cranes don't move.
cards.learningGoal: Union Leverage: (Prevailing wage, Operators, Stoppage).

cards.name: Fudge Pandering
cards.flavorText: Buying a half-pound of overpriced chocolate fudge while riding a rented bicycle.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Clichés: (Tourist trap, Pandering, Mandatory stop).

cards.name: Blue Water Bridge Jam
cards.flavorText: The line of semi-trucks trying to get into Canada is backed up for six miles.
cards.learningGoal: Border Logistics: (Customs, Backlog, Supply chain delay).

cards.name: Prop 3 Mobilization
cards.flavorText: We bypassed Lansing and got two million signatures to put this right in the state constitution!
cards.learningGoal: Direct Democracy: (Petition drive, Ballot initiative, Constitutional amendment).

cards.name: The 'Militia' Cabin
cards.flavorText: Some guys in tactical gear were holding drills in the woods. The FBI just raided them.
cards.learningGoal: Extremist Fallout: (Tactical gear, Raided, Paranoia, Anti-government).

cards.name: The County Chairman
cards.flavorText: We don't need a primary. I already decided who the candidate is over baked ziti.
cards.learningGoal: Machine Politics: (Hand-picked, The Boss, Closed-door decision).

cards.name: The Gold Bar Senator
cards.flavorText: They found gold bars in my jacket, but I'm still showing up to vote on the budget.
cards.learningGoal: Brazen Defiance: (Unfazed, Presumption of innocence, Brazen).

cards.name: North Jersey Commuter
cards.flavorText: I pay $18,000 in property taxes to sit in two hours of tunnel traffic every morning.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Frustration: (Expat, Bedroom community, Tunnel traffic).

cards.name: South Jersey Local
cards.flavorText: We go to Wawa, we route for the Eagles, and we want nothing to do with Newark.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Orbit: (Cultural sphere of influence, Cross-border loyalty).

cards.name: The Shore Mayor
cards.flavorText: Welcome to my town. Buy a beach badge, feed the meters, and don't feed the seagulls.
cards.learningGoal: Local Fiefdoms: (Revenue stream, Local ordinance, Seasonal economy).

cards.name: Central Jersey Believer
cards.effect: Wildcard: Swap your regional alignment each turn.
cards.flavorText: I swear Central Jersey exists! We have a Wawa AND a QuickChek across the street from each other!
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Mythology: Expressing adamant belief in a disputed concept.

cards.name: The County Line
cards.flavorText: If the party boss doesn't put you on the official bracket, you're in ballot Siberia.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Formatting: (Ballot placement, Siberia, The party line).

cards.name: Traffic Study
cards.flavorText: Time for some traffic problems in Fort Lee. The lanes are closed until further notice.
cards.learningGoal: Political Retribution: (Traffic study, Gridlock, Punitive measures).

cards.name: Taylor Ham Purist
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support in the North, lose 1 in the South.
cards.flavorText: It's a Taylor Ham, egg, and cheese on a hard roll. Don't you dare call it pork roll.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Name Dominance: Using a specific corporate trademark as a generic noun.

cards.name: Pork Roll Defender
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support in the South, lose 1 in the North.
cards.flavorText: The box literally says 'John Taylor's Pork Roll.' Learn how to read, North Jersey.
cards.learningGoal: Literal Interpretation: (Textual evidence, Culinary divide, Regional stubbornness).

cards.name: Full-Serve Gas Only
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from locals, confuse outsiders.
cards.flavorText: I will freeze in my car before I touch a gas nozzle. It's a Jersey constitutional right.
cards.learningGoal: Stubborn Convenience: (Full-serve, Pumping gas, Refusal to adapt).

cards.name: The Diner Meeting
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a $40 million state contract over disco fries and terrible coffee at 2 AM.
cards.learningGoal: Informal Settings: (Disco fries, Diner booth, Midnight oil).

cards.name: Waste Management Consultant
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: We're in the carting business. It's a completely legitimate enterprise, capiche?
cards.learningGoal: Mafia Euphemisms: (Waste management, Legitimate business, Stereotype).

cards.name: Bergen County Blue Laws
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Economic cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's Sunday in Paramus. You cannot buy a television, clothing, or a car. Go home.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Regulations: (Blue laws, Commercial restriction, Paramus).

cards.name: Property Tax Assessment
cards.flavorText: Your 3-bedroom split-level is now assessed at $1.2 million. Pay up or move to Florida.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Pain: (Revaluation, Property tax burden, Sticker shock).

cards.name: Fleeing to Boca Raton
cards.flavorText: The winters are cold and the taxes are high. The retirees are officially taking their pensions to Florida.
cards.learningGoal: Capital Flight: (Fixed income, Snowbird, Relocation).

cards.name: Jughandle Turn
cards.flavorText: To turn left, you must pass the light, take a sweeping right turn, and wait at a red light forever.
cards.learningGoal: Traffic Engineering Jargon: (Jughandle, Grade intersection, Inconvenience).

cards.name: NJ Transit Meltdown
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The 100-year-old bridge is stuck open. Every train on the Northeast Corridor is canceled.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Northeast corridor, Chokepoint, Outdated technology).

cards.name: Bennies Go Home
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support, but lose 1 Capital from tourism.
cards.flavorText: They bring their money from North Jersey, but they drive terribly and leave trash on the beach.
cards.learningGoal: Local Derogatories: (Bennie, Shoobie, Year-rounder vs. Tourist).

cards.name: Shoobies Go Home
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support, but lose 1 Capital from tourism.
cards.flavorText: Stop wearing socks with sandals and go back to Philadelphia!
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Insults: (Socks with sandals, Day-tripper, Beach etiquette).

cards.name: Bruce Springsteen Concert
cards.flavorText: He played for four straight hours. The entire state is united in exhausted, blue-collar euphoria.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Idolization: (Marathon set, Blue-collar anthems, Uniting figure).

cards.name: Wawa Run
cards.flavorText: I'm making a Wawa run, you want a Shorti? This campaign runs entirely on iced coffee and touchscreen ordering.
cards.learningGoal: Convenience Culture: (Hoagie, Touchscreen, Making a run).

cards.name: The Turnpike Toll Plaza
cards.flavorText: You missed the EZ-Pass lane and have to back up on a 12-lane highway. Chaos ensues.
cards.learningGoal: Highway Anxiety: (Toll plaza, EZ-Pass, Reversing on the highway).

cards.name: The State Bird
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You honked at me the millisecond the light turned green? Here's my policy response.
cards.learningGoal: Aggressive Body Language: Using physical gestures as political communication.

cards.name: Nepotism Hire
cards.flavorText: My brother-in-law is now the Deputy Director of the Turnpike Authority. What a coincidence!
cards.learningGoal: Patronage Vocabulary: (Nepotism, Brother-in-law, Cushy job).

cards.name: Home Rule
cards.flavorText: We have 565 separate municipalities. We need 565 police chiefs and 565 school superintendents!
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Redundancy: (Home rule, Consolidation, Redundant services).

cards.name: Beach Badge Fines
cards.flavorText: You stepped on the sand without a piece of plastic pinned to your swimsuit. That's a $100 fine.
cards.learningGoal: Micro-Taxation: (Beach badge, Ordinance, Nickel and diming).

cards.name: Pothole on Route 22
cards.flavorText: You tried to make a left turn from the center island of Route 22 and destroyed your axle.
cards.learningGoal: Specific Infrastructure Hazards: (Center island, Route 22, Axle damage).

cards.name: The Pine Barrens
cards.effect: Opponent's Urban cards have no effect here.
cards.flavorText: There's a million acres of pine trees, sand, and folklore down here. Don't get lost.
cards.learningGoal: Folklore Phrasing: (Uncharted, Folklore, Pinelands).

cards.name: Rutgers Tailgate
cards.flavorText: We might lose to Ohio State by 50 points, but we will win the tailgate in the grease trucks parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Defiant Fandom: (Fat sandwich, Grease trucks, Loyal despite losing).

cards.name: Atlantic City Bailout
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital now, lose 3 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We are saving the casinos again! Surely this will fix the state's budget deficit forever!
cards.learningGoal: Economic Gambles: (Bailout, Deficit, Doubling down).

cards.name: Unfunded Pension Crisis
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: We promised the public workers a pension, but we haven't funded it since 1996. Good luck!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Irresponsibility: (Unfunded liability, Public sector, Kicking the can).

cards.name: The State Police Escort
cards.flavorText: Doing 95 MPH down the Garden State Parkway with the troopers clearing the left lane.
cards.learningGoal: VIP Privilege: (Motorcade, Left lane cruiser, Exempt from the rules).

cards.name: Overdevelopment
cards.flavorText: We tore down the last farm in the county to build a luxury townhome complex and a mattress store.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Sprawl: (Overdevelopment, Strip mall, Paving paradise).

cards.name: The Phantom Smell
cards.flavorText: You rolled your windows down near the Elizabeth refineries. A grave sensory mistake.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Odors: (Refinery, Olfactory, Petrochemical).

cards.name: Double-Parked in Hoboken
cards.flavorText: I put my hazard lights on, which means I can legally abandon my car in the middle of Washington Street.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Entitlement: (Double-parked, Hazard lights, Complete disregard).

cards.name: Teachers Union Endorsement
cards.flavorText: The most powerful union in the state just backed you. You essentially cannot lose the election now.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Power: (Endorsement, Immovable force, War chest).

cards.name: The Gold Coast Developer
cards.flavorText: We're building another glass skyscraper in Jersey City. The skyline looks like Manhattan now.
cards.learningGoal: Real Estate Boom: (Gold Coast, Luxury high-rise, Skyline).

cards.name: Secaucus Junction Transfer
cards.flavorText: You missed your connection at Secaucus. You are now trapped in a massive, lonely train station for an hour.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Limbo: (Missed connection, Transfer station, Purgatory).

cards.name: Oh, Madonn'!
cards.flavorText: Expressing extreme Italian-American disbelief at your opponent's terrible tax proposal.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Exclamations: Using specific cultural slang to express shock.

cards.name: The Parkway vs. Turnpike
cards.effect: Opponent must discard a card if they use the wrong road.
cards.flavorText: The Parkway is for the beach and trees. The Turnpike is for trucks and industry. Know the difference.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Identity: (Artery, Toll road, Industrial corridor).

cards.name: High School Football Rivalry
cards.flavorText: The entire town is at the Thanksgiving Day game. A perfect place to shake hands and kiss babies.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Rituals: (Thanksgiving tradition, Rivalry, Retail politics).

cards.name: Property Tax Rebate
cards.flavorText: We are mailing you a check for $200! Just ignore that your taxes went up by $1,000 this year.
cards.learningGoal: Political Gimmicks: (Rebate, Bread and circuses, Shell game).

cards.name: Leaving the State
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: Your base is literally packing up U-Hauls and moving to the Carolinas.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Crisis: (Outmigration, U-Haul index, Brain drain).

cards.name: The 'What Exit?' Joke
cards.flavorText: You asked a local 'What exit are you from?' They rolled their eyes and walked away.
cards.learningGoal: Stereotype Fatigue: (Cliché, Overused, Out-of-stater).

cards.name: Asbury Park Revival
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: The boardwalk is beautiful again, but the dive bars are now serving $18 artisanal cocktails.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Gentrification: (Revival, Artisanal, Priced out).

cards.name: The 'You Talkin' To Me?'
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Somebody bumped your booth at the diner. The political debate just got personal.
cards.learningGoal: Confrontational Rhetoric: (In your face, Stepping up, Backing down).

cards.name: Bon Jovi Anthem
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We're halfway there! The crowd is screaming the chorus and your poll numbers are skyrocketing.
cards.learningGoal: Anthemic Motivation: (Skyrocketing, Singalong, Halfway there).

cards.name: Jersey Tomato Season
cards.flavorText: It's August. The tomatoes are ripe, the corn is sweet, and everyone forgets about the property taxes for a week.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Respite: (Farm stand, Heirloom, Seasonal bliss).

cards.name: Jersey Strong
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We survived hurricanes, corruption, and the highest taxes in America. We aren't going anywhere.
cards.learningGoal: Unbreakable Resilience: (Jersey Strong, Battered but not broken, Defiant).

cards.name: The NOVA Contractor
cards.effect: Tech and Defense cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: My consulting firm has a three-letter acronym, a massive DoD contract, and zero public transparency.
cards.learningGoal: Consulting Jargon: (Procurement, Defense contracting, Clearance, Synergy).

cards.name: The One-Term Governor
cards.flavorText: The Virginia constitution forbids me from running again, so I am officially running for President tomorrow.
cards.learningGoal: Term Limit Phrasing: (Consecutive term, Lame duck, Political stepping stone).

cards.name: The Tidewater Admiral
cards.effect: Naval and Infrastructure cards grant +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We build the aircraft carriers and coordinate the maritime logistics. Salute the fleet.
cards.learningGoal: Military/Maritime Vocabulary: (Brass, Fleet, Shipyard, Logistics).

cards.name: The Richmond Hipster
cards.effect: Arts and Culture cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: I only discuss state tax policy if we are sitting at a craft brewery on the James River.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Leisure: (Craft brewery, Riverfront, Gentrification).

cards.name: The Southwest Miner
cards.flavorText: You folks up in Fairfax forget that Virginia extends eight hours west into the mountains.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Alienation: (Forgotten corners, Rural divide, Extraction industry).

cards.name: The Piedmont Vintner
cards.flavorText: We turned Thomas Jefferson's failed vineyard experiments into a billion-dollar wedding industry!
cards.learningGoal: Agritourism Phrasing: (Vintner, Vineyard, Agritourism, Heritage).

cards.name: I-95 Gridlock
cards.flavorText: Traffic is backed up from Fredericksburg to DC. Your opponent missed the debate entirely.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Despair: (Gridlock, Standstill, Bumper-to-bumper, Bottleneck).

cards.name: I-66 Dynamic Tolling
cards.flavorText: It is 8:15 AM. The toll to drive ten miles into Washington is currently $47.50. Pay up.
cards.learningGoal: Variable Economics: (Dynamic pricing, Surge tolling, Commuter tax).

cards.name: The HRBT Backup
cards.flavorText: Trying to commute between Norfolk and Newport News? The bridge-tunnel is underwater and backed up for miles.
cards.learningGoal: Chokepoint Engineering: (Bridge-tunnel, Submerged, Backup).

cards.name: Newport News Shipbuilding
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: We are building nuclear submarines, aerospace components, and the local economy.
cards.learningGoal: Heavy Industry Jargon: (Shipbuilding, Defense contract, Manufacturing base).

cards.name: Loudoun County PTA
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but leaves if you play an Extreme card.
cards.flavorText: The wealthiest county in America is currently having a screaming match at a school board meeting.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Flashpoints: (School board, Flashpoint, Wealth bracket, Curriculum).

cards.name: Ashburn Data Centers
cards.flavorText: 70% of the world's internet traffic flows through a windowless concrete box in Northern Virginia.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Infrastructure: (Data center, Server farm, Fiber optics).

cards.name: Off-Year Election Fatigue
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We vote for Governor in odd years. We vote for state senate the next. The voters are exhausted.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Fatigue: (Off-year, Voter burnout, Perpetual campaign).

cards.name: The Dillon Rule
cards.effect: Block a local Infrastructure or Policy card.
cards.flavorText: Cities have no real power here! The General Assembly in Richmond must approve your new stop sign!
cards.learningGoal: Legal Preemption: (Dillon Rule, Municipal authority, Overruled).

cards.name: Personal Property Tax
cards.flavorText: Your constituents just got an annual tax bill for merely owning a Honda Civic. They are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Taxation Resentment: (Assessment, Personal property, Recurring tax).

cards.name: Commonwealth Status
cards.flavorText: We are not a state, we are a 'Commonwealth.' It legally means nothing, but it sounds incredibly fancy.
cards.learningGoal: Semantic Pretension: Using legalistic terms for aesthetic superiority.

cards.name: Government Shutdown
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: Congress failed to pass a budget. Half of Northern Virginia is sitting at home not getting paid.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Bureaucracy: (Furlough, Continuing resolution, Essential personnel).

cards.name: Norfolk Nuisance Flooding
cards.flavorText: It didn't even rain, but the ocean is currently in the street. Move your car to higher ground.
cards.learningGoal: Climate Adaptation: (Sea-level rise, Nuisance flooding, High tide).

cards.name: Moving the FBI HQ
cards.flavorText: We are fighting Maryland tooth and nail to put 7,000 federal agents in a suburban office park.
cards.learningGoal: Interstate Rivalry: (Bidding war, Relocation, Agency headquarters).

cards.name: Wawa vs. Sheetz Border
cards.effect: Opponent must discard a card if they pander to the wrong store.
cards.flavorText: East of Richmond is Wawa territory. West of Charlottesville is Sheetz. Do not mix them up.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Tribalism: (Territorial divide, Convenience, Regional loyalty).

cards.name: Brunswick Stew Festival
cards.flavorText: Stirring a 100-gallon cast iron pot of stew with a wooden canoe paddle shows you care about tradition.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Heritage: (Slow-cooked, Tradition, Hearty).

cards.name: Smithfield Ham Pandering
cards.flavorText: Serving thinly sliced, incredibly salty cured pork on a biscuit. It is a political necessity.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Delicacies: (Cured, Pandering, Acquired taste).

cards.name: General Assembly Short Session
cards.effect: Play 2 cards from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislature only meets for six weeks. Ram the bills through before the clock runs out!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Chaos: (Short session, Sine Die, Rushed legislation).

cards.name: The Pentagon Lobby
cards.flavorText: The Department of Defense needs a slightly bigger budget. The contractors are happy to assist.
cards.learningGoal: Military-Industrial Phrasing: (Procurement, Defense budget, The Pentagon).

cards.name: The Independent City
cards.flavorText: Unlike the rest of the US, Virginia cities are independent from counties. You can't tax us!
cards.learningGoal: Municipal Law: (Independent city, Annexation, Jurisdiction).

cards.name: Virginia is for Lovers
cards.flavorText: We slapped a 50-year-old tourism slogan on a bumper sticker. It still works perfectly.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Longevity: (Iconic slogan, Tourism campaign, Enduring).

cards.name: UVA vs. Virginia Tech
cards.effect: Swap your hand with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: A fight broke out over who has the better engineering program versus who wears more bow ties.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Stereotypes: (Rivalry, Engineering vs. Liberal Arts, Preppy).

cards.name: Thomas Jefferson Quote
cards.flavorText: Quoting a Founding Father to justify your highly specific zoning reform bill.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Plagiarism: (Founding ideals, Justification, Out of context).

cards.name: State Fair in Doswell
cards.flavorText: I am eating a deep-fried Oreo next to the birthplace of Secretariat to win the rural vote.
cards.learningGoal: Equestrian/Agricultural Optics: (Birthplace, Deep-fried, Fairgrounds).

cards.name: Blue Ridge Parkway Tourists
cards.flavorText: You are stuck behind a minivan going 15 miles per hour to look at the autumn foliage.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Frustration: (Foliage, Leaf peeping, Scenic route).

cards.name: Historical Reenactor
cards.flavorText: Wearing a tricorn hat in Williamsburg to remind voters that we basically invented this country.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Tourism: (Reenactment, Colonial, Living history).

cards.name: Chesapeake Bay Blue Crabs
cards.flavorText: We are arguing with Maryland over who has the better crab cakes. The answer is obviously us.
cards.learningGoal: Aquaculture Phrasing: (Estuary, Blue crab, Catch limit, Maritime dispute).

cards.name: The Purple State Pivot
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We elect Democrats for President and Republicans for Governor. We are delightfully unpredictable.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Fluidity: (Ticket-splitting, Bellwether, Purple state).

cards.name: EZ-Pass Transponder
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You tried to delay me with traffic, but I paid $30 to use the Express Lanes. See ya!
cards.learningGoal: Financial Privilege: (Express lanes, Surge pricing, Fast-tracked).

cards.name: ABC Store Monopoly
cards.flavorText: If you want vodka, you have to buy it from a state-owned store with terrible lighting.
cards.learningGoal: State Monopolies: (ABC board, State-run, Bureaucratic retail).

cards.name: The Federal Commuter
cards.flavorText: I take the Virginia Railway Express into DC every morning. Do not cut my transit funding.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Infrastructure: (Transit funding, Railway express, Commute).

cards.name: Grocery Tax Repeal
cards.flavorText: We eliminated the 1.5% tax on bread and milk. It's a rounding error, but the voters love it!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Micro-Policies: (Grocery tax, Relief, Rounding error).

cards.name: Mother of Presidents
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We birthed eight US Presidents. What has your state done lately?
cards.learningGoal: Historical Superiority: (Lineage, Birthplace, Legacy).

cards.name: Jet Noise
cards.flavorText: An F/A-18 Super Hornet just flew 500 feet over your outdoor rally. Nobody heard a word you said.
cards.learningGoal: Military Proximity: (Jet noise, Sound of freedom, Drowned out).

cards.name: Appalachian Trail Hiker
cards.flavorText: You got distracted trying to hike 500 miles through the Shenandoah instead of campaigning.
cards.learningGoal: Outdoor Recreation: (Thru-hike, Trailhead, Wilderness).

cards.name: The Peanut Lobby
cards.flavorText: Southside Virginia takes its peanuts very seriously. They fund campaigns in salted, roasted cash.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Lobbying: (Cash crop, Commodities, Export).

cards.name: Monument Avenue Debate
cards.flavorText: The statues are gone, but we are still arguing about what to put on the empty pedestals.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Flashpoints: (Monument, Pedestal, Historical reckoning).

cards.name: The Capitol Square Lobbyist
cards.flavorText: If you want this bill to pass, we need to have a quiet chat behind the George Washington statue.
cards.learningGoal: Lobbying Shorthand: (Capitol Square, Insider, Quiet chat).

cards.name: James River Tubing
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's 95 degrees in Richmond. Everyone is sitting in an inner tube drinking PBR on the river.
cards.learningGoal: Summer Leisure: (Inner tube, Stagnant, Beating the heat).

cards.name: The Gold Cup
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: Wearing seersucker and drinking mint juleps at a horse race in Great Falls to secure donor money.
cards.learningGoal: High Society Pandering: (Steeplechase, Seersucker, Old money).

cards.name: Chincoteague Pony Swim
cards.flavorText: Watching wild horses swim across a channel. It makes for fantastic, wholesome campaign B-roll.
cards.learningGoal: Wholesome Optics: (B-roll footage, Tradition, Uncontroversial).

cards.name: The Washington Post Editorial
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the North.
cards.flavorText: The editorial board just dragged your transit policy. The federal workers are displeased.
cards.learningGoal: Media Scrutiny: (Editorial board, Think piece, Beltway media).

cards.name: Uranium Mining Ban
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 3 from industry.
cards.flavorText: There's a massive uranium deposit in Pittsylvania County, and we are absolutely keeping it in the ground.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Extraction Fights: (Mining ban, Deposit, Environmental impact).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The Governor is leaving office next month. Time to pass the controversial pardons and appointments!
cards.learningGoal: Executive Power Grabs: (Midnight pardons, Lame duck, Appointments).

cards.name: The Tech Bro
cards.effect: Tech cards cost 1 less, but Grassroots cards cost 1 more.
cards.flavorText: My stock options vested, so I bought a $2 million tear-down and a very expensive raincoat.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Compensation: (Vesting, Stock options, RSU, Tear-down).

cards.name: The Eastern Apple Farmer
cards.flavorText: We grow the food, we bring in the sun, and we absolutely despise King County.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resentment: (The 509, Arid, Disdain for the capital).

cards.name: The Seattle Progressive
cards.effect: Start with +3 Support from urban voters.
cards.flavorText: We must tax the megacorporations to fund the compostable bike lane initiative!
cards.learningGoal: Progressive Urbanism: (Megacorporations, Compostable, Equity, Infrastructure).

cards.name: The Aerospace Machinist
cards.flavorText: We build the planes. Do not threaten our pensions, or we strike on Monday.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Militancy: (Machinists, Assembly line, Walkout).

cards.name: The Vancouver Commuter
cards.flavorText: I live in Washington for the zero income tax and shop in Oregon for the zero sales tax. It's an art.
cards.learningGoal: Tax Avoidance: (Income tax, Sales tax, Loophole, Border town).

cards.name: The Seattle Freeze
cards.flavorText: We should totally grab coffee sometime! (We will literally never grab coffee).
cards.learningGoal: Passive-Aggression: Using enthusiastic promises with zero intent to follow through.

cards.name: Rain for Nine Months
cards.effect: Both players lose 1 Support per turn.
cards.flavorText: It has been drizzling since October. The sun is a myth. Everyone is mildly depressed.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Vocabulary: (Drizzle, Overcast, Seasonal Affective, Gloom).

cards.name: Sunbreak!
cards.flavorText: The clouds parted for exactly 14 minutes. The entire state immediately put on shorts.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Optimism: (Sunbreak, Parting clouds, Fleeting).

cards.name: Using an Umbrella
cards.flavorText: You opened an umbrella in a drizzle. You have instantly exposed yourself as a Californian.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Shibboleths: (Gore-Tex, Shell jacket, Exposed as an outsider).

cards.name: Pike Place Fish Toss
cards.flavorText: Catching a slippery, 20-pound King Salmon for the cameras without dropping it. Pure optics.
cards.learningGoal: Spectacle Terminology: (Optics, Tourist attraction, Sleight of hand).

cards.name: Amazon Headquarters Threat
cards.flavorText: If you pass this head tax, we are moving 10,000 jobs to another state. Your move.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Blackmail: (Head tax, Capital flight, Relocation, Leverage).

cards.name: The Ferry Broken Down
cards.flavorText: The Bremerton ferry is out of service. You are stranded on an island with no alternate route.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Transit: (Ferry terminal, Stranded, Out of service, Sound).

cards.name: I-5 Gridlock at JBLM
cards.flavorText: You are passing the military base. Traffic has stopped forever. Accept your fate.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Resignation: (Gridlock, Standstill, Chokepoint).

cards.name: Snoqualmie Pass Closed
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: They are blasting the mountainside with dynamite. East and West are completely cut off.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Geography: (Avalanche control, Mountain pass, Severed).

cards.name: The Aroma of Tacoma
cards.flavorText: The wind shifted and the infamous paper mill smell hit the campaign trail.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Odors: (Aroma, Paper mill, Olfactory assault).

cards.name: Hanford Site Leak
cards.flavorText: A tank from the Manhattan Project is leaking again. The federal government is shrugging.
cards.learningGoal: Radiological Panic: (Contamination, Remediation, Radioactive, Legacy waste).

cards.name: Saving the Orcas
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We must save the pods! Ban the plastic bags! Reroute the shipping lanes!
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Desperation: (Pod, Endangered species, Shipping lanes, Conservation).

cards.name: Wildfire Smoke
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The air quality is 'Hazardous.' It's snowing ash in August. Don't go outside.
cards.learningGoal: Air Quality Vocabulary: (AQI, Particulate matter, Hazardous, Ash).

cards.name: Bikini Barista Stand
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: Only in Washington can you buy a 16oz Americano from someone in lingerie at a wooden shack.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Industry: (Drive-thru, Exploitation vs Empowerment, Niche).

cards.name: The Coffee Snob
cards.flavorText: I just drank four shots of ethically sourced, single-origin espresso. I am moving at light speed.
cards.learningGoal: Caffeinated Jargon: (Single-origin, Fair-trade, Over-caffeinated, Jitters).

cards.name: Mail-in Voting Pioneer
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We've been voting entirely by mail for years. We do not understand what a 'polling place' is.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Logistics: (Universal mail-in, Dropbox, Postmark, Canvassing).

cards.name: No State Income Tax
cards.flavorText: We fund the entire state on a wildly regressive sales tax and liquor tax. It's fine!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Policy: (Regressive tax, Income tax ban, Sales tax reliance).

cards.name: The Sound Transit Levy
cards.flavorText: We voted to build light rail to the suburbs! It will be completed in the year 2045.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Timelines: (Light rail, Levy, Phased rollout, Decades away).

cards.name: The Cascade Curtain
cards.effect: Opponent's Urban cards have no effect here.
cards.flavorText: Once you cross the mountains, the politics flip from deep blue to deep red instantly.
cards.learningGoal: Political Geography: (Cascade Curtain, Ideological divide, Sharp contrast).

cards.name: Craft IPA Pandering
cards.flavorText: Pretending to enjoy an incredibly bitter, pine-needle-flavored triple IPA to win the millennial vote.
cards.learningGoal: Beverage Pretentiousness: (Hops, IBU, Piney, Palate).

cards.name: Grunge Nostalgia
cards.flavorText: Wearing a flannel shirt and referencing Pearl Jam instantly buys you goodwill with Gen X voters.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Touchstones: (Grunge, Nostalgia, Authenticity, Flannel).

cards.name: The Timber Industry
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital per turn, but costs 1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We supply the wood for the world. Please stop hugging the trees we are trying to cut down.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Extraction: (Timber, Clear-cutting, Old-growth, Mills).

cards.name: Spokanites
cards.flavorText: We are the second biggest city in the state, and we are tired of being ignored by Seattle!
cards.learningGoal: Secondary City Complex: (Inland Empire, Overlooked, Regional hub).

cards.name: Tribal Casino Revenue
cards.flavorText: The Native tribes have immense political power and very deep pockets. Negotiate respectfully.
cards.learningGoal: Tribal Sovereignty: (Sovereign nation, Compact, Revenue sharing).

cards.name: The Autonomous Zone
cards.flavorText: Six blocks of the city have declared independence. The police have abandoned the precinct. Pure chaos.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Anarchy: (Autonomous zone, Protest, Barricades, Abandoned).

cards.name: The Boeing Strike
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: Thirty thousand machinists are on the picket line. The state economy is bleeding.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Stoppage: (Picket line, Ripple effect, Bleeding capital).

cards.name: Yakima Valley Ag
cards.flavorText: Cherries, apples, and hops. The agricultural heartland demands water rights and seasonal visas.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Demands: (Water rights, H-2A visas, Harvest season).

cards.name: The Floating Bridge
cards.flavorText: We built a bridge on top of floating concrete pontoons. A bad storm just sank it again.
cards.learningGoal: Engineering Hubris: (Floating bridge, Pontoons, Structural failure).

cards.name: Suburban King County
cards.effect: Provides +2 Support. Immune to Extreme attacks.
cards.flavorText: Wealthy, highly educated, and moderately progressive. You don't win the governorship without them.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Tipping Points: (Highly educated, Moderate, King County).

cards.name: State Liquor Store Privatization
cards.flavorText: We privatized liquor sales, but added a 20.5% tax plus a liter tax. It costs a fortune now.
cards.learningGoal: Taxation Sleight-of-Hand: (Privatization, Sin tax, Sticker shock).

cards.name: The Geoduck
cards.flavorText: Digging up a massive, strangely shaped bivalve from the mud to prove you appreciate local culture.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Oddities: (Bivalve, Foraging, Estuary).

cards.name: Banning Plastic Bags
cards.flavorText: You forgot your reusable tote bag, so you must carry your groceries in your arms like a raccoon.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Inconvenience: (Mandate, Reusable, Tote bag).

cards.name: Mount Rainier Erupts
cards.effect: Freeze the game. Both players lose 5 Support.
cards.flavorText: The majestic mountain is actually a ticking time bomb. Evacuate the river valleys immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Catastrophe: (Stratovolcano, Lahar, Evacuation zone, Looming).

cards.name: The San Juan Islands
cards.flavorText: I'm taking a seaplane to Friday Harbor where the cell service is terrible and the press can't find me.
cards.learningGoal: Exclusive Escapism: (Seaplane, Off the grid, Archipelago).

cards.name: The Space Needle Photo
cards.flavorText: Holding a rally with the Space Needle in the background. It's cliché, but it looks great on TV.
cards.learningGoal: Optics and Framing: (Backdrop, Iconic, Broadcast-ready).

cards.name: Hydroplane Races
cards.flavorText: Boats flipping over at 200 mph while the Blue Angels scream overhead. A Seattle summer tradition.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Motorsports: (Hydroplane, Seafair, Roostertail).

cards.name: The State Supreme Court
cards.flavorText: We ruled your new initiative unconstitutional. Try again next legislative session.
cards.learningGoal: Judicial Review: (Unconstitutional, Struck down, Injunction).

cards.name: Puget Sound Real Estate
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support from angry renters.
cards.flavorText: A 900-square-foot house built in 1942 just sold for $1.2 million over asking price, all cash.
cards.learningGoal: Housing Crisis: (Over asking, All cash, Tear-down, Pricing out).

cards.name: The Evergreen State
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We love our trees, our mountains, and our ocean. We will outlast any political scandal.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Resilience: (Evergreen, Conservation, Enduring).

cards.name: The 'Top Two' Primary
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The top two candidates advance, regardless of party. You are now running against someone in your own party!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Mechanics: (Top-two primary, Intra-party, Advancing).

cards.name: Gubernatorial Emergency Powers
cards.flavorText: I am issuing a sweeping executive mandate. The eastern counties are suing me immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Authority: (Emergency powers, Mandate, Sweeping, Litigation).

cards.name: The Columbia River Gorge
cards.flavorText: We generate massive amounts of cheap, clean power from the dams. Take that, fossil fuels.
cards.learningGoal: Energy Infrastructure: (Hydroelectric, Dam, Renewable, Grid).

cards.name: Salmon Run Blocked
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: The federal courts ordered us to fix every culvert in the state so the salmon can swim. It costs billions.
