cards.learningGoal: Ecological Litigation: (Culvert, Spawning, Federal mandate, Remediation).

cards.name: The $15 Minimum Wage
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from labor, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We raised the wage before anyone else in the country. The sky did not, in fact, fall.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Experiments: (Minimum wage, Pilot program, Trailblazer).

cards.name: Yeah, No, For Sure
cards.flavorText: A confusing string of contradictory words that ultimately means: 'I agree with you.'
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Contradictions: Decoding casual regional affirmations.

cards.name: The Maverick
cards.flavorText: I belong to my party, but I belong to my conscience first. (And I will make sure the cameras know it).
cards.learningGoal: Defiant Rhetoric: (Buck the trend, Conscience, Maverick, Crossing the aisle).

cards.name: The Maricopa Moderate
cards.flavorText: Whoever wins the Phoenix suburbs wins the state. I am the center of the political universe.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Geography: (Bellwether, Suburbs, The center of gravity).

cards.name: The Sun City Retiree
cards.flavorText: I moved here from Chicago 20 years ago. Don't you dare touch my golf cart or my Medicare.
cards.learningGoal: Fixed-Income Priorities: (Entitlements, Snowbird, Relocated).

cards.name: The Audit Fanatic
cards.flavorText: I demand to inspect these ballots for bamboo fibers under a blacklight immediately!
cards.learningGoal: Conspiratorial Vocabulary: (Forensic audit, Bamboo fibers, Irregularities).

cards.name: The Tucson Progressive
cards.effect: Arts and Environment cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: We are an oasis of arts, culture, and progressivism surrounded by a very red desert.
cards.learningGoal: Enclave Phrasing: (Oasis, Progressive dot, Bohemian, Surrounded).

cards.name: The Border Hardliner
cards.flavorText: We are building the wall, we are deputizing the posse, and we are ignoring the federal courts.
cards.learningGoal: Authoritarian Toughness: (Posse, Jurisdiction, Hardline, Defiance).

cards.name: But It's a Dry Heat!
cards.flavorText: It is 118 degrees outside, but at least you aren't sweating through your shirt in Florida!
cards.learningGoal: Rationalization: Using comparative optimism to excuse extreme discomfort.

cards.name: The Haboob
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: A 5,000-foot-tall wall of dust has swallowed Phoenix. The sky is brown and the campaign is paused.
cards.learningGoal: Apocalyptic Weather: (Haboob, Zero visibility, Engulfed).

cards.name: Takes Three Weeks to Count
cards.effect: The game does not end at 50 points; play 3 more turns.
cards.flavorText: The election was on Tuesday, but we will not know the winner until Thanksgiving.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Stalling: (Tabulation, Provisional ballots, Curing the vote).

cards.name: August AC Bill
cards.flavorText: Your electricity bill for a 3-bedroom house is $650 this month. The voters are outraged.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Shock: (Surcharge, Kilowatt-hour, Sticker shock, Peak pricing).

cards.name: Sonoran Hot Dog Pandering
cards.flavorText: Eating a hot dog wrapped in bacon, smothered in pinto beans and jalapeño mayo to win the Latino vote.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Fusion: (Smothered, Bacon-wrapped, Cross-cultural).

cards.name: The California Exodus
cards.flavorText: Half of Los Angeles just moved to Scottsdale. The tax base is up, but the traffic is atrocious.
cards.learningGoal: Migration Jargon: (Exodus, Priced out, Equity refugees).

cards.name: No Daylight Saving Time
cards.flavorText: We do not change our clocks in this state. The sun tells us what time it is.
cards.learningGoal: Defiant Consistency: (Opting out, Time zone, Unchanging).

cards.name: Leaving the Party
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: The party has left me, so I am leaving the party. (And keeping my committee assignments).
cards.learningGoal: Political Schisms: (Disaffiliation, Partisan gridlock, Striking out alone).

cards.name: The HVAC Repairman
cards.flavorText: The air conditioning broke in July. The repairman is currently the most powerful man in the state.
cards.learningGoal: Lifesaver Tropes: (Essential worker, Breaking down, Lifeline).

cards.name: Colorado River Tier 2 Shortage
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: Lake Mead looks like a puddle. We are cutting water to the alfalfa farms immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Scarcity: (Rationing, Tier 2 shortage, Allocation, Aquifer).

cards.name: Monsoon Season
cards.effect: Both players discard half their hand.
cards.flavorText: It hasn't rained in six months, and now there is a raging river flowing through the local intersection.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Volatility: (Flash flood, Torrential, Washout).

cards.name: Banning Foreign Alfalfa Farms
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from rural voters, lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We are no longer letting foreign mega-corporations pump our desert dry to feed cows overseas!
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Protectionism: (Extraction, Groundwater, Exporting resources).

cards.name: Searing Seatbelt Buckle
cards.flavorText: You touched the metal part of your seatbelt in August and branded your forearm.
cards.learningGoal: Sensory Hyperbole: (Searing, Branded, Blistering heat).

cards.name: Saguaro Cactus Vandalism
cards.flavorText: You backed your campaign bus into a 150-year-old protected Saguaro. The locals are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Taboos: (Endangered, Vandalism, Felony offense).

cards.name: ASU vs UofA Rivalry
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: You wore a Sun Devils hat in Tucson. The crowd is immediately hostile.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Tribalism: (Territorial, Hostile territory, House divided).

cards.name: The Sedona Energy Vortex
cards.flavorText: I am taking a weekend to hike the red rocks and align my political chakras.
cards.learningGoal: New Age Vocabulary: (Energy vortex, Chakras, Healing aura, Mysticism).

cards.name: Golf Course in the Desert
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital, but lose 1 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: Yes, we live in a mega-drought, but this 18-hole championship golf course is essential for the economy!
cards.learningGoal: Cognitive Dissonance: (Mega-drought, Lush, Misallocation).

cards.name: The Late Drop Box Dump
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: Wait! We just found 40,000 mail-in ballots dropped off at the very last minute! The lead changes!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Suspense: (Ballot dump, Last-minute surge, Tally).

cards.name: Snowbird Traffic
cards.flavorText: It's January. 300,000 RVs from Alberta and Minnesota are currently doing 45 MPH on the freeway.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Congestion: (Migration, RV park, Leisurely pace).

cards.name: The Grand Canyon Backdrop
cards.flavorText: Delivering a speech on the edge of a mile-deep abyss to show my policies are 'monumental.'
cards.learningGoal: Geological Grandiosity: (Abyss, Monumental, Breathtaking scale).

cards.name: Checking Your Shoes for Scorpions
cards.flavorText: You forgot to shake out your boots and got stung. You will survive, but your pride won't.
cards.learningGoal: Desert Paranoia: (Arachnid, Sting, Hyper-vigilance).

cards.name: Turquoise Jewelry Flex
cards.flavorText: Wearing a massive silver and turquoise bolo tie to prove you understand the state's heritage.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Optics: (Bolo tie, Artisanal, Cultural heritage).

cards.name: The Navajo Nation
cards.flavorText: You do not win a statewide election without securing the massive, organizing power of the reservations.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Sovereignty: (Reservation, Sovereign, Organizing power).

cards.name: The LDS Voting Bloc
cards.effect: Provides +2 Support per turn from conservatives.
cards.flavorText: Highly organized, deeply community-oriented, and a crucial demographic in the East Valley.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Demographics: (Voting bloc, Community-oriented, Mobilization).

cards.name: The Tech Transplant Bro
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital per turn, but opponent gains +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: I moved my crypto startup from San Francisco to Chandler for the low taxes and the pool.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Hub Expansion: (Silicon Desert, Crypto, Startup ecosystem).

cards.name: The Copper Miners
cards.flavorText: We dig the largest holes on Earth to pull out the copper that builds the world.
cards.learningGoal: Extraction Terminology: (Open-pit, Smelting, Commodity).

cards.name: Paving the Desert
cards.flavorText: We just approved another 5,000-home subdivision in the middle of nowhere. Don't ask about the water.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Sprawl: (Master-planned, Subdivision, Paving paradise).

cards.name: Banning Fake Grass
cards.flavorText: The Homeowners Association just banned your astroturf. You must plant desert gravel instead.
cards.learningGoal: Xeriscape Language: (Astroturf, Xeriscape, Desert landscaping, Mandate).

cards.name: Tubing the Salt River
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's Saturday. Everyone has tied their inner tubes together and is drinking heavily on the river.
cards.learningGoal: Leisure Escapism: (Tubing, Sunburned, Flotilla).

cards.name: The Flagstaff Freeze
cards.flavorText: Tourists arrived in shorts, only to realize Northern Arizona sits at 7,000 feet and is buried in snow.
cards.learningGoal: Geographical Misconceptions: (Elevation, Alpine, Unprepared).

cards.name: The Old Guard Republicans
cards.effect: Blocks any Extreme attacks against you.
cards.flavorText: We believe in a strong military, free trade, and absolutely despising loudmouth populists.
cards.learningGoal: Establishment Phrasing: (Old Guard, Legacy, Traditionalist).

cards.name: The Phoenix Light Rail
cards.flavorText: It only goes in one straight line and takes 40 minutes, but hey, it has air conditioning!
cards.learningGoal: Urban Transit Sarcasm: (Limited route, Linear, Respite).

cards.name: The Gila Monster
cards.flavorText: Your campaign manager was bitten by a slow-moving, brightly colored venomous lizard.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Hazards: (Venomous, Sluggish, Warning colors).

cards.name: Chimichanga Origin Dispute
cards.flavorText: We invented the deep-fried burrito in Tucson! Don't let anyone from Sonora tell you otherwise!
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Claiming: (Origin story, Deep-fried, Disputed history).

cards.name: The Mega-Church Endorsement
cards.flavorText: The pastor implicitly endorsed you from a stage featuring a full rock band and three jumbotrons.
cards.learningGoal: Evangelical Optics: (Megachurch, Jumbotron, Implicit endorsement).

cards.name: Rattlesnake on the Trail
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You stepped too close to my legislation. Hear that rattle? Back away slowly.
cards.learningGoal: Defensive Metaphors: (Coiled, Warning rattle, Striking distance).

cards.name: The Tipping Point State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The entire nation is watching Maricopa County. The presidency comes down to our suburbs.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Decisiveness: (Tipping point, Ground zero, Margin of victory).

cards.name: Sheriff's Posse
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the base, lose 2 from moderates.
cards.flavorText: I am making the inmates wear pink and setting up tents in the 110-degree heat. Tough on crime!
cards.learningGoal: Performative Cruelty: (Tough on crime, Humiliation, Unorthodox methods).

cards.name: Border Wall Construction
cards.flavorText: We stacked a bunch of metal shipping containers on the border! (The federal government is making us remove them).
cards.learningGoal: Stunt Politics: (Makeshift, Shipping container, Federal injunction).

cards.name: The I-10 Exodus
cards.flavorText: It's a long weekend in July. Half of Phoenix is driving to the California beach. Traffic is stalled.
cards.learningGoal: Heat Evasion: (Exodus, Beating the heat, Mass migration).

cards.name: Route 66 Nostalgia
cards.flavorText: Campaigning in a classic diner in Winslow, Arizona. It's pure, unadulterated Americana.
cards.learningGoal: Americana Vocabulary: (Mother Road, Kitsch, Nostalgia, Historic route).

cards.name: The Cyber Ninjas
cards.effect: Both players must discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: An uncertified company from Florida is currently recounting our ballots in a rented coliseum. Pure chaos.
cards.learningGoal: Unorthodox Governance: (Uncertified, Bizarre, Circus atmosphere).

cards.name: Protect the Grid
cards.flavorText: The AC demand is too high. Please turn up your thermostat to 78 degrees so the state doesn't go dark.
cards.learningGoal: Energy Crisis: (Grid load, Brownout, Conservation, Thermostat).

cards.name: The Filibuster Defender
cards.flavorText: I don't care what my party wants; I am preserving the Senate rules because I love the institution!
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Loyalty: (Preservation, Norms, Institutionalist, Holding the line).

cards.name: The Boise Tech Bro
cards.flavorText: I sold my house in San Jose, bought three in Meridian, and now I'm complaining about the traffic I caused.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Economics: (Transplant, Equity flight, Driving up prices).

cards.name: The Panhandle Survivalist
cards.flavorText: We live in the woods near the Canadian border. We hoard canned goods, ammunition, and a profound distrust of the government.
cards.learningGoal: Isolationist Vocabulary: (Off the grid, Distrust, Stockpiling).

cards.name: The Potato Baron
cards.flavorText: We grow the russets that feed the fast-food empires of the world. Respect the spud, or lose your funding.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Hegemony: (Russet, Fast-food empire, Cash crop).

cards.name: The Mormon Corridor
cards.flavorText: Rexburg and Idaho Falls run on deep faith, large families, and absolute, organized political conservatism.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Unification: (Voting bloc, Faith-based, Corridor).

cards.name: Greater Idaho Secession
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: We are formally inviting the rural, conservative half of Oregon to secede and join our state! The map is changing!
cards.learningGoal: Geopolitical Separatism: (Secession, Annexation, Redrawing lines).

cards.name: The Smurf Turf
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind the blinding, incredibly distracting blue astroturf of the Boise State football stadium.
cards.learningGoal: Visual Distractions: (Astroturf, Blinding, Iconic).

cards.name: The Out-of-State License Plate
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: Your campaign manager was spotted driving a car with California plates. The locals are preparing the pitchforks.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Resentment: (Pitchforks, Outsider status, Scowl).

cards.name: Wolf Reintroduction
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 4 from ranchers.
cards.flavorText: The wolves are back in the mountains! The ecologists are weeping with joy; the cattlemen are loading their rifles.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Flashpoints: (Reintroduction, Apex predator, Livestock depredation).

cards.name: Craters of the Moon
cards.flavorText: You are hiding in a 400-square-mile field of jagged, black volcanic rock. The press physically cannot reach you.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Isolation: (Lava field, Volcanic, Impassable).

cards.name: Basque Block Block-Party
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a city ordinance while eating croquetas and drinking Kalimotxo in downtown Boise.
cards.learningGoal: Diaspora Heritage: (Basque, Culinary diplomacy, Old World).

cards.name: The Hells Canyon Dam
cards.flavorText: We dammed the deepest river gorge in North America. The hydroelectric power keeps the state running and the salmon angry.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Standoffs: (Hydroelectric, Gorge, Ecological cost).

cards.name: The 150-Mile Commute
cards.flavorText: You are trying to drive from Nampa to Boise at 8 AM. The farmland is now subdivisions, and the highway is a parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Gridlock: (Sprawl, Bedroom community, Bottleneck).

cards.name: The 'Don't Move Here' Billboard
cards.flavorText: We paid for a billboard in Los Angeles telling people our state is terrible and full of bears. Stay away.
cards.learningGoal: Reverse Psychology: (Gatekeeping, Unwelcoming, Protecting the secret).

cards.name: Fry Sauce
cards.flavorText: Mixing ketchup and mayonnaise to win the hearts of the voters near the Utah border. It's an essential political strategy.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Condiments: (Fry sauce, Spillover culture, Essential).

cards.name: The Public Lands Fight
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from locals, lose 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The federal government owns 60% of our state! We are suing to get the forests and the mountains back!
cards.learningGoal: Federal Standoffs: (Encroachment, Federal land, Sovereignty).

cards.name: Wildfire Smoke
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The forests are burning. The sky is orange. You cannot breathe outside. The campaign moves entirely indoors.
cards.learningGoal: Climatic Realities: (Haze, Air Quality Index, Stifling).

cards.name: The Elk Hunt
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It is elk season. The legislature is empty, the businesses are closed, and half the state is walking through the mountains in camouflage.
cards.learningGoal: Sporting Truancy: (Sabbatical, Big game, Camouflage).

cards.name: The Supermajority
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: There are effectively zero Democrats in the statehouse. The only real political fights happen in the Republican primary.
cards.learningGoal: One-Party Dominance: (Supermajority, Steamroll, Internal factions).

cards.name: Grizzly Bear Encounter
cards.flavorText: A massive grizzly bear just walked through your outdoor fundraiser in Island Park. The donors are fleeing in terror.
cards.learningGoal: Apex Predators: (Encounter, Fleeing, Untamed).

cards.name: The Right-to-Work Law
cards.flavorText: We made it incredibly hard to form a union here. The corporate headquarters are flocking to our tax-friendly embrace.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Economics: (Union busting, Right-to-work, Corporate haven).

cards.name: The Potato Drop
cards.flavorText: Forget the Times Square ball. We drop a massive, glowing, fiberglass potato from a crane at midnight. Pure Idaho magic.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Kitsch: (Fiberglass, Novelty, Ringing in the year).

cards.name: Sun Valley Billionaires
cards.flavorText: Fundraising at a private ski lodge surrounded by tech CEOs and Hollywood celebrities hiding from the paparazzi.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Retreats: (Sun Valley, Paparazzi, Exclusive resort).

cards.name: The Sugar Beet Harvest
cards.flavorText: The harvest is in! The factories are boiling the beets, and the entire town smells like burnt sugar and cash.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Processing: (Sugar beet, Refining, Burnt sugar).

cards.name: The Gem State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We pull star garnets, silver, and gold from the earth! We are rugged, wealthy, and unstoppable!
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Pride: (The Gem State, Mineral wealth, Unstoppable).

cards.name: The Library Book Ban
cards.flavorText: The legislature is trying to ban certain books from the public libraries. The national media is having a field day.
cards.learningGoal: Censorship Debates: (Culture war, Scrutiny, Field day).

cards.name: The 80 MPH Speed Limit
cards.flavorText: Driving across the southern desert on I-84. The speed limit is 80, but you are doing 95 and haven't seen a cop in three hours.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Velocity: (Desolate, Speed limit, Covering ground).

cards.name: The Shoshone-Bannock Tribes
cards.flavorText: You must negotiate with the sovereign nations if you want to route your highway or your pipeline through the east.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Sovereignty: (Sovereign nation, Routing, Negotiation).

cards.name: The Recall Election
cards.flavorText: The local school board meeting devolved into a screaming match, and now the entire town is holding a recall election.
cards.learningGoal: Grassroots Volatility: (Recall, Screaming match, Devolved).

cards.name: The Nuclear Lab
cards.flavorText: We have a massive national laboratory in the desert quietly inventing the next generation of nuclear reactors.
cards.learningGoal: Scientific Secrecy: (National lab, Next-generation, Isolated).

cards.name: The 'Idaho Stop'
cards.flavorText: A cyclist legally treats a stop sign as a yield sign. You use this legal loophole to roll right past your opponent's attack.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Nuance: (The Idaho Stop, Loophole, Rolling through).

cards.name: The Wilderness Area
cards.flavorText: You tried to campaign in the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness. You are hiking. It will take weeks.
cards.learningGoal: Untamed Geography: (Wilderness designation, Motorless, Remote).

cards.name: The Property Tax Freeze
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We are freezing property taxes because the housing market exploded! (The local municipalities are now completely broke).
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Unintended Consequences: (Exploded market, Freezing rates, Broke).

cards.name: The Snake River Canyon Jump
cards.flavorText: You attempted a massive, flashy political stunt. You crashed into the canyon, but the voters respect the sheer audacity.
cards.learningGoal: Spectacle Politics: (Audacity, Stunt, Crashing and burning).

cards.name: The Militia Compound
cards.flavorText: An armed anti-government group just set up a compound in your district. The FBI is circling. Your polls are plummeting.
cards.learningGoal: Extremist Fallouts: (Militia, Compound, Standoff).

cards.name: The Napoleon Dynamite Festival
cards.flavorText: Selling 'Vote for Pedro' shirts to tourists in a tiny southeastern farming town. It's a reliable, if weird, revenue stream.
cards.learningGoal: Cinematic Nostalgia: (Cult classic, Nostalgia, Revenue stream).

cards.name: The Chukar Hunt
cards.flavorText: You went hunting for game birds on a 60-degree rocky incline. You twisted your ankle and ruined your campaign shoes.
cards.learningGoal: Rugged Leisure: (Chukar, Incline, Treacherous).

cards.name: The Californian Exodus
cards.effect: Provides +3 Capital, but opponent gains +1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: They sold their shack in LA for $1.5 million and bought a mansion in Eagle in cash. The resentment is palpable.
cards.learningGoal: Real Estate Economics: (Exodus, All-cash, Palpable resentment).

cards.name: The Dairy Boom
cards.flavorText: We brought the massive Greek yogurt factory to Twin Falls! The dairy farmers are thrilled, and the economy is creamy.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Processing: (Greek yogurt, Dairy boom, Value-add).

cards.name: The Whitewater Rafting Trip
cards.flavorText: Navigating Class V rapids with major donors. It shows you are brave, outdoorsy, and willing to risk their lives for cash.
cards.learningGoal: Adventure Philanthropy: (Whitewater, Class V, Outdoorsy).

cards.name: The Sagebrush Rebellion
cards.flavorText: We are reviving the 1970s movement to kick the federal government off our land! The ranchers are fully mobilized!
cards.learningGoal: Ideological Revivals: (Sagebrush Rebellion, Mobilized, State's rights).

cards.name: The Huckleberry Shake
cards.flavorText: Drinking a thick, purple milkshake made from wild mountain berries. It is impossible to be angry while drinking this.
cards.learningGoal: Foraged Delicacies: (Huckleberry, Foraged, Impossible to be angry).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislative session is only three months long. It's the final day, and they are passing bills at blinding speed.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Pacing: (Short session, Blinding speed, Sine die).

cards.name: The Silver Mine
cards.flavorText: A historic mining town in the Panhandle where prostitution was tolerated until the 1990s. The history is gritty and lucrative.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Grit: (Silver boomtown, Tolerated vice, Lucrative).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Billionaire
cards.flavorText: A billionaire from Texas bought 100,000 acres, fenced it off, and is now funding your entire reelection campaign.
cards.learningGoal: Land Consolidation: (Private ranch, Fenced off, Consolidation).

cards.name: The 'Famous Potatoes' License Plate
cards.flavorText: We put it on every single car in the state. We lean into the stereotype. We own the starch.
cards.learningGoal: Embracing Stereotypes: (Inescapable, Starch, Leaning in).

cards.name: The Highway 55 Crawl
cards.flavorText: Everyone in Boise is trying to drive up to McCall for the weekend. The two-lane mountain road is a parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Congestion: (Cabin weekend, Two-lane road, Congestion).

cards.name: The Religious Exemption
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the base, alienate national media.
cards.flavorText: We have a law protecting parents who use prayer instead of medicine. The national media is horrified, but it won't be repealed.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Exemptions: (Faith healing, Shield law, Horrified).

cards.name: The Tipping Point State
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We aren't a swing state. We are the deepest red wall in the West. The conservative momentum is absolute and unstoppable!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Certainty: (Red wall, Absolute, Unstoppable).

cards.name: The Lentil Festival
cards.flavorText: Eating a bowl of lentil chili in Moscow to secure the university vote. It's healthy, cheap, and very boring.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Legumes: (Lentils, Boring but necessary, The border).

cards.name: The 'Californication' Fear
cards.flavorText: You accused your opponent of trying to turn Idaho into California. It is the single most devastating insult in the state.
cards.learningGoal: Fear Mongering: (Californication, Devastating insult, Culture war).

cards.name: The Beacon Hill Boss
cards.flavorText: Nothing passes in this building without my explicit, behind-closed-doors permission.
cards.learningGoal: Oligarchic Phrasing: (Consensus, Closed doors, Power broker, Rubber stamp).

cards.name: The Harvard Academic
cards.effect: Tech and Education cards grant +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: According to my 400-page peer-reviewed study, your practical solution is theoretically flawed.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Register: (Peer-reviewed, Theoretical framework, Empirically unsound).

cards.name: The Townie
cards.effect: Immune to attacks from Out-of-State Factions.
cards.flavorText: I’ve lived in Charlestown my whole life, and I will not let you build a luxury condo on my corner!
cards.learningGoal: Anti-Gentrification Slang: (Priced out, Yuppies, Preserving the neighborhood).

cards.name: The Moderate Republican
cards.flavorText: I am a Republican who believes in climate change, healthcare, and ignoring the national party completely.
cards.learningGoal: Political Triangulation: (Fiscally conservative, Socially moderate, Bipartisan).

cards.name: The Western Mass Exile
cards.flavorText: Boston politicians think the state ends at Worcester. We have mountains and farms out here!
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Alienation: (Forgotten half, The Turnpike, Western divide).

cards.name: The Kennedy Scion
cards.flavorText: I have the jawline, the accent, and the fundraising network. It is my destiny to run.
cards.learningGoal: Dynastic Phrasing: (Lineage, Passing the torch, In the blood).

cards.name: Dunks Run
cards.flavorText: It is 14 degrees and snowing. I am holding a massive iced coffee in a styrofoam cup. I am invincible.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Brand Devotion: (Large iced, Extra extra, Liquid fuel).

cards.name: Storrowed!
cards.flavorText: A college student from out of state just drove a 12-foot U-Haul under a 10-foot bridge. Traffic is paralyzed.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Infrastructure Hazards: (Low clearance, Peeling the roof off, Gridlock).

cards.name: The Red Line is on Fire
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The subway train is literally smoking. Everyone is walking through the tunnels. Transit is dead.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Catastrophe: (Derailment, Shuttle buses, Systemic failure).

cards.name: Nor'easter
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The wind is howling off the Atlantic. Go to Market Basket and buy all the bread and milk.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Weather Panic: (Gale force, Stockpiling, Hunkering down).

cards.name: Wicked Smart
cards.flavorText: We have 114 colleges in this state. We are simply smarter than the rest of the country.
cards.learningGoal: Arrogant Superlatives: (Unmatched intellect, Hub of the Universe, Wicked smart).

cards.name: Taxachusetts
cards.flavorText: You proposed a 0.5% tax increase on millionaires, and the talk radio hosts are losing their minds.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Resentment: (Tax burden, Nickel and diming, Surtax).

cards.name: Prop 2½ Override
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, lose 2 Support from property owners.
cards.flavorText: We need to fund the new high school, which means everyone’s property taxes are going up. Fight!
cards.learningGoal: Local Governance: (Override, Levy limit, Municipal budget).

cards.name: The Cape Cod Bridges
cards.flavorText: It's Friday afternoon in July. You are stuck on the Sagamore Bridge for four agonizing hours.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Congestion: (Bottleneck, Summer people, Gridlock).

cards.name: Banning Happy Hour
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support from safety advocates, lose 1 from the youth.
cards.flavorText: Discounted drinks have been illegal here since 1984. We do not trust you to have cheap fun.
cards.learningGoal: Paternalistic Phrasing: (Public safety mandate, For your own good, Puritanical).

cards.name: The Big Dig Debt
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: We buried the highway 20 years ago, and we will be paying off the debt until the sun explodes.
cards.learningGoal: Megaproject Vocabulary: (Cost overrun, Debt servicing, Engineering marvel).

cards.name: Kendall Square Biotech
cards.flavorText: We are curing diseases and creating billionaires in a two-square-mile radius in Cambridge.
cards.learningGoal: Innovation Jargon: (Biotech, Life sciences, Venture capital, Incubation).

cards.name: Angry Sports Radio Caller
cards.flavorText: 'Hey Sully, first time caller. The Mayor's housing policy is a bigger disaster than the Patriots' offense!'
cards.learningGoal: Sports Metaphors in Politics: Blending athletic failure with policy critique.

cards.name: Allston Christmas
cards.effect: Both players discard half their hand.
cards.flavorText: 100,000 college students are moving on the exact same day. The streets are littered with abandoned futons.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Nightmare: (Lease turnover, Gridlock, Curbside scavenging).

cards.name: Space Savers
cards.flavorText: I shoveled this parking spot. I put a broken lawn chair in it. If you move it, I will destroy your car.
cards.learningGoal: Territorial Aggression: (Unwritten rules, Shoveled out, Retribution).

cards.name: The Golden Dome
cards.flavorText: I am hiding behind the thick, historic walls of Beacon Hill where transparency goes to die.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Protection: (Behind closed doors, Opaque, The Dome).

cards.name: Masshole Driver
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: Using a turn signal is giving information to the enemy. I am cutting across four lanes right now.
cards.learningGoal: Aggressive Maneuvering: (Cutting off, Right of way, Offensive driving).

cards.name: Clam Chowder Purity
cards.flavorText: If you put a tomato in the chowder, it is Manhattan style, and you are a traitor to the Commonwealth.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Authenticity, Cream-based, Sacrilege).

cards.name: Patriots Bandwagon
cards.flavorText: We won six Super Bowls. We expect our politicians to deliver the exact same level of ruthless victory.
cards.learningGoal: High Expectations: (Championship pedigree, Title town, Ruthless efficiency).

cards.name: Nantucket Fundraiser
cards.flavorText: Wearing Nantucket Reds and drinking cocktails on a yacht to secure millions in campaign cash.
cards.learningGoal: Ostentatious Wealth: (Old money, Yacht club, Exclusive access).

cards.name: Route 128 Corridor
cards.flavorText: Before Silicon Valley, there was Route 128. We still hold the patents and the defense contracts.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial History: (Tech corridor, Defense contractor, Innovation ecosystem).

cards.name: Berkshire Retreat
cards.flavorText: Listening to the Boston Symphony Orchestra on a manicured lawn to show you appreciate 'high culture.'
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Leisure: (High culture, Summer home, Refined tastes).

cards.name: The Spirit of America
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We started the American Revolution. You are welcome for your democracy.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Arrogance: (Cradle of Liberty, Birthplace of freedom, Superiority).

cards.name: Pahk the Cah
cards.flavorText: You mocked my accent, but you accidentally alienated the entire working-class voting bloc.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Shibboleths: (Dropping the R, Broad A, Working-class identifier).

cards.name: Blue Laws
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Economic cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's Sunday morning. You can't buy a car and the liquor stores open late. Go to church.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Regulations: (Blue laws, Sabbath restrictions, Holdover).

cards.name: The Teachers Union
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but costs 1 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: We control the school boards and the state legislature. Do not mess with the curriculum.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Dominance: (Voting bloc, Collective bargaining, Uncompromising).

cards.name: Ivy League Endowment
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Economic attacks next turn.
cards.flavorText: Harvard has a $50 billion endowment. They are basically a hedge fund that occasionally teaches classes.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Wealth: (Endowment, Tax-exempt, Hedge fund).

cards.name: Faneuil Hall Pandering
cards.effect: Gain +1 Support, but lose 1 Capital to overpriced food.
cards.flavorText: Shaking hands near a guy playing the keytar while eating an $18 lobster roll.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Clichés: (Overpriced, Cobblestones, Pandering to the cameras).

cards.name: The Seaport District
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: We built a sterile, glass-and-steel neighborhood for billionaires that will absolutely flood in 20 years.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification & Climate: (Sterile, Sea-level rise, Corporate architecture).

cards.name: Irish Catholic Voting Bloc
cards.flavorText: They don't make them like they used to, but if you win Dorchester and Southie, you win the city.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Loyalty: (Old neighborhood, Parish, Traditional bloc).

cards.name: The Green Monster
cards.effect: Block an Attack card costing 3 or less.
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind a 37-foot-tall green wall to stop the opponent's momentum dead in its tracks.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Metaphors: (Looming presence, Home field advantage, Impenetrable).

cards.name: Vetoing the Legislature
cards.flavorText: The Democratic legislature passed a massive tax bill. The Republican governor vetoed it. The cycle continues.
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Gridlock: (Veto power, Check and balance, Divided government).

cards.name: The Commuter Rail
cards.flavorText: The train to Worcester is delayed due to 'slippery rail conditions.' You are stranded in Framingham.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Excuses: (Slippery rail, Signal issue, Stranded).

cards.name: Town vs. Gown
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in college towns.
cards.flavorText: The university bought another tax-exempt building. The local taxpayers are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Municipal Conflict: (Town and gown, Tax base erosion, Institutional expansion).

cards.name: The Smear Campaign
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: We don't have proof, but we are accusing you of political witchcraft. The hysteria has consumed the electorate.
cards.learningGoal: Paranoia and Hysteria: (Witch hunt, Baseless accusation, Mob mentality).

cards.name: The Pike Tolls
cards.flavorText: They promised the tolls would disappear once the Mass Pike was paid off in the 80s. They lied.
cards.learningGoal: Broken Promises: (Toll gantry, Revenue stream, Broken trust).

cards.name: Candlepin Bowling
cards.flavorText: Throwing a grapefruit-sized ball at skinny wooden pins to prove you are an authentic New Englander.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Regional Hobbies: (Candlepin, Authentic, Oddity).

cards.name: Worcester Resurgence
cards.flavorText: We are the second biggest city in New England, we got the minor league baseball team, and we demand respect!
cards.learningGoal: Secondary City Pride: (Revitalization, Chip on the shoulder, Up-and-coming).

cards.name: The Revolutionary Heritage
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We threw the tea in the harbor! We fired the shot heard 'round the world! We yield to no one!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (Revolutionary, Rebellion, Yield to no one).

cards.name: The 'Pork' Earmark
cards.flavorText: I secured $2 million for a completely unnecessary gazebo in my district. My reelection is guaranteed.
cards.learningGoal: Pork Barrel Politics: (Earmark, Bringing home the bacon, Discretionary spending).

cards.name: South Coast Wind Farm
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from environmentalists, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We are building massive wind turbines off Martha's Vineyard. The rich people are complaining about the view.
cards.learningGoal: Green Energy Conflicts: (Offshore wind, Viewshed, NIMBYism).

cards.name: The Registry of Motor Vehicles
cards.flavorText: You need to renew your license. You took a number. You will be sitting in this plastic chair until you die.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Purgatory: (Inefficiency, Taking a number, Soul-crushing wait).

cards.name: The Boston Marathon
cards.flavorText: Running 26.2 miles to show your absolute grit, resilience, and refusal to quit. Boston Strong.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Resilience: (Grit, Endurance, Boston Strong, Unbreakable).

cards.name: The Mayflower Lineage
cards.flavorText: My ancestors came over on the Mayflower. Your petty scandals cannot penetrate my social standing.
cards.learningGoal: Old Money Arrogance: (Mayflower descendant, Brahmin, Untouchable prestige).

cards.name: The Shovel-Ready Project
cards.flavorText: We secured federal funding! The bridge will be fixed in a decade, maybe!
cards.learningGoal: Federal Bureaucracy: (Shovel-ready, Grant funding, Delayed timelines).

cards.name: The Nashville Transplant
cards.effect: Tech and Corporate cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: I just moved here from Los Angeles! I bought a $1.2 million tall-skinny house and a cowboy hat!
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Slang: (Tall-skinny, 'It City', Transplant, Cost of living).

cards.name: The Bluff City Boss
cards.flavorText: We are a blue city in a red state, and we sit on the mighty Mississippi. Don't ignore the Delta.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Defiance: (Bluff City, The Delta, Blue dot).

cards.name: The Appalachian Populist
cards.flavorText: From Knoxville to the Tri-Cities, we handle our own business. The state capital feels a million miles away.
cards.learningGoal: Isolationist Pride: (Handling our own, Mountain folk, Far removed).

cards.name: The Bachelorette
cards.effect: Chaotic: Randomly delays 1 card per turn.
cards.flavorText: She is wearing matching pink cowboy boots and screaming out of a roofless party bus. Traffic has stopped.
cards.learningGoal: Bachelorette Jargon: (Woo-girl, Matching outfits, Party foul).

cards.name: The Music Row Exec
cards.effect: Arts and Media cards grant +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: I can make you a superstar by Friday, but I own your masters for the next 40 years.
cards.learningGoal: Music Industry Vocabulary: (Masters, Royalties, Superstar, Contractual).

cards.name: The SEC Head Coach
cards.flavorText: I make $9 million a year. The Governor calls *me* for advice on Saturday mornings.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Power: (Head coach, SEC, State employee, Overpaid).

cards.name: The Three Grand Divisions
cards.flavorText: West, Middle, and East. Three entirely different states stapled together by the General Assembly.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Fragmentation: (Grand Divisions, Stapled together, Distinct cultures).

cards.name: No State Income Tax
cards.flavorText: We don't tax your paycheck! We just tax your groceries at 9.75% instead. Welcome to the South!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Irony: (Income tax, Sales tax, Regressive, Haven).

cards.name: Hot Chicken Pandering
cards.flavorText: You ordered the 'Poultrygeist' spice level for a photo op. You are currently weeping on live television.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Hubris: (Spice tolerance, Weeping, Sweating it out).

cards.name: Singing Rocky Top
cards.flavorText: Once the banjo kicks in, 100,000 people will sing about a moonshine still. It is deeply intimidating.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Intimidation: (Banjo, Anthem, Unison).

cards.name: Pedal Tavern Traffic Jam
cards.flavorText: Fifteen tourists are slowly pedaling a mobile bar at 3 mph. Downtown is completely paralyzed.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Nuisances: (Mobile bar, Pedal tavern, Gridlock).

cards.name: The Supermajority Flex
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We have a supermajority. We don't need your votes, your debate, or your microphone.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Dominance: (Supermajority, Steamroll, Gaveling down).

cards.name: Bipartisan Dolly Worship
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: There is only one thing every single Tennessean agrees on: Dolly Parton is a national treasure.
cards.learningGoal: Universal Reverence: (Patron saint, National treasure, Unifying figure).

cards.name: TVA Dam Release
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but lose 1 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: The Tennessee Valley Authority controls the river, the power, and the entire regional economy.
cards.learningGoal: New Deal Legacy: (TVA, Hydroelectric, Federal authority).

cards.name: Memphis BBQ Pandering
cards.flavorText: Eating a rack of dry-rubbed ribs on Beale Street while trying not to ruin your expensive suit.
cards.learningGoal: Messy Optics: (Dry rub, Smoked meat, Bib required).

cards.name: I-24 Gridlock
cards.flavorText: You moved to the suburbs for cheaper housing. You now spend your entire life staring at taillights.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Despair: (Exurbs, Taillights, Interstate backup).

cards.name: Swallowed by Kudzu
cards.translation: The Vine That Ate the South
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: The invasive green vines have completely covered your campaign billboards. Nature is reclaiming the state.
cards.learningGoal: Botanical Metaphors: (Invasive, Encroaching, Reclaiming).

cards.name: Jack Daniel's Dry County
cards.flavorText: We distill the most famous whiskey in the world here, but it's illegal to buy a glass of it in this county.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Irony: (Dry county, Distilling, Paradox).

cards.name: FedEx Hub Logistics
cards.flavorText: Every package in America flies through Memphis at 2 AM. Do not interrupt the global supply chain.
cards.learningGoal: Logistics Terminology: (Hub, Cargo, Supply chain, Overnight shipping).

cards.name: The Batman Building
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind the iconic, slightly ominous skyline of the Music City.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Nicknames: Using visual shorthand for landmarks.

cards.name: Brood X Cicadas
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Media cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: Trillions of bugs just emerged from the ground. Their screaming is drowning out all political ads.
cards.learningGoal: Biblical Plagues: (Swarm, Emerge, Deafening).

cards.name: Williamson County Elite
cards.effect: Provides +3 Capital, but leaves if you play an Extreme card.
cards.flavorText: Franklin is full of country music stars, tech executives, and very intense HOA presidents.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Affluence: (Elite, Gated community, High-income bracket).

cards.name: Smoky Mountain Cabin Rental
cards.flavorText: We built an 8-bedroom cabin on a 45-degree incline and charge tourists $800 a night to see a black bear.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Economics: (Rental market, Tourist trap, Scenic overlook).

cards.name: The Volunteer Navy
cards.flavorText: A flotilla of 200 boats is parked outside Neyland Stadium. The cocktails are flowing and the votes are secured.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Tailgating: (Flotilla, Moored, Pre-game rituals).

cards.name: Oak Ridge Scientists
cards.flavorText: We literally helped build the atomic bomb, and now we run supercomputers. Respect the nerds.
cards.learningGoal: Scientific Legacy: (National lab, Supercomputer, Classified history).

cards.name: Country Music Association
cards.flavorText: 100,000 country music fans wearing boots in 95-degree heat just shut down the entire city core.
cards.learningGoal: Event Chaos: (Blockade, Swarm, Festival season).

cards.name: The Expulsion
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: You broke decorum, so we are literally voting to expel you from the legislature entirely!
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Extremes: (Expulsion, Decorum, Nuclear option, Ousted).

cards.name: Moonshine Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Drinking 100-proof clear liquid out of a jar in the woods to finalize a highway funding bill.
cards.learningGoal: Bootlegger Lore: (Moonshine, White lightning, Appalachian tradition).

cards.name: The 'Meat and Three'
cards.flavorText: Fried catfish, mac and cheese, collard greens, and banana pudding. You'll need a nap, but you won the precinct.
cards.learningGoal: Southern Cuisine: (Meat and three, Comfort food, Caloric surplus).

cards.name: The Bristol Night Race
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: 160,000 people watching stock cars drive in a tiny circle. The noise is political power.
cards.learningGoal: Motorsports Pandering: (Short track, Stock cars, Deafening).

cards.name: Natchez Trace Joyride
cards.flavorText: The speed limit is 50 mph strictly enforced by federal rangers. You are going to be late.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Jurisdiction: (Parkway, Strictly enforced, Federal rangers).

cards.name: Bonnaroo Mud
cards.flavorText: You tried to campaign at the music festival, but your SUV sank into a foot of psychedelic mud.
cards.learningGoal: Counterculture Clashes: (Psychedelic, Quagmire, Festival grounds).

cards.name: The Corporate Relocation
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: A massive corporation just moved its headquarters here to escape taxes. The housing market is ruined.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Flight: (Relocation, Tax haven, Driving up the market).

cards.name: Fixin' To
cards.flavorText: I'm not doing it right now, but I'm 'fixin' to' get to that legislation eventually.
cards.learningGoal: Southern Syntax: (Fixin' to, Preparing to, Procrastination).

cards.name: Gospel Choir Endorsement
cards.flavorText: If the choir director nods at you during the solo, you have won the congregation.
cards.learningGoal: Spiritual Politics: (Choir, Congregation, Tacit approval).

cards.name: The Pothole on I-440
cards.flavorText: They 'fixed' the highway, but your campaign bus just hit a crater and blew two tires.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Gripes: (Suspension, Crater, Patch job).

cards.name: Blue Oval City
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, lose 2 Support from rural locals.
cards.flavorText: We gave Ford billions to build an electric truck plant in West Tennessee! The farmers are very confused.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Mega-Projects: (Mega-site, EV transition, Tax incentive).

cards.name: Vanderbilt Academia
cards.flavorText: We are the Ivy League of the South. We cost $80,000 a year and mostly stay on campus.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Elitism: (Endowment, Prestige, Bubble).

cards.name: The Grand Ole Opry
cards.flavorText: Stepping into the famous wooden circle on stage to prove you respect the roots of the music.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Reverence: (The Circle, Roots, Hallowed ground).

cards.name: Charter School Expansion
cards.effect: Spend 2 Capital, gain 3 Support from conservatives.
cards.flavorText: We are diverting public money to private charter schools! The teachers' unions are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Educational Policy: (Vouchers, Charter schools, Public funding).

cards.name: The State Fair Deep Fryer
cards.flavorText: I am eating a deep-fried Goo Goo Cluster. Please call my cardiologist.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Excess: (Deep-fried, Goo Goo Cluster, Artery-clogging).

cards.name: The Delta Blues
cards.flavorText: You don't understand Tennessee until you've heard a blues guitar crying at midnight in Memphis.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Soul: (The Blues, Beale Street, Melancholy).

cards.name: The Volunteer Spirit
cards.flavorText: We earned our name by volunteering to fight when the country needed us. We never back down!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Nicknames: (The Volunteer State, Stepping up, Unwavering).

cards.name: Californian License Plates
cards.flavorText: You were spotted driving a car with California plates. The locals are side-eyeing you heavily.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Suspicion: (Transplant, Out-of-stater, Driving up rent).

cards.name: The Bourbon Trail Spillover
cards.flavorText: Kentucky gets the credit, but the tourists are drinking plenty of our sour mash down here too.
cards.learningGoal: Liquor Economics: (Sour mash, Distilling, Spillover tourism).

cards.name: The Parthenon Replica
cards.flavorText: We built a full-scale replica of the Greek Parthenon in Nashville because... well, why not?
cards.learningGoal: Civic Oddities: (Replica, Classical architecture, The Athens of the South).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Oh, you think that little tax plan is going to pass? Well, bless your heart.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: Using extreme courtesy to deliver a devastating insult.

cards.name: The Legislative Session Ends
cards.flavorText: They drop the gavel and everyone runs out of the building. Pass the bills quickly!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Adjournment: (Sine Die, Gavel drop, Running out the clock).

cards.name: Dollywood Surcharge
cards.flavorText: The gateway to the Smokies is a neon-lit strip of pancake houses and mini-golf. It prints money.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Strip: (Neon-lit, Tourist trap, Printing money).

cards.name: The SEC Championship
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Our team made it to Atlanta! The entire state is euphoric and ready to vote for whoever is wearing our colors!
cards.learningGoal: Sports Euphoria: (Championship game, Wearing the colors, Riding the high).

cards.name: The Greenwich Hedge Funder
cards.effect: Start with +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support.
cards.flavorText: My property taxes could fund a small nation, and I will absolutely sue the state over affordable housing zoning.
cards.learningGoal: Wealth Jargon: (Hedge fund, Zoning, Elite, Gold Coast).

cards.name: The Hartford Actuary
cards.flavorText: We don't take risks here. We calculate the exact probability of your political failure and adjust our premiums accordingly.
cards.learningGoal: Risk Assessment: (Actuary, Premiums, Calculating risk).

cards.name: The New Haven Pizza Purist
cards.flavorText: It is called 'Apizza.' The crust is charred, not burnt. If you ask for a slice instead of a whole pie, get out.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Charred, Apizza, Purist, Sacrilege).

cards.name: The Quiet Corner Recluse
cards.flavorText: We live in the woods near the Rhode Island border. We like antiques and we want absolutely nothing to do with Fairfield County.
cards.learningGoal: Isolationist Geography: (Quiet Corner, Recluse, Antique economy).

cards.name: The Metro-North Commuter
cards.flavorText: I pay $4,000 a year to sit on a train for three hours a day. Please, for the love of God, upgrade the Wi-Fi.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Anguish: (Expat, Monthly pass, Metro-North, Exorbitant).

cards.name: UConn Hoops Dynasty
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The state is completely divided on everything except the absolute, ruthless dominance of Huskies basketball.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Unification: (Dynasty, Unifying force, Ruthless dominance).

cards.name: Eversource Rate Hike
cards.flavorText: Your delivery charge was somehow triple the cost of your actual electricity usage. Your campaign is bankrupt.
cards.learningGoal: Monopoly Frustration: (Rate hike, Delivery charge, Monopoly).

cards.name: I-95 Gridlock
cards.flavorText: A semi-truck jackknifed in Bridgeport. The entire eastern seaboard is now parked on the interstate.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Catastrophe: (Gridlock, Jackknifed, Eastern seaboard).

cards.name: Merritt Parkway Tree Branch
cards.flavorText: You were driving 70 mph on a scenic, 1930s highway with no shoulder, and a massive oak branch fell on your car.
cards.learningGoal: Historic Infrastructure: (Scenic highway, No shoulder, White-knuckle).

cards.name: Moving to Boca Raton
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: The millionaires got tired of the estate tax and officially changed their residency to Florida. The state budget is in shambles.
cards.learningGoal: Capital Flight: (Estate tax, Residency, Shambles).

cards.name: White Clam Apizza Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a ceasefire over a clam and garlic pizza. The grease burns the roof of your mouth, but the deal is struck.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Diplomacy: (White clam pie, Ceasefire, Historic rivalry).

cards.name: Warm Buttered Lobster Roll
cards.flavorText: Maine uses cold mayonnaise. We use warm, melted butter. We are simply more sophisticated than the rest of New England.
cards.learningGoal: Sophisticated Pandering: (Melted butter, Superiority, Coastal cuisine).

cards.name: The Yankees/Red Sox Line
cards.flavorText: South of Hartford is New York territory. North of Hartford is Boston territory. The state has a severe identity crisis.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Schisms: (Divided loyalties, Identity crisis, Cultural border).

cards.name: Yale Secret Society
cards.effect: See opponent's hand and steal 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The real decisions aren't made in the State Capitol. They are made in a windowless tomb in New Haven.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Conspiracies: (Secret society, Windowless tomb, True power).

cards.name: The Gilmore Girls Aesthetic
cards.flavorText: You drank coffee in a quaint town gazebo surrounded by colorful autumn leaves. The tourists are practically throwing money at you.
cards.learningGoal: Fictional Idealism: (Aesthetic, Quaint, Gazebo, Autumnal).

cards.name: Suing Over 'The Notch'
cards.flavorText: We are formally demanding that Massachusetts return the 2.5-square-mile chunk of land they stole from us in 1804!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Grievances: (The Notch, Border dispute, Cartographic theft).

cards.name: Electric Boat Submarines
cards.flavorText: We build the most advanced nuclear submarines on the planet in Groton. The Pentagon lobby sends its regards.
cards.learningGoal: Military-Industrial Dominance: (Nuclear submarine, Electric Boat, Naval dominance).

cards.name: Sikorsky Helicopters
cards.flavorText: We build the Black Hawks. Keep the federal defense spending high, and Stratford will vote for you forever.
cards.learningGoal: Aviation Defense: (Black Hawk, Federal spending, Manufacturing base).

cards.name: Foxwoods & Mohegan Sun
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from purists.
cards.flavorText: The two massive tribal casinos in the woods basically funded the state government for a decade.
cards.learningGoal: Vice Revenue: (Tribal sovereignty, Slot revenue, Budget shortfall).

cards.name: County Government? Never Heard of It
cards.flavorText: We abolished county governments in 1960. Every single one of our 169 towns fights exclusively for itself!
cards.learningGoal: Governance Quirks: (Abolished, Municipal independence, Hyper-local).

cards.name: The Mill Rate Reassessment
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: The town just reassessed the property values. Your opponent's base is facing a massive, unexpected tax hike.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Terminology: (Mill rate, Reassessment, Tax burden).

cards.name: Return of the Highway Tolls
cards.flavorText: You merely *suggested* putting toll booths back on the highways. The voters are ready to riot in the streets.
cards.learningGoal: Political Third Rails: (Toll gantry, Backlash, Untouchable policy).

cards.name: Bradley Airport Layover
cards.flavorText: It's not JFK or Logan, but the security line is five minutes long and you don't have to pay a toll to get there.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Relief: (Alternative hub, Low-stress, Accessibility).

cards.name: Naugatuck Valley Rust
cards.flavorText: Waterbury used to make the brass for the entire world. The factories are empty, but the voters still demand respect.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Decline: (Brass City, Deindustrialization, Blue-collar pride).

cards.name: Vineyard Vines Wardrobe
cards.flavorText: Wearing a pastel quarter-zip and a belt with little pink whales on it. You are immune to accusations of being out-of-touch, somehow.
cards.learningGoal: Preppy Aesthetics: (Pastel, Quarter-zip, Preppy, Uniform).

cards.name: The Steamed Cheeseburger
cards.flavorText: Eating a burger where both the meat and the cheese are cooked in a steam box. It looks terrifying, but the locals respect it.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Regional Fast Food: (Steamed, Oddity, Gelatinous cheese).

cards.name: WFSB Snow Closing Ticker
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: Everyone is glued to the bottom of the TV screen to see if their town's schools are closed. Politics must wait.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Anticipation: (Ticker, School closure, Snow day).

cards.name: Bear in the Trash Can
cards.flavorText: A 400-pound black bear is currently eating last night's takeout from your suburban driveway.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Wildlife: (Foraging, Encroachment, Nuisance).

cards.name: The Commuter Tax Battle
cards.flavorText: We are suing the state of New York for trying to tax our residents who work from home! Stand your ground!
cards.learningGoal: Interstate Taxation: (Telecommuting, Double taxation, Jurisdictional overreach).

cards.name: Charter Oak Metaphor
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We hid our charter in a tree to defy the British in 1687! We are the Constitution State, and we bow to no one!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (Charter Oak, Hiding the document, Bow to no one).

cards.name: Pez Dispenser Heritage
cards.flavorText: Funding your campaign with the bizarre, nostalgic tourist dollars from the Pez candy factory.
cards.learningGoal: Nostalgic Manufacturing: (Novelty, Candy dispenser, Kitsch).

cards.name: Sailboat Diplomacy
cards.flavorText: If you want the hedge-fund money, you have to attend the regatta in a pair of deck shoes without socks.
cards.learningGoal: Nautical Networking: (Regatta, Long Island Sound, Deck shoes).

cards.name: Tweed Airport Expansion
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the city.
cards.flavorText: You approved a longer runway in New Haven. The wealthy neighborhood next door is launching a barrage of lawsuits.
cards.learningGoal: Aviation NIMBYism: (Runway expansion, Noise ordinance, Barrage of lawsuits).

cards.name: Grinder vs. Sub
cards.flavorText: If you walk into a deli in this state and ask for a 'hoagie,' you will be deported to Pennsylvania. It's a grinder.
cards.learningGoal: Lexical Gatekeeping: (Grinder, Submarine sandwich, Deli etiquette).

cards.name: Mark Twain House Tour
cards.flavorText: Hosting a fundraiser in the Hartford mansion where Huckleberry Finn was written. Very high-brow.
cards.learningGoal: Literary History: (High-brow, Gilded Age, Architectural oddity).

cards.name: The Hartford Yard Goats
cards.flavorText: The stadium was billions over budget, but the mascot is a goat that eats baseballs and the voters love it.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Distractions: (Over budget, Minor league baseball, Branding success).

cards.name: High-Speed Rail Promise
cards.flavorText: We are going to make the train to New York take 30 minutes! (The tracks curve too much, it will never happen).
cards.learningGoal: Transit Delusions: (High-speed rail, Curvature, Impossible physics).

cards.name: The Wealth Gap
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: You have Greenwich billionaires and struggling post-industrial cities in the same zip code. The inequality is glaring.
cards.learningGoal: Socioeconomic Divide: (Wealth gap, Disparity, Glaring inequality).

cards.name: Coastal Flooding
cards.flavorText: The Long Island Sound is currently in the lobby of your waterfront campaign headquarters. Buy some rain boots.
cards.learningGoal: Climate Reality: (King tide, Sea-level rise, Waterfront property).

cards.name: The Nutmegger Defiance
cards.flavorText: They called us 'Nutmeggers' because we supposedly sold fake wooden spices to out-of-staters. We embrace the hustle!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Hustle: (Nutmegger, Counterfeit, Embracing the insult).

cards.name: The MoCo Bureaucrat
cards.effect: Tech and Defense cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: I live in Montgomery County, I work for a three-letter agency in D.C., and I complain about the Metro daily.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Lexicon: (Agency, Commuter rail, Three-letter acronym).

cards.name: The PG County Boss
cards.flavorText: We have the highest concentration of federal wealth and the absolute tightest grip on the state primary.
cards.learningGoal: Political Consolidation: (Machine politics, Grip on power, Concentration).

cards.name: The Bawlmer Politician
cards.flavorText: We don't do polished. We do rowhouses, Natty Boh, and surviving the chaos of City Hall.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Grit: (Rowhouse, Unpolished, Surviving the fray).

cards.name: The Eastern Shore Waterman
cards.flavorText: We dredge the oysters, we pick the crabs, and we absolutely resent everyone crossing the Bay Bridge.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Trades: (Dredging, Waterman, Resentment of tourists).

cards.name: The Panhandle Populist
cards.flavorText: We are practically West Virginia out here. Stop taxing our pickup trucks to pay for your subway!
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Alienation: (Panhandle, Practicality, Disconnected from the capital).

cards.name: The Maryland Flag Obsession
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We put our chaotic, medieval heraldry flag on our cars, our socks, and our crabs. We yield to no one!
cards.learningGoal: State Identity: (Vexillology, Heraldry, Obsessive merchandising).

cards.name: Old Bay on Everything
cards.flavorText: Ice cream? Add Old Bay. Bloody Mary? Add Old Bay. Policy proposal? Sprinkle some Old Bay on it.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Dogma: (Universal application, Savory, Non-negotiable).

cards.name: The Pterodactyl District
cards.flavorText: My congressional district connects three unrelated neighborhoods via a 10-foot strip of highway. It's beautiful.
cards.learningGoal: Redistricting Absurdity: (Gerrymander, Cartography, Sprawling, Disjointed).

cards.name: The Capital Beltway
cards.flavorText: You are stuck in inner-loop traffic near the Mormon Temple. You will die in this car. Accept it.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Despair: (Inner-loop, Beltway, Standstill, Perpetual traffic).

cards.name: Bay Bridge Summer Traffic
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: It is a Friday in July. A million cars are creeping toward Ocean City. The state is temporarily closed.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Migration: (Goin' down the ocean, Bottleneck, Escapism).

cards.name: Federal Government Shutdown
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: Congress failed to pass a budget. Half your donors and voters just lost their paychecks. Panic ensues.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Crisis: (Furlough, Essential personnel, Federal dependency).

cards.name: Picking Crabs on Newspaper
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a state contract while smashing a blue crab with a wooden mallet. Do not touch your eyes.
cards.learningGoal: Messy Optics: (Mallet, Shucking, Casual diplomacy).

cards.name: The O! During the Anthem
cards.flavorText: Screaming 'O' during the Star-Spangled Banner is legally required. Out-of-staters are terrified.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Tribalism: (Anthem tradition, Startling outsiders, Hometown pride).

cards.name: The Purple Line Delay
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital now, lose 2 Support later.
cards.flavorText: We are building a new rail line! It is billions over budget and will be finished sometime next century.
cards.learningGoal: Megaproject Vocabulary: (Over budget, Behind schedule, Transit corridor).

cards.name: Jousting Tournament
cards.flavorText: Yes, the official state sport is riding a horse with a lance to spear a tiny ring. It’s very historic.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Traditions: (Jousting, Lance, Equestrian, State symbol).

cards.name: Fort Meade Expansion
cards.effect: Gain +5 Capital, but opponent sees your hand.
cards.flavorText: We are building massive windowless buildings for the NSA. The defense contractors are throwing money everywhere.
cards.learningGoal: Intelligence Jargon: (Cybersecurity, Classified, Defense contractor, Surveillance).

cards.name: Berger Cookie Bribe
cards.flavorText: Sliding a tin of cake-like cookies covered in half an inch of fudge across the table. They cannot say no.
cards.learningGoal: Sweet Tooth Indulgence: (Decadent, Bribe, Irresistible).

cards.name: The Mason-Dixon Line
cards.effect: Wildcard: Swap your regional alignment each turn.
cards.flavorText: Are we Northern? Are we Southern? We drink sweet tea but love unions. We are fundamentally confused.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Limbo: (Identity crisis, Border state, Duality).

cards.name: Threatening to Move to Virginia
cards.flavorText: The taxes went up 1%, so the millionaires are threatening to move across the Potomac. Again.
cards.learningGoal: Tax Avoidance: (Capital flight, Cross-border rivalry, Relocation threat).

cards.name: The Purple State Pivot
cards.flavorText: We vote deep blue nationally, but we love a moderate Republican governor who fixes the roads.
cards.learningGoal: Ticket Splitting: (Pragmatism, Split-ticket voting, Moderate appeal).

cards.name: Thrashers Fries Pandering
cards.flavorText: Eating a bucket of fries soaked in peanut oil and apple cider vinegar. If you ask for ketchup, you are exiled.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Condiment bans, Authentic experience, Boardwalk fare).

cards.name: Camp David Retreat
cards.flavorText: I am taking a helicopter to a highly classified presidential retreat in the woods. Do not text me.
cards.learningGoal: Presidential Hideaway: (Undisclosed location, Retreat, Classified).

cards.name: Natty Boh Cheers
cards.flavorText: Drinking cheap, iconic local beer from a can featuring a one-eyed man with a handlebar mustache.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Mascot Loyalty: (Iconography, Cheap beer, Working-class roots).

cards.name: Save the Bay Campaign
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We must save the oysters, the crabs, and the wetlands! (Please ignore the farm runoff).
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Conservation: (Estuary, Runoff, Ecological restoration).

cards.name: The Squeegee Boys
cards.flavorText: You stopped at a red light in Baltimore. Your windshield is being washed whether you want it or not. Tip them.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Hustle: (Unsolicited service, Squeegee, Intersection dynamics).

cards.name: Johns Hopkins Medical
cards.flavorText: We cure the rarest diseases on Earth. Our doctors have more political power than the Mayor.
cards.learningGoal: Medical Elitism: (Specialist, Prestige, Unparalleled care).

cards.name: The Preakness Stakes
cards.flavorText: Forget the horse race. The infield is a mud-soaked festival of absolute, lawless debauchery.
cards.learningGoal: Revelry and Chaos: (Debauchery, Infield, Triple Crown, Mud-soaked).

cards.name: D.C. Commuter Rail
cards.flavorText: I sleep on the Penn Line for an hour every morning. If you cut the transit budget, I will destroy you.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Dependency: (Commuter rail, Bedroom community, Budget cuts).

cards.name: The I-270 Tech Corridor
cards.flavorText: Miles of glass buildings filled with pharmaceutical companies and government research labs.
cards.learningGoal: Innovation Sprawl: (Corridor, Pharma, R&D, Incubator).

cards.name: The Naval Academy
cards.flavorText: You are surrounded by midshipmen in crisp white uniforms. Disrespect the military at your own peril.
cards.learningGoal: Military Prestige: (Midshipmen, Service academy, Crisp optics).

cards.name: Red Line Cancellation
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the city.
cards.flavorText: You canceled a billion-dollar light rail project to build more highways. The city will never forgive you.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Grievances: (Canceled project, Disinvestment, Transit equity).

cards.name: The Harbor Tunnel Toll
cards.flavorText: It costs $4 to drive under the water. The EZ-Pass transponder simply prints money for the state.
cards.learningGoal: Toll Revenue: (Transponder, Crossing fee, Revenue generation).

cards.name: Cicada Brood X
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Media cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: Trillions of red-eyed bugs have emerged from the ground. They are screaming at 100 decibels.
cards.learningGoal: Biological Phenomenon: (Brood, Emergence, Deafening, Exoskeleton).

cards.name: The Governor's Mansion
cards.flavorText: Hiding in the oldest state capitol still in continuous legislative use. History is my shield!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Shielding: (Continuous use, Statehouse, Architectural prestige).

cards.name: Smith Island Cake
cards.flavorText: Serving the official state dessert. It has ten microscopic layers of cake and fudge. It's an engineering marvel.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Architecture: (Decadent, Microscopic layers, Official designation).

cards.name: Scrapple for Breakfast
cards.effect: Opponent loses 1 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: You tried to serve scrapple to a lobbyist from Bethesda. They fainted at the ingredients list.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Delicacies: (Ambiguous, Offal, Acquired taste).

cards.name: Port of Baltimore Logistics
cards.flavorText: We move the cars, the sugar, and the steel. Keep the channel dredged and the unions happy.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Logistics: (Dredged channel, Cargo hub, Longshoremen).

cards.name: Humidity Like Soup
cards.flavorText: It is 95 degrees with 98% humidity. Breathing feels like drinking hot bathwater.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Hyperbole: (Oppressive humidity, Muggy, Sauna-like).

cards.name: The 'Hon'
cards.flavorText: A waitress with a beehive hairdo called you 'Hon.' Your political stress instantly melts away.
cards.learningGoal: Endearing Slang: (Term of endearment, Beehive hairdo, Working-class charm).

cards.name: Annapolis Lobbying
cards.flavorText: If you want the bill passed, we need to discuss it on my 40-foot sloop in the Chesapeake Bay.
cards.learningGoal: Wealthy Persuasion: (Sloop, Nautical leisure, Schmoozing).

cards.name: The Old Line State
cards.flavorText: George Washington praised our troops' discipline! We hold the line against bad policy!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Valor: (Holding the line, Old Line State, Revolutionary prestige).

cards.name: Suburban Sprawl
cards.flavorText: We just turned a 200-year-old dairy farm into a massive townhome community and a Panera Bread.
cards.learningGoal: Development Reality: (Sprawl, Paving over history, Mixed-use).

cards.name: The Ravens Flock
cards.flavorText: It is Purple Friday. If you are not wearing purple camouflage, you are an enemy of the state.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Fanaticism: (Flock, Mandated attire, Civic religion).

cards.name: Crabcake Diplomacy
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: All jumbo lump meat. No filler. Broiled, never fried. You have brought total peace to the legislature.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Perfection: (Jumbo lump, No filler, Broiled).

cards.name: State Police Escort
cards.flavorText: Doing 90 MPH down Route 50 in the left lane with a police escort. You are untouchable.
cards.learningGoal: VIP Exemption: (Police escort, Speeding, Untouchable).

cards.name: Oyster Shell Recycling
cards.flavorText: We are dumping millions of old shells back into the water to grow new bivalves. It's weird but it works.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Science: (Bivalves, Restoration, Shell recycling).

cards.name: The Route 1 Strip
cards.flavorText: Traffic is backed up because 10,000 UMD students are crossing the street to buy cheap pizza.
cards.learningGoal: Campus Traffic: (Pedestrian crossing, College town, Chaos).

cards.name: Banning Plastic Straws
cards.flavorText: You passed an aggressive environmental law. Everyone is drinking iced coffee out of soggy paper tubes now.
cards.learningGoal: Micro-Legislation: (Mandate, Soggy, Inconvenient progress).

cards.name: The Potomac River Crossing
cards.flavorText: I'm taking the American Legion Bridge into Virginia where the Maryland press won't follow me.
cards.learningGoal: Jurisdictional Evasion: (Border crossing, Fleeing the press, Cross-river).

cards.name: The Free State
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We refused to enforce Prohibition in the 1920s, and we refuse to listen to your terrible ideas today!
cards.learningGoal: Defiant History: (The Free State, Nullification, Stubborn independence).

cards.name: The DFL Pragmatist
cards.flavorText: We don't just have Democrats here. We have farmers, we have labor, and we have very long meetings.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Nuance: (Acronyms, Coalition building, Farmer-Labor).

cards.name: The Iron Ranger
cards.flavorText: My grandfather mined the ore that won World War II. Do not tell me how to use this land.
cards.learningGoal: Generational Pride: (Iron Range, Ore, Heritage, Deep roots).

cards.name: The Edina Cake-Eater
cards.flavorText: I have a heated driveway, a golden retriever, and very strong opinions about local zoning laws.
cards.learningGoal: Class Insults: (Cake-eater, Affluent, Exclusivity, Zoning).

cards.name: The Uptown Progressive
cards.flavorText: We are replacing all parking spots with protected bike lanes and community gardens immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Urbanist Vocabulary: (Protected lanes, Community garden, Progressive).

cards.name: The Somali Advocate
cards.flavorText: From Mogadishu to Minneapolis, our community is organized, entrepreneurial, and ready to vote.
cards.learningGoal: Diaspora Representation: (New Americans, Entrepreneurial, Organized).

cards.name: The Rochester Specialist
cards.flavorText: Our city is essentially a world-class hospital with some houses attached to it.
cards.learningGoal: Medical Superiority: (World-class, Mecca, Biomedical).

cards.name: The Outstate Farmer
cards.flavorText: You folks inside the I-494 loop have absolutely no idea what it takes to grow your food.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resentment: (Greater Minnesota, Outstate, The Loop).

cards.name: Minnesota Nice
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: 'Oh, that's a very... interesting... policy proposal you have there.' (Translation: I hate it).
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: Using compliments to deliver devastating insults.

cards.name: The Minnesota Goodbye
cards.flavorText: You slapped your knees and said 'Welp,' but you stood in the doorway talking for 45 more minutes.
cards.learningGoal: Social Rituals: (Prolonged departure, Obligatory chatter, Lingering).

cards.name: Uff Da!
cards.flavorText: A Scandinavian exclamation used for lifting heavy boxes, receiving bad news, or hearing your opponent's tax plan.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Exclamations: (Exhaustion, Overwhelmed, Scandinavian heritage).

cards.name: You Betcha!
cards.flavorText: Delivering an incredibly enthusiastic confirmation with a thick, drawn-out vowel sound.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Affirmations: (You betcha, Don't cha know, Drawn-out vowels).

cards.name: Duck, Duck, Gray Duck
cards.flavorText: You called it 'Goose' on national television. You have alienated the entire state electorate.
cards.learningGoal: Childhood Dogma: (Defending regional oddities with extreme prejudice).

cards.name: Calling it a 'Casserole'
cards.flavorText: It is a Hotdish, you monster. Take your coastal culinary vocabulary and get out.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Hotdish, Cream of mushroom, Sacrilege).

cards.name: Tater Tot Hotdish
cards.flavorText: Serving a baking dish full of ground beef, canned soup, and crispy potatoes brings both parties together.
cards.learningGoal: Comfort Food: (Crispy, Canned, Bipartisan, Hearty).

cards.name: The DFL Trifecta
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We control the House, the Senate, and the Governor. We are passing 400 bills this afternoon!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Dominance: (Trifecta, Steamroll, Ramming it through).

cards.name: Target Corporate HQ
cards.flavorText: We provide the state with chic, affordable home goods and massive campaign donations.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Leverage: (Headquarters, Chic, Philanthropy).

cards.name: The BWCA
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 3 from miners.
cards.flavorText: We must protect the pristine, motor-free wilderness from the copper-nickel mines!
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Preservation: (Pristine, Motor-free, Watershed).

cards.name: Copper-Nickel Mining
