cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but trigger environmental protests.
cards.flavorText: We need the minerals for electric vehicle batteries. We are opening the mine!
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Pragmatism: (Extraction, Supply chain, Green economy trade-off).

cards.name: Snow Emergency
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: You parked on the even side of the street on an odd day during a blizzard. Your car is gone.
cards.learningGoal: Municipal Enforcement: (Snow emergency, Tow lot, Impounded).

cards.name: The Polar Vortex
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The air physically hurts your face. The governor just canceled school for the entire state.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Cold: (Windchill, Frostbite, Polar Vortex, Shutting down).

cards.name: The Skyway System
cards.flavorText: Minneapolis has 9 miles of elevated, heated glass tunnels. I haven't worn a coat since November.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Adaptation: (Skyway, Climate-controlled, Interconnected).

cards.name: Mall of America
cards.flavorText: An indoor roller coaster, an aquarium, and zero sales tax on clothing. The tourists are spending heavily.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Tourism: (Megamall, Consumerism, Zero sales tax).

cards.name: The Jucy Lucy
cards.flavorText: You ate a burger with the cheese cooked inside the meat and burned the roof of your mouth for the cameras.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Danger: (Molten, Stuffed, Authentic).

cards.name: Lutefisk Dinner
cards.flavorText: You invited the press to a church basement to eat gelatinous, lye-soaked cod. The optics are horrifying.
cards.learningGoal: Acquired Tastes: (Gelatinous, Pungent, Ancestral).

cards.name: Princess Kay of the Milky Way
cards.effect: Gain +2 Support at the State Fair.
cards.flavorText: You posed next to a 90-pound sculpture of a dairy princess carved entirely out of Grade A butter.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Spectacle: (Sculpted, Grade A, Dairy association).

cards.name: Sweet Martha's Cookies
cards.flavorText: Handing out a plastic bucket overflowing with warm, melty chocolate chip cookies buys unlimited goodwill.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Excess: (Overflowing, Unlimited goodwill, Melty).

cards.name: Prince Tribute
cards.flavorText: We bathed the I-35W bridge in purple lights. The entire state is united in musical reverence.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Icons: (Reverence, Tribute, Unifying).

cards.name: Ice Fishing House
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating the state budget inside a plywood shack on a frozen lake with a propane heater and an auger.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Leisure: (Ice auger, Shack, Frozen solid).

cards.name: Pond Hockey Rink
cards.flavorText: Lacing up your skates in 10-degree weather to show the voters you have true Minnesota grit.
cards.learningGoal: Sporting Authenticity: (Pond hockey, Lacing up, Grit).

cards.name: Mosquito Swarm
cards.flavorText: The boundary waters mosquitoes are the size of hummingbirds. They are draining your campaign staff.
cards.learningGoal: Pest Hyperbole: (Swarm, Bloodsuckers, Bug spray).

cards.name: The Twin City Rivalry
cards.effect: Opponent must choose a side and alienate the other.
cards.flavorText: Minneapolis is new and flashy. St. Paul is old and quiet. You cannot please both of them.
cards.learningGoal: Sibling City Rivalry: (Contrast, Alienate, Divided loyalties).

cards.name: St. Paul Bureaucracy
cards.flavorText: The streets make no sense, the restaurants close at 9 PM, and the permitting process takes years.
cards.learningGoal: Administrative Sluggishness: (Bureaucracy, Sleepy, Permitting).

cards.name: Education Union
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but costs 1 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: The single most powerful lobbying force in the state. Do not cross the teachers.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Dominance: (Lobbying force, War chest, Organized labor).

cards.name: Suburban Soccer Moms
cards.effect: Provides +2 Support. Immune to Extreme attacks.
cards.flavorText: The ring of suburbs around the Twin Cities decides every single statewide election. Pander to them.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Tipping Points: (Collar counties, Swing voters, Moderation).

cards.name: Fleeing to Naples
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the winter.
cards.flavorText: Your donors got tired of the snow and officially moved their primary residence to Florida for tax purposes.
cards.learningGoal: Capital Flight: (Snowbird, Primary residence, Tax haven).

cards.name: Legal Weed Rollout
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from youth, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We legalized it, but the bureaucratic rollout is so confusing that everyone is just buying gummies at the gas station.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Confusion: (Rollout, Loophole, Gray market).

cards.name: State Fair Pandering
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: Two million people in 12 days. Eat something deep-fried on a stick and shake a thousand hands.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Rituals: (Get-Together, Deep-fried, Handshaking).

cards.name: High School Hockey Tournament
cards.flavorText: The entire state stops to watch teenagers play hockey and rank the quality of their mullets.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Sports Culture: (Tourney, Mullet, Flow, Distraction).

cards.name: The Immigrant Entrepreneur
cards.flavorText: A massive, bustling Somali shopping center pumping revenue and culture into the local economy.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Integration: (Bustling, Diaspora, Entrepreneurial).

cards.name: Lake Minnetonka Boat Party
cards.flavorText: Your campaign staff was caught acting terribly on a rented pontoon boat. The scandal is front-page news.
cards.learningGoal: Summer Scandals: (Pontoon, Debauchery, Front-page).

cards.name: Cabin Up North
cards.flavorText: I'm driving three hours north to Brainerd. There is no cell service. I cannot be reached for comment.
cards.learningGoal: Escapism Vocabulary: (Up North, Brainerd, Unreachable).

cards.name: Walleye Opener
cards.flavorText: It's the second weekend in May. The Governor is out on a boat. All political activity is legally suspended.
cards.learningGoal: Outdoor Traditions: (Walleye, Opener, Dropping a line).

cards.name: Pothole on I-35W
cards.flavorText: The freeze-thaw cycle opened a crater the size of a bathtub. Your campaign bus blew an axle.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Frost heave, Freeze-thaw, Crater).

cards.name: First Avenue Concert
cards.flavorText: Hosting a rally at the iconic star-covered nightclub proves you have serious cultural credibility.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Cachet: (Iconic, Venue, Credibility).

cards.name: Stuck in a Snowbank
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You tried to attack me, but my car got stuck in the snow and your supporters instinctively helped push me out.
cards.learningGoal: Midwestern Solidarity: (Instinctive help, Pushing out, Shared struggle).

cards.name: Paul Bunyan Statue
cards.flavorText: Taking a photo next to a 15-foot-tall fiberglass lumberjack and his blue ox in Bemidji.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Americana: (Fiberglass, Lumberjack, Kitsch).

cards.name: L'Étoile du Nord
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the North. We are resilient, we are educated, and we will survive this winter!
cards.learningGoal: State Motto: (Star of the North, Resilience, Enduring).

cards.name: The Farm Bill
cards.flavorText: Sugar beets, corn, and soybeans. We must secure the federal subsidies to keep the tractors running.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Ag Policy: (Subsidy, Sugar beets, Commodities).

cards.name: Ranked Choice Voting
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: You didn't win the first round, but you were everyone's second choice! You win the election!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Reform: (Ranked choice, Instant runoff, Consensus candidate).

cards.name: Defund Debate
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: You proposed a deeply controversial public safety overhaul. The suburban voters are terrified.
cards.learningGoal: Flashpoint Politics: (Overhaul, Public safety, Backlash).

cards.name: The Madison Progressive
cards.flavorText: We will mandate that all city vehicles be powered exclusively by recycled cheese whey and good vibes.
cards.learningGoal: Progressive Utopianism: (Mandate, Exclusive, Sustainable infrastructure).

cards.name: The WOW County Conservative
cards.flavorText: Waukesha, Ozaukee, and Washington counties. We mow our lawns diagonally and we vote in every single election.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Discipline: (Firewall, Unwavering, Reliable turnout).

cards.name: The Milwaukee Socialist
cards.flavorText: We have a proud history of electing socialists who genuinely just wanted to build really good public parks and water systems.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Pragmatism: (Sewer socialism, Public works, Civic duty).

cards.name: The Up North Tavern Owner
cards.flavorText: I pour the Brandy Old Fashioneds, I fry the cod, and I tell the locals who to vote for.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Gatekeeping: (Supper club, Pouring drinks, Guiding the vote).

cards.name: The Dairy Farmer
cards.effect: Immune to attacks from out-of-state Factions.
cards.flavorText: We have more cows than people in this county. Do not lecture us about agricultural tariffs.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Defiance: (Tariffs, Livelihood, Dairyland).

cards.name: Squeaky Cheese Curds
cards.flavorText: If the cheese curd doesn't physically squeak against your teeth, it's not fresh, and you lose my vote.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Audible freshness, Squeak, Uncompromising standard).

cards.name: Spotted Cow Smuggling
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: It is illegal to sell New Glarus beer outside of Wisconsin. Selling it in Illinois is a highly lucrative political crime.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Exclusivity: (Bootlegging, Contraband, Crossing state lines).

cards.name: The Lambeau Leap
cards.flavorText: You jumped into a crowd of freezing, beer-soaked fans wearing foam cheese blocks on their heads. Pure political gold.
cards.learningGoal: Athletic Pandering: (The Leap, Optics, Crowd surfing).

cards.name: Act 10 Flashback
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: You tried to strip collective bargaining rights. 100,000 people are sleeping on the marble floor of the State Capitol.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Conflict: (Collective bargaining, Uprising, Occupation, Stripped rights).

cards.name: Friday Fish Fry
cards.flavorText: It is Friday night. Every VFW hall and tavern is serving deep-fried cod and potato pancakes. The state is at peace.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Rituals: (Fish fry, VFW hall, Communal dining).

cards.name: Brandy Old Fashioned Sweet
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Muddled fruit, brandy, and a splash of Sprite. A whiskey Old Fashioned is a federal offense here.
cards.learningGoal: Cocktail Pedantry: (Muddled, Sweet wash, Regional variation).

cards.name: The Tavern League
cards.flavorText: The most powerful lobbying group in the state. They ensure that happy hour is legally protected at all costs.
cards.learningGoal: Industry Leverage: (Tavern League, Happy hour, Institutional power).

cards.name: Foxconn Factory Promise
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital now, lose 3 Support later.
cards.flavorText: We gave them $3 billion in tax breaks to build flat-screen TVs! (They built a single, empty warehouse).
cards.learningGoal: Economic Boondoggles: (Corporate welfare, Bait-and-switch, Hollow promise).

cards.name: Gerrymandered Maps
cards.flavorText: My legislative district looks like a sprawling inkblot test designed to avoid college campuses.
cards.learningGoal: Redistricting Terminology: (Cracking, Packing, Inkblot, Gerrymander).

cards.name: Supreme Court Spending
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: We spent $40 million on a single state supreme court race. The airwaves are pure, unadulterated toxic sludge.
cards.learningGoal: Judicial Politicization: (War chest, Airwaves, Toxic campaign).

cards.name: F.I.B.s
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the South.
cards.flavorText: An Illinois driver just cut you off on I-94. Use the local, highly profane acronym to express your outrage.
cards.learningGoal: Interstate Hostility: (Derogatory acronym, Flatlander, Border rivalry).

cards.name: Bratwurst Boil
cards.flavorText: Boiling processed meat in cheap beer and onions before grilling it. This is the cornerstone of our democracy.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Foundations: (Simmering, Tailgate, Cornerstone).

cards.name: Deer Hunting Season
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: It is late November. The entire state is wearing blaze orange and sitting in a tree stand. Politics are paused.
cards.learningGoal: Sporting Absences: (Blaze orange, Tree stand, AWOL).

cards.name: Ice Fishing Derby
cards.flavorText: A thousand pickup trucks are parked on a frozen lake. We are drinking schnapps and catching walleye.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Leisure: (Ice shanty, Auger, Frozen solid).

cards.name: The Driftless Area
cards.effect: Opponent's Eastern cards have no effect here.
cards.flavorText: The glaciers missed the southwest corner of the state, leaving deep valleys, trout streams, and stubborn swing voters.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Geography: (Driftless, Unglaciated, Topography).

cards.name: Publicly Owned Franchise
cards.flavorText: The Green Bay Packers have no billionaire owner! We are the only true socialist utopia in the NFL!
cards.learningGoal: Community Ownership: (Shareholder, Stock certificate, Defying the billionaires).

cards.name: Ope, Let Me Squeeze Past Ya
cards.flavorText: A devastating political maneuver executed while maintaining an aggressive level of eye-contact and politeness.
cards.learningGoal: Passive-Aggressive Vernacular: (Ope, Squeeze past, Weaponized politeness).

cards.name: The Marquette Poll
cards.flavorText: Charles Franklin just released the new poll numbers. The entire state holds its collective breath.
cards.learningGoal: Polling Anxiety: (Gold standard, Margin of error, Crosstabs).

cards.name: Cranberry Bog Harvest
cards.flavorText: Standing waist-deep in a flooded bog of floating red berries makes for a fantastic, albeit cold, photo op.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Optics: (Cranberry bog, Waders, Harvest).

cards.name: Recall Election
cards.effect: The game does not end at 50 points; play 2 more turns.
cards.flavorText: You didn't like the election results, so you gathered a million signatures to just do the election over again next year.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Exhaustion: (Recall, Do-over, Signature drive).

cards.name: The Bubbler
cards.flavorText: You asked for a 'drinking fountain' instead of a 'bubbler.' The locals immediately know you are a transplant.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Shibboleths: (Bubbler, Regional dialect, Outsider test).

cards.name: Giant Musky Statue
cards.flavorText: Standing inside the gaping jaws of a 143-foot-long fiberglass fish to win the Northern Wisconsin vote.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Kitsch: (Fiberglass giant, Musky, Pandering to the North).

cards.name: Kwik Trip Run
cards.flavorText: A gas station that commands absolute cult loyalty. I'm grabbing a Glazer donut and bagging my own milk.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Cults: (Bagged milk, Cult loyalty, Pit stop).

cards.name: Lake Geneva Mansion
cards.flavorText: Wealthy Illinois residents are buying up all the lakefront property. The locals are completely priced out.
cards.learningGoal: Wealth Migration: (Summer retreat, Priced out, Lakefront).

cards.name: Bucky Badger
cards.flavorText: A belligerent, anthropomorphic badger doing push-ups every time the football team scores. The energy is infectious.
cards.learningGoal: Mascot Fervor: (Belligerent, Anthropomorphic, Infectious energy).

cards.name: UW System Defunding
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital from conservatives, lose 3 Support from academia.
cards.flavorText: We are slashing the university budget! What do we need liberal arts for when we have dairy science?
cards.learningGoal: Educational Hostility: (Slashing budgets, Liberal arts, Tenure).

cards.name: The Tipping Point
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We swung by 22,000 votes in 2016. We swung by 20,000 votes in 2020. Every single doorstep matters.
cards.learningGoal: Margin of Victory: (Pendulum, Razor-thin, Tipping point).

cards.name: Shoveling the Neighbor's Walk
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You attacked me, but my neighbor fired up his snowblower and cleared my driveway. We stand together.
cards.learningGoal: Communal Resilience: (Snowblower, Clearing the walk, Neighborly duty).

cards.name: State Fair Cream Puff
cards.flavorText: Eating a pastry the size of a softball filled with a pound of heavy whipping cream. You are a true Wisconsinite.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Gluttony: (Cream puff, Softball-sized, Confection).

cards.name: Frozen Tundra
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: It is negative 15 degrees. You are sitting on cold aluminum bleachers. You cannot feel your toes. Win the game.
cards.learningGoal: Endurance Hardships: (Frozen tundra, Wind chill, Enduring the elements).

cards.name: The Farm Bureau
cards.flavorText: Soybeans, corn, and ginseng. Keep the agricultural subsidies flowing, and we will keep the tractors running.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Lobbying: (Farm Bureau, Ginseng, Subsidies).

cards.name: Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The opposing party won the governorship, so the legislature meets at 3 AM to strip the office of all its powers.
cards.learningGoal: Procedural Hardball: (Lame duck, Stripping powers, Midnight session).

cards.name: The Union Hall
cards.effect: Blocks any Corporate attacks against you.
cards.flavorText: The manufacturing base may be shrinking, but the heavy equipment operators still remember how to strike.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Tenacity: (Union hall, Heavy equipment, Holding the line).

cards.name: Forward!
cards.flavorText: The state motto is just one word. We don't look back, we don't retreat, we just keep moving Forward.
cards.learningGoal: Determined Phrasing: (Unrelenting, State motto, Forward momentum).

cards.name: Smelt Dipping
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It is 2 AM in the spring. We are standing in a freezing creek with nets catching tiny silver fish. Don't ask why.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Foraging: (Smelt dipping, Netting, Spring run).

cards.name: The Bellwether County
cards.flavorText: Whoever wins the cherry-growing peninsula wins the state. The tourists are gone, and the locals have flipped.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Indicators: (Bellwether, Peninsula, Shifting winds).

cards.name: Cheesehead Hat
cards.flavorText: Wearing a giant wedge of yellow polyurethane foam on your head makes you completely immune to embarrassment.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Absurdity: (Polyurethane, Cheesehead, Embracing the joke).

cards.name: Snowmobile Trail Funding
cards.effect: Gain +2 Capital but lose 1 Support in cities.
cards.flavorText: We just allocated $5 million to groom the trails up in Vilas County. The two-stroke engines are roaring.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Infrastructure: (Snowmobile, Groomed trails, Two-stroke).

cards.name: The Hodag
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: You invoked the mythical, spiked green beast of the Northwoods. The voters are either charmed or terrified.
cards.learningGoal: Cryptid Folklore: (The Hodag, Northwoods, Mythical beast).

cards.name: Culver's ButterBurger
cards.flavorText: If the bun isn't heavily buttered and toasted, it belongs in the garbage. Welcome to the fast-food elite.
cards.learningGoal: Fast Food Dogma: (Butter-toasted, Elite tier, Flavor profile).

cards.name: The Door Peninsula
cards.flavorText: We sell cherry wine and expensive watercolor paintings to tourists from Chicago. The economy thrives.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Economy: (Peninsula, Cherry wine, Boutique).

cards.name: Cheese Castle
cards.flavorText: A literal castle on I-94 that sells cheese, sausage, and beer to terrified out-of-staters entering Wisconsin.
cards.learningGoal: Border Commerce: (Roadside attraction, Out-of-stater, Provisioning).

cards.name: The Missing 'To'
cards.flavorText: 'Do you want to come with?' Dropping the preposition at the end of the sentence proves you belong here.
cards.learningGoal: Grammatical Quirks: (Preposition drop, Regional syntax, Linguistic belonging).

cards.name: Paul Bunyan's Axe
cards.flavorText: We beat Minnesota in football and stole the giant wooden axe. Our political dominance over our neighbor is complete.
cards.learningGoal: Rivalry Trophies: (Border battle, Giant axe, Territorial bragging rights).

cards.name: The Polar Bear Plunge
cards.flavorText: Jumping into a partially frozen lake on New Year's Day to raise money for charity. You are freezing, but you are a hero.
cards.learningGoal: Charitable Masochism: (Polar plunge, Hypothermia, Philanthropy).

cards.name: The Rancher Patrician
cards.flavorText: My family has run cattle on this 50,000-acre spread since 1880. Do not tell me how to manage the wolves.
cards.learningGoal: Generational Landholders: (Spread, Acreage, Cattleman, Land management).

cards.name: The Bozeman Billionaire
cards.flavorText: I bought a ranch because I watched 'Yellowstone', and now I want to close the public access road to the river.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Economics: (Boz-Angeles, Public access, Fencing it off).

cards.name: The Butte Miner
cards.flavorText: This city was built on copper, union blood, and open-pit mining. We are the grittiest, bluest dot in a red state.
cards.learningGoal: Labor History: (Union blood, Open-pit, The Richest Hill on Earth).

cards.name: The Split-Ticket Voter
cards.flavorText: We will vote for a deeply conservative legislature and then re-elect a liberal Democratic Senator. We are an enigma.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Independence: (Split-ticket, Enigma, Bucking the trend).

cards.name: The Tester Buzzcut
cards.flavorText: You sport a flat-top haircut and six missing fingers from a meat grinder accident. The authenticity is off the charts.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Authenticity: (Flat-top, Meat grinder, Unmistakable branding).

cards.name: The Gianforte Body Slam
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support, but you gain 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: You literally tackled a reporter the night before the election. You got arrested, but you still won the race. Pure Montana.
cards.learningGoal: Aggressive Escalation: (Body slam, Misdemeanor, Winning anyway).

cards.name: The Yellowstone Effect
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from locals per turn.
cards.flavorText: A Kevin Costner TV show made the state look so cool that billionaires bought all the housing. The locals are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Media Gentrification: (Cinematic appeal, Pricing out, The Yellowstone Effect).

cards.name: Grizzly Bear Encounter
cards.flavorText: Your opponent went hiking without bear spray. They spent six hours hiding in a tree. The campaign is delayed.
cards.learningGoal: Apex Dangers: (Grizzly, Bear spray, Treeing, Apex predator).

cards.name: The Berkeley Pit
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: A 900-foot-deep pit of highly acidic, toxic water left over from copper mining. A flock of snow geese landed in it and died.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Catastrophe: (Toxic lake, Superfund site, Highly acidic).

cards.name: Big Sky Country
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The sky is vast, the mountains are towering, and the freedom is absolute. The momentum is huge!
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Grandeur: (Big Sky, Vastness, Unbounded).

cards.name: The 80 MPH Speed Limit
cards.flavorText: Driving across the state takes 12 hours. The speed limit is 80, but the highway patrol won't stop you at 95.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Velocity: (Covering ground, Desolate interstate, Pushing the limit).

cards.name: Out-of-State License Plate
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the rurals.
cards.flavorText: Your campaign SUV has California plates. A guy in a Ford F-250 just gave you the finger on Highway 93.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Hostility: (Out-of-stater, Scowl, Unwelcoming).

cards.name: The Testicle Festival
cards.flavorText: A legendary, highly inappropriate festival centered around eating deep-fried bull testicles and drinking heavily. Pure chaos.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Debauchery: (Rocky Mountain Oyster, Inappropriate, Debauchery).

cards.name: Glacier National Park
cards.flavorText: You tried to cross the park in July. The road is stunningly beautiful, but it is clogged with 5,000 rented RVs.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Gridlock: (Going-to-the-Sun, Overcrowded, Breathtaking).

cards.name: The Wind Chill Warning
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The wind is blowing off the plains. The air physically hurts your face. Campaigning is legally suspended.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Cold: (Wind chill, Bitterly cold, Lethal temperatures).

cards.name: The Coal Mine Closure
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The coal-fired power plants are shutting down. The union jobs are gone. The town is dying. The transition is brutal.
cards.learningGoal: Energy Transitions: (Coal-fired, Stranded assets, Economic cratering).

cards.name: The Stream Access Law
cards.flavorText: The state constitution says the public owns the water! The billionaire cannot fence off the trout stream! We fish where we want!
cards.learningGoal: Public Trust Doctrine: (Stream access, Fencing off, Public trust).

cards.name: The Huckleberry Bear Claw
cards.flavorText: Eating a massive, sticky pastry filled with wild, foraged mountain berries. It secures the sweet-toothed voter base.
cards.learningGoal: Foraged Delicacies: (Huckleberry, Foraged, Bear claw).

cards.name: The Bison Hunt
cards.flavorText: The bison wandered out of the national park, so the hunters are waiting at the border. It's controversial, but traditional.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Management: (Bison, Park boundary, Culling).

cards.name: The Two-Lane Highway
cards.flavorText: You are stuck behind a logging truck doing 45 mph on a twisting mountain road. You cannot pass. You will be late.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Infrastructure: (Two-lane, Logging truck, Twisting).

cards.name: The Indian Reservations
cards.flavorText: Seven reservations, massive landmass, and deep political organizing. You cannot win a tight race without the Native vote.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Organizing: (Sovereign, Voting power, Turnout).

cards.name: The Fly Fisherman
cards.flavorText: We row the drift boats and tie the flies for the billionaires. We want the rivers clean and the fish biting.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Economics: (Drift boat, Tying flies, Catch and release).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislature only meets for 90 days every two years! The frantic deal-making in the final hours is legendary.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Pacing: (Biennial session, Frantic, Sine die).

cards.name: The Supermajority
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We have complete control of the legislature. We are overriding the Governor's vetoes before the ink is dry.
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Dominance: (Supermajority, Steamroll, Veto override).

cards.name: The Corner Crossing Lawsuit
cards.flavorText: Hunters stepped over the corner of a billionaire's private property to access public land. The lawsuits are raging.
cards.learningGoal: Property Rights Standoff: (Corner crossing, Trespassing, Public access).

cards.name: The Craft Brewer
cards.flavorText: Every town of 500 people somehow has a world-class microbrewery. The beer is flowing and the economy is hopping.
cards.learningGoal: Micro-Economies: (Microbrewery, Hopping, Taproom).

cards.name: The Missoula Liberal
cards.flavorText: We are the liberal bastion of the state. We ride bikes, we protest, and we deeply annoy the ranchers in the east.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Enclaves: (Bastion, Annoying the locals, Progressive bubble).

cards.name: The Continental Divide
cards.flavorText: The Rocky Mountains literally split the state. The rainy, forested west has nothing in common with the flat, windy east.
cards.learningGoal: Topographical Divides: (Continental Divide, Rain shadow, Two states in one).

cards.name: The Elk Tag
cards.flavorText: You drew a highly coveted, out-of-state elk hunting tag. You are spending $10,000 to walk through the woods.
cards.learningGoal: Hunting Economics: (Coveted tag, Lottery draw, Out-of-state hunter).

cards.name: The Bakken Oil Patch
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: The oil boom spilled over from North Dakota. The man camps are full, the rigs are pumping, and the cash is flowing.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Boomtowns: (The Bakken, Man camp, Fracking).

cards.name: The Copper King Mansion
cards.flavorText: Hiding inside a wildly opulent 19th-century mansion built entirely on the exploited labor of underground miners.
cards.learningGoal: Gilded Age Inequality: (Copper King, Opulent, Exploited labor).

cards.name: The Legislature Banning a Member
cards.flavorText: The supermajority literally refused to let a transgender lawmaker speak on the floor. The national outrage is deafening.
cards.learningGoal: Authoritarian Silencing: (Microphone cut, Censure, National outrage).

cards.name: The Prairie Dog Town
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's horse stepped in a prairie dog hole. The campaign trail is delayed by a sprained ankle.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Hazards: (Prairie dog, Burrow, Sprained ankle).

cards.name: The High Plains Drifter
cards.flavorText: You are driving across the eastern plains. There is no radio signal, no cell service, and no towns for 100 miles.
cards.learningGoal: Vast Desolation: (Drifter, Desolate, Dead zone).

cards.name: The 'Yellowstone' Spinoff
cards.flavorText: Another prequel TV show dropped. Another wave of tourists wearing brand-new cowboy hats just got off the plane.
cards.learningGoal: Media Tourism: (Prequel, Brand-new hats, Cosplaying cowboys).

cards.name: The Wolf Pack
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from ranchers, lose 1 from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: We are expanding the wolf hunting season to protect the elk herds. The environmentalists are filing federal injunctions.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Management: (Wolf pack, Culling, Federal injunction).

cards.name: The Treasure State
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the Treasure State! We pull gold, silver, and sapphires from the earth! Our war chest is overflowing!
cards.learningGoal: State Motto: (Treasure State, War chest, Sapphires).

cards.name: The Unabomber Cabin
cards.flavorText: Reminding everyone that a famous domestic terrorist lived in a 10x12 cabin in the Montana woods for 25 years.
cards.learningGoal: Dark History: (Unabomber, Hermit, Off the grid).

cards.name: The Avalanche
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: A massive wall of snow just buried the mountain pass. The western half of the state is completely cut off from the capital.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Forces: (Avalanche, Buried, Cut off).

cards.name: The Pasty
cards.flavorText: Eating a heavy, dense pocket of meat and potatoes that Cornish miners used to take underground. Pure working-class fuel.
cards.learningGoal: Immigrant Cuisine: (The Pasty, Cornish miner, Caloric density).

cards.name: The Montana Militia
cards.flavorText: An anti-government group is refusing to pay taxes and has barricaded themselves in a compound. The FBI is negotiating.
cards.learningGoal: Extremist Standoffs: (Militia, Sovereign citizen, Barricaded).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Checkbook
cards.flavorText: Your campaign is entirely funded by a tech billionaire who visits the state for two weeks every August.
cards.learningGoal: Carpetbagger Funding: (Out-of-state donor, Checkbook, Part-time resident).

cards.name: The Flathead Lake Monster
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is distracted by rumors of a 40-foot serpentine monster living in the largest freshwater lake in the West.
cards.learningGoal: Folklore Panics: (Cryptid, Serpentine, Local legend).

cards.name: The Montgomery Insider
cards.flavorText: Nothing moves in the capital without a handshake, a sweet tea, and an understanding of who your daddy is.
cards.learningGoal: Lineage & Nepotism: (Generational ties, Who your people are, The Machine).

cards.name: The Huntsville Engineer
cards.flavorText: We build the rockets, the missile defense systems, and yes, the actual lunar rovers that drove on the moon.
cards.learningGoal: Aerospace Affirmation: (Lunar rover, Payload, Trajectory, Engineering).

cards.name: The Gulf Coast Mayor
cards.flavorText: Down here in Lower Alabama, we care about shrimp boats, condominiums, and hurricane deductibles.
cards.learningGoal: Coastal Pragmatism: (Condominium, Deductible, Snowbird economy).

cards.name: The Birmingham Aristocrat
cards.flavorText: We live in Mountain Brook, we work in banking, and our zoning laws are absolutely impenetrable.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Geography: (Over the mountain, Impenetrable zoning, Old money).

cards.name: The Black Belt Populist
cards.flavorText: The rich, dark soil grew the cotton, birthed the civil rights movement, and demands to be heard.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Reverence: (Black Belt, Legacy, Birthed, Deep roots).

cards.name: The SEC Head Coach
cards.flavorText: I make $11 million a year and could win a write-in campaign for Senate without leaving my office.
cards.learningGoal: Deification: (Write-in campaign, Unquestioned authority, Head coach).

cards.name: Roll Tide!
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but Auburn voters boycott you.
cards.flavorText: You wore a crimson tie to the debate. Half the state will now die for you; the other half wishes you were dead.
cards.learningGoal: Fierce Tribalism: (Polarizing, Crimson, Blood oath).

cards.name: War Eagle!
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but Alabama voters boycott you.
cards.flavorText: You mentioned rolling Toomer's Corner. The plains are united behind you, but Tuscaloosa is furious.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Devotion: (The Plains, War Eagle, Divided house).

cards.name: The Iron Bowl
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: It is the Saturday after Thanksgiving. The entire state has ceased all political and economic activity to watch football.
cards.learningGoal: Total Paralysis: (Ceased activity, Standstill, Gridiron).

cards.name: The State Constitution
cards.flavorText: Alabama has the longest constitution in the world. You need a statewide amendment just to hire a county dog catcher.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Bloat: (Amendment, Micro-management, Unwieldy document).

cards.name: James Spann's Suspenders
cards.flavorText: The legendary meteorologist just took his suit jacket off and rolled up his sleeves. Take cover immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Meteorological Panic: (Take cover, Imminent threat, Polygon).

cards.name: Tornado Warning
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The sirens are blaring. Everyone is sitting in an interior hallway wearing a bicycle helmet.
cards.learningGoal: Severe Weather Vocabulary: (Interior hallway, Dixie Alley, Blaring).

cards.name: White BBQ Sauce
cards.flavorText: You dunked smoked chicken into a mayonnaise-and-vinegar-based sauce. It looks horrifying but tastes like heaven.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Oddities: (Mayonnaise-based, Horrifying optics, Smoked chicken).

cards.name: The Space Force HQ Fight
cards.flavorText: We are fighting Colorado to the bitter end to keep the Space Command headquarters in Huntsville!
cards.learningGoal: Interstate Rivalry: (Tug-of-war, Bitter end, Military brass).

cards.name: Riding a Horse to the Polls
cards.flavorText: You rode a horse to the voting booth wearing a cowboy hat. You looked ridiculous and lost the election.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Backfire: (Stunt politics, Ridiculous optics, Equestrian).

cards.name: The Redneck Riviera
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: Millions of Midwesterners are drinking cheap beer on our white-sand beaches. The sales tax revenue is glorious.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Derogatories: (Redneck Riviera, Sales tax revenue, Influx).

cards.name: Flora-Bama Line
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a treaty in a legendary dive bar that physically sits on the Florida-Alabama border. Bushwackers for everyone.
cards.learningGoal: Jurisdictional Blurring: (Dive bar, Cross-border, Bushwacker).

cards.name: The Megachurch Pastor
cards.flavorText: If the pastor nods at you from the pulpit of the 10,000-seat sanctuary, you just won the county.
cards.learningGoal: Evangelical Influence: (Sanctuary, Pulpit, Voting bloc).

cards.name: Highway 280 Traffic
cards.flavorText: You are stuck behind 14 stoplights on the most congested, poorly planned suburban highway in the South.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Gridlock: (Poorly planned, Congested, Stoplights).

cards.name: Talladega Superspeedway
cards.effect: Both players must discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: 100,000 people are watching cars go 200 mph in a circle. A massive crash just wiped out the frontrunners.
cards.learningGoal: Motorsports Chaos: (Superspeedway, The Big One, Wiped out).

cards.name: Ten Commandments Monument
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the base, trigger a federal lawsuit.
cards.flavorText: We rolled a two-ton granite monument into the state judicial building in the middle of the night. See you in federal court.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Defiance: (Granite monument, Federal lawsuit, Midnight installation).

cards.name: Sweet Home Alabama
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: You played the Lynyrd Skynyrd song at a rally. The crowd is singing every word. You are invincible.
cards.learningGoal: Anthemic Invincibility: (Singalong, State anthem, Crowd control).

cards.name: Mobile Mardi Gras
cards.flavorText: We invented Mardi Gras! New Orleans stole it! Have a MoonPie thrown directly at your face!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Jealousy: (Claiming the origin, MoonPie, Parading).

cards.name: The Boll Weevil Monument
cards.flavorText: You laid a wreath at the statue honoring the beetle that destroyed the cotton crop and forced the state to diversify.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Irony: (Honoring a pest, Diversification, Agricultural history).

cards.name: Banning a Textbook
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 3 from moderates.
cards.flavorText: We found a math book that we didn't like. It has been permanently removed from the state curriculum.
cards.learningGoal: Censorship Rhetoric: (Curriculum, Banned, Objectionable material).

cards.name: The Waffle House Index
cards.flavorText: A Category 4 hurricane hit, but the local Waffle House is serving scattered hashbrowns. The economy will recover.
cards.learningGoal: Disaster Economics: (Waffle House Index, Scattered and smothered, Resiliency).

cards.name: Auto Plant Subsidy
cards.flavorText: We gave a foreign automaker zero taxes for 20 years, but hey, the county got 3,000 manufacturing jobs!
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Welfare: (Tax abatement, Foreign automaker, Job creation).

cards.name: The Lottery Debate
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital now, lose 2 Support later.
cards.flavorText: We are finally going to pass a state lottery to fund schools! (The bill dies in committee for the 25th consecutive year).
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Purgatory: (Dies in committee, Perpetual debate, Revenue shortfall).

cards.name: Buying Lottery Tickets in Georgia
cards.flavorText: Half the state is currently driving across the Georgia or Florida border to buy Powerball tickets.
cards.learningGoal: Border Leakage: (Lost revenue, Crossing the state line, Powerball).

cards.name: Meat and Three
cards.flavorText: Eating country-fried steak, fried okra, mac and cheese, and a biscuit. Your cholesterol is peaking, but the voters love it.
cards.learningGoal: Southern Cuisine: (Meat and three, Fried okra, Artery-clogging).

cards.name: The Peanut Farmers
cards.flavorText: Down in Dothan, the peanut is king. We boil them, we roast them, and we fund your political action committee.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Monopolies: (Wiregrass, Boiled peanuts, PAC money).

cards.name: The Yellowhammer
cards.flavorText: A resilient little woodpecker that survives everything. Just like my deeply flawed campaign!
cards.learningGoal: Symbolic Resilience: (Woodpecker, Yellowhammer, Weathering the storm).

cards.name: The Vulcan Statue
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind a 56-foot-tall, bare-bottomed cast-iron Roman god overlooking the city of Birmingham.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Oddities: (Cast-iron, Bare-bottomed, Overlooking).

cards.name: Out-of-State Agitators
cards.flavorText: This scandal isn't our fault! It's those meddling agitators from New York and California causing trouble!
cards.learningGoal: Scapegoating: (Meddling, Agitators, Outside interference).

cards.name: Banned from the Mall
cards.flavorText: Your opponent was reportedly banned from the local indoor mall for highly questionable behavior. The whispers are deafening.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Scandal: (Banned, Highly questionable, Whispers).

cards.name: The U.S. Space & Rocket Center
cards.flavorText: Wearing a blue flight suit and sitting in a simulated capsule to show you are focused on the future.
cards.learningGoal: Nostalgic Tourism: (Space Camp, Flight suit, Simulated).

cards.name: The Southern Baptist Convention
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but opponent cannot play Progressive cards.
cards.flavorText: If you don't show up to church on Sunday, you don't show up on the ballot on Tuesday.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Gatekeeping: (Moral majority, Convention, Sunday service).

cards.name: Sweet Tea IV Drip
cards.flavorText: You consumed 100 grams of liquid cane sugar in a single Mason jar. Your heart is racing, but your legislation is passing.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Caffeination: (Mason jar, Cane sugar, Liquid fuel).

cards.name: Bear Bryant's Houndstooth
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: You put on a black-and-white houndstooth fedora. You are now channeling the spirit of the greatest coach in history.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Veneration: (Houndstooth, Fedora, Channeling the spirit).

cards.name: The 'Bless Your Heart' Defense
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You smiled sweetly, patted their arm, and told them 'Bless your heart.' Their political career is effectively over.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Devastating insult, Smiled sweetly, Southern shade).

cards.name: Sunday Blue Laws
cards.flavorText: You tried to buy a bottle of wine on a Sunday morning. The cashier looked at you like you were a criminal.
cards.learningGoal: Prohibition Holdovers: (Blue laws, Dry county, Restricted sales).

cards.name: The Civil Rights Trail
cards.flavorText: Walking across the historic bridge in Selma to connect your campaign to the giants of American history.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Weight: (Civil rights, Giants of history, Historic bridge).

cards.name: The Farm Bureau
cards.flavorText: We own the forests and we plant the cotton. Keep the property taxes low and we will keep you in office.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Leverage: (Timberland, Cash crop, Property tax cap).

cards.name: The Missing Tooth Joke
cards.flavorText: You beat the national media to the punchline with a self-deprecating joke. The locals appreciate the defense.
cards.learningGoal: Self-Deprecation: (Punchline, Stereotype, Beating them to it).

cards.name: The Heart of Dixie
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the deep, beating heart of the American South. We are stubborn, we are proud, and we vote!
cards.learningGoal: Regional Defiance: (Heart of Dixie, Beating heart, Stubborn pride).

cards.name: The Hurricane Deductible
cards.flavorText: A Category 3 storm just hit Mobile. Your campaign headquarters roof is gone and the insurance company is ignoring your calls.
cards.learningGoal: Coastal Insurance Woes: (Wind and hail, Deductible, Adjuster).

cards.name: The Hyundai Plant
cards.flavorText: We offered massive tax incentives and now they are building Elantras in Montgomery. Win-win!
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Recruitment: (Foreign direct investment, Assembly line, Incentives).

cards.name: The Bassmaster Classic
cards.flavorText: Weighing a 10-pound largemouth bass on a brightly lit stage in front of 5,000 screaming fishermen.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Sports: (Largemouth bass, Weigh-in, Angler).

cards.name: The State Senate Filibuster
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: A state senator is currently reading the recipe for a pecan pie to delay a controversial budget vote.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Stalling: (Filibuster, Running out the clock, Reading the phonebook).

cards.name: The Shuttlesworth Airport
cards.flavorText: We finally renovated the airport! It still only has direct flights to Atlanta and Dallas, but it looks nice!
cards.learningGoal: Aviation Sarcasm: (Renovation, Direct flight, Regional hub).

cards.name: The Broad Street Aristocrat
cards.flavorText: We have lived on this peninsula since 1670. The humidity is terrible, but the pedigree is impeccable.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Pedigree: (Impeccable, Lineage, Aristocracy, South of Broad).

cards.name: The Upstate Industrialist
cards.flavorText: We lured the foreign automakers and transformed the foothills into an economic juggernaut.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Hubris: (Juggernaut, Foreign investment, Foothills).

cards.name: The Midlands Bureaucrat
cards.flavorText: Columbia is miserably hot, but it is where the state contracts are signed. Welcome to the swamp.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Realism: (Swamp, State contracts, Compromise).

cards.name: First-in-the-South Kingmaker
cards.flavorText: You don't win the Presidency without kissing the ring in South Carolina first. I expect a cabinet position.
cards.learningGoal: Political Leverage: (Kingmaker, Kiss the ring, Stepping stone).

cards.name: The Lowcountry Waterman
cards.flavorText: We catch the shrimp, pick the oysters, and absolutely resent the tourists from Ohio.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Authenticity: (Pluff mud, Oystering, Resentment).

cards.name: Palmetto Bug Panic
cards.flavorText: A two-inch roach just flew directly at your face during a live television interview.
cards.learningGoal: Sensory Horror: (Erratic flight, Palmetto bug, Infestation).

cards.name: Pluff Mud at Low Tide
cards.flavorText: The tide rolled out, and the marsh smells like rotten eggs. The out-of-towners are gagging.
cards.learningGoal: Olfactory Nuance: (Sulfur, Low tide, Decomposing marsh).

cards.name: Hurricane Evacuation
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: I-26 is now one-way heading west. Grab the photo albums and board up the windows.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Logistics: (Lane reversal, Boarding up, Storm surge).

cards.name: Mustard-Based BBQ
cards.flavorText: It’s tangy, it’s yellow, and if you ask for a tomato-based sauce, you will be asked to leave.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Dogma: (Tangy, Mustard-based, Culinary exile).

cards.name: Clemson vs. Carolina
cards.effect: Both players discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: The state is completely paralyzed by a football game. The orange and garnet bloodlines are at war.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Tribalism: (House divided, Garnet and black, Orange blood).

cards.name: The Grand Strand Tourist
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital, but opponent gains +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: Millions of tourists in neon shirts playing mini-golf. The sales tax revenue is immense.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Aesthetics: (Grand Strand, Neon-lit, Mini-golf capital).

cards.name: Ohio Transplants
cards.flavorText: Half of Ohio just moved to a master-planned community near Hilton Head. The locals are printing bumper stickers.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Shifts: (Transplant, Rust belt refugee, Halfback).

cards.name: Gated Community Retirees
cards.flavorText: We drive golf carts to the grocery store and will sue the state if property taxes go up by $10.
cards.learningGoal: Retiree Entitlement: (Gated enclave, Fixed income, Litigious).

cards.name: BMW Manufacturing Plant
cards.flavorText: We brought German engineering to the Upstate! The economy is booming and the supply chain is robust.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Revitalization: (Supply chain, German engineering, Manufacturing boom).

cards.name: Boeing Dreamliner Factory
cards.flavorText: We build the airplanes and we bust the unions. Welcome to a right-to-work paradise.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Defiance: (Right-to-work, Union busting, Aerospace).

cards.name: Sweetgrass Baskets
cards.flavorText: Buying a beautifully woven basket on Highway 17 to show respect for the region's deepest roots.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Preservation: (Gullah Geechee, Woven heritage, Ancestral arts).

cards.name: The Heritage Classic
cards.flavorText: Drinking cocktails at Harbour Town while billionaires wearing tartan plaid jackets write campaign checks.
cards.learningGoal: Ostentatious Wealth: (Tartan plaid, Harbour Town, High society).

cards.name: I-26 Gridlock
cards.flavorText: You are trying to drive from Columbia to Charleston on a Friday. You are not moving.
cards.learningGoal: Commuter Despair: (Gridlock, Parking lot, Inadequate infrastructure).

cards.name: Boiled Peanut Stand
cards.flavorText: Stopping at a tent on a two-lane highway to buy a dripping, salty styrofoam cup of legumes.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Commerce: (Roadside stand, Salty brine, Legumes).

cards.name: First in the South Primary
cards.effect: Double your Capital and Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The entire national media is camped out in Greenville. The money is flowing like a river!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Gravity: (National spotlight, War chest, Presidential primary).

cards.name: Potholes in Columbia
cards.flavorText: You hit a pothole near the State House so deep it realigned your campaign bus's suspension.
cards.learningGoal: Deferred Maintenance: (Crater, Realignment, Crumbling roads).

cards.name: Shrimping Boat Fleet
cards.flavorText: We pull the shrimp from the sound. Protect our waterways from development, or lose the county.
cards.learningGoal: Aquaculture Lobby: (Trawling, Estuary, Coastal conservation).

cards.name: Evangelical Upstate
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but opponent cannot play Progressive cards.
cards.flavorText: You do not win a primary here without knowing your Bible verses and defending traditional values.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Gatekeeping: (Primary base, Biblical literacy, Traditionalism).

cards.name: Moped in Traffic
cards.flavorText: You are stuck behind a rented moped going 15 miles per hour down Ocean Boulevard.
cards.learningGoal: Vacation Nuisances: (Moped, Strip cruising, Boulevard traffic).

cards.name: Sand Gnats
cards.flavorText: Invisible, flesh-eating gnats are swarming your outdoor rally. Everyone is scratching their ankles in misery.
cards.learningGoal: Pest Annoyance: (No-see-ums, Invisible swarm, Ankle biters).

cards.name: The Palmetto Tree
cards.flavorText: We put our flag on our hats, our coolers, and our dogs. It is simply the best logo in the Union.
cards.learningGoal: Vexillology Pride: (Crescent moon, Palmetto tree, Branding).

cards.name: Fort Sumter Metaphor
cards.flavorText: We fired the first shots once, and we will absolutely ignore federal mandates again!
cards.learningGoal: Secessionist Echoes: (Defiance, First shots, States' rights).

cards.name: Southern Charm
cards.flavorText: A devastating political insult wrapped in a tray of warm biscuits and a blindingly bright smile.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Southern charm, Blinding smile, Disarming).

cards.name: Sweet Tea Coma
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: You drank 32 ounces of tea that was 40% cane sugar. The glycemic crash has paused the debate.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Excess: (Glycemic index, Sugar crash, Over-sweetened).

cards.name: Golf Cart Parade
cards.flavorText: Campaigning via a customized golf cart in a coastal town. The epitome of low-speed luxury.
cards.learningGoal: Leisure Logistics: (Low-speed vehicle, Coastal cruising, Customized).

cards.name: Unannexed Enclaves
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: The county zoning map looks like Swiss cheese. Your opponent just promised services to a neighborhood that doesn't legally exist.
cards.learningGoal: Zoning Chaos: (Unannexed, Sprawl, Jurisdictional nightmare).

cards.name: Frogmore Stew
cards.flavorText: Dumping shrimp, corn, sausage, and potatoes onto a newspaper-covered picnic table. Bipartisan joy.
cards.learningGoal: Communal Dining: (Lowcountry boil, Frogmore stew, Dumping the pot).

cards.name: The Nullification Crisis
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from the base, trigger a federal lawsuit.
cards.flavorText: We don't like this federal law, so we are simply pretending it doesn't apply to us!
cards.learningGoal: Constitutional Rebellion: (Nullification, Ignoring the feds, Rebellion).

cards.name: The Political Chameleon
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: I was a moderate yesterday, I am a hardliner today, and I will be whatever I need to be tomorrow.
cards.learningGoal: Ideological Flexibility: (Chameleon, Pivoting, Survival instinct).

cards.name: Pimento Cheese Sandwich
cards.flavorText: Aiken is basically just a waiting room for the Augusta National. Pass the $1.50 cheese sandwiches.
cards.learningGoal: Proximity Pandering: (Spillover economy, Pimento cheese, The border).

cards.name: The General Assembly
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The governor has no real power here! The legislature controls the boards, the judges, and the money!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Supremacy: (Stripped executive, Assembly control, The real power).

cards.name: State-Owned Utility Failure
cards.flavorText: We spent $9 billion on nuclear reactors we never finished. You voted for it. Your career is over.
cards.learningGoal: Catastrophic Boondoggles: (Nuclear abandonment, Sunk cost, Ratepayer bailout).

cards.name: College Baseball Supremacy
cards.flavorText: We don't just care about football; we will pack 8,000 people into a baseball stadium in February.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Sports Fanaticism: (The Diamond, Year-round sports, Pack the stands).

cards.name: Blue Laws
cards.effect: Opponent skips a turn trying to buy a drink.
cards.flavorText: You cannot buy a bottle of wine before church. It’s the law, and you must sit and think about what you’ve done.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Restrictions: (Blue laws, Dry Sunday, Prohibition holdover).

cards.name: Beach Renourishment
cards.flavorText: We spent millions dredging sand onto the beach! (A mild storm washed it all away three weeks later).
cards.learningGoal: Futile Infrastructure: (Renourishment, Dredging, Sisyphean task).

cards.name: The Broad Street Ring
cards.flavorText: If you didn't go to law school in this state, you aren't getting into this meeting.
cards.learningGoal: Nepotistic Networks: (Old boys club, Ring, Closed doors).

cards.name: Waffle House After Midnight
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a ceasefire in the smoking section of a 24-hour diner while a fistfight breaks out in the parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Late-Night Diplomacy: (Scattered and smothered, Smothering the beef).

cards.name: Peach Capital of the World
cards.flavorText: We produce more peaches than the 'Peach State,' and we will remind them of this fact every single day.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Rivalries: (Stolen valor, Produce bragging rights).

cards.name: The State Fair
cards.flavorText: Eating a deeply unhealthy sphere of fried dough while looking at a prize-winning pig. Politics 101.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Gluttony: (Artery-clogging, State fair, Deep-fried).

cards.name: Sea Level Rise
cards.flavorText: It's a sunny day in downtown Charleston, but the streets are under two feet of ocean water.
cards.learningGoal: Climate Reality: (King tide, Sunny day flooding, Sea level rise).

cards.name: Carolina Shag
cards.flavorText: Doing a smooth, six-count swing dance on a wooden pavilion to beach music. You are incredibly charming.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Heritage: (Carolina Shag, Beach music, Smooth footwork).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Oh, you thought you had the votes to pass that bill? Bless your heart.
cards.learningGoal: Passive-Aggressive Insults: (Weaponized pity, Sweet delivery, Devastating intent).

cards.name: South of the Border
cards.flavorText: You got distracted by 150 consecutive billboards for a tacky, neon-lit roadside attraction on I-95.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Kitsch: (Billboard fatigue, Sombrero tower, Tourist trap).

cards.name: Secession Talk
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: If Washington doesn't back down, we will simply leave the Union! (Again). The base is absolutely fired up!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Extremism: (Secessionist, Threatening to leave, Echoes of the past).

cards.name: The Senate Leader
cards.flavorText: I don't play for the news cycle. I play for the federal judiciary. The turtle always wins the race.
cards.learningGoal: Strategic Patience: (The long game, Judiciary, Outlasting, Tactical delay).

cards.name: The Legacy Governor
cards.translation: The Blue Dot in a Red State
cards.flavorText: My dad was the governor, I am the governor, and I will kindly veto your supermajority's legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Dynastic Pragmatism: (Legacy, Veto power, Bipartisan appeal).

cards.name: The Bourbon Baron
cards.flavorText: We age the whiskey for twelve years, but the tax lobbying pays off immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Distilling Jargon: (Aged, Charred oak, The Angel's Share, Taxation).

cards.name: The Appalachian Populist
cards.flavorText: From Pikeville to Hazard, we take care of our own. Frankfort forgot we existed decades ago.
cards.learningGoal: Isolationist Geography: (The Holler, Forgotten corners, Self-reliance).

cards.name: The Golden Triangle Elite
cards.flavorText: We control the money, the horses, and the highways. The rest of the state just works here.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Arrogance: (Golden Triangle, Economic engine, Consolidated wealth).

cards.name: Northern Kentucky Expat
cards.flavorText: We are physically in Kentucky, but spiritually and economically, we are just an Ohio suburb.
cards.learningGoal: Border Identities: (Orbit, Spillover, Bedroom community).

cards.name: The Pappy Allocation
cards.flavorText: Sliding a bottle of 23-year-old family reserve across the desk. The legislation is guaranteed to pass.
cards.learningGoal: Luxury Scarcity: (Allocation, Secondary market, Liquid gold, Bribery).

cards.name: Dry County Hypocrisy
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the South.
cards.flavorText: Your county produces 90% of the world's bourbon, but it's illegal to buy a beer at the gas station.
cards.learningGoal: Prohibition Ironies: (Dry county, Bootlegger, Hypocritical, Archaic).

cards.name: The Hot Brown Coma
cards.flavorText: You ate an open-faced turkey sandwich smothered in boiling cheese and bacon. You need a nap immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Excess: (Open-faced, Smothered, Comatose, Richness).

cards.name: Big Blue Nation
cards.effect: Provides +4 Support, but leaves if you play a Louisville card.
cards.flavorText: The most demanding, passionate, and terrifying fanbase in college sports. Wear blue or be banished.
cards.learningGoal: Fanatic Devotion: (Banner year, Recruiting class, Uncompromising).

cards.name: Cards Nation
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but leaves if you play a UK card.
cards.flavorText: The Battle of the Bluegrass divides families, offices, and the entire state legislature. Pick a side.
cards.learningGoal: Fierce Rivalries: (House divided, Battle of the Bluegrass, Loyalty).

cards.name: The Two Most Exciting Minutes
cards.flavorText: The roses, the hats, the weeping to 'My Old Kentucky Home.' You are riding a wave of pure state pride.
cards.learningGoal: Equestrian Grandiosity: (The Run for the Roses, Pomp and circumstance, Majestic).

cards.name: Millionaire's Row
cards.flavorText: Drinking $20 mint juleps with billionaires and celebrities. The campaign checks are writing themselves.
cards.learningGoal: High Society Networking: (Aristocracy, Millionaire's Row, Schmoozing).

cards.name: The Infield Debauchery
cards.flavorText: Forget the horses. 80,000 people are covered in mud, drinking heavily, and running on port-a-potties.
cards.learningGoal: Revelry and Chaos: (Debauchery, Mud-soaked, Lawless).

cards.name: Mint Julep Pandering
cards.flavorText: Pretending to enjoy a cup of crushed ice, bourbon, and entirely too much simple syrup for the cameras.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Tradition: (Pandering, Syrupy, Muddled).

cards.name: The Coal Severance Tax
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The mines are closing, the severance tax revenue is gone, and the county budgets are completely empty.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Devastation: (Severance tax, Shortfall, Economic transition).

cards.name: Friends of Coal License Plate
cards.flavorText: We put a black license plate on our Prius in Lexington to show we absolutely support the miners.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Sympathy: (Virtue signaling, Disconnect, Lip service).

cards.name: Ale-8-One Sugar Rush
cards.flavorText: Chugging a highly caffeinated ginger-citrus soda. You are operating at maximum legislative speed.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Caffeination: (Ginger-citrus, Late-night fuel, Regional soda).

cards.name: The Rickhouse Fire
cards.flavorText: Lightning struck the barrel warehouse. A flaming river of whiskey is flowing into the Kentucky River.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Disasters: (Rickhouse, Barrel strength, Flammable, Catastrophe).

cards.name: Mammoth Cave Filibuster
cards.flavorText: We dragged the committee into the longest cave system on Earth. Your opponent is literally lost in the dark.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Hyperbole: (Stalactite, Subterranean, Lost in the dark).

cards.name: Florence Y'all Water Tower
cards.flavorText: A massive water tower that literally just says 'Y'all.' It is grammatically incorrect but incredibly charming.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Americana: (Colloquialism, Welcoming, Kitsch).

cards.name: The Brent Spence Bridge
cards.flavorText: The bridge connecting to Ohio is falling apart, but nobody wants to pay the tolls to fix it. Traffic is stalled.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Gridlock: (Bottleneck, Crumbling, Toll dispute).

cards.name: Toyota Plant Georgetown
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from populists.
cards.flavorText: We gave them massive tax breaks, and now they build half the Camrys in America. The economy humms.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Subsidies: (Assembly line, Tax incentive, Economic engine).

cards.name: The Ark Encounter
cards.flavorText: We gave a massive tax incentive to build a 510-foot-long wooden boat in a field. The tourists are flocking.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Tourism: (Tax abatement, Fundamentalism, Spectacle).

cards.name: The Veto Override
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The Democratic Governor vetoed the bill, so the Republican legislature overrode it 15 minutes later.
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Dominance: (Veto override, Steamroll, Supermajority, Ineffective executive).

cards.name: Kentucky Colonel Commission
cards.flavorText: You cannot attack me; the Governor legally declared me a Kentucky Colonel! I have a certificate!
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Titles: (Honorary, Pretension, Paper shield).

cards.name: Louisville Slugger
cards.flavorText: Swinging a 120-foot-tall steel baseball bat at your opponent's terrible tax proposal.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Symbolism: (Home run, Swinging for the fences, Heavy hitter).

cards.name: Bluegrass Music Festival
cards.flavorText: Three guys playing the mandolin, upright bass, and banjo at 200 beats per minute. The crowd is energized.
cards.learningGoal: Acoustic Fervor: (Bluegrass, Picking, High-energy).

cards.name: Cumberland Gap Tourist
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got distracted trying to hike the historic passage through the Appalachian Mountains.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Geography: (The Gap, Pioneer, Impassable).

cards.name: Fort Knox Gold
cards.flavorText: We theoretically hold the entire gold reserve of the United States. We are leveraging the aura of wealth.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Mythology: (Bullion, Depository, Untouchable wealth).

cards.name: Mitch's Freeze
cards.flavorText: Your opponent just stared blankly into space for 30 seconds during a press conference. The optics are terrible.
cards.learningGoal: Optics Failure: (Glitch, Freezing up, Uncomfortable silence).

cards.name: The Red State Pivot
cards.flavorText: The coal miners used to vote for the unions. Now they vote on the culture war. The map has flipped entirely.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Shifts: (Realignment, Flipping the map, Cultural wedge).

cards.name: The Distiller's Strike
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The union workers at the bourbon plant walked out. The global supply chain of Old Fashioneds is in peril.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Disputes: (Walkout, Supply chain, Liquor industry).

cards.name: Horse Syndicate
cards.flavorText: We spend $50 million on a horse that might run fast one time. We own the politicians, too.
cards.learningGoal: Equestrian Elitism: (Syndicate, Stud fee, Blue bloods).

cards.name: The Sleepy Capital
cards.flavorText: Frankfort is tiny, hard to get to, and shuts down at 5 PM. Good luck passing that emergency legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Administrative Sluggishness: (Sleepy capital, Isolated, Slow-moving).

cards.name: Mutton BBQ
cards.flavorText: Eating slow-smoked adult sheep dipped in a black, Worcestershire-based sauce. A very specific regional requirement.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Regional Cuisine: (Mutton, Black dip, Acquired taste).

cards.name: The Creation Museum
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 3 from moderates.
cards.flavorText: We are passing a bill requiring equal time for dinosaurs on Noah's Ark!
cards.learningGoal: Culture War Legislation: (Revisionism, Equal time, Fundamentalism).

cards.name: Bipartisan Bourbon Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: We might hate each other's politics, but we both appreciate a neat pour of a single barrel pick.
cards.learningGoal: Liquor Diplomacy: (Single barrel, Neat pour, Finding common ground).

cards.name: The Pension Crisis
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: We promised the teachers a pension, but we haven't funded it in 20 years. The math has finally caught up to us.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Devastation: (Unfunded liability, Pension crisis, Insolvent).

cards.name: The State Fair Pork Producer
cards.flavorText: Flipping a massive, incredibly thick pork chop on an industrial grill to show you support agriculture.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Optics: (Pork producer, Sizzle, Hearty).

cards.name: High School Basketball
cards.flavorText: There are no classes in the state tournament. The smallest rural school is playing the biggest Louisville powerhouse.
cards.learningGoal: Underdog Narratives: (Hoosiers story, Unclassed, David vs Goliath).

cards.name: Hillbilly Elegy Backlash
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in rural areas.
cards.flavorText: You tried to explain Appalachian poverty using a bestselling book written by a guy from Ohio. They hate you.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Gatekeeping: (Outsider narrative, Poverty porn, Condescension).

cards.name: The Turtle Pace
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The bill is dead. I am not bringing it to the floor. I will not discuss it. It is buried in my shell.
cards.learningGoal: Obstructionism: (Blockade, Dying in committee, Refusal to budge).

cards.name: Corvette Museum Sinkhole
cards.flavorText: The floor collapsed and swallowed eight vintage sports cars. A bizarre tragedy that halted local tourism.
cards.learningGoal: Bizarre Disasters: (Sinkhole, Swallowed, Automotive tragedy).

cards.name: The River City
cards.flavorText: We are progressive, we are artsy, and we are constantly trying to convince the rest of the state we belong here.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Enclaves: (River city, Progressive dot, Artsy).

cards.name: Bourbon Trail Tourism
cards.flavorText: Millions of bachelorette parties and corporate retreats are spending $200 a bottle at the gift shop.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Boom: (The Trail, Tasting room, Premium pricing).

cards.name: Sine Die
cards.flavorText: The legislative session is over. The gavel has dropped. The deals are done and the doors are locked.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Adjournment: (Sine Die, Gavel drop, Session concludes).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You smiled sweetly, patted their arm, and told them 'Bless your heart.' Their political career is effectively over.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Devastating insult, Smiled sweetly, Southern shade).

cards.name: The Unbridled Spirit
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the thoroughbreds of American politics. We run fast, we hit hard, and we never apologize!
cards.learningGoal: Unrestrained Momentum: (Unbridled, Thoroughbred, Unstoppable force).

cards.name: The First Sunday in May
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: The horses have run. The bourbon is gone. The entire state is experiencing a collective, agonizing headache.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Exhaustion: (Collective hangover, Recovery day, Drained).

cards.name: The Kingfish Populist
cards.flavorText: Every man a king! We are building roads, bridges, and free hospitals! Just don't ask where the money came from.
cards.learningGoal: Populist Grandiosity: (Every man a king, Patronage, Absolute power).

cards.name: The Cajun Power Broker
cards.flavorText: We drill the oil, we trap the crawfish, and we speak a language Baton Rouge barely understands.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Isolation: (Cajun French, Cultural autonomy, Deep roots).

cards.name: The New Orleans Aristocrat
cards.effect: Arts and Tourism cards generate +2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: I live in the Garden District and my family has been in the exact same Mardi Gras krewe since 1884.
cards.learningGoal: Old Money Exclusivity: (Aristocracy, Pedigree, Krewe, Stately).

cards.name: The North Louisiana Conservative
cards.flavorText: Down south they are drinking and dancing. Up here in Shreveport, we are praying and voting.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Schisms: (Cultural divide, Pious, The Bible Belt).

cards.name: The Unapologetic Felon
cards.flavorText: The only way I can lose this election is if I'm caught in bed with either a dead girl or a live boy.
cards.learningGoal: Brazen Defiance: (Unapologetic, Teflon, Beating the rap, Quoting Edwin Edwards).

cards.name: The Jungle Primary
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: Every candidate from every party runs on the same ballot. Pure, unadulterated political chaos.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Formatting: (Jungle primary, Runoff, Free-for-all).

cards.name: Napoleonic Code
cards.effect: Block any Attack card costing 3 or less.
cards.flavorText: You tried to sue me using English Common Law? We don't do that here. Read the civil code, cher.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Exceptions: (Napoleonic Code, Civil law, Jurisprudence).

cards.name: Drive-Thru Daiquiri
cards.flavorText: As long as the paper wrapper is still on the straw, this 32oz frozen cocktail in my cupholder is completely legal.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Loopholes: (Technically legal, Open container, Drive-thru vice).

cards.name: Mardi Gras Paralyzation
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: It is Fat Tuesday. The entire city of New Orleans is drunk and wearing purple. Government has ceased to exist.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Paralysis: (Debauchery, Revelry, Government shutdown).

cards.name: Crawfish Boil Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Standing around a newspaper-covered table eating spicy mudbugs to broker a peace treaty.
cards.learningGoal: Communal Dining: (Mudbug, Purging, Peeling, Backroom deal).

cards.name: Finding the King Cake Baby
cards.flavorText: You bit into the cake and found the tiny plastic baby! You are blessed, but now you have to buy the next cake.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Obligations: (Tradition, Good fortune, Passing the buck).

cards.name: Gumbo Purism
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the South.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent put tomatoes in their seafood gumbo. The Cajuns have officially declared war.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Dogma: (Roux, Purist, Sacrilege, Authenticity test).

cards.name: Boudin Stop at a Gas Station
cards.flavorText: Eating pork and rice sausage out of a casing in a gas station parking lot off I-10. You are a man of the people.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Pandering: (Boudin, Gas station delicacy, Casing).

cards.name: Who Dat Nation
cards.flavorText: If the Saints win on Sunday, the voters are forgiving on Monday. If they lose, heads will roll in City Hall.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Religion: (Who Dat, The Dome, Vicarious mood swings).

cards.name: Death Valley Night Game
cards.effect: Both players must discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: 100,000 LSU fans screaming in the dark. The noise level just registered as a minor earthquake.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Intimidation: (Death Valley, Seismic, Deafening).

cards.name: Second Line Parade
cards.flavorText: Following a brass band down the street waving a handkerchief. The political momentum is infectious.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Celebration: (Second line, Brass band, Infectious rhythm).

cards.name: Hurricane Evacuation
cards.flavorText: Both sides of the interstate are flowing north. A Category 4 is in the Gulf. Pack the car.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Logistics: (Contraflow, Category 4, The Cone of Uncertainty).

cards.name: Sinking Coastline
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: We are losing a football field of land every hour. The map of the state is literally shrinking.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Devastation: (Erosion, Vanishing coast, Sinking).

cards.name: 100% Humidity
cards.flavorText: You walked from your car to the campaign office and sweat through your entire seersucker suit.
cards.learningGoal: Oppressive Weather: (Sweltering, Seersucker, Suffocating).

cards.name: The River Pilots
cards.flavorText: We guide the massive cargo ships up the river. You can only join our union if your great-grandfather was a pilot.
cards.learningGoal: Nepotistic Cartels: (River pilot, Monopoly, Generational wealth).

cards.name: Big Oil and Gas
cards.effect: Provides +3 Capital, but opponent gains +1 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: We employ the state and we fund the campaigns. Don't look too closely at the air quality monitors.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Dominance: (Petrochemical, Refinery, Turning a blind eye).

cards.name: The Cajun Navy
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: The government failed, so hundreds of guys in flat-bottom boats with shotguns showed up to save the neighborhood.
cards.learningGoal: Vigilante Altruism: (Flat-bottom boat, Rescue operation, Taking matters into their own hands).

cards.name: Formosan Termite Swarm
cards.flavorText: It's May in New Orleans. The streetlights are swarming with billions of flying wood-eaters. Stay indoors.
cards.learningGoal: Pest Invasions: (Formosan, Swarming, Structural damage).

cards.name: Sewerage & Water Board
cards.flavorText: A mild thunderstorm hit and the city flooded because half the drainage pumps were 'undergoing maintenance.'
cards.learningGoal: Municipal Incompetence: (Drainage pump, Flooding, Institutional failure).

cards.name: Boil Water Advisory
cards.flavorText: The water pressure dropped, so you have to boil your tap water before brushing your teeth. Again.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Boil advisory, Water pressure, Decrepit).

cards.name: Trial Lawyer Billboards
cards.flavorText: 'Wrecked? Get a Check!' There are 400 consecutive billboards of angry lawyers pointing at you on the highway.
cards.learningGoal: Litigious Landscape: (Personal injury, Aggressive marketing, Billboard blight).

cards.name: The Sugar Cane Farmers
cards.flavorText: We burn the cane fields in the winter to harvest the sugar. The ash falls like black snow.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Practices: (Cane field, Controlled burn, Sugar lobby).

cards.name: The Industrial Tax Exemption
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, lose 3 Support from local schools.
cards.flavorText: We exempted the massive chemical plant from paying local property taxes for ten years! The schools are broke.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Welfare: (Tax exemption, Starving the beast, Loophole).

cards.name: Lagniappe
cards.flavorText: Giving the voters just a tiny, unexpected bonus to keep them smiling. A baker's dozen of political favors.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Generosity: (Lagniappe, A little extra, Gratuity).

cards.name: Vote for the Crook
cards.flavorText: He may be under federal investigation, but at least he's not an extremist! Hold your nose and vote!
cards.learningGoal: Pragmatic Cynicism: (Hold your nose, Lesser of two evils, Famous bumper sticker).

cards.name: The Federal Indictment
cards.effect: All Active Faction buffs are destroyed.
