cards.flavorText: The FBI just raided the mayor's house, the contractor's office, and a very specific trash collection company.
cards.learningGoal: Endemic Corruption: (Indictment, Federal raid, Kickbacks).

cards.name: Parish Police Jury
cards.flavorText: We don't have counties, we have Parishes. And we don't have a commission, we have a Police Jury. Learn the law!
cards.learningGoal: Geopolitical Quirks: (Parish, Police Jury, Distinct governance).

cards.name: Bipartisan Gumbo Pot
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from moderates, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: Throwing the Democrats, the Republicans, and the Independents into the same pot and letting it simmer.
cards.learningGoal: Political Blending: (Melting pot, Simmering, Coalition).

cards.name: Vieux Carré Commission
cards.flavorText: You want to paint your shutters a slightly different shade of green? The historical commission will see you in court.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Preservation: (Vieux Carré, Shutters, Archival, Over-regulation).

cards.name: The Hospitality Industry
cards.flavorText: We pour the Hand Grenades and clean up the beads. The state economy literally survives on our tips.
cards.learningGoal: Service Economy: (Hospitality, Tips, Bourbon Street, Vice tourism).

cards.name: Chemical Plant Flaring
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: A massive pillar of fire is shooting out of the refinery stack behind your press conference. It looks terrible.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Optics: (Flaring, Petrochemical corridor, Plume).

cards.name: Sports Betting Revenue
cards.flavorText: We finally legalized it on our phones. Everyone is betting their rent money on SEC football. The state is rich!
cards.learningGoal: Vice Revenue: (Sportsbook, Wagering, Rent money).

cards.name: Moving to Houston
cards.flavorText: The insurance rates doubled, so your donors are packing up the U-Haul and moving to Texas.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Migration: (Capital flight, Insurance premiums, U-Haul index).

cards.name: The Atchafalaya Basin Bridge
cards.flavorText: You are stuck on a two-lane bridge suspended over a massive, alligator-filled swamp. A truck broke down.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Chokepoints: (Suspended bridge, Basin, Bottleneck).

cards.name: Stealing the Pothole Cone
cards.flavorText: Someone put an orange cone in a massive pothole. Someone else stole the cone. Your opponent drove into the hole.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Absurdity: (Pothole, Makeshift warnings, Neglect).

cards.name: French Quarter Curfew
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the suburbs, lose 2 from the city.
cards.flavorText: Crime is up, so we are shutting down the most famous party street in the world at midnight.
cards.learningGoal: Reactionary Policy: (Curfew, Crackdown, Killing the vibe).

cards.name: Throw Me Something, Mister!
cards.flavorText: Throwing cheap plastic beads from a balcony. The crowd goes wild for something they will throw away tomorrow.
cards.learningGoal: Frivolous Pandering: (Trinkets, Mardi Gras beads, Cheap thrills).

cards.name: The State Capitol Sniper
cards.flavorText: Pointing to the actual bullet holes still in the marble walls of the State Capitol to prove politics is a blood sport.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Assassinations: (Marble columns, Blood sport, Eerie reminders).

cards.name: Drive-Thru Daq Shop Lobby
cards.flavorText: We own every daiquiri shop in a 50-mile radius. Don't touch our styrofoam cups or our open container loopholes.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Lobbying: (Syndicate, Styrofoam, Vice peddlers).

cards.name: The Cajun Two-Step
cards.flavorText: Playing the accordion and the washboard at a political rally. Everyone is dancing and eating boudin.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Traditions: (Fais do-do, Washboard, Accordion, Zydeco).

cards.name: Catholic Voting Bloc
cards.flavorText: Pro-labor, heavily traditional, and fiercely loyal to their parishes. A fascinating, powerful demographic.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Demographics: (Catholic enclave, Pro-labor, Traditionalist).

cards.name: Baptist Voting Bloc
cards.flavorText: Deeply conservative and morally rigid. If you want to win north of Alexandria, you better be in the pews on Sunday.
cards.learningGoal: Evangelical Gatekeeping: (Moral rigidity, Pews, The Bible Belt).

cards.name: Let the Good Times Roll!
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The jazz is playing, the food is spicy, and the money is flowing! We don't care about tomorrow!
cards.learningGoal: Hedonistic Momentum: (Laissez les bons temps rouler, Living in the moment, Euphoria).

cards.name: The Nutria Rat
cards.flavorText: A 20-pound, orange-toothed swamp rat just walked across the stage. Your opponent is deeply unsettled.
cards.learningGoal: Invasive Species: (Nutria, Orange-toothed, Unsettling).

cards.name: The Pelican State
cards.flavorText: The state bird famously tears its own flesh to feed its young. We will sacrifice everything to win this fight!
cards.learningGoal: Grisly Symbolism: (Self-sacrifice, Pelican, Tearing flesh, Unyielding).

cards.name: The Portland Progressive
cards.flavorText: We will power the city entirely on compost, good vibes, and artisanal espresso!
cards.learningGoal: Progressive Utopianism: (Artisanal, Compostable, Equity, Utopian).

cards.name: The Timber Baron
cards.flavorText: My grandfather cut the Douglas Firs that built this state. Stop chaining yourselves to my inventory.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Heritage: (Timber, Inventory, Clear-cut, Generational).

cards.name: Greater Idaho Secessionist
cards.flavorText: We have absolutely nothing in common with the Willamette Valley. Move the state line immediately!
cards.learningGoal: Secessionist Rhetoric: (Defector, Annexation, Drawing lines, Autonomy).

cards.name: The Nike Exec
cards.flavorText: Our corporate campus in Beaverton basically funds the state. Just do it (pass the tax abatement).
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Leverage: (Tax abatement, Sponsorship, Philanthropy).

cards.name: The Pinot Vintner
cards.flavorText: The volcanic soil gives our wine a delicate, earthy finish, much like my highly curated political campaign.
cards.learningGoal: Oenophile Jargon: (Terroir, Notes, Curated, Earthy finish).

cards.name: State Senate Walkout
cards.effect: The game pauses; Opponent skips 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: You didn't have the votes to stop the bill, so you literally fled the state so the legislature lacked a quorum.
cards.learningGoal: Procedural Sabotage: (Denying a quorum, Fleeing jurisdiction, Standoff).

cards.name: Measure 110 Rollback
cards.effect: Spend 3 Capital, gain 4 Support from moderates.
cards.flavorText: We decriminalized everything, reconsidered, and are now frantically trying to put the toothpaste back in the tube.
cards.learningGoal: Policy Reversal: (Decriminalization, Backpedaling, Toothpaste in the tube).

cards.name: Pump Your Own Gas
cards.effect: Both players discard 1 card in confusion.
cards.flavorText: They changed the law. You now have to touch the gas pump yourself. The entire state is in a state of existential terror.
cards.learningGoal: Codependent Infrastructure: (Self-serve, Existential terror, Helplessness).

cards.name: Wildfire Smoke
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: It's August. The sky looks like Mars. You cannot go outside, and the air smells like a campfire.
cards.learningGoal: Apocalyptic Climate: (AQI, Particulate matter, Mars-like, Haze).

cards.name: Urban Growth Boundary
cards.flavorText: You cannot build that subdivision here! Beyond this invisible line is sacred farmland and very strict zoning!
cards.learningGoal: Land Use Planning: (Containment, Sprawl, Boundary, High-density).

cards.name: The Cascade Curtain
cards.flavorText: West of the mountains: rain, tech, and tofu. East of the mountains: high desert, cattle, and extreme conservatism.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Polarization: (The Divide, Ideological split, Rain shadow).

cards.name: Food Cart Pod Diplomacy
cards.flavorText: Solving a budget crisis while eating a bulgogi taco and vegan mac-and-cheese in a gravel parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Micro-Gastronomy: (Pod, Fusion cuisine, Gravel lot).

cards.name: Spotted Owl Injunction
cards.effect: Block any Corporate or Infrastructure attack.
cards.flavorText: A federal judge ruled that a tiny, adorable bird is more important than your entire logging operation.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Litigation: (Injunction, Endangered species, Blockade).

cards.name: Voodoo Doughnut Photo Op
cards.flavorText: You paid $6 for a doughnut covered in Cap'n Crunch and shaped like a voodoo doll. The tourists love it.
cards.learningGoal: Kitsch Tourism: (Novelty, Pink box, Overhyped, Tourist trap).

cards.name: The Naked Bike Ride
cards.flavorText: Ten thousand nude cyclists just rode past your fundraising dinner. This is completely normal here.
cards.learningGoal: Counterculture Spectacle: (Body positivity, Desensitized, Spectacle).

cards.name: No Sales Tax
cards.flavorText: We pay incredibly high income and property taxes, but buying a flat-screen TV is 8% cheaper! We are financial geniuses!
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Irony: (No sales tax, Income tax reliance, Shopper's haven).

cards.name: Crossing the Columbia
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We are finally going to replace the 100-year-old bridge to Washington! (It will cost $6 billion and take twenty years).
cards.learningGoal: Megaproject Stagnation: (Gridlock, Over budget, Interstate cooperation).

cards.name: Umbrella Shaming
cards.flavorText: You opened an umbrella during a drizzle. You have outed yourself as a Californian. True Oregonians just get wet.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Gatekeeping: (Gore-Tex, Drizzle, Shaming, Purist).

cards.name: Marionberry Pie
cards.flavorText: Serving a slice of pie made from a blackberry hybrid invented at Oregon State University. Total local credibility.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Pride: (Hybrid, Cultivar, Local credibility).

cards.name: Vote-by-Mail Pioneer
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We've been voting in our pajamas at the kitchen table since 1998. We have perfected the democratic process.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Superiority: (Vote-by-mail, Convenience, High turnout).

cards.name: The Exploding Whale
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: You tried to solve a problem with dynamite. It rained blubber on the voters and crushed a car. A legendary disaster.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Absurdity: (Dynamite, Blubber, Unintended consequences, Legendary).

cards.name: Drawbridge Delay
cards.flavorText: You are trying to cross downtown Portland, but the Burnside Bridge is up for a sailboat. You will be late to the debate.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Transit: (Drawbridge, Navigable waterway, Gridlock).

cards.name: Silicon Forest
cards.flavorText: Intel and a dozen other tech companies are quietly manufacturing the microchips that run the planet.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Hubs: (Silicon Forest, Semiconductor, Fabrication).

cards.name: The Malheur Occupation
cards.flavorText: Armed militants took over a remote federal wildlife refuge and demanded someone mail them snacks. Pure chaos.
cards.learningGoal: Anti-Government Extremism: (Occupation, Federal land, Standoff).

cards.name: Crater Lake Majesty
cards.flavorText: Standing at the edge of the deepest, bluest lake in America. The optics are incredibly majestic and serene.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Grandeur: (Caldera, Serene, Untouched beauty).

cards.name: The Hazelnut Monopoly
cards.flavorText: We grow 99% of the US hazelnut crop. Do not call them filberts unless you want a fight.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Monopolies: (Hazelnut, Filbert, Export market).

cards.name: Kombucha on Tap
cards.flavorText: You consumed 16 ounces of fermented, slightly alcoholic tea. Your gut biome is thriving, and your policies are passing.
cards.learningGoal: Health Food Fads: (Fermented, Gut biome, Probiotic).

cards.name: The Oregon Trail Nostalgia
cards.flavorText: You invoked the pioneer spirit, but the voters just remembered the video game where everyone died of waterborne illness.
cards.learningGoal: Pioneer Mythology: (Covered wagon, Dysentery, Generational trauma).

cards.name: Tillamook Cheese Factory
cards.flavorText: A massive dairy cooperative on the rainy coast that controls the cheese market and the hearts of the voters.
cards.learningGoal: Dairy Cooperatives: (Aged cheddar, Cooperative, Coastal agriculture).

cards.name: Beaver vs. Duck
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: Oregon State vs. University of Oregon. The state is cleanly split in half. Green and yellow versus orange and black.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Tribalism: (The Civil War, Rivalry, House divided).

cards.name: Powell's City of Books
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a treaty in the 'Color-Coded Rooms' of a bookstore that takes up an entire city block.
cards.learningGoal: Literary Pretentiousness: (Independent bookstore, City block, Intellectual flex).

cards.name: Dungeness Crab Season
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: The crab pots are full. The butter is melted. The coastal towns are finally making money again.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Harvest: (Crab pot, Fleet, Bountiful harvest).

cards.name: The Californians Are Coming
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent was endorsed by a California real estate developer. The locals are preparing the pitchforks.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Resentment: (Transplant, Gentrification, Driving up prices).

cards.name: Sluggish Transit
cards.flavorText: You took the light rail to the airport. It stopped 45 times. You missed your flight.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Transit Woes: (Light rail, Frequent stops, Sluggish).

cards.name: High Desert Isolation
cards.flavorText: You live in Bend. You hike, you drink craft beer, and you pretend the rest of the state doesn't exist.
cards.learningGoal: Lifestyle Enclaves: (High desert, Remote work, Insulated).

cards.name: The State of Jefferson
cards.flavorText: Southern Oregon and Northern California want to form their own state! They even have a flag with two X's on it!
cards.learningGoal: Separatist Movements: (State of Jefferson, Rebellion, Disenfranchised).

cards.name: Antifa Protester
cards.flavorText: A group of protesters dressed entirely in black has barricaded the street outside your opponent's fundraiser.
cards.learningGoal: Street Politics: (Black bloc, Direct action, Barricade).

cards.name: The Douglas Fir
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You tried to chop me down, but I am deeply rooted in the volcanic soil of this great state!
cards.learningGoal: Botanical Metaphors: (Deeply rooted, Old growth, Resilient).

cards.name: Rain for Eight Months
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: It has been drizzling since Halloween. Vitamin D levels are critically low. The electorate is incredibly grumpy.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Depression: (SAD, The Big Dark, Drizzle, Deficit).

cards.name: Alis Volat Propriis
cards.translation: She Flies With Her Own Wings
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The state motto! We don't need Washington D.C., and we don't need California! We chart our own course!
cards.learningGoal: Fierce Independence: (State motto, Autonomy, Charting a course).

cards.name: The Oil Baron
cards.flavorText: My family has been drilling since statehood. As goes the price of crude, so goes my political donation.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Economics: (Crude, Boom and bust, Statehood, Philanthropy).

cards.name: The Tribal Chief
cards.flavorText: We run the casinos, we fund the infrastructure, and we have a direct line to the federal courts. Negotiate with us.
cards.learningGoal: Sovereignty Jargon: (Jurisdiction, Compact, Sovereign authority).

cards.name: The Tulsa Aristocrat
cards.effect: Arts and Culture cards grant +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We have art deco skyscrapers and old-money philanthropy. We politely pretend Oklahoma City doesn't exist.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Rivalries: (Art Deco, Philanthropy, Old money).

cards.name: The Panhandle Rancher
cards.flavorText: We live an eight-hour drive from the state capitol. We handle our own business out here in the dust.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Alienation: (Panhandle, No Man's Land, Self-reliance).

cards.name: The Dispensary Entrepreneur
cards.flavorText: There are currently more medical dispensaries in this town than gas stations. Welcome to the Wild West.
cards.learningGoal: Emerging Markets: (Green rush, Zoning loophole, Wild West).

cards.name: McGirt v. Oklahoma
cards.effect: Opponent's state-level legal attacks are nullified.
cards.flavorText: The Supreme Court just ruled that half the state is legally a Native American reservation. The governor is having a meltdown.
cards.learningGoal: Jurisdictional Shock: (Nullified, Landmark ruling, Legal meltdown).

cards.name: Tribal Casino Revenue
cards.flavorText: The state budget is failing, but the sovereign casinos just cut a massive check for education. You are saved.
cards.learningGoal: Revenue Sharing: (Gaming compact, Windfall, Sovereign wealth).

cards.name: Fracking Earthquake Swarm
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: You injected wastewater into the bedrock, and now the state capitol is physically vibrating.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Consequences: (Wastewater, Induced seismicity, Bedrock).

cards.name: The Oil Boom
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The rigs are pumping, the roughnecks are spending, and the state budget is overflowing with cash!
cards.learningGoal: Economic Euphoria: (Overflowing coffers, Roughneck, Boomtown).

cards.name: The Oil Bust
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled. Both players lose 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The price of oil just crashed. 10,000 jobs vanished overnight. The state budget is in absolute ruins.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Devastation: (Bust, Deficit, Vanished, Contraction).

cards.name: Fraidy Hole
cards.flavorText: The sirens are blaring. Grab the dog, the photo albums, and the weather radio, and get underground.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Preparedness: (Fraidy hole, Subterranean, Taking cover).

cards.name: Gary England's Blessing
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: The legendary weatherman just took his suit jacket off on live TV. The entire state is immediately mobilized.
cards.learningGoal: Meteorological Panic: (Suit jacket off, Imminent threat, Cult following).

cards.name: Tornado Siren on a Saturday
cards.effect: Opponent skips their turn in confusion.
cards.flavorText: It is exactly 12:00 PM on a clear Saturday. Out-of-staters panic while the locals don't even blink.
cards.learningGoal: Routine Alarms: (Unfazed, Conditioning, Siren test).

cards.name: Storm Chaser Traffic
cards.flavorText: Your campaign bus is stuck behind 40 minivans covered in antennas chasing a supercell.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Tourism: (Supercell, Storm chaser, Mesocyclone).

cards.name: Softball-Sized Hail
cards.flavorText: A massive spring storm just totaled every car in your opponent's campaign fleet. Deductibles are through the roof.
cards.learningGoal: Severe Weather Damage: (Totaled, Deductible, Catastrophic hail).

cards.name: Turnpike Toll Authority
cards.flavorText: We promised the tolls would go away once the highway was paid off in 1953. We lied. Keep paying.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Monopolies: (Toll gantry, Perpetual fee, Broken promises).

cards.name: Medical Marijuana Loophole
cards.effect: Spend 1 Capital, gain 3 Support from libertarians.
cards.flavorText: You have a 'headache'? Here is your card. The state is technically red, but entirely green.
cards.learningGoal: Regulatory Loopholes: (Oversight, Gray area, Blanket approval).

cards.name: Braum's Burger Bag
cards.flavorText: If you don't campaign at the local dairy store with a bag of burgers and a milkshake, you aren't a real Oklahoman.
cards.learningGoal: Fast Food Loyalty: (Vertically integrated, Dairy store, Crinkle cut).

cards.name: El Reno Onion Burger
cards.flavorText: Smashing half a pound of thinly sliced onions into a beef patty to prove you respect working-class history.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Heritage: (Depression-era, Smashed patty, Historic roots).

cards.name: Chicken-Fried Steak Coma
cards.flavorText: You ate a piece of battered, deep-fried beef covered in white pepper gravy. You require a three-hour nap.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Excess: (Deep-fried, White gravy, Food coma).

cards.name: Indian Taco Stand
cards.flavorText: Campaigning at a powwow while eating chili and cheese piled high on fresh, warm frybread. Pure goodwill.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Cuisine: (Frybread, Powwow, Cultural engagement).

cards.name: Calf Fry Festival
cards.flavorText: Your out-of-state opponent bit into a deep-fried bull testicle without asking what it was. The locals are laughing.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Hazing: (Calf fry, Initiation, Culinary shock).

cards.name: Boomer Sooner!
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support, but annoy everyone else.
cards.flavorText: The band just played the exact same ten-second song for the 85th time today. It is psychological warfare.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Intimidation: (Psychological warfare, Repetitive, Fight song).

cards.name: The Bedlam Series
cards.effect: Both players discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: The state is cleanly, viciously divided in half. Crimson and cream versus orange and black.
cards.learningGoal: Fierce Rivalries: (Bedlam, House divided, Bitter history).

cards.name: Thunder Up!
cards.flavorText: The only major professional sports team in the state is winning. The entire electorate is wearing blue and orange.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Unification: (Bandwagon, Unifying force, Small market).

cards.name: The Golden Driller
cards.effect: Block an Attack card costing 3 or less.
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind a 75-foot-tall golden statue of an oil worker holding a real derrick. Iconic protection.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Monument: (Iconic, Golden Driller, Oil boom heritage).

cards.name: Route 66 Kitsch
cards.flavorText: Selling neon signs, diner mugs, and cheap nostalgia to European tourists driving across the state.
cards.learningGoal: Americana Tourism: (Kitsch, Nostalgia, Mother Road).

cards.name: The Blue Whale of Catoosa
cards.flavorText: You got distracted by a giant, smiling, concrete whale floating in a pond off Route 66.
cards.learningGoal: Bizarre Landmarks: (Concrete oddity, Distraction, Road trip stop).

cards.name: Red Dirt Music
cards.flavorText: A guy with a scruffy beard and an acoustic guitar is singing about a pickup truck. The voters are weeping.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Subcultures: (Red Dirt, Acoustic, Gritty authenticity).

cards.name: Tiger King Roadside Zoo
cards.flavorText: Your opponent was photographed taking a campaign donation from a wildly eccentric exotic animal breeder in a mullet.
cards.learningGoal: True Crime Chaos: (Eccentric, Exploitation, Viral scandal).

cards.name: The Oklahoma Standard
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: A disaster hit, but the community rallied instantly. We rebuild, we support, and we never break.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Resilience: (The Oklahoma Standard, Unbreakable, Rallying cry).

cards.name: The Land Run Reenactment
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: You jumped the gun and claimed the political territory before the starting pistol even fired!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Metaphors: (Jumping the gun, Land Run, Claiming territory).

cards.name: The Straight-Ticket Vote
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The voters literally just pushed the 'Vote All R' button at the top of the ballot. The down-ballot races are locked.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Mechanics: (Straight-ticket, Down-ballot, Unwavering).

cards.name: Ten Commandments Monument
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from the base, trigger a federal lawsuit.
cards.flavorText: We dropped a massive stone tablet of biblical laws on government property. The ACLU lawyers are descending.
cards.learningGoal: Church and State: (Monument, First Amendment, Legal descending).

cards.name: Banning AP History
cards.flavorText: The State Superintendent just went on national TV to declare war on public school history books.
cards.learningGoal: Educational Flashpoints: (Curriculum, Culture war, Superintendent).

cards.name: Scissortail Park
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but lose 1 Support from rural locals.
cards.flavorText: We passed a penny sales tax to build a gorgeous urban park. The city is thriving; the rural counties are annoyed.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Revitalization: (Penny tax, Civic investment, Thriving).

cards.name: The Bible Belt Buckle
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but opponent cannot play Progressive cards.
cards.flavorText: You do not win an election in this state without securing the blessing of the massive, non-denominational megachurches.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Gatekeeping: (Bible Belt buckle, Megachurch, Non-denominational).

cards.name: Tribal License Plate
cards.flavorText: You tried to ticket my campaign vehicle, but I have a Cherokee Nation license plate. State jurisdiction does not apply!
cards.learningGoal: Jurisdictional Shields: (Sovereign tag, Exemption, Traffic jurisdiction).

cards.name: Cattle Baron's Ball
cards.flavorText: Eating prime rib and writing massive campaign checks at a gala sponsored by the state's largest ranchers.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Wealth: (Cattle baron, Beef trust, High-society gala).

cards.name: Rural Hospital Closure
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: You refused to expand federal funding, and now an entire county has to drive 50 miles to find an emergency room.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Failures: (Healthcare desert, Closure, Refusal to expand).

cards.name: Out-of-State Oil Exec
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's biggest donor actually lives in Dallas. The local wildcatters are deeply insulted.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Carpetbagger: (Intruder, Wildcatter, Crossing the Red River).

cards.name: Sweatin' Like a Sinner
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It is 105 degrees. Campaigning door-to-door has been suspended due to the risk of spontaneous combustion.
cards.learningGoal: Southern Hyperbole: (Oppressive heat, Spontaneous combustion, Hyperbolic).

cards.name: Noodling for Catfish
cards.flavorText: Sticking your bare arm into a muddy hole to let a 60-pound flathead catfish bite you. Rural authenticity established.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Foraging: (Noodling, Bare-handed, Authenticity).

cards.name: SEC Realignment
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: The Sooners are leaving for the SEC. The television money is huge, but the in-state betrayal will last forever.
cards.learningGoal: Athletic Economics: (Realignment, Television rights, Betrayal).

cards.name: Oklahoman vs. Okie
cards.flavorText: Older folks think 'Okie' is an insult from the Dust Bowl. Younger folks embrace it. Tread carefully.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic History: (Dust Bowl, Reclaimed slur, Generational shift).

cards.name: The Bentonville Billionaire
cards.flavorText: My company's revenue is higher than the GDP of most European nations. Do not touch my tax incentives.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Hegemony: (Home office, GDP, Global footprint, Leverage).

cards.name: The Springdale Poultry King
cards.flavorText: We feed the world, we employ the region, and we ask that you ignore the smell when the wind blows south.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Monopolies: (Vertical integration, Poultry, Aromatic nuisance).

cards.name: The NWA Transplant
cards.flavorText: I moved here from California to sell software to Walmart and ride $8,000 mountain bikes on the weekends.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Aesthetics: (Transplant, Vendor, Single-track, Boomtown).

cards.name: The Little Rock Insider
cards.flavorText: I have survived three governors, two scandals, and a thousand rubber-chicken dinners. I know where the bodies are buried.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Memory: (Rubber-chicken dinner, Insider, Survival instinct).

cards.name: The Delta Farmer
cards.flavorText: We grow the rice and soybeans that keep this state afloat. Stop giving all our tax money to Fayetteville.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Resentment: (Flatlands, Cash crop, Geographical divide).

cards.name: The Ozark Traditionalist
cards.flavorText: We live in the hollers, we mind our own business, and we do not trust anyone in a suit from Pulaski County.
cards.learningGoal: Isolationist Geography: (Holler, Mind our own business, Distrust).

cards.name: Wooo Pig Sooie!
cards.flavorText: The most terrifying, unhinged, and glorious auditory assault in college sports. The crowd is in a frenzy!
cards.learningGoal: Auditory Intimidation: (Unhinged, Frenzy, Collective chant).

cards.name: The $19,000 Lectern
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: You bought a custom lectern with a credit card meant for state business. The audits are descending immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Scandals: (Misappropriation, Audit, Scrutiny, Optics).

cards.name: Duck Season in Stuttgart
cards.effect: Both players skip their next turn.
cards.flavorText: The legislature is empty. The governor is gone. Everyone is sitting in a freezing flooded timber blind. Politics can wait.
cards.learningGoal: Sporting Truancy: (Flooded timber, Duck blind, Exodus).

cards.name: Cheese Dip Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Do NOT call it queso. We invented it in Little Rock in 1935. Eat the liquid gold and sign the legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Claiming: (Invented, Disputed origin, Liquid gold).

cards.name: Crater of Diamonds
cards.flavorText: A tourist just dug up a 3-carat diamond from the dirt. It's fantastic PR and completely distracts from your terrible poll numbers.
cards.learningGoal: Unlikely Windfalls: (Unearthed, PR distraction, Stroke of luck).

cards.name: Hot Springs Bathhouse
cards.flavorText: Al Capone used to soak here, and now we are using it to quietly launder some campaign funds.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Infamy: (Thermal waters, Mobster, Quiet dealings).

cards.name: Clinton Presidential Library
cards.flavorText: Hiding in a beautiful, glass-and-steel building that the locals constantly joke looks like a giant mobile home.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Nicknames: (Mobile home, Glass-and-steel, Presidential legacy).

cards.name: Dry County Bootlegging
cards.flavorText: Half the state can't legally buy a beer, so the liquor stores positioned exactly one inch across the county line are printing money.
cards.learningGoal: Prohibition Logistics: (Dry county, County line, Printing money).

cards.name: Chocolate Gravy Breakfast
cards.flavorText: You ate biscuits smothered in a thick, hot, cocoa-based syrup. Your blood sugar is spiking and you need a nap.
cards.learningGoal: Caloric Excess: (Smothered, Blood sugar spike, Indulgence).

cards.name: Fried Catfish Friday
cards.flavorText: Eating bottom-feeding fish battered in cornmeal. A greasy, delicious requirement for any serious statewide candidate.
cards.learningGoal: Communal Dining: (Battered, Cornmeal, Bottom-feeder).

cards.name: The Big Three
cards.flavorText: The holy trinity of Northwest Arkansas. They own the logistics, the food, and the retail. Bow down.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Oligarchy: (Holy trinity, Logistics, Bow down).

cards.name: Supermajority Steamroll
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We don't need your votes, we don't need a debate, and we are turning your microphone off. The bill passes!
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Dominance: (Steamroll, Rubber stamp, Gaveling down).

cards.name: Fleeing to Missouri
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from youth, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We won't legalize it or build casinos, so millions of tax dollars are driving across the northern border every weekend.
cards.learningGoal: Vice Tourism: (Tax flight, Northern border, Lost revenue).

cards.name: NWA Mountain Biking
cards.flavorText: Pretending you love riding a carbon-fiber mountain bike on perfectly manicured trails built by billionaires.
cards.learningGoal: Manufactured Authenticity: (Carbon-fiber, Manicured, Manufactured).

cards.name: Rice Capital of the World
cards.flavorText: We grow half the rice in the United States. We are actively exporting to foreign nations while wearing overalls.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Bragging: (Export market, Yield, Commodity).

cards.name: Pine Timber Lobby
cards.flavorText: We own millions of acres of loblolly pines. The paper mills smell terrible, but the lobbying checks clear instantly.
cards.learningGoal: Extraction Economics: (Timberland, Loblolly, Paper mill).

cards.name: 100% Humidity
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: It's 95 degrees, but it feels like you are breathing through a wet wool blanket. The campaign trail is sweltering.
cards.learningGoal: Climatic Oppression: (Sweltering, Sauna, Oppressive heat).

cards.name: Ozark Ice Storm
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: It doesn't snow here, it just rains an inch of solid ice. The pine trees are snapping and the power grid is dead.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Catastrophes: (Freezing rain, Snapping branches, Power grid).

cards.name: Mosquito Swarm
cards.flavorText: You tried to host an outdoor fundraiser in July near a rice field. The guests are being eaten alive by bloodsuckers.
cards.learningGoal: Pest Invasions: (Bloodsuckers, Swarm, Eaten alive).

cards.name: J.B. Hunt Convoy
cards.flavorText: You are stuck on I-40 behind two massive semi-trucks trying to pass each other at 66 miles per hour.
cards.learningGoal: Highway Gridlock: (Convoy, Semi-truck, Elephant race).

cards.name: The Evangelical Base
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but opponent cannot play Progressive cards.
cards.flavorText: If your truck isn't in the church parking lot on Sunday morning, your name won't be on the ballot on Tuesday.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Gatekeeping: (Pews, Moral authority, Voting bloc).

cards.name: The LEARNS Act
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital from conservatives, lose 3 Support from teachers.
cards.flavorText: We are completely overhauling the public school system and redirecting funds. The lawsuits are already filed.
cards.learningGoal: Educational Flashpoints: (Overhaul, Voucher, Redirection).

cards.name: Banning the Dictionary
cards.flavorText: The legislature is deeply concerned about what is in the public library. We are reviewing everything, including the encyclopedias.
cards.learningGoal: Culture War Censorship: (Reviewing, Banning, Deeply concerned).

cards.name: Hope Watermelon Festival
cards.flavorText: Posing for a photo next to a genetically massive, 200-pound watermelon to prove you love the agricultural sector.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Spectacle: (Genetically massive, Prize-winning, Pandering).

cards.name: Fayetteville Hipsters
cards.flavorText: We are the lone progressive oasis in the mountains. We wear flannel, drink craft beer, and vote against the supermajority.
cards.learningGoal: College Town Enclaves: (Oasis, Flannel, Outnumbered).

cards.name: The Natural State
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We have the mountains, the rivers, and the diamonds. You can't beat our scenery, even if you hate our politics.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Pride: (Scenery, The Natural State, Untouched beauty).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You smiled sweetly, patted their arm, and destroyed their entire legislative agenda with three polite words.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Condescension, Devastating, Smiled sweetly).

cards.name: Fixin' To
cards.flavorText: 'I'm not going to fix that bridge today, but I am absolutely fixin' to get around to it soon.'
cards.learningGoal: Southern Procrastination: (Fixin' to, Intent without action, Buying time).

cards.name: The SEC Loss Meltdown
cards.flavorText: The football team just lost to a massive underdog. The entire state is in mourning and calling for the coach to be fired.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Despair: (Mourning, Calling for heads, Crushing defeat).

cards.name: The Southern Drawl
cards.flavorText: You are speaking so slowly and with such thick molasses that your opponent simply fell asleep at the podium.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Pacing: (Molasses, Drawl, Lulling to sleep).

cards.name: White River Fly Fishing
cards.flavorText: Standing waist-deep in freezing water, casting for brown trout with out-of-state billionaires to secure campaign funding.
cards.learningGoal: High-End Leisure: (Fly fishing, Waders, Schmoozing).

cards.name: Tornado Alley Outskirts
cards.flavorText: The sky turned bruised purple. The sirens are spinning up. Everyone to the center hallway immediately!
cards.learningGoal: Meteorological Dread: (Bruised sky, Spinning up, Taking cover).

cards.name: The Delta Blues
cards.flavorText: Tapping into the deep, soulful, and historically impoverished roots of the Mississippi River delta. Respect the music.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Lineage: (Soulful, Impoverished roots, The Delta).

cards.name: State Fair Corndog
cards.flavorText: You consumed a foot-long tube of mystery meat battered in sweet cornmeal. Your cholesterol is peaking.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Gluttony: (Mystery meat, Battered, Peaking).

cards.name: Out-of-State Agitators
cards.flavorText: This protest isn't organic! It's funded by coastal elites who flew in to disrupt our peaceful way of life!
cards.learningGoal: Scapegoating Tactics: (Agitators, Coastal elites, Disruptive).

cards.name: The Old State House
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind the beautiful, massive white columns of the original state capitol building.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Shielding: (Antebellum, Columns, Heritage).

cards.name: Pecan Pie Bribe
cards.flavorText: Sliding a dense, sugary, corn-syrup-laden slice of pie across the table. They cannot say no to southern baking.
cards.learningGoal: Sweet Diplomacy: (Corn syrup, Dense, Irresistible).

cards.name: Blanchard Springs Caverns
cards.flavorText: You are hiding 200 feet underground in a massive, dripping limestone cave where the press literally cannot get a cell signal.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Evasion: (Subterranean, Limestone, Off the grid).

cards.name: Tyson Odor on the Wind
cards.flavorText: The wind shifted. Your outdoor rally now smells like boiling chicken bones. The crowd disperses immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Olfactory: (Rendering plant, Wind shift, Nauseating).

cards.name: Bill Clinton Nostalgia
cards.flavorText: Reminding the voters of the 1990s, when the state briefly held the most powerful office on the entire planet.
cards.learningGoal: Political Mythmaking: (Nostalgia, The Boy from Hope, Glory days).

cards.name: The 18-Wheeler Breakdown
cards.flavorText: A massive shipping truck blew a tire on the bridge over the Arkansas River. You are completely trapped.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Nightmare: (Blown tire, Bottleneck, Trapped).

cards.name: Property Tax Shock
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the suburbs.
cards.flavorText: The county finally updated the property values for the first time in a decade. The voters are screaming.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Pain: (Reassessment, Sticker shock, Outrage).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Pardon
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The Governor is leaving office tomorrow. Time to pardon a bunch of political allies and flee the capital!
cards.learningGoal: Executive Privilege: (Clemency, Lame duck, Fleeing).

cards.name: Sine Die
cards.flavorText: The short, chaotic legislative session is finally over. Throw the papers in the air and go home!
cards.learningGoal: Procedural Relief: (Sine Die, Gavel drop, Session concludes).

cards.name: The Caucus Organizer
cards.flavorText: I have 40 people sitting in a high school gymnasium, and I will not let them leave until they vote for you.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Attrition: (Caucus, Precinct captain, Wearing them down).

cards.name: The Ethanol Lobbyist
cards.flavorText: We mandate that you put corn in your gas tank. Question it, and your political career ends today.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Mandates: (Ethanol, Subsidies, Third rail).

cards.name: The Des Moines Actuary
cards.flavorText: We are the insurance capital of the world. We have calculated the exact risk of your tax proposal.
cards.learningGoal: Risk Mitigation: (Actuary, Underwriter, Calculated risk).

cards.name: The College Town Progressive
cards.flavorText: We are progressive oases in a sea of corn. We drink craft beer and fiercely debate zoning laws.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Enclaves: (Oasis, Progressive bubble, Zoning).

cards.name: The Western Iowa Hardliner
cards.flavorText: We are fiercely conservative, deeply agricultural, and we do not care what the national media thinks of us.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Defiance: (Hardliner, Defiant, Echo chamber).

cards.name: The First-in-the-Nation Myth
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The Democrats left us, but the Republicans stayed! The national media is eating at our diners again!
cards.learningGoal: Political Nostalgia: (First-in-the-nation, Primary calendar, Relevancy).

cards.name: The Caucus App Crash
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 3 Support.
cards.flavorText: The vote-counting app completely crashed. Nobody knows who won. The entire state is a national laughingstock.
cards.learningGoal: Technological Failure: (Glitch, Laughingstock, Incompetence).

cards.name: Casey's Breakfast Pizza
cards.flavorText: Eating a slice of gas station pizza covered in eggs, bacon, and cheese. It is a sacred culinary institution.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Delicacies: (Gas station gourmet, Culinary institution, Sacred).

cards.name: The Butter Cow
cards.flavorText: Posing next to a life-sized cow sculpted entirely out of salted butter. You have officially arrived in Iowa.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Art: (Sculpted, Spectacle, Salted butter).

cards.name: RAGBRAI
cards.flavorText: Ten thousand cyclists are riding across the entire state, drinking beer, and blocking every two-lane highway.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Gridlock: (Peloton, Trans-state, Bicycling).

cards.name: The Derecho
cards.flavorText: A 100-mph wall of wind just flattened half the state's corn crop and ripped the roof off your campaign office.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Weather: (Derecho, Straight-line winds, Flattened).

cards.name: Knee-High by the Fourth of July
cards.flavorText: The corn is growing perfectly. The farmers are happy, and the agricultural donations are flowing.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Optimism: (Yield, Bountiful, Traditional milestone).

cards.name: The Hog Confinement Odor
cards.flavorText: The wind shifted over a 10,000-head pork facility. Your opponent's outdoor rally is immediately canceled.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Olfactory: (Confinement, Manure, Nauseating).

cards.name: Wind Turbine Royalties
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from NIMBYs.
cards.flavorText: We harvest the wind! The turbines look terrible, but the checks keep the rural counties afloat.
cards.learningGoal: Renewable Leasing: (Turbine, Royalty, Aesthetic blight).

cards.name: Hawkeye Tailgate
cards.flavorText: Waving at the children's hospital overlooking the stadium. It is the most universally loved tradition in the state.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Philanthropy: (Universally loved, Touching tradition, Optics).

cards.name: Cyclone Chaos
cards.flavorText: Iowa State just upset a top-ten team. The goalposts are in the lake and the electorate is heavily distracted.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Revelry: (Upset, Goalposts, Distraction).

cards.name: The Pizza Ranch
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a rural endorsement while eating fried chicken and dessert pizza under a fake wagon wheel.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Pandering: (Buffet, Kitsch, Digesting).

cards.name: Soil Erosion Panic
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: We are losing our incredibly rich topsoil to the rivers. The environmentalists and the farmers are both panicking.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Devastation: (Topsoil, Erosion, Runoff).

cards.name: The Grassley Twitter Account
cards.flavorText: The senior senator tweeted something entirely unreadable about the history of the History Channel. We must decipher it.
cards.learningGoal: Social Media Absurdity: (Incomprehensible, Unfiltered, Cryptic).

cards.name: Field of Dreams Game
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital but opponent draws a card.
cards.flavorText: Playing baseball in a literal cornfield in Dyersville to extract money from nostalgic tourists and national TV.
cards.learningGoal: Cinematic Nostalgia: (Ghostly, Cornfield, Manufactured charm).

cards.name: Pork Chop on a Stick
cards.flavorText: Eating an impossibly thick, dripping pork chop off a wooden dowel. Your cholesterol rises, but so do your polls.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Gluttony: (Dowel, Artery-clogging, Obligatory).

cards.name: Ope! Just Sneakin' Past
cards.flavorText: A perfectly polite, passive-aggressive maneuver to avoid answering a direct debate question.
cards.learningGoal: Polite Evasion: (Ope, Sneaking past, Deflection).

cards.name: Suburban Des Moines
cards.flavorText: Ankeny, West Des Moines, Waukee. They have massive houses, low crime, and completely decide the state.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Tipping Points: (Swing vote, Master-planned, Sprawl).

cards.name: The Pork Producers
cards.flavorText: We have 24 million pigs and 3 million people. We run this state. Period.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Dominance: (Swine, Lobbying power, Outnumbering).

cards.name: The Farm Bureau
cards.flavorText: If you don't kiss the ring of the Farm Bureau, you aren't winning a single county outside the cities.
cards.learningGoal: Lobbying Gatekeepers: (Firewall, Kissing the ring, Agrarian).

cards.name: Soybean Tariffs
cards.flavorText: Your opponent supported a massive tariff war. China stopped buying our beans. The farmers are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Global Trade Shocks: (Tariff, Retaliation, Export market).

cards.name: Winter Driving Superiority
cards.flavorText: You survived driving an icy two-lane highway in a Honda Civic. Your opponent's attacks mean nothing to you.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Resilience: (Black ice, White-knuckle, Unfazed).

cards.name: Tornado Sirens on a Tuesday
cards.flavorText: Out-of-staters are diving into the ditches, but the locals are just annoyed the test interrupted their phone calls.
cards.learningGoal: Routine Alarms: (Unfazed, Conditioning, Siren test).

cards.name: The Mississippi Flood
cards.flavorText: The river is cresting in Davenport again. They refused to build a flood wall, so downtown is an aquarium.
cards.learningGoal: Stubborn Infrastructure: (Cresting, Flood wall, Submerged).

cards.name: The Missouri River Flood
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: The western border is underwater. I-29 is completely closed. The logistical nightmare begins.
cards.learningGoal: Border Crises: (Underwater, Logistical nightmare, Detour).

cards.name: Fleeing to Chicago
cards.flavorText: Your policies alienated the college graduates, so they packed up their Subarus and moved to Illinois.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Shifts: (Brain drain, Out-migration, Urban flight).

cards.name: Gravel Road Commute
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's pristine campaign bus is stuck behind a tractor on a washboard gravel road.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Logistics: (Washboard road, Dust cloud, Stuck).

cards.name: The Blue State Pivot
cards.flavorText: We voted for Obama twice, then swung hard to the right. The electorate is elastic and deeply confusing.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Elasticity: (Swung hard, Elastic, Unpredictable).

cards.name: Eminent Domain Fight
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from farmers, lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We are refusing to let a massive corporation bury a carbon-capture pipeline under our family farms!
cards.learningGoal: Property Rights Fights: (Eminent domain, Carbon-capture, Rebellion).

cards.name: The Six-Week Abortion Ban
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 3 from moderates.
cards.flavorText: We passed one of the strictest laws in the country. The special session is over, the lawsuits have begun.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Flashpoints: (Special session, Heartbeat bill, Lawsuits).

cards.name: The Meatpacking Plant
cards.flavorText: A grueling, punishing industry that drives the economy of small towns and relies entirely on immigrant labor.
cards.learningGoal: Immigration & Labor: (Grueling, Meatpacking, Unsung labor).

cards.name: Voter ID Law
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the base, lose 2 from the city.
cards.flavorText: We tightened the voting rules! It's a massive victory for election integrity, or blatant suppression, depending on your zip code.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Mechanics: (Election integrity, Suppression, Tightening the rules).

cards.name: The State Capitol Dome
cards.flavorText: Hiding in a beautiful, gilded capitol building while staring out at a perfectly flat horizon.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Shielding: (Gilded, 23-Karat, Horizon).

cards.name: The 99-County Tour
cards.flavorText: You drove to every single, tiny, remote county in the state. Your suspension is ruined, but the voters respect the hustle.
cards.learningGoal: Exhaustive Campaigning: (The Full Grassley, 99 Counties, Pounding the pavement).

cards.name: Subsidized Broadband
cards.flavorText: We spent millions to get fiber-optic internet to a farm with three cows and one house.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Infrastructure: (Broadband, Fiber-optic, Last mile).

cards.name: The Veto Pen
cards.flavorText: The legislature tried to pass a rogue bill, but the Governor just slashed it with absolute authority.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Check: (Veto pen, Absolute authority, Slashing).

cards.name: Amana Colonies Tourism
cards.flavorText: Buying expensive woolen blankets and eating family-style schnitzel. The tourists love the historical aesthetic.
cards.learningGoal: Heritage Tourism: (Family-style, Schnitzel, Utopian past).

cards.name: Rhubarb Pie
cards.flavorText: Eating a pie that is incredibly tart, requiring massive amounts of sugar to be palatable. A perfect political metaphor.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Metaphors: (Tart, Palatable, Sugar-coating).

cards.name: The Combine Harvester
cards.flavorText: You are driving a $750,000 piece of GPS-guided farm equipment. You are harvesting votes at incredible speed.
cards.learningGoal: Ag-Tech: (Combine, GPS-guided, Precision agriculture).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The election is over, but the legislature is staying up until 4 AM to pass sweeping, controversial reforms.
cards.learningGoal: Procedural Hardball: (Lame duck, Midnight vote, Sweeping reforms).

cards.name: The Iowa Nice Defense
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You attacked me, but I just smiled, offered you a casserole, and watched your polling numbers plummet for being rude.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Iowa Nice, Passive resistance, Backfiring).

cards.name: School Voucher Push
cards.effect: Spend 2 Capital, gain 3 Support from conservatives.
cards.flavorText: We are handing out state money for private school tuition. The rural school districts are in full panic mode.
cards.learningGoal: Educational Overhauls: (Vouchers, School choice, Defunding fears).

cards.name: The State Patrol Escort
cards.flavorText: Doing 95 MPH down the interstate with a trooper escort. You are untouchable by local press.
cards.learningGoal: VIP Exemption: (Trooper escort, Untouchable, Speeding).

cards.name: The Ag-Gag Law
cards.flavorText: We made it a crime to secretly film the inside of a slaughterhouse. We protect our own!
cards.learningGoal: Information Control: (Ag-gag, Undercover, Whistleblower).

cards.name: The Heartland Myth
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the heartland! We are the salt of the earth! We define what it means to be American!
cards.learningGoal: Nostalgic Grandiosity: (The Heartland, Salt of the earth, Defining the nation).

cards.name: The Culinary Boss
cards.flavorText: We make the beds, we serve the drinks, and we single-handedly decide who wins this state. Do not cross the union.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Dominance: (Culinary Union, Kingmaker, Hospitality).

cards.name: The Casino Mogul
cards.effect: Start with +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support.
cards.flavorText: I own six mega-resorts on the Strip. My name goes on the building, and my money goes into the Super PAC.
cards.learningGoal: Oligarchic Wealth: (Mega-resort, Tycoon, Super PAC).

cards.name: The Rural Miner
cards.flavorText: We pull gold and lithium out of the dirt. We hate the federal government, and we hate Las Vegas even more.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Independence: (Sagebrush Rebellion, Lithium, Prospector).

cards.name: The Washoe Swing Voter
cards.flavorText: Clark County is blue, the rurals are red. Whoever wins Reno wins the entire election. Pander to me.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Tipping Points: (Swing county, Washoe, The Decider).

cards.name: The Reid Machine
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: Harry Reid may be gone, but his meticulously organized, ruthless political machine still churns out the votes.
cards.learningGoal: Machine Politics: (The Machine, Ruthless organization, Turnout).

cards.name: Lake Mead Bathtub Ring
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The water is almost below the intake valves. The most desperate environmental and economic crisis in the West is here.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Scarcity: (Bathtub ring, Mega-drought, Dead pool).

cards.name: The 24/7 Liquor License
cards.flavorText: It is 4 AM. You are drinking a massive, sugary cocktail while playing video poker. You are energized but making terrible choices.
cards.learningGoal: Vice Economies: (24/7 license, Neon, Video poker).

cards.name: Area 51 Raid
cards.effect: Both players discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: A million people on the internet threatened to storm the secret Air Force base. The national guard is deployed.
cards.learningGoal: Conspiratorial Absurdity: (Classified, Viral stunt, Storming the gates).

cards.name: Legal Prostitution Lobby
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the South.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent wants to outlaw the rural brothels. The libertarian ranchers are furious at the government overreach.
cards.learningGoal: Vice Legality: (Legal brothel, Government overreach, Libertarian streak).

cards.name: Californian Expat
cards.flavorText: I moved from Los Angeles to Henderson to escape the income tax! Why is it 115 degrees in July?
cards.learningGoal: Tax Avoidance: (Tax refugee, Equity flight, Priced out).

cards.name: No State Income Tax
cards.flavorText: We fund the entire state by heavily taxing the tourists who lose their life savings at the blackjack tables.
cards.learningGoal: Regressive Taxation: (Gaming tax, Passing the buck, Tourist trap).

cards.name: F-1 Race on the Strip
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: You shut down the Vegas Strip for months to build a race track for European billionaires. The hospitality workers are enraged.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Infrastructure: (Formula 1, Disruption, Paving over locals).

cards.name: Raiders Stadium Subsidies
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital now, lose 2 Support later.
cards.flavorText: We gave a billionaire $750 million in public money for a football stadium. The room tax is astronomical.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Welfare: (Stadium subsidy, Room tax, Billionaire handout).

cards.name: The Yucca Mountain Fight
cards.flavorText: The feds want to bury all of America's radioactive waste inside our mountain. We will fight this until the end of time.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Standoffs: (Radioactive waste, Yucca Mountain, Not in my backyard).

cards.name: Wild Burro Hazard
cards.flavorText: A herd of wild donkeys is blocking the highway in Beatty. Your campaign bus is completely stuck.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Obstruction: (Wild burros, Feral, Desert highway).

cards.name: The Clark County Count
cards.effect: The game does not end at 50 points; play 2 more turns.
cards.flavorText: It is three days after the election. Las Vegas is still counting mail-in ballots. The entire nation is screaming at us.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Anxiety: (Tabulation, Mail-in delay, National spotlight).

cards.name: The Heat Dome
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The asphalt is literally melting your shoes. The power grid is straining. Campaigning outside is a death sentence.
cards.learningGoal: Lethal Weather: (Heat dome, Melting asphalt, Power grid strain).

cards.name: Burning Man Exodus
cards.flavorText: It rained in the desert. 70,000 tech bros covered in mud are trapped on a single-lane dirt road. The state laughs.
cards.learningGoal: Counterculture Disasters: (The Playa, Mud-soaked, Silicon Valley retreat).

cards.name: The Buffet Pandering
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a union contract over a massive plate of crab legs and prime rib at 2 PM on a Tuesday.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Excess: (All-you-can-eat, Crab legs, Gluttony).

cards.name: The Strip Sprawl
cards.flavorText: The massive, beige, master-planned stucco subdivisions that ring the valley. This is where the actual voters live.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Geography: (Master-planned, Stucco, Sprawl).

cards.name: Reno Tech Revival
cards.flavorText: We are building massive battery factories and server farms! We are no longer just Vegas's older, grittier brother!
cards.learningGoal: Economic Diversification: (Gigafactory, Server farm, Gritty revival).

cards.name: The Gaming Control Board
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Corporate cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: If you want to do business in this state, you must pass the most rigorous, invasive background check on Earth.
cards.learningGoal: Regulatory Power: (Gaming license, Background check, The Board).

cards.name: Nye County Rebellion
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the rurals.
cards.flavorText: A rural county commissioner just declared federal law null and void and tried to hand-count the ballots.
cards.learningGoal: Anti-Government Extremism: (Null and void, Sovereign citizen, Hand-count).

cards.name: Water Cop Patrol
cards.flavorText: You were caught watering your lawn on the wrong day. The Southern Nevada Water Authority has fined you heavily.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Enforcement: (Water authority, Mandatory conservation, Fined).

cards.name: The Sphere
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got completely mesmerized by a 300-foot-tall, glowing, blinking digital eyeball in the middle of the desert.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Spectacle: (LED dome, Mesmerized, Immersive).

cards.name: Hoover Dam Power
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind a 700-foot-tall wall of solid 1930s concrete that powers the entire Southwest.
cards.learningGoal: Engineering Grandeur: (Hydroelectric, Concrete marvel, FDR legacy).

cards.name: The Independent Voter
cards.effect: Wildcard: Grants either +2 Capital or +2 Support randomly each turn.
cards.flavorText: Almost 40% of the state is registered as non-partisan. They are cynical, transient, and incredibly hard to poll.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Volatility: (Non-partisan, Transient, Hard to poll).

cards.name: The A's Relocation
cards.effect: Spend 2 Capital, gain 3 Support from donors.
cards.flavorText: We are paying another billionaire to bring the worst baseball team in history to the Strip!
cards.learningGoal: Sports Washing: (Relocation, Boondoggle, Billionaire subsidy).

cards.name: Legal Cannabis Lounge
cards.flavorText: We finally made it legal to smoke weed in public lounges. The tourists are thrilled, the casinos are terrified.
cards.learningGoal: Vice Expansion: (Cannabis lounge, Vice economy, Tourism).

cards.name: Mining Royalties
cards.flavorText: We pull more gold out of the ground than almost any country on Earth. Do not raise our extraction taxes.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Leverage: (Gold mining, Extraction tax, Royalties).

cards.name: The Transient Electorate
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: Half the people who voted for you last time have moved to Arizona, and the new residents don't know your name.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Churn: (Transient, Revolving door, Lack of roots).

cards.name: The State Line Casino
cards.flavorText: Campaigning at a depressing casino right on the California border next to a massive solar farm and a roller coaster.
cards.learningGoal: Border Economics: (Desolate, State line, Captive audience).

cards.name: Basque Dining
cards.flavorText: Eating family-style lamb and drinking a lethally strong, bitter cocktail in Elko to win the rural vote.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Heritage: (Basque, Family-style, Lethal cocktail).

cards.name: The 15 Freeway Backup
cards.flavorText: It is Sunday afternoon. Three million Californians are trying to drive back to Los Angeles at the exact same time.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Nightmares: (Mass exodus, Bottleneck, The 15).

cards.name: The Desert Tortoise
cards.flavorText: You tried to build a massive solar array, but someone found an endangered tortoise. The project is delayed for five years.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Hurdles: (Endangered species, Habitat, Bureaucratic delay).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislature only meets for 120 days every two years. It's the final night, and the chaotic deal-making is legendary.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Chaos: (Biennial session, Sine Die, Midnight deals).

cards.name: The Nevada Test Site
cards.flavorText: We used to watch atomic bombs explode from the roofs of the casinos! We are a tough, irradiated people!
cards.learningGoal: Atomic Era History: (Irradiated, Test site, Mushroom cloud).

cards.name: The Pahrump Libertarian
cards.flavorText: We live in the desert, we hoard ammunition, and we want the government to leave us completely alone.
cards.learningGoal: Isolationist Survivalism: (Libertarian, Off the grid, Ammunition).

cards.name: The Vegas Golden Knights
cards.flavorText: They won the Stanley Cup. They are the only thing everyone in Las Vegas actually agrees on.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Unification: (Expansion team, Stanley Cup, Hometown pride).

cards.name: The Water Grab
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the rurals.
cards.flavorText: Las Vegas tried to build a 300-mile pipeline to steal groundwater from the ranchers. The ranchers sued.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Wars: (Water grab, Groundwater, Legal injunction).

cards.name: The Tipping Point State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The entire presidential election comes down to a few thousand union workers in Clark County.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Decisiveness: (Tipping point, Razor-thin margin, Kingmaker).

cards.name: The Casino Strike
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The bartenders and maids just walked out. The mega-resorts are bleeding millions. Settle the contract now.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Action: (Picket line, Bleeding money, Contract dispute).

cards.name: The Prostitution Ban
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from moderates, lose 2 from libertarians.
cards.flavorText: You proposed banning the legal brothels. Half the state applauds, the other half screams about freedom.
cards.learningGoal: Moral Flashpoints: (Vice regulation, Puritanical, Libertarian backlash).

cards.name: Lake Tahoe Elites
cards.flavorText: Fundraising on a massive wooden boat on the clearest, most expensive alpine lake in America.
cards.learningGoal: Alpine Wealth: (Billionaire retreat, Pristine lake, High-society).

cards.name: The Gun Show Loophole
cards.effect: Spend 1 Capital, gain 3 Support from conservatives.
cards.flavorText: Las Vegas hosts the largest firearms convention on Earth. The political lobbying power is deafening.
cards.learningGoal: Second Amendment Lobby: (Convention, Firearms, Lobbying power).

cards.name: The Nevada Day Parade
cards.flavorText: We are the only state that legally mandates a holiday to celebrate when we joined the Union. (Because it was during the Civil War).
cards.learningGoal: Civic Pride: (Battle Born, Statehood, Mandatory holiday).

cards.name: The Dust Devil
cards.flavorText: A miniature tornado of sand and dirt just blew through your opponent's outdoor press conference.
cards.learningGoal: Minor Weather Nuisance: (Dust devil, Swirling, Blinding).

cards.name: The Casino Comp
cards.flavorText: You got caught in a minor scandal, but the casino boss comped the reporter a penthouse suite and the story vanished.
cards.learningGoal: Corrupt Perks: (Comped, Penthouse, Making the problem disappear).

cards.name: Battle Born
cards.flavorText: We were born during the Civil War! We survived the mob, the mafia, and the desert! We will not back down!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (Battle Born, Resilience, Unyielding).

cards.name: The Bishop
cards.flavorText: I manage the spiritual and social lives of a few hundred families. If I suggest a candidate, they win the neighborhood.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Organization: (The Ward, Bishopric, Tacit endorsement).

cards.name: The Silicon Slopes Bro
cards.flavorText: I moved my software company from California to Lehi for the views, the tax breaks, and the endless supply of young, polite talent.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Hub Jargon: (Silicon Slopes, SaaS, Transplant, Talent pool).

cards.name: The Pioneer Descendant
cards.flavorText: My ancestors crossed the plains pushing handcarts. I now own 40 car dealerships and half the commercial real estate in the valley.
cards.learningGoal: Generational Wealth: (Handcart pioneers, Pedigree, Dealership empire).

cards.name: The Moab Environmentalist
cards.flavorText: We must stop the oil drilling! We must protect the canyons! (Also, please buy a $700 jacket at my outdoor gear shop).
cards.learningGoal: Eco-Capitalism: (Red rock, Extraction ban, Outdoor recreation).

cards.name: The Mormon Corridor
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Progressive cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The most highly organized, deeply unified, and reliably conservative voting bloc in the entire United States.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Unification: (The Corridor, Voting bloc, Ideological purity).

cards.name: Dirty Soda Sugar Rush
cards.flavorText: You just drank 44 ounces of Diet Coke mixed with coconut syrup and heavy cream. Your heart is vibrating.
cards.learningGoal: Mormon Vice: (Dirty soda, Sugar rush, Caffeine loophole).

cards.name: Multi-Level Marketing Capital
cards.flavorText: We sell essential oils, leggings, and nutritional supplements via complex 'downlines.' The economy is thriving!
cards.learningGoal: Network Marketing: (Downline, Essential oils, Pyramid scheme).

cards.name: Green Jell-O Salad
cards.flavorText: Eating gelatin filled with shredded carrots to show you respect the deepest, weirdest cultural traditions of the state.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Oddities: (Gelatin, Potluck, Cultural tradition).

cards.name: The Zion Curtain
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to order a drink, but a 7-foot wall was legally required to hide the bartender mixing it.
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Liquor Laws: (Zion Curtain, Mixing barrier, State-controlled).

cards.name: Arsenic Dust Storm
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The Great Salt Lake is drying up. Toxic dust is blowing into the capital. The ecological apocalypse is here.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Catastrophe: (Toxic dust, Drying lakebed, Apocalyptic).

cards.name: The Minivan Gridlock
cards.flavorText: You are stuck behind a million 15-passenger vans heading to soccer practice. The interstate is completely paralyzed.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Logistics: (15-passenger van, Sprawl, Gridlock).

cards.name: Fry Sauce Pandering
cards.flavorText: Mixing ketchup and mayonnaise together and declaring it the greatest culinary invention in human history.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Condiments: (Fry sauce, Culinary pride, Innovation).

cards.name: The Independent Conservative
cards.flavorText: I am deeply conservative, but I will absolutely cross party lines to scold the national leadership on television.
cards.learningGoal: Maverick Conservatism: (Crossing party lines, Moral scolding, Independent streak).

cards.name: General Conference Weekend
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: The entire state is sitting at home watching 10 hours of church broadcasts. Politics do not exist this weekend.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Rituals: (General Conference, Broadcast, Civic pause).

cards.name: National Park Overcrowding
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: You promised an outdoor retreat, but Zion National Park looks like Disneyland on a holiday weekend.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Strain: (The Mighty Five, Overcrowding, Shuttle system).

cards.name: The Inversion
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: Cold air trapped the pollution in the valley. The sky is brown, you cannot breathe, and you cannot see the mountains.
cards.learningGoal: Topographical Weather: (The Inversion, Smog trap, Particulate matter).

cards.name: Temple Square Renovation
cards.flavorText: The center of the city is a massive, multi-year construction crater. Traffic is routed into absolute oblivion.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Reconstruction: (Renovation, Seismic upgrade, Detour).

cards.name: The State Liquor Store
cards.flavorText: You have to buy wine from a state-run bunker with terrible hours, but the state makes an absolute fortune on the markup.
cards.learningGoal: State Monopolies: (Markup, State-run, Archaic restrictions).

cards.name: Sundance Film Festival
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: Park City is overrun by celebrities in expensive winter coats. The fundraising checks are massive.
cards.learningGoal: Elitist Tourism: (Sundance, Celeb-spotting, Price gouging).

cards.name: The Coal Country Pushback
cards.flavorText: We mine the coal that powers the grid. Stop trying to turn our entire county into a national monument!
cards.learningGoal: Resource Extraction Fights: (National monument, Extraction, Pushback).

cards.name: Ski Resort Water Wars
cards.flavorText: The billionaire ski resorts are draining the local watershed to make artificial snow. The farmers are suing.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Allocation: (Snowmaking, Watershed, Artificial powder).

cards.name: The Olympic Bid
cards.flavorText: We hosted it perfectly in 2002, and we are going to host it perfectly again! Give us the billions in federal transit money!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Grandiosity: (Olympic bid, Infrastructure funding, Legacy).

cards.name: Gerrymandering Salt Lake
cards.flavorText: We took the only progressive city in the state and sliced it into four different rural congressional districts. Masterful.
cards.learningGoal: Redistricting Tactics: (Slicing the pie, Diluting the vote, Gerrymander).

cards.name: Polite Rejection
cards.flavorText: A devastatingly polite, soft-spoken refusal that leaves you feeling good about losing the argument.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Soft-spoken, Smiling rejection, Defusion).

cards.name: The Pioneer Day Parade
cards.flavorText: Forget the 4th of July. We throw our biggest parade to celebrate the day the pioneers walked into the valley.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Exceptionalism: (Pioneer Day, The Trek, Local holiday).

cards.name: The Bear Ears Debate
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 3 from ranchers.
cards.flavorText: The President made it a monument! Then shrunk it! Then made it a monument again! The legal whiplash is intense.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Land Use: (National Monument, Designation, Legal whiplash).

cards.name: The Secret Polygamist Compound
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in a scandal.
cards.flavorText: A bizarre, fundamentalist cult on the border just made national news. The entire state has to spend a month explaining they aren't associated.
cards.learningGoal: Fringe Extremism: (Fundamentalist, Compound, Reputational damage).

cards.name: The Tech IPO
cards.flavorText: A local software company just went public for $10 billion. The venture capital money is flooding the campaign coffers.
cards.learningGoal: Tech Economics: (IPO, Unicorn, Venture capital, Cash infusion).

cards.name: The Jello Belt
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We have the highest birth rate and the youngest population in the country. Our demographics are our destiny!
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Superiority: (Birth rate, Youthful population, The Jell-O Belt).

cards.name: The 'Heck' and 'Darn'
cards.flavorText: You tried to run a vicious smear campaign, but your opponent just said 'Oh, my heck' and completely defused the tension.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Purity: (Minced oaths, Clean language, Defusing tension).

cards.name: The Missionary Fluent
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Half the state speaks a second language perfectly because they lived in Madagascar for two years. The international outreach is unmatched.
cards.learningGoal: Language Acquisition: (Polyglot, Missionary work, Global outreach).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The voters passed a ballot initiative to expand Medicaid, so the legislature stayed up late to rewrite it completely.
cards.learningGoal: Subverting Democracy: (Ballot initiative, Override, Midnight rewrite).

cards.name: The Fast Offering
cards.flavorText: The state doesn't need a massive welfare budget because the church just takes care of everyone internally.
cards.learningGoal: Private Welfare: (Fast offering, Bishop's storehouse, Self-reliance).

cards.name: The Great Salt Lake Stink
cards.flavorText: The wind shifted. The entire valley smells like decomposing brine shrimp. The press conference is canceled.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Olfactory: (Brine shrimp, Decomposing, Lake effect).

cards.name: The Utes vs. Cougars
cards.flavorText: University of Utah vs. BYU. The religious, cultural, and athletic divide is absolute. Friendships end today.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Tribalism: (The Holy War, Rivalry, Absolute divide).

cards.name: The 10% Tithe
cards.flavorText: You tried to attack my budget, but my base has been donating 10% of their gross income since childhood. We understand math.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Discipline: (Tithing, Gross income, Frugality).

cards.name: The Ski Bum
cards.flavorText: I live in my van, I only ski powder, and I absolutely refuse to let snowboarders on this mountain.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Gatekeeping: (Ski bum, Powder hound, Banning snowboarders).

cards.name: The In-N-Out Burger Line
cards.flavorText: A new burger place opened in Draper. The drive-thru line is three miles long and traffic is gridlocked for a week.
cards.learningGoal: Fast Food Hysteria: (Drive-thru gridlock, Cult following, Suburban chaos).

cards.name: The Modest Swimsuit
cards.flavorText: Campaigning at the local reservoir in a swimsuit that covers the shoulders and the knees. Wholesome optics achieved.
cards.learningGoal: Modesty Standards: (Wholesome optics, Sartorial rules, Covering up).

cards.name: The Data Center Sprawl
cards.flavorText: The NSA built a massive data center here because power is cheap. The civil libertarians are furious, but the construction jobs are great.
cards.learningGoal: Surveillance Infrastructure: (Data center, Cheap power, Civil liberties).

cards.name: The Essential Oil Pitch
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got trapped at a neighborhood party where someone aggressively tried to sell them lavender oil for three hours.
cards.learningGoal: Aggressive Sales Tactics: (Essential oils, MLM pitch, Cornered).

cards.name: The California Exodus
cards.flavorText: Thousands of Californians moved here for the cheap housing. The locals are furious that a starter home is now $600,000.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Crisis: (Starter home, Exodus, Priced out).

cards.name: The State Capitol View
cards.flavorText: Delivering a speech from the gorgeous state capitol that literally looks down on the entire city. The visual superiority is undeniable.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Superiority: (Perch, Looking down, Visual dominance).

cards.name: The Genealogy Flex
cards.flavorText: You casually mentioned that you can trace your ancestry back to 14th century England. The locals are deeply impressed.
cards.learningGoal: Ancestral Obsession: (Genealogy, Family tree, Tracing the roots).

cards.name: Industry
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The state motto! We work like a hive of bees! We are productive, tireless, and entirely unified in our goals!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Productivity: (The Beehive State, Tireless, Unified hive).

cards.name: The Polygamist Joke
cards.flavorText: A national reporter made a lazy joke about having multiple wives. The entire state rolls its eyes in bored unison.
cards.learningGoal: Stereotype Fatigue: (Lazy cliché, Rolling eyes, Outdated joke).

cards.name: The Delta Planter
cards.flavorText: My family has farmed this flat, alluvial soil for five generations. The tractors are guided by satellites, but the politics haven't changed.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Elite: (Alluvial, Planter, Generational wealth, Agribusiness).

cards.name: The Gulf Coast Hustler
cards.flavorText: We survive hurricanes and build massive casinos right back on the beach. Keep the vice taxes low.
