cards.learningGoal: Resilient Economics: (Vice tax, Rebuilding, Gaming revenue).

cards.name: The Jackson Insider
cards.flavorText: The city's infrastructure might be crumbling around us, but the political machine inside this building runs flawlessly.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Irony: (Crumbling infrastructure, Political machine, Disconnect).

cards.name: The Pine Belt Populist
cards.flavorText: We harvest the timber, we mind our own business, and we do not trust the politicians in Jackson.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Independence: (Pine Belt, Harvesting, Distrust).

cards.name: The Oxford Elitist
cards.effect: Arts and Culture cards grant +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We wear bowties to football games, quote Faulkner, and politely look down on the rest of the state.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Arrogance: (The Velvet Ditch, Bowtie, Literary pretension).

cards.name: The Grove Tailgate
cards.effect: Gain +5 Support, but lose 1 Capital to chandeliers.
cards.flavorText: We literally set up crystal chandeliers in pop-up tents to drink bourbon before a football game. Pure pageantry.
cards.learningGoal: Ostentatious Revelry: (Pageantry, Chandelier, Holy Grail).

cards.name: The Cowbell Ringer
cards.flavorText: 100,000 Mississippi State fans are violently ringing metal cowbells. The noise is deafening and completely disorienting.
cards.learningGoal: Auditory Warfare: (Clanging, Disorienting, Auditory assault).

cards.name: The Jackson Water Crisis
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The pumps failed, the pipes broke, and the capital city has no drinking water. A catastrophic failure of governance.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Collapse: (Boil advisory, Catastrophic, Negligence, Infrastructure).

cards.name: The Hall of Famer's Volleyball Court
cards.flavorText: You allegedly diverted millions in federal poverty funds to build a college volleyball stadium. The FBI is on line one.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Scandals: (Misallocation, Diverted funds, Scandalous).

cards.name: The Mighty Mississippi
cards.flavorText: The levees are straining. The river is a mile wide and muddy brown. The lowlands are completely submerged.
cards.learningGoal: Natural Forces: (Cresting, Levee, Submerged, Floodplain).

cards.name: Comeback Sauce Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a state contract while eating fried green tomatoes dipped in a mayonnaise-and-chili-sauce masterpiece.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Signatures: (Masterpiece, Zesty, Condiment diplomacy).

cards.name: Catfish Farming
cards.flavorText: We flooded the fields to raise bottom-feeders. Serve it with hushpuppies and secure the rural vote.
cards.learningGoal: Aquaculture Jargon: (Bottom-feeder, Hushpuppy, Pond-raised).

cards.name: Changing the State Flag
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from moderates, lose 2 from hardliners.
cards.flavorText: We finally retired the 1894 flag! The corporate boycotts have ended, but the traditionalists are grumbling.
cards.learningGoal: Symbolic Reforms: (Retiring symbols, Boycott, Traditionalist).

cards.name: The Humidity Wall
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: It is 98 degrees with 100% humidity. Stepping outside feels like walking into a hot, wet mouth.
cards.learningGoal: Oppressive Weather: (Sweltering, Suffocating, Oppressive humidity).

cards.name: The Chitlin' Circuit
cards.flavorText: Campaigning at a historic, cinderblock juke joint in Clarksdale. You have tapped into the absolute soul of the South.
cards.learningGoal: Musical History: (Juke joint, Chitlin' Circuit, Soulful roots).

cards.name: Brain Drain
cards.flavorText: Every college graduate in the state is packing a U-Haul and moving to Georgia or Texas for better jobs. The talent pool is vanishing.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Crises: (Brain drain, Out-migration, Vanishing talent).

cards.name: Federal Funds Dependency
cards.flavorText: We complain about Washington D.C. constantly, while simultaneously relying on them for 40% of our entire state budget.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Contradictions: (Dependency, Lifeline, Hypocrisy).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Pardon
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The Governor is leaving office, so he just pardoned 200 people on a Sunday night. The press is absolutely scrambling.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Overreach: (Clemency, Scrambling, Lame duck).

cards.name: Kudzu Invasion
cards.translation: The Vine That Ate the South
cards.flavorText: The aggressive green vine has completely swallowed your opponent's campaign bus. They are trapped in the foliage.
cards.learningGoal: Botanical Metaphors: (Invasive, Swallowed, Foliage).

cards.name: Delta Hot Tamales
cards.flavorText: Eating spicy, cornmeal-wrapped meat boiled in a coffee can. A beautiful, weird collision of Mexican and Southern history.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Collision: (Boiled, Shuck, Culinary history).

cards.name: The Supermajority
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We have absolute control of the House and Senate. Your dissenting opinion has been politely ignored.
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Control: (Steamroll, Dissenting, Absolute control).

cards.name: Bless Your Heart
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You smiled sweetly and delivered a phrase that sounds like a prayer but is actually a devastating character assassination.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Character assassination, Sugar-coated, Devastating).

cards.name: The State Fair Biscuit Booth
cards.flavorText: Waiting in line for an hour to get a free, piping-hot biscuit dripping with molasses. You are a man of the people.
cards.learningGoal: Comfort Food Pandering: (Piping-hot, Dripping, Man of the people).

cards.name: Blue Laws
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to buy a bottle of wine on a Sunday in a rural county. They have been publicly shamed.
cards.learningGoal: Prohibition Holdovers: (Blue laws, Publicly shamed, Archaic).

cards.name: The Writers' Legacy
cards.flavorText: We produced Faulkner, Welty, and Grisham. We might rank 50th in everything else, but we will out-write you any day.
cards.learningGoal: Literary Superiority: (Legacy, Out-write, Cultural capital).

cards.name: The Southern Drawl
cards.flavorText: Speaking so slowly and with such thick molasses that your opponent completely loses their train of thought.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Pacing: (Drawl, Molasses, Lulling to sleep).

cards.name: Hurricane Camille Nostalgia
cards.flavorText: You survived the worst hurricane in American history. A minor campaign finance scandal means absolutely nothing to you.
cards.learningGoal: Trauma Resilience: (Benchmark, Unfazed, Weathering the storm).

cards.name: The Medical Marijuana Fight
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support, but trigger a Supreme Court lawsuit.
cards.flavorText: The voters passed it overwhelmingly! So the state Supreme Court invalidated the entire ballot initiative process!
cards.learningGoal: Subverting Democracy: (Invalidated, Ballot initiative, Legal technicality).

cards.name: The SEC Schedule
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It's October. Nobody cares about your tax policy; they only care if the backup quarterback is healthy for the Alabama game.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Distraction: (Depth chart, Distracted, Priority shift).

cards.name: Cruisin' The Coast
cards.flavorText: Highway 90 is entirely clogged with 10,000 vintage hot rods. Your campaign motorcade is stuck behind a '57 Chevy.
cards.learningGoal: Nostalgic Gridlock: (Hot rod, Motorcade, Cruising).

cards.name: The Gulf Oil Spill
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: A deepwater rig exploded. The shrimp boats are docked, the beaches are black, and the economy is in absolute ruins.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Disasters: (Tar ball, Deepwater, Economic ruin).

cards.name: The State Nickname
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We will invite you in, feed you until you burst, and politely disagree with everything you stand for. Welcome!
cards.learningGoal: Unwavering Politeness: (Hospitality, Bursting, Courteous disagreement).

cards.name: Pothole on I-55
cards.flavorText: Your opponent hit a crater on the interstate that hasn't been paved since 1988. Their axle is completely destroyed.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Neglect: (Crater, Axle, Deferred maintenance).

cards.name: The Mosquito Truck
cards.flavorText: A truck driving 10 mph just sprayed a massive, thick cloud of pesticide over your opponent's outdoor fundraiser.
cards.learningGoal: Pest Control: (Pesticide fog, Fumigation, Dispersing the crowd).

cards.name: Biloxi Shrimping Fleet
cards.flavorText: Standing on the docks as the local clergy bless the shrimp boats for a safe season. Wholesome, working-class optics.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Traditions: (Clergy, Blessing, Working-class optics).

cards.name: The Income Tax Elimination
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital from conservatives, lose 3 Support from teachers.
cards.flavorText: We are phasing out the state income tax entirely! (Please do not ask how we will pave the roads).
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Starvation: (Phasing out, Race to zero, Starving the beast).

cards.name: The 'It's Not That Bad' Defense
cards.flavorText: We might be 49th in healthcare, but hey, at least we aren't 50th! Thank God for Arkansas!
cards.learningGoal: Deflecting Criticism: (Silver lining, Deflection, Grasping at straws).

cards.name: The Soybean Tariffs
cards.flavorText: The international trade war just tanked the price of soybeans. The Delta farmers are furious and locking their checkbooks.
cards.learningGoal: Global Economics: (Trade war, Tanked prices, Retaliation).

cards.name: The Front Porch Campaign
cards.flavorText: Sitting in a rocking chair, drinking sweet tea, and talking to voters face-to-face. The old-school tactics still work perfectly.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Politics: (Old-school, Rocking chair, Face-to-face).

cards.name: Natchez Trace Parkway
cards.flavorText: You took the historic, federally protected two-lane road. It is beautiful, but the speed limit is 50 mph and you cannot pass.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Inconvenience: (Federally protected, Impassable, Meandering).

cards.name: The Magnolia State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The magnolias are blooming, the air is sweet, and the voters are entirely enchanted by your southern charm!
cards.learningGoal: Botanical Enchantment: (Blooming, Enchanted, Intoxicating scent).

cards.name: The Last Abortion Clinic
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 4 from progressives.
cards.flavorText: The Supreme Court case that overturned Roe started right here. The cultural and legal shockwaves are monumental.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Epicenters: (Shockwaves, Standoff, Landmark case).

cards.name: The Strip Mall Casino
cards.flavorText: A depressing, windowless room in a strip mall filled with Video Lottery Terminals. It isn't glamorous, but it generates tax revenue.
cards.learningGoal: Vice Economics: (Windowless, Terminal, Depressing revenue).

cards.name: The 'Big House' Penitentiary
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: A scandal broke about the inhumane, terrifying conditions at the state's oldest prison. The federal judges are intervening.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Failures: (Inhumane, Intervening, Penal farm).

cards.name: The SEC Network
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to run an attack ad, but the entire state was watching Paul Finebaum argue about college football.
cards.learningGoal: Media Diet: (Echo chamber, Sports fanaticism, Drowning out the noise).

cards.name: The Two Mississippis
cards.flavorText: The wealthy suburbs of Madison versus the crushing poverty of the Delta. You cannot govern both with the same promises.
cards.learningGoal: Socioeconomic Gulf: (Crushing poverty, Affluence, Disparate realities).

cards.name: The Rebel Mascot Retirement
cards.flavorText: We retired the old mascot decades ago, but people are still angrily protesting about it in the stadium parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Stubbornness: (Refusal to move on, Mascots, Culture war holdovers).

cards.name: The Crawfish Boil
cards.flavorText: You proved you aren't an elitist by pinching the tail, sucking the head, and eating spicy mudbugs off a newspaper.
cards.learningGoal: Authenticity Test: (Pinching tails, Sucking heads, Unpretentious).

cards.name: The Good Ole Boy Network
cards.flavorText: If your granddaddy didn't hunt with my granddaddy, your zoning permit is never getting approved.
cards.learningGoal: Nepotistic Cartels: (Good ole boy, Courthouse ring, Gatekeeping).

cards.name: The Civil Rights Trail
cards.flavorText: Standing at a historic marker to acknowledge the state's brutal, heavy past. The optics are solemn and necessary.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Reckoning: (Solemn, Brutal past, Acknowledgment).

cards.name: The JoCo Suburbanite
cards.flavorText: We live in Overland Park, our schools are pristine, and we are the only reason this state occasionally elects a Democrat.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Power: (Pristine, Swing county, Bellwether, Demographic shift).

cards.name: The Wichita Aviator
cards.flavorText: We build the Cessnas, the Boeings, and the Learjets. If the aerospace industry sneezes, the state economy catches a cold.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Monoculture: (Aerospace, Hub, Economic dependency).

cards.name: The High Plains Farmer
cards.flavorText: We grow the wheat that feeds the world. The towns are shrinking, the wind is howling, but we vote in every election.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Stoicism: (High plains, Howling wind, Depopulation).

cards.name: The Lawrence Progressive
cards.flavorText: We are a liberal oasis of coffee shops, basketball fanaticism, and college students who will probably move to Colorado after graduation.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Enclaves: (Oasis, Brain drain, Liberal arts).

cards.name: The Brownback Experiment
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: You eliminated the income tax to spur growth. The schools went broke, the roads crumbled, and your career imploded.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Catastrophe: (Trickle-down, Deficit, Implosion, Cautionary tale).

cards.name: The Wizard of Oz Joke
cards.flavorText: You made a 'we aren't in Kansas anymore' joke to a crowd of locals. The groans are deafening and your credibility is dead.
cards.learningGoal: Stereotype Fatigue: (Tired cliché, Eye-roll, Lack of originality).

cards.name: Tornado Alley
cards.flavorText: The sky turned green and the sirens are blaring. Your opponent's campaign headquarters was just relocated to the next county.
cards.learningGoal: Meteorological Destruction: (F5, Siren, Relocated, Splintered).

cards.name: The Koch Network
cards.flavorText: The billionaire brothers from Wichita just opened their checkbook. Your campaign is now a fully funded libertarian juggernaut.
cards.learningGoal: Dark Money: (Juggernaut, Libertarian, Unprecedented funding).

cards.name: Flint Hills Pasture Burn
cards.flavorText: The ranchers set fire to the tallgrass prairie to renew the soil. The smoke has completely blinded the interstate.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Practices: (Controlled burn, Tallgrass, Obscured vision).

cards.name: Rock Chalk Jayhawk
cards.flavorText: An incredibly slow, eerie, and intimidating chant echoing through the basketball arena. The sheer acoustic power is terrifying.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Intimidation: (Eerie, Resonant, Chanting, Acoustic power).

cards.name: The EMAW Crowd
cards.flavorText: Every Man A Wildcat! We are the pragmatic, hard-working agricultural school, and we despise the snobs in Lawrence.
cards.learningGoal: Land-Grant Pride: (Pragmatic, Land-grant, Working-class ethos).

cards.name: Wind Farm Subsidies
cards.flavorText: The wind never stops blowing here, so we built 10,000 massive white fans in the wheat fields. The royalties are massive.
cards.learningGoal: Renewable Economics: (Turbine, Royalties, Aesthetic blight).

cards.name: The Border War
cards.flavorText: We fought a literal guerrilla war against Missouri in the 1850s, and we still refuse to share a metropolitan transit system with them.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Grudges: (Guerrilla war, Bleeding Kansas, Border Ruffian).

cards.name: I-70 Monotony
cards.flavorText: You are driving the 400 incredibly flat, straight miles between Kansas City and Denver. The sensory deprivation puts you to sleep.
cards.learningGoal: Highway Hypnosis: (Monotony, Flatline, Sensory deprivation).

cards.name: The State Line Poach
cards.effect: Spend 1 Capital, gain 3 Support from donors.
cards.flavorText: We offered a corporation $50 million in tax breaks to move their office 500 feet across State Line Road from Missouri! Victory!
cards.learningGoal: Zero-Sum Economics: (Poaching, Border war, Net-zero growth).

cards.name: The Supreme Court Block
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Policy Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The conservative legislature passed the bill, but the moderate State Supreme Court struck it down. The stalemate continues.
cards.learningGoal: Judicial Review: (Struck down, Stalemate, Checks and balances).

cards.name: Value Them Both
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 4 from progressives.
cards.flavorText: The legislature tried to remove abortion rights from the state constitution, but the suburban voters mobilized and crushed it.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Backlash: (Referendum, Mobilization, Stunning defeat).

cards.name: The Dodge City Feedlot
cards.flavorText: The wind shifted over a massive cattle feedlot. Your opponent's outdoor fundraiser smells like 50,000 cows.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Olfactory: (Feedlot, Manure, Pungent).

cards.name: Sunflowers in August
cards.flavorText: Taking a majestic campaign photo in a field of eight-foot-tall sunflowers. The optics are incredibly wholesome.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Aesthetics: (Wholesome optics, Majestic, State flower).

cards.name: The Ogallala Aquifer
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: We pumped too much water to grow corn in the desert. The aquifer is dry. The agricultural economy is collapsing.
cards.learningGoal: Resource Depletion: (Aquifer, Depletion, Unsustainable, Collapse).

cards.name: Chili and Cinnamon Rolls
cards.flavorText: Eating a bowl of chili with a giant, sugary cinnamon roll on the side. It makes no culinary sense, but it is a sacred state tradition.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Oddities: (Sweet and savory, Sacred tradition, Mismatched).

cards.name: The Moderate Republican
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: I am a Republican who believes in funding public schools and fixing roads. The national party hates me, but the locals love me.
cards.learningGoal: Political Triangulation: (Dying breed, Pragmatism, Bucking the party).

cards.name: The Meatpacking Plant
cards.flavorText: Garden City and Dodge City rely on immigrants to run the massive slaughterhouses. A fascinating, complex demographic shift.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Realities: (Slaughterhouse, Labor force, Complex dynamics).

cards.name: The Capitol Dome
cards.flavorText: Standing in the statehouse beneath the massive, terrifying painting of John Brown holding a rifle and a Bible.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Extremism: (Abolitionist, Mural, Terrifying fervor).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Veto
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The Democratic Governor just vetoed the Republican legislature's gerrymandered map. The override battle begins.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Action: (Veto, Gerrymander, Override battle).

cards.name: The School Finance Lawsuit
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The state Supreme Court ruled the school funding unconstitutional again. The legislature is scrambling to find a billion dollars.
cards.learningGoal: Constitutional Mandates: (Unconstitutional, Funding formula, Scrambling).

cards.name: The Big 12 Tournament
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It is March. Half the state has driven to Kansas City to drink beer and watch basketball. Politics are entirely suspended.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Truancy: (Tournament, Exodus, Suspended reality).

cards.name: Cosmosphere Field Trip
cards.flavorText: We randomly have the Apollo 13 command module in a museum in Hutchinson. The tourist dollars are out of this world.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Tourism: (Space race, Command module, Out of this world).

cards.name: The Salt Mines
cards.flavorText: Hiding your controversial campaign documents in the massive, climate-controlled salt caverns 650 feet below Hutchinson.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Storage: (Subterranean, Climate-controlled, Vault).

cards.name: The Dust Bowl Warning
cards.flavorText: The rain stopped, the wind picked up, and the topsoil is blowing. The generational trauma of the 1930s instantly returns.
cards.learningGoal: Generational Trauma: (Dust Bowl, Topsoil, Desolation).

cards.name: The Fake State Line
cards.effect: Opponent must discard a card if they confuse the cities.
cards.flavorText: We are Kansas City, KANSAS. We have the NASCAR track and the soccer stadium. Stop giving Missouri the credit!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Identity: (Misplaced credit, Twin cities, Inferiority complex).

cards.name: The B-29 Bomber
cards.flavorText: Taking a flight on a restored WWII bomber built in Wichita. An incredible display of the state's industrial might.
cards.learningGoal: Aviation History: (Restored, Arsenal of democracy, Industrial might).

cards.name: The Anti-Slavery Roots
cards.flavorText: We entered the union as a Free State! We bled for this! We will not bow to your authoritarian policies!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (Free State, Abolition, Bleeding Kansas).

cards.name: The Pivot Sprinkler
cards.flavorText: Those massive green circles you see from the airplane? That's us pumping the aquifer dry to grow alfalfa.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Engineering: (Center pivot, Aerial view, Irrigation).

cards.name: The BBQ Debate
cards.flavorText: You claimed Texas brisket was better than Kansas City burnt ends. You have been physically removed from the state.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Rivalries: (Burnt ends, Masterpiece, Blasphemy).

cards.name: The Prairie Dog Town
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's campaign bus hit a massive colony of prairie dog holes and snapped an axle.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Hazards: (Colony, Burrow, Snapped axle).

cards.name: The 'Ad Astra' Motto
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Ad Astra Per Aspera! To the stars through difficulties! We survived the tornados and the tax cuts, and we are rising!
cards.learningGoal: State Motto: (Ad Astra, Through difficulties, Resilience).

cards.name: The 3.2 Beer Ban
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from youth, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We finally allowed grocery stores to sell strong beer! Welcome to the modern era, Kansas!
cards.learningGoal: Archaic Laws: (3.2 beer, Prohibition holdovers, Modernization).

cards.name: The Turnpike Toll
cards.flavorText: If you want to drive from Wichita to KC, you have to pay the toll authority. The revenue stream is magnificent.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Monopolies: (Toll plaza, Cash grab, Revenue stream).

cards.name: The Brain Drain
cards.flavorText: Your regressive social policies convinced every college graduate to move to Colorado the second they got their diploma.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Flight: (Brain drain, Regressive, Greener pastures).

cards.name: The Rural Co-Op
cards.flavorText: We own our own power lines out here in the wheat fields. Don't let the big city utility companies near us.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Infrastructure: (Cooperative, Utility, Independence).

cards.name: The Dotted Line Map
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The state is a perfect rectangle divided into 105 perfectly square counties. The bureaucratic redundancy is beautiful.
cards.learningGoal: Cartographic Precision: (Redundancy, Perfect grid, Bureaucratic).

cards.name: The Tallgrass Prairie
cards.flavorText: Standing in the last remaining expanse of untouched tallgrass prairie on Earth. The ecological optics are stunning.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Grandeur: (Untouched, Expanse, Ecosystem).

cards.name: The Supermajority Threat
cards.flavorText: The extreme wing of the party almost had a supermajority, but three suburban moms flipped their districts to stop them.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Checks: (Firewall, Supermajority, Flipping the district).

cards.name: The Wheat Harvest
cards.flavorText: A fleet of massive combines is moving south to north across the state. The harvest is in, and the economy is saved.
cards.learningGoal: Migratory Labor: (Custom harvesters, Fleet, Bountiful).

cards.name: The State Fair Tractor Pull
cards.flavorText: Watching modified tractors belch black smoke while dragging a massive sled of lead weights. Pure rural entertainment.
cards.learningGoal: Motorsports Oddities: (Modified, Belching smoke, Tractor pull).

cards.name: The Hidden Submarine
cards.flavorText: Wait, why is there a Navy base in the middle of a landlocked state? The confusing logistics have delayed your opponent.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Anomalies: (Landlocked, Misplaced, Logistical confusion).

cards.name: The 'What's the Matter' Book
cards.flavorText: A national pundit wrote another condescending book asking 'What's the Matter with Kansas?' The state unites in annoyance.
cards.learningGoal: Media Tropes: (Condescension, Punditry, Think piece).

cards.name: The Governor's Mansion
cards.flavorText: The Democratic Governor is hiding in the mansion, preparing to veto whatever the Republican legislature sends to the desk.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Standoffs: (Standoff, Veto pen, Defensive posture).

cards.name: The Sunflower State
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are sunny, we are resilient, and we grow where we are planted! The momentum is shining upon us!
cards.learningGoal: Botanical Optimism: (Resilient, Blooming, Golden hour).

cards.name: The Unicameral Senator
cards.flavorText: We don't have a House and a Senate. We just have one room, no party labels, and a lot of filibusters.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Quirks: (Unicameral, Non-partisan, Filibuster, Chamber).

cards.name: The Omaha Oracle
cards.flavorText: The entire state economy revolves around an 90-year-old billionaire who still eats McDonald's for breakfast.
cards.learningGoal: Billionaire Aesthetics: (Frugality, Oracle, Economic gravity).

cards.name: The Sandhills Rancher
cards.flavorText: We have more cattle than people, and we sit on top of the largest underground aquifer on the continent.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Scale: (Aquifer, Sandhills, Cattle to person ratio).

cards.name: The Lincoln Academic
cards.flavorText: We wear red, we research agriculture, and we try to pretend the rest of the state isn't mad at us.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Bubbles: (Flagship, Land-grant, Institutional tension).

cards.name: Husker Football Delusion
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We haven't been relevant in twenty years, but if you put on a red jacket and yell 'Go Big Red,' the voters will cry.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Nostalgia: (Glory days, Delusion, Unwavering loyalty).

cards.name: Eating a Runza
cards.flavorText: Eating a hot dough pocket filled with ground beef and cabbage. It's a culinary requirement for public office.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Fast Food: (Dough pocket, Obligatory, Acquired taste).

cards.name: The Berkshire Hathaway Meeting
cards.effect: Gain +5 Capital, but lose 1 Support from populists.
cards.flavorText: 40,000 investors just descended on Omaha. The steakhouses are full and the campaign checks are massive.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Pilgrimage: (Shareholders, Capitalist, Pilgrimage).

cards.name: Strategic Air Command
cards.flavorText: We control the nation's nuclear deterrent from a bunker in Bellevue. Treat us with respect.
cards.learningGoal: Military Posture: (Deterrent, Bunker, Strategic command).

cards.name: The Platte River Smirk
cards.translation: A Mile Wide and an Inch Deep
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's policy proposal was just compared to our famous river: entirely superficial and mostly useless.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Metaphors: (Superficial, Shallow, Mile wide and an inch deep).

cards.name: College World Series
cards.flavorText: The entire college baseball world is drinking in our downtown for two weeks. The tax revenue is flowing!
cards.learningGoal: Event Economics: (Tournament, Tax revenue, Hospitality boom).

cards.name: Property Tax Revolt
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the rurals.
cards.flavorText: The farmers are paying exorbitant taxes on their dirt. They are bringing their tractors to the capitol to protest.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Grievances: (Exorbitant, Tax burden, Agrarian revolt).

cards.name: The Blue Dot
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: We split our electoral votes! Omaha is going rogue and voting for the other party. The rest of the state is furious.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Quirks: (Splitting votes, Rogue district, The Blue Dot).

cards.name: Carhenge
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got confused while visiting a scale replica of Stonehenge made entirely of gray-painted classic cars.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Kitsch: (Scale replica, Junkyard, Bizarre attraction).

cards.name: Omaha Henry Doorly Zoo
cards.flavorText: Campaigning inside the world's largest indoor desert. The optics are incredibly exotic for the Midwest.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Pride: (World-renowned, Exotic, Bio-dome).

cards.name: The Keystone XL Pipeline
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from industry, lose 3 from ranchers.
cards.flavorText: You want to run a massive oil pipe right through our pristine groundwater? The lawsuits begin now.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Standoffs: (Pipeline, Groundwater, Easement, Litigation).

cards.name: Corn Detasseling
cards.flavorText: The summer rite of passage: waking up at 4 AM to rip the tops off corn stalks in a muddy field. Character building!
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Labor: (Rite of passage, Detasseling, Character building).

cards.name: The Meatpacking Plant
cards.flavorText: The slaughterhouses drive the economy and bring a massive, complex immigrant workforce to the rural plains.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Realities: (Meatpacking, Migrant workforce, Economic driver).

cards.name: Tornado Sirens
cards.flavorText: The sky turned the color of a bruised lime. The sirens are blaring. The campaign trail is officially paused.
cards.learningGoal: Meteorological Threat: (Bruised sky, Blaring, Taking cover).

cards.name: The Non-Partisan Ballot
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Faction cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: There are no D's or R's on the legislative ballot. You actually have to figure out what the candidate believes.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Nuance: (Non-partisan, Stealth, Stripped of labels).

cards.name: The I-80 Monotony
cards.flavorText: Driving from Omaha to Wyoming is a 450-mile exercise in sensory deprivation. Your opponent fell asleep at the wheel.
cards.learningGoal: Highway Hypnosis: (Straightaway, Sensory deprivation, Monotony).

cards.name: The 'Good Life' Slogan
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: We don't have mountains, but we have low unemployment and good beef. It's not for everyone, but it's the Good Life.
cards.learningGoal: Sloganeering: (Self-aware, Unpretentious, The Good Life).

cards.name: The Filibuster Blockade
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: A single senator is reading the dictionary for eight hours to kill a controversial bill. The chamber is paralyzed.
cards.learningGoal: Obstructionism: (Filibuster, Paralyzed chamber, Running the clock).

cards.name: Wind Chill Warning
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: The wind is blowing straight down from Canada with absolutely nothing to stop it. The electorate is frozen.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Cold: (Wind chill, Unobstructed, Bitterly cold).

cards.name: The Ethanol Mandate
cards.flavorText: We are passing a law to require more corn liquor in the gasoline! The petroleum industry is deeply annoyed.
cards.learningGoal: Biofuel Lobby: (Ethanol, Mandate, Agricultural subsidy).

cards.name: Chili and Cinnamon Rolls
cards.flavorText: Eating a bowl of savory chili paired directly with a massive, sugary cinnamon roll. The ultimate Midwestern comfort food.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Dissonance: (Sweet and savory, Comfort food, School lunch).

cards.name: The Governor's Pig Roast
cards.flavorText: Eating slow-roasted pork on a farm while high-dollar donors write checks behind a tractor.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Fundraising: (Pig roast, High-dollar, Good-old-boy network).

cards.name: The Platte Institute
cards.flavorText: A conservative think tank just released a 40-page white paper completely dismantling your tax plan.
cards.learningGoal: Ideological Warfare: (Think tank, White paper, Dismantling).

cards.name: The Great Platte River Road
cards.flavorText: We invoked the spirit of the Oregon Trail and the Mormon Pioneers! We are the gateway to the West!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Grandiosity: (Pioneer spirit, Gateway, Covered wagon).

cards.name: The Crane Migration
cards.flavorText: A million Sandhill Cranes just landed in the river. The tourists are clogging the roads. No politics today, only birds.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Spectacle: (Migration, Avian, Clogging the roads).

cards.name: The Suburbs of West Omaha
cards.flavorText: Elkhorn and Millard are booming. If you want to win statewide, you have to win the cul-de-sacs.
cards.learningGoal: Suburban Sprawl: (McMansion, Cul-de-sac, Boomtown).

cards.name: The Property Tax Cap
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We promised to lower property taxes for the 15th year in a row! (The bill died in committee again).
cards.learningGoal: Perpetual Failures: (Dying in committee, Broken record, Cap).

cards.name: The Arbor Day Foundation
cards.flavorText: We literally invented Arbor Day in Nebraska City. The environmental optics are deeply rooted here.
cards.learningGoal: Botanical History: (Arbor Day, Deeply rooted, Green optics).

cards.name: The Blizzard of '97
cards.flavorText: You survived a blizzard that buried houses. A little political scandal means nothing to you.
cards.learningGoal: Resilience Narratives: (Shared trauma, Buried, Weathering the storm).

cards.name: The Rural Co-op
cards.flavorText: We are the only state in the country where every single electric utility is publicly owned. The corporations cannot touch us.
cards.learningGoal: Public Infrastructure: (Publicly owned, Utility co-op, Defying privatization).

cards.name: The Brain Drain
cards.flavorText: Your regressive policies caused all the University of Nebraska graduates to immediately move to Illinois.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Crisis: (Brain drain, Out-migration, Regressive).

cards.name: The Husker Firing
cards.effect: Both players must discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: The university just fired the football coach and paid him millions to leave. The entire state is in an uproar.
cards.learningGoal: Sports Financials: (Buyout, Uproar, Sunk cost).

cards.name: The Telemarketing Hub
cards.flavorText: Omaha has historically neutral accents and cheap labor, making it the call center capital of the world.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Niches: (Neutral accent, Telemarketing, Hub).

cards.name: The ConAgra Departure
cards.flavorText: A massive Fortune 500 agricultural company moved its headquarters to Chicago. The downtown real estate market is weeping.
cards.learningGoal: Capital Flight: (Relocation, Real estate crash, Corporate exodus).

cards.name: The Kwik Shop Run
cards.flavorText: Buying a coffee and a donut at the local gas station to prove you aren't an out-of-touch coastal elite.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Politics: (Out-of-touch, Everyman, Quick stop).

cards.name: The Term Limit Shuffle
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: The senator is term-limited, so he is running for mayor, and the mayor is running for senate. The faces never change.
cards.learningGoal: Political Musical Chairs: (Term limits, Swapping seats, Entrenched).

cards.name: The 'Nebraska Nice'
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You attacked me, but I just smiled and offered you a Runza. The voters punished you for being rude.
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Nebraska Nice, Punished for rudeness, Disarming).

cards.name: The Beef Council
cards.flavorText: We produce the beef. We are the backbone of the state. If you support fake meat, you will be destroyed.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Gatekeeping: (Beef Council, Backbone, Dietary politics).

cards.name: The Ag-Gag Bill
cards.flavorText: We made it illegal to secretly film inside a slaughterhouse. We protect our industries from journalists!
cards.learningGoal: Information Control: (Ag-gag, Whistleblower, Shielding).

cards.name: The State Fair
cards.flavorText: Walking through a humid pavilion to look at a 1,000-pound pig while eating a funnel cake.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Absurdity: (Humid pavilion, Swine, Funnel cake).

cards.name: The Platte River Crossing
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got stuck behind a slow-moving tractor on a historic, two-lane bridge over a shallow river.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Logistics: (Slow-moving, Shallow river, Bottleneck).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Filibuster
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The session is ending, but a rogue senator has taken the floor and refuses to yield. The clock is ticking down.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Drama: (Refusing to yield, Running out the clock, Lame duck).

cards.name: The Cornhusker State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We grow the corn, we feed the world, and we vote in massive numbers! The harvest is ours!
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Momentum: (Bountiful harvest, Yield, Feeding the world).

cards.name: Ope, Let Me Squeeze Past Ya
cards.flavorText: A devastating political maneuver executed with an aggressive level of midwestern politeness.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Syntax: (Ope, Polite maneuver, Midwestern).

cards.name: The Flood of 2019
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: Ice jams destroyed the levees. Entire towns are underwater. The agricultural losses are catastrophic.
cards.learningGoal: Natural Disasters: (Ice jam, Levee breach, Catastrophic losses).

cards.name: The State Motto
cards.flavorText: You tried a corrupt backroom deal, but the state motto was invoked, and the voters demand fairness!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Ideals: (Equality, Jurisprudence, Invocation).

cards.name: The Santa Fe Elite
cards.flavorText: I bought a $3 million adobe house, I collect turquoise jewelry, and I have very strong opinions on zoning laws.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Aesthetics: (Adobe, Turquoise, Zoning, Wealthy transplant).

cards.name: The ABQ Hustler
cards.flavorText: We don't have Santa Fe money. We have endless sprawl, amazing food, and a slightly terrifying crime rate.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Realism: (Duke City, Sprawl, Gritty reality).

cards.name: The Los Alamos Scientist
cards.effect: Tech and Defense cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavorText: We invented the atomic bomb, and now we quietly conduct classified research while sipping artisanal coffee.
cards.learningGoal: Scientific Isolation: (Classified research, The Hill, Atomic legacy).

cards.name: The Rural Rancher
cards.flavorText: From Las Cruces to Carlsbad, we pump the oil and run the cattle. Keep Santa Fe out of our business.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Independence: (Cattle ranching, Oil patch, Disdain for the capital).

cards.name: Red or Green?
cards.flavorText: You ordered a breakfast burrito and choked when they asked 'Red or Green?' You are outed as a tourist.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (The State Question, Flustered, Authentic).

cards.name: Christmas Style
cards.flavorText: You asked for both red AND green chile on your enchiladas. The locals respect your indecisive brilliance.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Diplomacy: (Christmas style, Indecisive, Best of both worlds).

cards.name: The Roswell Incident
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: We crashed a weather balloon in 1947 and turned it into an 80-year, billion-dollar alien tourism industry.
cards.learningGoal: Kitsch Tourism: (UFO, Crash site, Monetizing a conspiracy).

cards.name: Breaking Bad Tour
cards.flavorText: Your opponent was photographed throwing a pizza on a roof. The locals are incredibly tired of this joke.
cards.learningGoal: Pop Culture Fatigue: (Tired joke, Media trope, Exploitation).

cards.name: Meow Wolf Expansion
cards.flavorText: A weird, psychedelic art installation somehow became a massive corporate juggernaut. The tax revenue is wild.
cards.learningGoal: Arts Economics: (Psychedelic, Immersive art, Corporate juggernaut).

cards.name: The Roundhouse
cards.flavorText: Our state capitol is literally shaped like a circle. It is very easy for lobbyists to trap you in the hallway.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Quirks: (The Roundhouse, Circular logic, Cornered).

cards.name: The Film Tax Credit
cards.flavorText: We gave Netflix a billion dollars in tax breaks so they can pretend the desert is actually Afghanistan.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Subsidies: (Tax credit, Film industry, Generous incentives).

cards.name: The Spaceport Boondoggle
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We spent $200 million on a spaceport in the middle of the desert! (Billionaires have flown out of it twice).
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Failures: (Spaceport, Boondoggle, Billionaire playground).

cards.name: The Hatch Valley
cards.flavorText: We grow the greatest peppers on planet Earth. Colorado claims they do, but Colorado is full of liars.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Superiority: (Hatch chile, Stolen valor, Capsaicin).

cards.name: Zozobra
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: A 50-foot marionette is burned to the ground to destroy the city's sadness. The political slate is wiped clean.
cards.learningGoal: Cathartic Rituals: (Zozobra, Effigy, Catharsis, Clean slate).

cards.name: Balloon Fiesta Traffic
cards.flavorText: It's 5:00 AM. 500 hot air balloons are launching, and I-25 is a completely paralyzed parking lot.
cards.learningGoal: Event Logistics: (Mass ascension, Gridlock, Pre-dawn).

cards.name: The Oil Boom
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The oil is pumping in the southeast! The state budget is suddenly running a multi-billion dollar surplus!
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Euphoria: (Permian Basin, Surplus, Boomtown).

cards.name: The Bust
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The price of oil crashed. The state budget is in absolute ruins. The public schools are panicking.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Devastation: (Bust, Deficit, Revenue shock).

cards.name: The Water Rights Fight
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from farmers, lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We are fighting Texas in the Supreme Court over river water! We will not yield a single drop!
cards.learningGoal: Resource Scarcity: (Water rights, Interstate lawsuit, Aquifer).

cards.name: Monsoon Season
cards.effect: Both players discard half their hand.
cards.flavorText: It hasn't rained in months, and now a wall of water is rushing down the arroyo. Washouts everywhere.
cards.learningGoal: Desert Climate: (Monsoon, Arroyo, Flash flood).

cards.name: The Luminarias
cards.flavorText: You lit a candle inside a brown paper bag. Half the state calls it a luminaria, half calls it a farolito. Tread lightly.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Divisions: (Paper bag lantern, Regional dialect, Tread lightly).

cards.name: The Navajo Nation
cards.flavorText: You do not win a statewide election without the massive, highly organized voting power of the reservations.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Sovereignty: (Reservation, Voting bloc, Sovereign nation).

cards.name: The Pueblos
cards.flavorText: We have lived in these adobe structures for a thousand years. Your political term limits mean nothing to us.
cards.learningGoal: Ancestral Endurance: (Pueblo, Millennium, Deep time).

cards.name: White Sands Missile Range
cards.flavorText: We test highly classified military lasers in a blindingly white gypsum desert. Do not cross the perimeter.
cards.learningGoal: Military Secrecy: (Gypsum desert, Missile range, Classified testing).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislature only meets for 30 days in even years! The bills are flying through committee at light speed!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Chaos: (Short session, Light speed, Cramming it in).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Developer
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the rurals.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent took a donation from a developer who wants to build a golf course in the desert. Unforgivable.
cards.learningGoal: Environmental Taboos: (Water thief, Golf course in the desert, Unforgivable).

cards.name: The Blue State Pivot
cards.flavorText: The demographics shifted, the suburbs turned blue, and the state is no longer the swing state it used to be.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Shifts: (Demographic shift, Solidifying the map, Blue state).

cards.name: The 400-Year-Old Church
cards.flavorText: Standing in an adobe mission built in the 1600s. The historical weight of this state crushes the East Coast.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Grandiosity: (Spanish Colonial, Adobe mission, Deep history).

cards.name: Biscochito Bribe
cards.flavorText: Sliding a plate of lard-based, cinnamon-anise cookies across the table. The official state cookie opens doors.
cards.learningGoal: Sweet Diplomacy: (Biscochito, Lard-based, Anise).

cards.name: The Interstate 40 Trucker
cards.flavorText: A semi-truck flipped on I-40 near Gallup. The main artery of the American Southwest is completely severed.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Nightmare: (Artery, Severed, East-West corridor).

cards.name: The Uranium Mine Cleanup
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The Cold War left massive radioactive scars across the state. The cleanup bill is astronomical and overdue.
cards.learningGoal: Toxic Legacy: (Uranium, Radioactive scar, Remediation).

cards.name: The Allsup's Chimichanga
cards.flavorText: Eating a deep-fried, bean-and-meat cylinder from a local gas station at 2 AM. A true New Mexican rite of passage.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Cuisine: (Chimichanga, Gas station delicacy, Deep-fried).

cards.name: The Altitude Sickness
cards.flavorText: Your opponent from Washington D.C. tried to give a fiery speech in Santa Fe and immediately needed an oxygen tank.
cards.learningGoal: Physiological Limits: (Hypoxia, High altitude, Gasping for air).

cards.name: The Piñon Smoke
cards.flavorText: The smell of burning piñon wood fills the air. The electorate is feeling nostalgic, cozy, and forgiving.
cards.learningGoal: Olfactory Nostalgia: (Piñon wood, Cozy, Forgiving).

cards.name: The Dirt Road Commute
cards.flavorText: Your campaign SUV is stranded on a heavily rutted dirt road in Catron County with zero cell service.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Isolation: (Rutted, Washboard road, Dead zone).

cards.name: The Sandia Tramway
cards.flavorText: Taking a massive cable car to the top of the mountains for a photo op. The view of the sprawl is spectacular.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Infrastructure: (Tramway, Aerial view, Urban sprawl).

cards.name: The State Senate Filibuster
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The session is ending, and a rogue senator is reading a recipe for green chile stew to run out the clock.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Stalling: (Filibuster, Running the clock, Refusal to yield).

cards.name: The Missing Trigger Word
cards.flavorText: You pronounced the town 'MAD-rid' instead of 'Muh-DRID.' The locals instantly know you are an outsider.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Shibboleths: (Pronunciation test, Misplaced emphasis, Outsider).

cards.name: The Art Market
cards.flavorText: Santa Fe is flooded with wealthy art collectors buying pottery and turquoise. The sales tax is flowing.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Economics: (Art market, Wealthy collectors, Artisanal).

cards.name: The Taos Hum
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is going crazy trying to figure out where the mysterious, low-frequency buzzing sound is coming from.
cards.learningGoal: Auditory Anomalies: (Low-frequency, Unexplained, Maddening).

cards.name: The Acequia System
cards.flavorText: We must protect the 300-year-old communal irrigation ditches! Water is life in the desert!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Infrastructure: (Acequia, Communal irrigation, Water is life).

cards.name: The Land of Enchantment
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The sky is vast, the mountains are purple, and the food is perfect. We are enchanted and unstoppable!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Pride: (Enchantment, Vast sky, Unstoppable).

cards.name: The National Lab Leak
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: Someone walked out of Los Alamos with highly classified nuclear blueprints. The federal government is shutting everything down.
cards.learningGoal: Intelligence Disasters: (Security breach, Classified blueprints, Lockdown).

cards.name: The Border Wall Debate
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from conservatives, lose 4 from progressives.
cards.flavorText: The border debate is raging. The checkpoints are backed up, and the federal rhetoric is blinding.
cards.learningGoal: Geopolitical Flashpoints: (Border checkpoint, Rhetoric, Polarization).

cards.name: The 'Mañana' Attitude
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: We will get to your urgent political crisis... tomorrow. Or maybe the day after. There is no rush.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Pacing: (Mañana, Relaxed pace, Lack of urgency).

cards.name: The Very Large Array
cards.flavorText: Standing in front of 27 massive satellite dishes listening to deep space. Your campaign message is broadcast to the stars.
cards.learningGoal: Scientific Grandeur: (Radio telescope, Deep space, Broadcast).

cards.name: The Chupacabra Rumor
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: Someone claimed they saw the legendary goat-sucker near the border. The media is distracted by the cryptid hunt.
cards.learningGoal: Folklore Panics: (Chupacabra, Cryptid, Media circus).

cards.name: The Honolulu Insider
cards.flavorText: The Democratic Party here isn't just a party; it's a massive, impenetrable family tree.
cards.learningGoal: One-Party Rule: (Impenetrable, Family tree, The Machine).

cards.name: The Outer Island Populist
cards.flavorText: Oahu gets all the money, and we get all the tourists. We are tired of being the state's theme park.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resentment: (Outer island, Neglect, Theme park).

cards.name: The Mainland Transplant
cards.flavorText: I just moved from California, bought a $4 million beachfront property, and I'm very concerned about the local chickens.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Disconnect: (Transplant, Beachfront, Disconnected).

cards.name: The Sovereignty Advocate
cards.flavorText: This is illegally occupied land. We demand the restoration of the Hawaiian Kingdom and the protection of the Mauna.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Rights: (Sovereignty, Illegal occupation, Restoration).

cards.name: The Spam Musubi
cards.flavorText: A block of rice topped with grilled, soy-glazed canned meat, wrapped in seaweed. It fuels the entire electorate.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Syncretism: (Soy-glazed, Canned meat, Portable energy).

cards.name: The Jones Act
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: A century-old federal law mandates that only American ships can bring goods here. A gallon of milk now costs $9.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Strangulation: (Monopoly, Shipping lane, Exorbitant cost).

cards.name: The Honolulu Rail Project
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: We started building a train 15 years ago. It is billions over budget, goes nowhere, and is actively rusting.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Disasters: (Boondoggle, Sunk cost, Rusting infrastructure).

cards.name: Aloha Shirt Dress Code
cards.flavorText: You tried to call me unprofessional, but I am wearing a tailored, reverse-print Reyn Spooner shirt. I am legally formal.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Norms: (Reverse-print, Business casual, Tailored).

cards.name: The H-1 Parking Lot
cards.flavorText: You are trying to drive across Oahu at 4:30 PM. You are surrounded by Teslas and lifted Tacomas. You are trapped.
cards.learningGoal: Island Gridlock: (Lifted truck, Bottleneck, Gridlock).

cards.name: The Fake Missile Alert
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: 'BALLISTIC MISSILE THREAT INBOUND. THIS IS NOT A DRILL.' Someone pushed the wrong button. The state is traumatized.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Catastrophe: (False alarm, Inbound threat, Traumatized).

cards.name: Mauna Kea Protest
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from locals, lose 3 Capital from tech.
cards.flavorText: We are physically blocking the road to stop a 30-meter telescope from being built on a sacred mountain.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Standoffs: (Sacred ground, Blockade, Astronomy vs. Tradition).

cards.name: The Super Ferry Failure
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We built a massive ferry to connect the islands! Then the environmentalists and surfers legally banished it forever.
cards.learningGoal: Failed Innovations: (Banished, Environmental injunction, Sunk cost).

cards.name: Feral Chickens
cards.flavorText: Thousands of wild chickens are screaming outside your opponent's hotel window at 4:00 AM. Sleep is impossible.
cards.learningGoal: Avian Nuisance: (Feral, Screaming, Sleep deprivation).

cards.name: The Tourist Tax
cards.effect: Gain +5 Capital, but locals complain about crowds.
cards.flavorText: We just raised the hotel tax again. The tourists will complain, but they will absolutely keep coming.
cards.learningGoal: Revenue Extraction: (Surcharge, Captive audience, Tourist tax).

cards.name: Illegal Vacation Rentals
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in residential areas.
cards.flavorText: Your neighborhood is now entirely composed of tourists rolling suitcases at 3 AM. The locals are furious.
cards.learningGoal: Housing Crises: (Vacation rental, Blight, Priced out).

cards.name: The Shave Ice Line
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got stuck in a 45-minute line for finely crushed ice covered in condensed milk.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Distractions: (Shave ice, Condensed milk, Tourist trap).

cards.name: The Mainland Brain Drain
cards.flavorText: The median home price is $1.1 million. Every high school graduate is moving to Las Vegas to afford rent.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Flight: (Priced out, Brain drain, Exorbitant cost of living).

cards.name: The 'Ninth Island'
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Half the state's population lives in or frequently visits Las Vegas. The political and economic ties are unbreakable.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Anomalies: (The Ninth Island, Economic ties, Diaspora).

cards.name: Volcanic Eruption
cards.flavorText: The Big Island volcano is erupting. The lava just slowly, methodically swallowed a subdivision.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Forces: (Lava flow, Swallowed, Pele's wrath, Methodical destruction).

cards.name: Vog
cards.flavorText: The trade winds died. The volcanic ash and gas are hanging over the islands. Everyone has a terrible headache.
cards.learningGoal: Air Quality Alarms: (Vog, Trade winds, Particulate matter).

cards.name: The Macadamia Nut Monopoly
cards.flavorText: We control the chocolate-covered nut market. Do not question our agricultural dominance.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Niche: (Macadamia, Monopoly, Chocolate-covered).

cards.name: The OHA Budget
cards.effect: Provides +3 Support, but costs 1 Capital per turn.
cards.flavorText: A massive, politically complex state agency tasked with improving the conditions of Native Hawaiians. The audits are brutal.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Complexity: (State agency, Audit, Fiduciary duty).

cards.name: The Zippy's Run
cards.flavorText: Eating fried chicken, Spam, and teriyaki beef out of a cardboard box at 2 AM. Pure local political capital.
cards.learningGoal: Comfort Food Pandering: (Bento box, Late-night run, Local capital).

cards.name: The Surfer Ethos
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: You invoked the legendary Eddie Aikau. The ultimate symbol of bravery, selflessness, and riding giant waves.
cards.learningGoal: Heroic Mythology: (Selflessness, Legend, Dropping in).

cards.name: The Centipede in the Shoe
cards.flavorText: Your opponent put their shoe on without checking it. An 8-inch, venomous centipede just ended their campaign day.
cards.learningGoal: Tropical Hazards: (Venomous, Lurking, Searing pain).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Billionaire
cards.flavorText: A tech billionaire just bought 98% of an entire island. The wealth disparity is reaching dystopian levels.
cards.learningGoal: Oligarchic Takeovers: (Island purchase, Wealth disparity, Dystopian).

cards.name: The State Senate Unanimous Vote
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: There is only one Republican in the 25-seat State Senate. The bills pass with terrifying, unchallenged uniformity.
cards.learningGoal: Partisan Monolith: (Unchallenged, Uniformity, Supermajority).

cards.name: The Pothole on Nimitz
cards.flavorText: The roads here are heavily salted by the ocean air and poorly maintained. Your opponent's tire is completely blown.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Decay: (Rim bender, Salt air, Poorly maintained).

cards.name: The Poke Bowl Boom
cards.flavorText: Serving fresh, marinated ahi tuna over rice. It’s light, it’s healthy, and it distracts from the housing crisis.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Exports: (Marinated ahi, Distraction, Exported trend).

cards.name: The Military Presence
cards.flavorText: The US military controls a massive percentage of the land and economy on Oahu. You must salute the brass.
cards.learningGoal: Military-Industrial Posture: (Pacific Command, Strategic outpost, Brass).

cards.name: The Red Hill Fuel Leak
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The military's underground fuel tanks leaked jet fuel directly into the drinking water. The outrage is catastrophic.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Disasters: (Jet fuel, Aquifer, Contamination, Catastrophic outrage).

cards.name: The Aloha Spirit
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: The 'Aloha Spirit' is literally codified into state law. Your aggressive attack ad was deemed illegal vibes.
cards.learningGoal: Codified Culture: (Legal mandate, Bad vibes, Aloha spirit).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislative session is ending. The deals are cut behind closed doors, and everyone is putting leis on each other.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Celebrations: (Sine die, Closed doors, Festive adjournment).

cards.name: The Feral Pig Hunt
cards.flavorText: You went hunting for invasive wild boars in the rainforest. The locals respect your ruggedness.
cards.learningGoal: Invasive Management: (Wild boar, Rainforest, Eradication).

cards.name: The Sunscreen Ban
cards.flavorText: We banned chemicals that kill the coral reefs. The tourists are getting sunburned, but the fish are happy.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Legislation: (Reef safe, Coral bleaching, Mandate).

cards.name: The Local Boy/Girl
cards.flavorText: I graduated from a local high school. You moved here five years ago. My roots deflect your arguments.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Shielding: (Hometown hero, Deep roots, Outsider status).

cards.name: The 'Ice' Epidemic
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: The dark underbelly of paradise. A devastating drug crisis ravaging the rural communities and the unhoused population.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Crises: (Underbelly, Ravaging, Epidemic).

cards.name: The Hula Halau
cards.flavorText: Standing alongside a traditional hula school. You are showing deep respect for the ancient, living culture of the islands.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Reverence: (Living culture, Traditional, Preservation).

cards.name: The Trade Winds Stop
cards.flavorText: The ocean breeze completely died. The islands are baking in still, humid air. Everyone is too hot to vote.
cards.learningGoal: Meteorological Stagnation: (Trade winds, Stifling, Stagnant air).

cards.name: The North Shore Swell
cards.flavorText: The winter swell arrived. The traffic on the North Shore is paralyzed by people watching the massive waves.
cards.learningGoal: Surfing Spectacle: (Winter swell, Paralyzed traffic, Massive break).

cards.name: The Taro Patch
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from locals, lose 1 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We are protecting the ancient agricultural terraces from developers. Water belongs to the land, not the resorts.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Agriculture: (Taro patch, Terraces, Water rights).

cards.name: The 'Da Kine'
cards.flavorText: You used the ultimate local placeholder word perfectly in a sentence. It means everything and nothing. You win the argument.
cards.learningGoal: Pidgin Linguistics: (Universal placeholder, Contextual, Local dialect).

cards.name: The Hawaiian Homelands
cards.flavorText: The state promised land to Native Hawaiians, but the waitlist is decades long and people are dying before they get a home.
cards.learningGoal: Broken Promises: (Waitlist, Generational delay, Broken trust).

cards.name: The Lei Greeting
cards.flavorText: You accepted so many heavy flower necklaces that you literally cannot see over them or walk to the podium.
cards.learningGoal: Hospitality Overload: (Floral arrangement, Overburdened, Fragrant trap).

cards.name: The Pineapple Plantation
cards.flavorText: Pineapple and sugar are basically dead here, but we still sell the nostalgia to the tourists by the millions.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Ghosts: (Plantation era, Nostalgia, Dead industry).

cards.name: The State Motto
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: 'Ua Mau ke Ea o ka ʻĀina i ka Pono.' The life of the land is perpetuated in righteousness. A profound, unifying cry!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Righteousness: (State motto, Perpetuated, Righteousness, Profound).

cards.name: The Down East Lobsterman
cards.flavorText: I wake up at 3 AM to pull heavy traps out of freezing water. I do not care about your zoning regulations in Portland.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Grit: (Lobsterman, Down East, Freezing waters).

cards.name: The Independent Centrist
cards.flavorText: I caucus with the Democrats, but I wear flannel and occasionally vote with the Republicans. The voters adore my ambiguity.
cards.learningGoal: Political Triangulation: (Centrist, Caucus, Flannel-clad, Ambiguity).

cards.name: The Portland Foodie
cards.flavorText: We have more artisanal bakeries per capita than Brooklyn. Please ignore the housing crisis and eat this $14 croissant.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gentrification: (Artisanal, Per capita, Housing crisis).

cards.name: The County Logger
cards.flavorText: We live in 'The County.' We are closer to Quebec than we are to Boston. We handle our own business in the woods.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Isolation: (The County, Aroostook, Deep woods).

cards.name: The Electoral Split
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: Maine splits its electoral votes! The rural 2nd District just voted for the opposite party of the 1st District! Chaos!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Anomalies: (Split allocation, Going rogue, Congressional District 2).

cards.name: Ranked-Choice Voting
cards.effect: Opponent's attacks are delayed by 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: You didn't win the first round, but you were everyone's second choice! You survive the instant runoff and take the seat!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Reform: (Ranked-choice, Instant runoff, Consensus).

cards.name: The Flatlander Invasion
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from locals per turn.
cards.flavorText: People from Massachusetts are buying up all the coastal property. The locals are furious and the property taxes are skyrocketing.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Resentment: (Flatlander, Masshole, Buying up property).

cards.name: The L.L. Bean Boot
cards.flavorText: You are wearing the iconic rubber-bottomed hunting shoe. You are immune to snow, mud, and political slush.
cards.learningGoal: Iconic Apparel: (Rubber-bottomed, Slush, Iconic).

cards.name: Mud Season
cards.flavorText: The snow is melting. The unpaved roads have turned into three feet of inescapable brown soup. The campaign is stuck.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Vernacular: (Mud season, Quagmire, Unpaved, Inescapable).

cards.name: Drinking Moxie
cards.flavorText: Drinking a soda that tastes like burnt root beer and gentian root. It is horrifying, but the locals respect your bravery.
cards.learningGoal: Acquired Tastes: (Moxie, Gentian root, Bitter, Bravery test).

cards.name: Moose Collision
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's campaign SUV hit a massive, antlered tank on a dark highway. The car is totaled. The moose walked away.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Disasters: (Totaled, Antlered, Roadblock).

cards.name: The Whoopie Pie Debate
cards.flavorText: Eating two massive, soft chocolate cookies filled with a pound of vanilla frosting. Pennsylvania claims they invented it. We disagree.
cards.learningGoal: Dessert Rivalries: (Whoopie pie, Disputed origin, Confection).

cards.name: The Nor'easter
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: A massive winter storm is dumping three feet of snow and howling off the Atlantic. Throw another log in the woodstove.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Winter: (Nor'easter, Whiteout, Howling, Woodstove).

cards.name: The Stephen King Novel
cards.flavorText: A thick fog rolled into the small coastal town. Everyone is suddenly terrified that a clown is going to emerge from the sewer.
cards.learningGoal: Literary Horror: (Fog rolling in, Spooky optics, Ominous).

cards.name: Ayuh
cards.flavorText: A single, softly spoken, inhaled syllable that means 'yes,' 'I agree,' or 'please stop talking.' Masterful deflection.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Linguistics: (Ayuh, Inhaled syllable, Masterful deflection).

cards.name: The Paper Mill Closure
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The paper mill shut down. 500 jobs vanished overnight. The river smells better, but the town's economy is completely dead.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Collapse: (Paper mill, Town killer, Vanished overnight).

cards.name: The Lobster Roll Purist
cards.flavorText: You ordered your lobster roll warm with butter instead of cold with mayonnaise. You belong in Connecticut. Get out.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Purist, Connecticut style, Get out).

cards.name: Vacationland
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: The license plate promises paradise. The tourists bring billions of dollars, but they drive terribly on Route 1.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Economics: (Vacationland, Route 1, Dual-edged sword).

cards.name: The LePage Tirade
cards.effect: Both players must discard their hands and draw 3 cards.
cards.flavorText: The governor just said something so incredibly offensive on live radio that the national media is descending on Augusta.
cards.learningGoal: Political Volatility: (Unfiltered, Tirade, National scrutiny).

cards.name: The Right Whale Injunction
cards.flavorText: The federal government is restricting lobster traps to protect an endangered whale. The lobstermen are ready to riot.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Regulations: (Right whale, Injunction, Restricting gear).

cards.name: Acadia National Park
cards.flavorText: You tried to drive up Cadillac Mountain at sunrise. You are stuck behind 4,000 minivans from New York.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Congestion: (Cadillac Mountain, Sunrise, Overcrowded).

cards.name: The Ice Fishing Derby
cards.flavorText: Sitting on a frozen lake in a plywood box, drinking Allen's Coffee Brandy, and waiting for a flag to pop up.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Pastimes: (Ice shanty, Coffee brandy, Tip-up).

cards.name: The Turnpike Toll
cards.flavorText: If you want to drive south of Augusta, you have to pay the toll authority. It's highway robbery, but the state is rich.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Tolls: (Toll barrier, Highway robbery, I-95).

cards.name: The Town Meeting
cards.flavorText: There is no city council. The entire town meets in the high school gymnasium to scream at each other about the snowplow budget.
cards.learningGoal: New England Governance: (Town meeting, Direct democracy, Screaming match).

cards.name: The 'From Away' Stigma
cards.flavorText: You moved here 40 years ago, but your grandfather wasn't born here, so you are still considered 'from away.' You lose the argument.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Gatekeeping: (From away, Generational roots, Outsider).

cards.name: The Blueberry Barrens
cards.flavorText: We grow the tiny, wild blueberries. The rakers are in the fields, the bears are eating the profits, and the pies are perfect.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Niches: (Wild blueberry, Barrens, Raking).

cards.name: The Kennebunkport Compound
cards.flavorText: Fundraising on the rocky coast near a massive, secretive family compound. The old-money Republicans are opening their checkbooks.
cards.learningGoal: Political Dynasties: (Compound, Old money, Secretive).

cards.name: The Dirigo Motto
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The state motto is 'Dirigo.' We lead the nation in voting rights, independence, and freezing our tails off!
cards.learningGoal: State Pride: (Dirigo, I lead, Unwavering independence).

cards.name: The Blackfly Swarm
cards.flavorText: The snow melted, and now billions of tiny, biting flies are swarming your face. The woods are uninhabitable until July.
cards.learningGoal: Insect Plagues: (Blackfly, Biting swarm, Uninhabitable).

cards.name: The Submarine Base
cards.flavorText: We overhaul nuclear submarines right on the border with New Hampshire. It's a massive economic engine. Salute the Navy.
cards.learningGoal: Military Infrastructure: (Shipyard, Nuclear overhaul, Economic engine).

cards.name: The Potato Blossom Festival
cards.flavorText: Crowning the Potato Queen in Aroostook County. It's deeply rural, entirely wholesome, and secures the northern vote.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Pageantry: (Potato Queen, Wholesome, Northern pride).

cards.name: The Heating Oil Crisis
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the cold.
cards.flavorText: The price of heating oil just doubled. People are choosing between eating and freezing. Your opponent has no solution.
cards.learningGoal: Energy Poverty: (Heating oil, Freezing, Sticker shock).

cards.name: The State House Dome
cards.flavorText: Hiding in the state capitol building, completely disconnected from the reality of the lobstermen on the coast.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Disconnect: (The Augusta Bubble, Disconnected, The Dome).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Veto
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The Governor is leaving, so he just vetoed 40 bipartisan bills out of pure, unfiltered spite. The legislature is scrambling.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Spite: (Unfiltered, Veto pen, Scrambling).

cards.name: The Somalian Refugees
cards.flavorText: Thousands of refugees moved to an old, dying mill town and completely revitalized the economy. A beautiful demographic shift.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Revivals: (Refugee, Mill town, Revitalized).

cards.name: The Route 1 Crawl
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got stuck behind someone driving 20 mph looking for antique stores in Wiscasset.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Delays: (Antiquing, Route 1, Crawling pace).

cards.name: The Sea Level Rise
cards.flavorText: The king tides are washing directly over the piers in Portland. The working waterfront is literally underwater.
cards.learningGoal: Climate Realities: (King tide, Working waterfront, Submerged).

cards.name: The Windjammer Cruise
cards.flavorText: Sailing off the coast of Camden on a 19th-century wooden schooner. It's incredibly scenic and historically authentic.
cards.learningGoal: Nautical Tourism: (Schooner, Windjammer, Historically authentic).

cards.name: The Franco-American Vote
cards.flavorText: French-Canadian heritage runs deep in the old mill towns. If you can speak a little Quebecois, you win the district.
cards.learningGoal: Heritage Voting Blocs: (Franco-American, Mill town, Quebecois).

cards.name: The PFAS Contamination
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The dairy farms are contaminated with forever chemicals from old sludge fertilizer. The farms are ruined. Tragic and toxic.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Scandals: (PFAS, Forever chemicals, Contaminated, Sludge).

cards.name: The Red Hot Dog
cards.flavorText: Eating a bright, neon-red hot dog with a natural casing that physically 'snaps' when you bite it. A Maine delicacy.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Processed Meat: (Neon-red, Snapper, Natural casing).

cards.name: The Independent Voter
cards.effect: Wildcard: Grants either +2 Capital or +2 Support randomly each turn.
cards.flavorText: Most voters in Maine refuse to join a political party. They are stubborn, unpredictable, and fiercely independent.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Independence: (Unenrolled, Unpredictable, Stubborn).

cards.name: The Snowmobile Trail
cards.flavorText: We have thousands of miles of interconnected trails. The tourists are drinking at the lodges and spending money.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Economics: (Snowmobile, Interconnected trails, Lodge economy).

cards.name: The L.L. Bean Midnight Run
cards.flavorText: You got caught in a scandal, so you went to Freeport at 3 AM to buy a flannel shirt and hide among the insomniac tourists.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Anomalies: (24/7 retail, Insomniac, Hiding in plain sight).

cards.name: The Sovereign Nation
cards.flavorText: The tribes are fighting for full sovereignty rights that the state has denied them for decades. Respect the first peoples.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Rights: (Wabanaki, Sovereignty, Denied rights).

cards.name: The Moosehead Lake Retreat
cards.flavorText: Fundraising at a remote, massive lake surrounded by pine trees and billionaires pretending to be lumberjacks.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Elitism: (Moosehead, Remote, Pretend lumberjacks).

cards.name: The 'Can't Get There From Here'
cards.flavorText: You asked a local for directions. They gave you an incredibly confusing route and then just gave up. You are lost forever.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resignation: (Can't get there from here, Confusing route, Lost).

cards.name: The FITN Kingmaker
cards.flavorText: I run a diner in Manchester. Every four years, the future President of the United States comes here to beg for my vote.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Power: (First-in-the-Nation, Kingmaker, Retail politics).

cards.name: The Free Stater
cards.flavorText: We moved 20,000 libertarians here to take over the local government and abolish the library. Live free or die!
cards.learningGoal: Libertarian Migration: (Free State Project, Abolish, Minimalist government).

cards.name: The State House Rep
cards.flavorText: We have a 400-member House of Representatives. I get paid $100 a year, and I sit next to a guy dressed as a wizard.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Bloat: (The General Court, Volunteer legislature, Absurdity).

cards.name: The Masshole Refugee
cards.flavorText: I moved across the border from Massachusetts to avoid the income tax. I still commute to Boston every single day.
cards.learningGoal: Tax Avoidance: (Refugee, Cross-border commuter, Tax haven).

cards.name: Live Free or Die
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The greatest, most aggressive state motto in the country! We have no seatbelt laws, no helmet laws, and no income tax!
cards.learningGoal: Aggressive Independence: (Live Free or Die, Unregulated, Uncompromising).

cards.name: The State Liquor Store
cards.flavorText: We put massive, state-owned discount liquor stores directly on the interstate to extract money from Massachusetts drivers.
cards.learningGoal: State Monopolies: (Extracting revenue, Highway robbery, Discount liquor).

cards.name: The Town Meeting
cards.flavorText: It is a Tuesday in March. The entire town is sitting in folding chairs, screaming at each other about a $400 snowplow budget.
cards.learningGoal: Direct Democracy: (Town meeting, Warrant, Folding chairs).

cards.name: No Income Tax, No Sales Tax
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Economic attacks next turn.
cards.flavorText: We refuse to pass a broad-based tax. The state budget is held together entirely by property taxes, liquor sales, and duct tape.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Stubbornness: (Straitjacket, Broad-based tax, Regressive).

cards.name: The Property Tax Shock
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: Because there is no income tax, the local property taxes just skyrocketed. The retirees are furious and your career is over.
cards.learningGoal: Taxation Squeeze: (Skyrocketing, Property tax burden, Squeezed).

cards.name: The Old Man of the Mountain
cards.flavorText: The iconic stone face fell off the mountain 20 years ago, but we still put it on our license plates. The grief is eternal.
cards.learningGoal: Lost Icons: (Crumbled, Stone face, Mourning a rock).
