cards.name: The Dixville Notch Midnight Vote
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: A tiny town of five people voted at exactly midnight. The national media treats this like it predicts the entire election.
cards.learningGoal: Media Spectacles: (Midnight vote, Outsized importance, National stunt).

cards.name: The Mount Washington Wind
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: A 231-mph gust of wind just hit the observatory. The temperature is negative 40. Do not go above the treeline.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Meteorology: (Hurricane-force, Above the treeline, Lethal).

cards.name: The Leaf Peepers
cards.flavorText: A million tourists from New York are driving 15 mph down the Kancamagus Highway to look at red leaves. You are trapped.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Gridlock: (Leaf peepers, Foliage, Kancamagus, Trapped).

cards.name: The Primary Diner Stop
cards.flavorText: You ate a plate of greasy hashbrowns while 50 national reporters took photos of you chewing. You are a frontrunner.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Politics Optics: (Chewing for the cameras, Frontrunner, Diner stop).

cards.name: The Purple State Pendulum
cards.flavorText: We elect a Democratic federal delegation and a Republican governor with a massive supermajority. We cannot be categorized.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Elasticity: (Pendulum, Split-ticket, Uncategorizable).

cards.name: The Northern Pass Defeat
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from environmentalists, lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We absolutely refused to let Canada run massive ugly powerlines through our beautiful mountains to power Massachusetts!
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure NIMBYism: (Powerline, Viewshed, Blockade).

cards.name: Mud Season
cards.flavorText: The snow melted, and the dirt roads have turned into deep, brown trenches. Your campaign Prius is completely stuck.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Vernacular: (Mud season, Trenches, Impassable).

cards.name: The Black Fly Swarm
cards.flavorText: You tried to host a rally in May. Billions of tiny biting flies chased the voters into their cars.
cards.learningGoal: Insect Plagues: (Black fly, Biting swarm, Driven indoors).

cards.name: The Dartmouth Bubble
cards.flavorText: Hanover is an incredibly wealthy, liberal Ivy League bubble in the middle of the woods. The locals deeply resent the students.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Elitism: (Ivy League, Bubble, Town vs Gown).

cards.name: The Granite State
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are made of granite! We are stubborn, we are hard, and we will absolutely not compromise on anything!
cards.learningGoal: Geological Metaphors: (Bedrock, Stubborn, Granite State).

cards.name: The Moose Brake
cards.flavorText: A massive moose is standing perfectly still in the middle of Route 3. You cannot honk. You must wait for it to leave.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Obstruction: (Moose, Impenetrable roadblock, Waiting it out).

cards.name: The Ski Resort Buyout
cards.flavorText: A massive corporation bought all the local ski mountains. The lift tickets are now $200. The locals are priced out of winter.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Consolidation: (Ski pass monopoly, Priced out, Corporate buyout).

cards.name: The 'Live Free' Hypocrisy
cards.flavorText: The state motto is 'Live Free or Die,' but we are the only state in New England where marijuana is still illegal. The irony is staggering.
cards.learningGoal: Ideological Contradictions: (Hypocrisy, Prohibition island, Staggering irony).

cards.name: The 400-Member House Vote
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: It takes an hour just to take attendance in the state legislature. The bureaucratic inertia is insurmountable.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Inertia: (Roll call, Insurmountable, Herding cats).

cards.name: The Franco-American Heritage
cards.flavorText: Manchester and Nashua were built by French-Canadian mill workers. Eat the poutine and secure the working-class vote.
cards.learningGoal: Immigrant History: (Mill town, Franco-American, Working-class).

cards.name: The Border Toll Plazas
cards.flavorText: We put a massive toll plaza right on the two-mile stretch of coastline we own, just to tax people driving to Maine.
cards.learningGoal: Predatory Infrastructure: (Toll plaza, Cash grab, Pass-through tax).

cards.name: The Governor's Council
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Policy Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We have a bizarre, five-person elected council that has to approve every contract and judge the governor picks.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Checks: (Executive Council, Veto power, Bizarre structure).

cards.name: The Fentanyl Crisis
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: A devastating crisis ravaging the working-class towns. There are no easy political answers, only tragedy.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Crises: (Epidemic, Ravaging, Overdose crisis).

cards.name: The New Hampshire Advantage
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from progressives.
cards.flavorText: We poach businesses from Massachusetts by promising them zero taxes. It's an economic strategy based entirely on spite.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Poaching: (The Advantage, Tax-free, Spite-based economics).

cards.name: The Town Dump
cards.flavorText: Everyone goes to the town dump on Saturday morning. It is the absolute epicenter of local political gossip and rumors.
cards.learningGoal: Small-Town Networking: (Transfer station, Epicenter, Rumor mill).

cards.name: The 'Masshole' Driver
cards.flavorText: A driver from Massachusetts is doing 55 mph in the left passing lane on I-93. The road rage is boiling over.
cards.learningGoal: Interstate Hostility: (Masshole, Left-lane camper, Road rage).

cards.name: The Seabrook Station
cards.flavorText: We built a massive nuclear power plant on the coast in the 1980s. The protests were legendary, but the power is clean.
cards.learningGoal: Energy History: (Nuclear reactor, Clamshell Alliance, Legendary protests).

cards.name: The Portsmouth Gentrification
cards.flavorText: Portsmouth used to be a gritty seaport. Now it is full of $100 tapas restaurants and Boston billionaires.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Gentrification: (Gritty seaport, Tapas, Priced out).

cards.name: The First-in-the-Nation Defense
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: The national party tried to take our primary away! We passed a state law forcing our primary to be first! We will defy them!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Defiance: (Defying the party, Primary calendar, Unyielding).

cards.name: The Broad-Based Tax Pledge
cards.flavorText: Your opponent refused to sign the pledge promising to never institute an income tax. The attack ads are writing themselves.
cards.learningGoal: Political Pledges: (The Pledge, Fatal error, Attack ad fodder).

cards.name: The Gun Show
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the base, alienate moderates.
cards.flavorText: You can carry a concealed weapon here without a permit. The libertarians are thrilled; the Mass transplants are terrified.
cards.learningGoal: Second Amendment Laws: (Constitutional carry, Permitless, Polarization).

cards.name: The Ice Storm
cards.effect: All Active Faction buffs are destroyed.
cards.flavorText: An inch of freezing rain just coated the entire state. The trees are snapping, the power is out, and the woodstoves are roaring.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Catastrophes: (Freezing rain, Snapping branches, Off the grid).

cards.name: The Sap Boil
cards.flavorText: It's March. We are boiling tree sap in a wooden sugar shack. The tourists are buying $30 bottles of syrup.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Traditions: (Sugar shack, Sap boil, Liquid gold).

cards.name: The Timber Lobby
cards.flavorText: Up north in Coos County, the timber industry still holds sway. Do not implement new logging regulations.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Leverage: (Timberland, Coos County, Logging).

cards.name: The Write-In Campaign
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The President wasn't on the ballot, so we organized a massive write-in campaign to prove a point!
cards.learningGoal: Grassroots Organizing: (Write-in campaign, Proving a point, Mobilization).

cards.name: The State Motto License Plate
cards.flavorText: A tourist realized that the 'Live Free or Die' license plates are actually stamped by inmates in the state prison. The irony is palpable.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Irony: (Prison labor, Palpable irony, Cognitive dissonance).

cards.name: The Providence Boss
cards.flavorText: I went to federal prison, came out, and immediately ran for mayor again. The voters love a comeback story.
cards.learningGoal: Political Comebacks: (Mayor for life, Federal prison, Teflon politician).

cards.name: The Newport Aristocrat
cards.flavorText: We live in 100-room 'summer cottages' built in the 1890s. We do not associate with the mainlanders.
cards.learningGoal: Old Money Aesthetics: (Gilded Age, Summer cottage, Aristocracy).

cards.name: The Quahogger
cards.flavorText: We rake the giant clams out of the mud. The water is cold, the work is hard, and the chowder is clear.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Foraging: (Quahog, Raking, Clear chowder).

cards.name: The Italian Mob Legacy
cards.flavorText: Nobody saw nothing. The campaign donation fell off the back of a truck. Mind your own business.
cards.learningGoal: Organized Crime Tropes: (Fell off a truck, Mind your business, Omertà).

cards.name: Refusing to Drive 20 Minutes
cards.flavorText: You asked a local to drive from Providence to Warwick. They refused, claiming they needed to pack an overnight bag.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Hyperbole: (Overnight bag, Cross-state, Absurd scale).

cards.name: Del's Lemonade Diplomacy
cards.flavorText: Drinking a frozen lemon slushie with actual chunks of lemon rind in it. If you use a straw, you are a tourist.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Gatekeeping: (Frozen slush, No straw allowed, Summer staple).

cards.name: Coffee Milk for the Kids
cards.flavorText: You drank a glass of milk heavily flavored with sugary coffee syrup. You are hyperactive and ready to pass legislation.
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Regional Beverages: (Coffee milk, Sugary syrup, State drink).

cards.name: The Mafia Indictment
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The FBI raided City Hall. Half the city council is wearing wiretaps. The political machine is temporarily broken.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Corruption: (Wiretap, Plunder Dome, Indictment).

cards.name: The Big Blue Bug
cards.flavorText: Hiding behind Nibbles Woodaway, the 58-foot-long blue termite on the roof of a pest control building.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Kitsch: (Iconic landmark, Giant pest, Bizarre mascot).

cards.name: The Pothole Lawsuit
cards.flavorText: The roads here are the worst in America. Your opponent's campaign bus just lost a wheel on Route 146.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Neglect: (Axle wrecker, Pothole, Worst in America).

cards.name: I Know a Guy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: You need a zoning variance? A cousin's brother-in-law works at City Hall. Consider it done.
cards.learningGoal: Nepotistic Networks: (I know a guy, Variance, Patronage).

cards.name: The 'Awful Awful' Drink
cards.flavorText: Drinking a massive, incredibly thick milkshake. It is 'awful big, awful good,' and requires a nap immediately afterward.
cards.learningGoal: Dessert Linguistics: (Awful Awful, Colossal, Dairy coma).

cards.name: The Rhode Island Accent
cards.flavorText: You parked your 'cah' in the 'yahd' and ordered a 'pizzah.' The working-class voters instantly accept you.
cards.learningGoal: Phonetic Shibboleths: (Dropped R, Working-class identifier, Dialect).

cards.name: The Ocean State
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We might be tiny, but we have 400 miles of coastline! The sea is our blood and our political leverage!
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Pride: (Ocean State, Coastline, Leverage).

cards.name: The Brown University Bubble
cards.flavorText: We sit on College Hill, wear tweed, and debate Marxist theory while entirely ignoring the city below us.
cards.learningGoal: Academic Disconnect: (College Hill, Marxist theory, Ivory tower).

cards.name: The Calamari Comeback
cards.flavorText: You went on national television holding a plate of fried squid to announce the state's delegate votes. Brilliant optics.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Pandering: (Roll call, Fried squid, Viral optics).

cards.name: The Twin River Casino
cards.flavorText: We built a massive casino right on the Massachusetts border to suck all the gambling revenue out of Boston.
cards.learningGoal: Predatory Economics: (Border casino, Sucking revenue, Vice monopoly).

cards.name: The Clam Cake
cards.flavorText: Eating a dense, deep-fried ball of dough containing three microscopic pieces of clam. A greasy political necessity.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Illusions: (Clam cake, Fritter, Doughy).

cards.name: The Independent Voter
cards.flavorText: Half the state isn't registered with a party. They are cynical, sarcastic, and completely unpredictable.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Sarcasm: (Unenrolled, Cynical, Unpredictable).

cards.name: The State Name Change
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from progressives, lose 1 from traditionalists.
cards.flavorText: We formally dropped 'and Providence Plantations' from our absurdly long state name. The history books are updated.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Reckoning: (Formal name change, Plantation legacy, Updating history).

cards.name: The Block Island Ferry
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is stuck on a ferry packed with incredibly rowdy bachelor parties heading to Ballard's.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Chaos: (Ferry voyage, Rowdy, Captive audience).

cards.name: The General Assembly
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: The Speaker of the House runs the state. The Governor is just a figurehead. Your legislation is dead in committee.
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Supremacy: (Smith Hill, Figurehead, Dead in committee).

cards.name: The 38 Studios Bankruptcy
cards.effect: Drain 1 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: We gave a retired baseball player $75 million to make a video game. The company went bankrupt instantly.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Boondoggles: (Venture capital failure, Boondoggle, Guaranteed loan).

cards.name: The Washington Bridge Closure
cards.flavorText: The main bridge connecting the East Bay to Providence literally broke. Traffic is a horrific, inescapable nightmare.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Catastrophe: (Critical failure, Severed connection, Nightmare).

cards.name: The Swamp Yankee
cards.flavorText: We live in the woods near the Connecticut border. We chop wood, we fix our own trucks, and we hate Providence.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Resentment: (Swamp Yankee, Stubbornness, Off the grid).

cards.name: WaterFire
cards.flavorText: We set 80 braziers on fire in the middle of the river while playing classical music. The tourists are throwing money at us.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Revitalization: (WaterFire, Braziers, Renaissance).

cards.name: The Hot Wiener
cards.flavorText: Eating three tiny hot dogs covered in meat sauce, mustard, and celery salt. 'Three all the way!'
cards.learningGoal: Hyper-Regional Fast Food: (New York System, Meat sauce, Celery salt).

cards.name: The State House Dome
cards.flavorText: Hiding under the fourth-largest self-supported marble dome in the world. The architectural arrogance is staggering.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Arrogance: (Self-supported dome, Georgian marble, Looming).

cards.name: The Catholic Voting Bloc
cards.flavorText: Rhode Island is the most Catholic state in America. If the Bishop is mad at you, your political career is over.
cards.learningGoal: Religious Demographics: (The Parish, Heavily Catholic, Bishop's ire).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Student
cards.effect: Opponent loses 2 Support in the neighborhoods.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to pander to art students from New York who aren't even registered to vote here.
cards.learningGoal: Pandering Misfires: (Art school, Hipster, Not registered).

cards.name: The Jewelry District
cards.flavorText: We rebranded the old, abandoned jewelry factories into tech hubs! The gentrification is swift and merciless.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Rebranding: (Knowledge District, Gentrification, Rebranded).

cards.name: The Toll Gantry Lawsuit
cards.effect: Spend 1 Capital, gain 3 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: We put tolls specifically on 18-wheelers from out of state. The trucking industry sued us immediately. We don't care.
cards.learningGoal: Interstate Commerce Fights: (Truck-only tolls, Legal battle, Gantry).

cards.name: The Narragansett Beer
cards.flavorText: Cracking open a cheap, iconic tallboy can. You are drinking the beer from Jaws. You are a local hero.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Revival: (Hi Neighbor, Iconic, Tallboy).

cards.name: The Fall River Border
cards.effect: Opponent must discard a card if they cross the border.
cards.flavorText: It's technically Massachusetts, but we all share the exact same accents, Portuguese bakeries, and grim economic realities.
cards.learningGoal: Border Blurring: (Spillover, Shared grimness, Portuguese bakeries).

cards.name: The Mafia Graveyard
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is distracted trying to figure out which concrete foundation Raymond Patriarca allegedly buried his enemies under.
cards.learningGoal: Morbid Folklore: (Concrete foundation, Mob boss, Whispers).

cards.name: The Smallest State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are 48 miles long and 37 miles wide! We have a massive chip on our shoulder and we will fight anyone!
cards.learningGoal: Napoleon Complex: (Smallest state, Chip on the shoulder, Scrappy).

cards.name: The Beach Pass Panic
cards.flavorText: You are trying to go to the beach on a Saturday in July. The parking lot filled up at 7:00 AM. Go home.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Frustration: (Beach pass, Capacity, Turned away).

cards.name: The 'I Grew Up With Him'
cards.flavorText: You can't attack me; my mother played bingo with your mother at St. Mary's in 1985!
cards.learningGoal: Social Entanglement: (Six degrees, Bingo ties, Entangled).

cards.name: The Coal Baron
cards.flavorText: We blow the tops off the mountains, we extract the black gold, and we own the state legislature.
cards.learningGoal: Extraction Economics: (Mountaintop removal, Coal baron, Black gold).

cards.name: The UMWA Miner
cards.flavorText: My great-grandfather fought at the Battle of Blair Mountain. We bled for this union. Do not cross the picket line.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Militancy: (Blair Mountain, Union blood, Picket line).

cards.name: The Holler Populist
cards.flavorText: Washington D.C. has entirely abandoned us. We rely on our neighbors, our rifles, and our faith.
cards.learningGoal: Appalachian Isolation: (The Holler, Abandoned, Self-reliant).

cards.name: The Centrist Senator
cards.flavorText: I am a Democrat in a state that voted 70% Republican. I will single-handedly hold up the entire federal government's agenda.
cards.learningGoal: Political Triangulation: (Centrist, Holding up the agenda, Defying gravity).

cards.name: Pepperoni Roll Pandering
cards.flavorText: Eating a stick of spicy pepperoni baked inside a soft, sweet yeast roll. It is the greatest culinary invention in the state.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary History: (Yeast roll, Portable lunch, Inventor).

cards.name: The Mothman Sighting
cards.flavorText: A terrifying, red-eyed, winged creature was spotted near the old TNT plant. The electorate is panicked and distracted.
cards.learningGoal: Cryptid Folklore: (Mothman, Red-eyed, Urban legend).

cards.name: Country Roads Singalong
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: You played the song. Every single person in the state immediately wrapped their arms around each other and started weeping.
cards.learningGoal: Anthemic Devotion: (Singalong, Almost heaven, Weeping).

cards.name: Mountaintop Removal
cards.effect: Gain +5 Capital, but lose 2 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: We literally blew the top off a mountain and dumped it into the valley to get to the coal. The money is flowing.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Devastation: (Mountaintop removal, Severed peaks, Valley fill).

cards.name: The Switchback Highway
cards.flavorText: Your opponent's campaign bus is trying to navigate a steep, 15-mph hairpin turn on a mountain road behind a logging truck.
cards.learningGoal: Topographical Nightmares: (Switchback, Hairpin turn, Navigating).

cards.name: The Opioid Crisis
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The pharmacies flooded the small towns with millions of pills. The addiction crisis is ravaging the state.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Crises: (Pill mill, Ravaging, Epidemic, Despair).

cards.name: The Hatfield-McCoy Feud
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the South.
cards.flavorText: You accidentally insulted someone whose great-great-grandfather was shot by your great-great-grandfather. The feud resumes.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Grudges: (Blood feud, Generational, Retribution).

cards.name: New River Gorge Bridge
cards.flavorText: You parachuted off an 876-foot-tall steel arch bridge to show the voters you are fearless. Or insane.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Sports Spectacle: (Base jumping, Steel arch, Fearless).

cards.name: The Brain Drain
cards.flavorText: There are no tech jobs, so every college graduate from WVU is packing their bags and moving to Columbus or Charlotte.
cards.learningGoal: Demographic Flight: (Brain drain, Out-migration, Lack of opportunity).

cards.name: Burning the Couch
cards.effect: Flip a coin. Heads: +3 Support. Tails: -3 Support.
cards.flavorText: WVU just won a huge football game. The students are literally dragging furniture into the street and setting it on fire.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Arson: (Burning couches, Riotous celebration, Morgantown).

cards.name: The Coal Severance Tax
cards.flavorText: When the price of coal goes up, the state takes a cut. It's the only thing keeping the county budgets alive.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Taxation: (Severance tax, Budget lifeline, Fluctuation).

cards.name: The Chemical Valley
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: We produce the chemicals that build the modern world. Just don't drink the water downstream from the plant.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Trade-offs: (Chemical Valley, Toxic runoff, Compromise).

cards.name: The Teacher Strike
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: Every teacher in all 55 counties just walked out. They are wearing red, occupying the capitol, and completely paralyzing the state.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Uprisings: (Wildcat strike, Walkout, Solidarity, Red bandanas).

cards.name: The Golden Dome
cards.flavorText: Hiding in the massive, gold-leafed dome of the state capitol in Charleston. It is shiny, historic, and incredibly insulated.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Shielding: (Gold-leafed, Insulated, Gilded).

cards.name: Ramp Festival
cards.flavorText: Eating wild, aggressively pungent spring onions foraged from the mountains. You smell terrible, but the locals respect you.
cards.learningGoal: Foraged Delicacies: (Ramps, Pungent, Foraging, Wild leek).

cards.name: The Greenbrier Resort
cards.flavorText: Fundraising at a wildly opulent resort that secretly housed an underground nuclear bunker for the US Congress for 30 years.
cards.learningGoal: Cold War Secrets: (Nuclear bunker, Opulence, Classified).

cards.name: The Flatlander Insult
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is from Ohio. They complained about driving up a hill. The entire state is laughing at them.
cards.learningGoal: Topographical Elitism: (Flatlander, Outsider, Weakness).

cards.name: The Mine Collapse
cards.effect: All Active Corporate buffs are destroyed.
cards.flavorText: A disaster in the mines. The entire state is holding its breath while the rescue teams go underground. Corporate safety is scrutinized.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Tragedies: (Mine collapse, Rescue operation, Scrutiny).

cards.name: The Bluegrass Jam
cards.flavorText: Three guys on a porch playing the banjo, fiddle, and upright bass. The authentic Appalachian culture is vibrating.
cards.learningGoal: Musical Heritage: (Pickin', Bluegrass, Acoustic roots).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Landlord
cards.flavorText: Your biggest donor owns 10,000 acres of West Virginia timber but lives in New York. The locals are preparing the pitchforks.
cards.learningGoal: Absentee Economics: (Out-of-state landlord, Extraction, Resentment).

cards.name: The State Flag
cards.flavorText: Mountaineers are Always Free! We seceded from Virginia during the Civil War because we refused to be enslaved!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (State motto, Secession, Fierce independence).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Trash
cards.flavorText: We are getting paid to let East Coast states dump their garbage in our landfills. It's humiliating but lucrative.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Dumping: (Landfill, Trash import, Humiliating revenue).

cards.name: Tudor's Biscuit World
cards.flavorText: Buying the campaign staff a massive, greasy, glorious biscuit filled with bacon, egg, and cheese. Morale is restored.
cards.learningGoal: Fast Food Euphoria: (Massive biscuit, Morale boost, Local chain).

cards.name: The Broadband Desert
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to run a digital ad campaign, but half the state physically doesn't have high-speed internet.
cards.learningGoal: Digital Divides: (Broadband desert, Disconnected, Lagging infrastructure).

cards.name: The Interstate 79 Crawl
cards.flavorText: Your campaign bus hit a massive buck on the interstate. The front bumper is destroyed.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Hazards: (Deer collision, Bumper destroyed, Interstate).

cards.name: The Red State Shift
cards.flavorText: This state voted for Jimmy Carter, Bill Clinton, and Michael Dukakis. Now it is the reddest state in the nation. The whiplash is intense.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Realignment: (Whiplash, Flipping the map, Red shift).

cards.name: The Right-to-Work Law
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital from donors, lose 3 Support from labor.
cards.flavorText: We passed a law destroying the power of the UMWA. The corporations are thrilled, the grandfathers are rolling in their graves.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Battles: (Right-to-work, Union busting, Rolling in their graves).

cards.name: The Moonshiner
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: Selling 100-proof corn liquor in a Mason jar out of the trunk of a car to fund the grassroots campaign.
cards.learningGoal: Bootlegger History: (White lightning, Moonshine, Illicit revenue).

cards.name: The Black Lung Fund
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the coalfields.
cards.flavorText: The coal company went bankrupt and tried to dodge paying the healthcare costs for the sick miners. You are defending the miners.
cards.learningGoal: Occupational Hazards: (Black lung, Corporate dodging, Broken promises).

cards.name: The Potomac Highlands
cards.flavorText: We sell expensive cabins to federal bureaucrats from Washington D.C. who want to pretend they are rugged for the weekend.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Gentrification: (Weekend warriors, Pretend ruggedness, Cabin rentals).

cards.name: The Natural Gas Fracking
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from environmentalists.
cards.flavorText: The coal is dying, but the natural gas is booming! The drill rigs are back and the pipelines are full.
cards.learningGoal: Energy Transitions: (Marcellus Shale, Fracking, Pipeline).

cards.name: The Empty Main Street
cards.flavorText: The local grocery store closed. Now the only place to buy food in the entire county is a discount dollar store.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Decay: (Main Street decay, Discount store, Food desert).

cards.name: The State Fair of West Virginia
cards.flavorText: Eating a cinnamon roll the size of a hubcap while watching a demolition derby in the mud.
cards.learningGoal: Carnival Absurdity: (Hubcap-sized, Demolition derby, Fairgrounds).

cards.name: The Oil Executive
cards.flavorText: We pull the crude out of the frozen tundra, put it in the pipeline, and fund 80% of the entire state budget.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Monolith: (North Slope, Crude, Funding the state).

cards.name: The Bush Pilot
cards.flavorText: I fly a tiny prop plane with giant tires into villages that don't have roads. I am the only lifeline they have.
cards.learningGoal: Aviation Lifelines: (Bush pilot, Off-grid, Tundra tires).

cards.name: The Anchorage Bureaucrat
cards.flavorText: Half the state lives in this city. The rest of the state considers us a soft, terrible suburb of Seattle.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Concentration: (Los Anchorage, Disdain, Soft city).

cards.name: The Independent Maverick
cards.flavorText: I lost the primary, so I ran a write-in campaign for the US Senate and won anyway. I bow to no party.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Defiance: (Write-in campaign, Maverick, Bucking the party).

cards.name: The Permanent Fund Dividend
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: The state takes the oil money and writes a $1,500 check to every single man, woman, and child! The economy is booming!
cards.learningGoal: Universal Basic Income: (PFD, Oil wealth, Direct payment).

cards.name: Cutting the PFD
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent suggested cutting the oil dividend check to balance the budget. They will be hunted for sport.
cards.learningGoal: Political Suicide: (Third rail, Slashing the check, Hunted).

cards.name: The Iditarod Trail
cards.flavorText: A grueling 1,000-mile race through the frozen wilderness. You are showing incredible stamina and respect for tradition.
cards.learningGoal: Endurance Traditions: (Iditarod, Musher, Grueling).

cards.name: Ranked Choice Voting
cards.effect: Opponent's attacks are delayed by 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: We instituted open primaries and ranked choice! The extreme candidates are furious, but the moderates keep winning!
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Reform: (Open primary, Ranked choice, Consensus candidate).

cards.name: The Trans-Alaska Pipeline
cards.flavorText: An 800-mile steel tube running from the Arctic Ocean to Valdez. It is the absolute lifeblood of the Alaskan economy.
cards.learningGoal: Megaprojects: (Trans-Alaska Pipeline, Artery, Lifeblood).

cards.name: Moose in the Driveway
cards.flavorText: Your opponent cannot leave their house because a massive, angry moose is eating their garbage can.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Wildlife: (Massive obstacle, Nuisance, Territorial).

cards.name: The 'Lower 48' Insult
cards.flavorText: Your opponent referenced how things are done 'down in the states.' The locals are immediately furious at the condescension.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Elitism: (Lower 48, Condescension, Outsider ignorance).

cards.name: Six Months of Darkness
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The sun literally does not rise above the horizon in Utqiagvik. The SAD (Seasonal Affective Disorder) is crippling.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Latitude: (Polar night, Seasonal Affective Disorder, Crippling).

cards.name: The Midnight Sun
cards.flavorText: It is 2 AM and the sun is still shining. You haven't slept in three days, but your campaign is moving at light speed.
cards.learningGoal: Circadian Rhythm: (Midnight sun, Manic energy, Light speed).

cards.name: The Capital Move Debate
cards.flavorText: You can only reach the state capital by boat or plane. We argue about moving it to the road system every ten years. It never happens.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Absurdity: (Inaccessible, Relocation debate, Road system).

cards.name: The Bristol Bay Salmon
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from fishermen, lose 3 from miners.
cards.flavorText: We are blocking a massive copper mine to protect the greatest wild sockeye salmon run on planet Earth!
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Standoffs: (Sockeye salmon, Watershed, Extractive threat).

cards.name: The Out-of-State Cruise Ships
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: Three massive cruise ships just dumped 10,000 tourists into a town of 3,000 people. The jewelry stores are thrilled.
cards.learningGoal: Mass Tourism: (Floating city, Influx, Overcrowding).

cards.name: The Permafrost Thaw
cards.flavorText: The frozen ground is melting. Roads are buckling, pipes are snapping, and houses are literally sinking into the mud.
cards.learningGoal: Climate Catastrophe: (Permafrost, Buckling, Thawing).

cards.name: Sarah Palin's Ghost
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from the national media.
cards.flavorText: You looked through a scope, mentioned Russia, and used folksy slang. The national media eats it up, but the locals roll their eyes.
cards.learningGoal: Political Tropes: (Grizzly Mama, Folksy, Media circus).

cards.name: The Snowmachine
cards.flavorText: Your opponent called it a 'snowmobile.' They are immediately deported back to Minnesota. It is a snowmachine.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Gatekeeping: (Snowmachine, Nomenclature, Deported).

cards.name: The Bridge to Nowhere
cards.effect: Gain +3 Capital now, lose 2 Support later.
cards.flavorText: You secured $400 million to build a bridge to an island with 50 people on it. It became a national symbol of waste.
cards.learningGoal: Pork Barrel Politics: (Bridge to Nowhere, Earmark, National symbol).

cards.name: The Ferry System Cuts
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the Southeast.
cards.flavorText: You cut the budget for the state ferry system. The coastal towns are completely stranded and they want your head.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Infrastructure: (Marine Highway, Stranded, Budget cuts).

cards.name: The Native Corporations
cards.effect: Provides +3 Capital, but opponent gains +1 Support from populists.
cards.flavorText: The 1971 settlement created massive, incredibly wealthy regional corporations owned by Alaska Natives. The political leverage is huge.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Economics: (ANCSA, Regional corporation, Leverage).

cards.name: The Earthquake
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: A 7.2 magnitude earthquake just hit Anchorage. The roads cracked, but the locals barely spilled their coffee.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Resilience: (Seismic jolt, Magnitude, Unfazed).

cards.name: The Tsunami Warning
cards.flavorText: The sirens are blaring on the coast. Everyone is driving their trucks up the mountain. The campaign is paused.
cards.learningGoal: Emergency Evacuation: (Tsunami warning, High ground, Sirens blaring).

cards.name: The Alaska Highway
cards.flavorText: You are driving the 1,500-mile, heavily potholed road through Canada to get to the Lower 48. Your windshield is shattered by gravel.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Road Trips: (ALCAN, Potholed, Shattered windshield).

cards.name: The Permanent Fund Board
cards.flavorText: You appointed your friends to the board that manages the $70 billion oil wealth fund. The power is absolute.
cards.learningGoal: Fiduciary Power: (Wealth fund, Sovereign wealth, Absolute power).

cards.name: The Halibut Charter
cards.flavorText: You paid $300 to go on a boat and pull a 100-pound flatfish off the bottom of the ocean. The voters respect the harvest.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Fishing: (Halibut, The Spit, Deep-sea harvest).

cards.name: The Texas Comparison
cards.flavorText: A Texan bragged about their state's size. You pulled out a map showing Alaska is two and a half times bigger. The Texan is silenced.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Supremacy: (Supremacy, Cartography, Silencing the brag).

cards.name: The Dry Village
cards.flavorText: Many rural villages ban alcohol entirely. A bottle of cheap vodka on the black market costs $100. The social issues are complex.
cards.learningGoal: Prohibition Economics: (Dry village, Bootlegger, Black market).

cards.name: The Bear Spray Canister
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You always carry a massive can of pepper spray on your hip. You successfully deterred both a grizzly and a hostile reporter.
cards.learningGoal: Wilderness Preparedness: (Deterrent, Bear spray, Hostile encounter).

cards.name: The Northern Lights
cards.flavorText: The sky is exploding with green and purple ribbons of light. The electorate is mesmerized and feeling deeply spiritual.
cards.learningGoal: Atmospheric Spectacle: (Aurora Borealis, Mesmerized, Solar winds).

cards.name: The Ice Road Trucker
cards.flavorText: Driving a semi-truck carrying drilling pipes across a frozen river. It's dangerous, lucrative, and essential for the oil patch.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Extremes: (Ice road, Dalton Highway, Hazardous cargo).

cards.name: The Wild Blueberry Forage
cards.flavorText: Sitting on the tundra filling buckets with tiny, tart blueberries while keeping one eye out for bears.
cards.learningGoal: Foraging Hazards: (Tundra, Tart, Hyper-vigilance).

cards.name: The Federal Overreach
cards.effect: Opponent loses 3 Support in the rurals.
cards.flavorText: Your opponent wants the federal government to lock up more land as a national monument! We will not surrender our land!
cards.learningGoal: Federal Antagonism: (Overreach, Locking it up, Sovereignty).

cards.name: The X-C Ski Commute
cards.flavorText: The roads are completely iced over, so you just put on cross-country skis and glided to the campaign office.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Adaptability: (Cross-country skis, Gliding, Unfazed by ice).

cards.name: The Mat-Su Valley
cards.flavorText: Wasilla and Palmer. They are deeply red, highly suspicious of Anchorage, and the absolute base of the conservative movement.
cards.learningGoal: Ideological Strongholds: (The Valley, Conservative base, Suspicious).

cards.name: The King Crab Season
cards.flavorText: The boats are braving 40-foot freezing swells in the Bering Sea. The death rate is high, but the money is astronomical.
cards.learningGoal: Dangerous Economics: (Bering Sea, Swells, Astronomical risk).

cards.name: The Cabin in the Woods
cards.flavorText: I live in a log cabin with no running water. I use a generator and an outhouse. Leave me alone, but I will vote for you.
cards.learningGoal: Off-Grid Realities: (Hermit, Outhouse, Generator power).

cards.name: The Rank-and-File Strike
cards.effect: Drain 2 Capital from both players per turn.
cards.flavorText: The public employees are striking! The ferries are docked, the plows are parked, and the state is freezing in place.
cards.learningGoal: Public Sector Labor: (Walkout, Docked, Freezing in place).

cards.name: The 'Sourdough'
cards.flavorText: You have survived enough winters to be considered a true Alaskan 'Sourdough.' You are immune to accusations of being a transplant.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Badges: (Sourdough, Cheechako, Surviving the winter).

cards.name: The Registered Agent
cards.flavorText: This single-story building is the legal home to 300,000 corporations. We are the center of the financial universe.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Haven: (Registered agent, Legal home, Incorporation, P.O. Box).

cards.name: The DuPont Heir
cards.flavorText: My family invented gunpowder, nylon, and Teflon. We own the museums, the gardens, and most of the state's history.
cards.learningGoal: Dynastic Wealth: (DuPont legacy, Chateau Country, Industrialist, Heirlooms).

cards.name: The Rehoboth Beachcomber
cards.flavorText: The President is in town, the boardwalk is packed, and I'm waiting for a Grotto Pizza. Life is good.
cards.learningGoal: Resort Economics: (Boardwalk, Summer capital, Beachcomber, Seasonal).

cards.name: The Blue Hen Hardliner
cards.flavorText: We aren't just chickens; we are fighting cocks from the Revolutionary War. Go Hens!
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Identity: (Blue Hen, Fighting ability, Mascot, Alumni).

cards.name: The Slower Lower Native
cards.flavorText: Once you cross the Chesapeake & Delaware Canal, the speed limit drops and the chicken farms begin.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Divide: (Slower Lower, Below the Canal, Rural roots).

cards.name: The First State Pride
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We ratified the Constitution first! We lead every presidential inauguration and we lead this game!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Precedence: (Ratify, Inauguration, First State, Leading the way).

cards.name: Court of Chancery
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Action cards next turn.
cards.flavorText: We don't use juries for business disputes. A single judge in Wilmington just decided your company's fate.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Specialization: (Chancery, Bench trial, Non-jury, Corporate law).

cards.name: Tax-Free Shopping
cards.flavorText: People are driving from four different states just to buy a laptop without a sales tax. The revenue is glorious.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Incentives: (Sales tax, Tax-free, Cross-border, Revenue).

cards.name: The DuPont Highway
cards.flavorText: You are stuck behind a tractor and a chicken truck on the oldest divided highway in America.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure History: (Divided highway, Crawl, Agricultural traffic).

cards.name: Horseshoe Crab Spawning
cards.flavorText: Millions of blue-blooded prehistoric crabs are on the beach. It’s a mess, but it’s our mess.
cards.learningGoal: Ecological Heritage: (Living fossil, Spawning, Blue-blooded, Shorebirds).

cards.name: Dogfish Head Diplomacy
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a merger over a 90 Minute IPA. We keep it 'off-centered' in Milton.
cards.learningGoal: Brand Loyalty: (Craft brewery, Off-centered, Hoppy, Merger).

cards.name: The Nylon Capital
cards.flavorText: We built the first nylon plant in the world here. If it's synthetic and durable, it probably started in Seaford.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Legacy: (Nylon, Synthetic, Manufacturing hub).

cards.name: Grotto Pizza Controversy
cards.flavorText: You publicly criticized the sauce swirl. Half the state wants you exiled to Maryland immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Dogma: (The Swirl, Legendary, Divisive, Local staple).

cards.name: The Dover Speedweek
cards.flavorText: 40 stock cars are vibrating the entire capital city. The noise is deafening and the politics are paused.
cards.learningGoal: Motorsports Chaos: (Monster Mile, Banking, Stock cars, Vibration).

cards.name: Punkin Chunkin
cards.flavorText: We launched a pumpkin at 400 miles per hour using a giant air cannon. Your policy proposal didn't stand a chance.
cards.learningGoal: Physics Fun: (Chunkin, Trebuchet, Centrifugal, Projectile).

cards.name: The Scrapple Breakfast
cards.flavorText: Eating everything but the oink. If you can survive a Bridgeville breakfast, you can survive the Senate.
cards.learningGoal: Rustic Cuisine: (Scrapple, Offal, Slab, Acquired taste).

cards.name: The Clifford Brown Jazz Fest
cards.flavorText: The music is playing on Rodney Square. The city is alive, and your poll numbers are swinging.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Vibrancy: (Jazz fest, Syncopation, Legacy, Rodney Square).

cards.name: The C&D Canal Bridge
cards.flavorText: You can't reach me; I'm on the other side of the bridge and the drawbridge is up.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Barrier: (Canal, Gateway, Drawbridge, Crossing).

cards.name: The 'Small Wonder' Effect
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You tried to smear me, but I went to high school with your cousin. We settled it at a charcoal pit.
cards.learningGoal: Social Intimacy: (Two degrees, Small wonder, Familiarity, Settling it).

cards.name: Corporate Franchise Tax
cards.flavorText: We don't need an income tax when every company in the Fortune 500 pays us a fee just to exist here.
cards.learningGoal: Revenue Streams: (Franchise tax, Incorporation fee, Golden goose).

cards.name: The Wilmington Waterfront
cards.flavorText: We turned the old shipyards into luxury condos and a minor league ballpark. Gentrification at its finest.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Renewal: (Waterfront, Shipyard, Condo, Revitalization).

cards.name: The Firefly Music Festival
cards.flavorText: 50,000 people are camping in the woods in Dover. No one is answering their phones for a week.
cards.learningGoal: Counterculture Impact: (Woodlands, Headliner, Camping, Radio silence).

cards.name: The Delmarva Chicken Festival
cards.flavorText: We are frying 800 chicken quarters in a 10-foot pan. The grease is the engine of our economy.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Spectacle: (Frying pan, Broilers, Delmarva, Quarters).

cards.name: The 'New Castle' Snobbery
cards.flavorText: My town has cobblestone streets from 1700. Your modern criticisms are simply uncouth.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Elitism: (Cobblestone, Colonial, Uncouth, Preservation).

cards.name: The Peach Blossom
cards.flavorText: Reminding everyone that we were once the peach capital of the world before the blight hit.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Nostalgia: (Blight, Orchard, Blossom, State flower).

cards.name: The Slippery Weakfish
cards.flavorText: Your opponent’s funding just slipped through their fingers like a prize-winning Weakfish.
cards.learningGoal: Metaphorical Loss: (Weakfish, Slippery, Prize-winning, Game fish).

cards.name: The Winterthur Gala
cards.flavorText: Fundraising in a 175-room mansion surrounded by priceless antiques and DuPont ghost stories.
cards.learningGoal: High-Society Fundraising: (Estate, Gala, Antique, Opulence).

cards.name: The Horseshoe Crab Medical Miracle
cards.flavorText: Their blue blood saves lives in every hospital in the country. We harvest the crabs and the profits.
cards.learningGoal: Biotech Innovation: (Blue blood, Lysate, Biomedical, Harvest).

cards.name: The Biden Train Ride
cards.flavorText: I’ve taken the train from Wilmington to D.C. 8,000 times. I know every conductor and every voter on the platform.
cards.learningGoal: Political Branding: (Amtrak, Commuter, Platform, Rail-riding).

cards.name: The 'Slower Lower' Accent
cards.flavorText: Dropping the G's and slowing down the speech to win the heart of Sussex County.
cards.learningGoal: Linguistic Pacing: (Drawl, Slower Lower, Sussex, Local charm).

cards.name: The Mid-Atlantic Buffer
cards.flavorText: We aren't the North, we aren't the South. We are the calm, tax-free center of the storm.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Neutrality: (Buffer state, Mid-Atlantic, Neutral, Calm).

cards.name: The 'Small Wonder' Slogan
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are small enough to be efficient and big enough to matter! We are the Diamond State!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Efficiency: (Diamond State, Small Wonder, Efficient, Strategic).

cards.name: The UD Creamery
cards.flavorText: Eating a scoop of '1906' on campus. It's made by students and it's better than anything in Philadelphia.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Treats: (Creamery, Agriculture school, Scoop, Local pride).

cards.name: The Blue Hen Mascot
cards.flavorText: We are named after the fighting hens that soldiers took into battle in 1776. We don't back down.
cards.learningGoal: Military History: (Fighting hen, Brood, Revolutionary, Tenacity).

cards.name: The 'First State' License Plate
cards.flavorText: Our plates are black and gold and they remind everyone who got here first. Absolute authority.
cards.learningGoal: Symbolic Superiority: (License plate, Black and gold, Authority, First).

cards.name: The Return Day Parade
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Two days after the election, the winners and losers ride in a carriage together and bury an actual hatchet in sand.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Rituals: (Burying the hatchet, Return Day, Carriage, Bipartisan).

cards.name: The Charcoal Pit
cards.flavorText: If it's good enough for a sitting President, it's good enough for the voters in North Wilmington.
cards.learningGoal: Political Landmarks: (Charcoal pit, Milkshake, Presidential, North Wilmington).

cards.name: The Crab House Feast
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a tax break while covered in crab seasoning and drinking cheap beer on a paper-covered table.
cards.learningGoal: Maritime Negotiation: (Crab house, Mallet, Seasoning, Newspaper).

cards.name: The Johnson Controls Plant
cards.flavorText: We power the cars of America. The blue-collar vote is solid as long as the assembly line keeps moving.
cards.learningGoal: Blue-Collar Power: (Assembly line, Manufacturing, Solid, Storage).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Veto
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The Governor is leaving, so he’s signing everything in sight. The political landscape is shifting fast.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Action: (Veto, Lame duck, Signature, Shifting).

cards.name: The K Street Lobbyist
cards.flavorText: I don't vote in this city, but I write the checks that determine who does. Let’s do lunch at The Monocle.
cards.learningGoal: Influence Jargon: (Peddling, Quid pro quo, Retainer, Access).

cards.name: The Alphabet Agent
cards.flavorText: I work for a three-letter agency. My job title is 'Analyst' and my clearances are none of your business.
cards.learningGoal: Security Lexicon: (Classified, Clearance, Agency, Redacted).

cards.name: The Gentrification Expat
cards.flavorText: I moved here from Ohio to work on a campaign. Now I live in a luxury condo where a historic jazz club used to be.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Change: (Condo, Gentrification, Displacement, Expat).

cards.name: The Local Advocate
cards.flavorText: Taxation without representation is a war crime. We want a vote on the floor, not just a license plate slogan.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Grievance: (Disenfranchised, Statehood, Representation).

cards.name: The Think Tank Fellow
cards.flavorText: I have a PhD from Georgetown and a 50-page white paper that proves your entire campaign is mathematically impossible.
cards.learningGoal: Intellectual Elitism: (Wonk, White paper, Empirically, Think tank).

cards.name: Taxation Without Representation
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We pay the highest federal taxes per capita and have zero voting power in Congress. The outrage is our fuel!
cards.learningGoal: Political Irony: (Per capita, Outrage, Disenfranchised).

cards.name: Federal Government Shutdown
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: Congress didn't pass the budget. The Smithsonian is closed, the trash isn't being picked up, and nobody is getting paid.
cards.learningGoal: Bureaucratic Limbo: (Furlough, Essential personnel, Lapse in funding).

cards.name: The Motorcade Blockade
cards.flavorText: Twenty black SUVs just shut down K Street. You are trapped on the sidewalk for 45 minutes while the President gets a burger.
cards.learningGoal: Logistical Nuisance: (Motorcade, Gridlock, Perimeter).

cards.name: Cherry Blossom Tourists
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: A million tourists just arrived to take selfies with pink trees. The Metro is a mosh pit and the locals are hiding.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Congestion: (Peak bloom, Swarm, Mosh pit).

cards.name: The Sunday Brunch Summit
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a cabinet appointment over a $30 plate of Eggs Benedict. The optics are expensive and the stakes are high.
cards.learningGoal: Elite Socializing: (Brunch, Stakes, High-society, Power-pairing).

cards.name: Alphabet Agency Leak
cards.effect: See opponent's hand and discard 1 card.
cards.flavorText: An anonymous source at the FBI just sent a manila envelope to the Washington Post. Your secrets are out.
cards.learningGoal: Espionage Tropes: (Anonymous source, Manila envelope, Whistleblower).

cards.name: Statehood Referendum
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support, but trigger a Congressional Veto.
cards.flavorText: We voted 86% in favor of becoming a state! Unfortunately, a senator from a state with fewer people than our city said no.
cards.learningGoal: Constitutional Standoff: (Referendum, Veto, Disparity).

cards.name: The Metro Smelling of Smoke
cards.flavorText: The train is off-loaded due to 'arcing insulators.' You are now waiting for a shuttle bus in the rain.
cards.learningGoal: Transit Failure: (Off-loaded, Signal problem, Arcing).

cards.name: Mumbo Sauce Pandering
cards.flavorText: Drenching your fried chicken in a sweet, tangy, local sauce to prove you aren't just another federal carpetbagger.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Authenticity: (Tangy, Secret sauce, Carry-out).

cards.name: The Georgetown Cocktail Party
cards.flavorText: The real laws aren't passed in the Capitol; they are passed in a brick townhouse over gin and tonics.
cards.learningGoal: Soft Power: (Townhouse, Networking, Back-channel).

cards.name: Congress Overruling Local Law
cards.effect: Opponent's last Policy card is nullified.
cards.flavorText: Congress just used its oversight power to cancel the city's new budget. Welcome to the District.
cards.learningGoal: Home Rule Tension: (Oversight, Nullified, Jurisdictional overreach).

cards.name: The Intern Army
cards.flavorText: A thousand college students in poorly fitting suits are doing your research for free. The energy is high, the pay is zero.
cards.learningGoal: Exploitative Labor: (Internship, Free labor, Networking).

cards.name: Ben’s Chili Bowl Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Eating a Half-Smoke at the most iconic counter in the city. You look relatable, even if your shoes cost $800.
cards.learningGoal: Iconic Establishments: (Half-smoke, Counter service, Relatable).

cards.name: The National Mall Rally
cards.flavorText: You secured the permit for the Lincoln Memorial steps. The crowd size is being debated on cable news for days.
cards.learningGoal: Public Spectacle: (National Mall, Permit, Cable news cycle).

cards.name: Escalator Etiquette
cards.flavorText: Your opponent stood on the left side of the Metro escalator during rush hour. The commuters are physically shoving them.
cards.learningGoal: Social Taboos: (Escalator etiquette, Rush hour, Commuter rage).

cards.name: The Pentagon Move
cards.flavorText: National Landing is booming! The defense contractors and tech giants are moving in, and the rent is doubling.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Hubs: (Headquarters, Defense corridor, Booming).

cards.name: The Swamp Metaphor
cards.flavorText: You accused me of being part of the 'Swamp'? I was born here. This is a reclaimed wetland, not a metaphor.
cards.learningGoal: Local Identity: (Wetland, Reclaimed, Metaphor vs. Reality).

cards.name: The Watergate Hotel
cards.flavorText: Reminding everyone of the most famous burglary in political history. The name is now a suffix for every minor mistake.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Scandals: (Burglary, Suffix, Infamous).

cards.name: Diplomatic Immunity
cards.flavorText: You parked illegally and insulted a cop, but your car has 'D' plates. You are legally untouchable.
cards.learningGoal: Legal Privileges: (Diplomatic immunity, Untouchable, Red plates).

cards.name: The Smithsonian Field Trip
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got lost in the Air and Space Museum for four hours. They are exhausted and overstimulated.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Exhaustion: (Overstimulated, Fatigue, Field trip).

cards.name: The Federal Reserve
cards.flavorText: The Fed just raised rates. Your opponent's campaign loans are now much more expensive. Pure fiscal pain.
cards.learningGoal: Macroeconomics: (Interest rates, Fiscal, The Fed).

cards.name: The Beltway Insider
cards.flavorText: You were booked on 'Meet the Press.' The entire establishment is talking about your 'brave' stance.
cards.learningGoal: Media Diet: (Establishment, Talking head, Punditry).

cards.name: Snow Day Panic
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 1 turn.
cards.flavorText: There is half an inch of snow on the ground. The federal government is closed and the grocery stores are empty.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Hyperbole: (Dusting, Paralyzed, Grocery run).

cards.name: The 14th Street Corridor
cards.flavorText: We are negotiating the green energy bill over half-off oysters and craft cocktails. The lobbyists are paying.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Leisure: (Happy hour, Corridor, Lobbyist-funded).

cards.name: The 'Chocolate City' Legacy
cards.flavorText: Cranking the percussion-heavy, local sound of the District. The beat is infectious and the roots are deep.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Heritage: (Go-Go music, Percussion, Chocolate City).

cards.name: The Presidential Pardon
cards.flavorText: The leader of the free world just signed a piece of paper making your legal troubles disappear.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Clemency: (Pardon, Legal shield, Disappear).

cards.name: The White House Correspondence Dinner
cards.flavorText: You made a self-deprecating joke in a tuxedo while celebrities and reporters laughed. The checks are massive.
cards.learningGoal: Social Networking: (Correspondence, Tuxedo, Self-deprecation).

cards.name: The Rock Creek Park Run
cards.flavorText: Running 10 miles through the woods to prove you have the cardiovascular health to manage a federal budget.
cards.learningGoal: Performative Fitness: (Cardiovascular, Trail run, High-performance).

cards.name: The 'Secret' Speakeasy
cards.flavorText: Taking a donor to an unmarked door in an alleyway. The exclusivity makes them feel powerful and generous.
cards.learningGoal: Subterranean Networking: (Speakeasy, Unmarked, Exclusivity).

cards.name: The Embassies
cards.flavorText: The whole world is represented on Massachusetts Avenue. The international intelligence is flowing into your office.
cards.learningGoal: Global Diplomacy: (Embassy Row, Intelligence, Sovereignty).

cards.name: The Rent is Too High
cards.flavorText: The local workers can't afford to live in the city anymore. Your base is moving to Maryland and Virginia.
cards.learningGoal: Housing Crisis: (Displacement, Sky-high rent, Urban flight).

cards.name: The Summer Humidty
cards.flavorText: It is 98 degrees with 100% humidity. Breathing feels like drinking hot water. Your opponent’s spirit is broken.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Sarcasm: (Potomac soup, Oppressive, Spirit-breaking).

cards.name: The Marine One Flyover
cards.flavorText: The green helicopter just flew over your rally. The sheer proximity to power makes the voters feel important.
cards.learningGoal: Aviation Symbolism: (Marine One, Proximity, Executive aura).

cards.name: The Bureaucracy Maze
cards.flavorText: You trapped your opponent in a cycle of filing redundant federal forms. They are drowning in paperwork.
cards.learningGoal: Red Tape: (Redundant, Paperwork, Drowning).

cards.name: Statehood License Plate
cards.flavorText: Our license plates literally complain about our lack of rights. We wear our victimhood as a shield.
cards.learningGoal: Branding as Defense: (Slogan, Shield, Victimhood).

cards.name: The National Zoo Panda
cards.flavorText: The pandas are back! The entire city is distracted by cute, fluffy bears. The scandals are forgotten.
cards.learningGoal: Distraction Politics: (Panda diplomacy, Cute, Forgotten).

cards.name: The Old Post Office
cards.flavorText: Your opponent was caught charging the taxpayers for a $1,200-a-night suite at a hotel owned by a politician.
cards.learningGoal: Conflict of Interest: (Overpriced, Suite, Taxpayer-funded).

cards.name: The 5 PM Rush
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to leave the city at 5 PM on a Friday. They are still on the 14th Street Bridge.
cards.learningGoal: Traffic Reality: (Rush hour, Beltway, Standstill).

cards.name: The Justified Arrogance
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We run the world. We make the laws. We decide the future. If you aren't in D.C., you aren't in the room!
cards.learningGoal: Oligarchic Momentum: (Inside the room, Global influence, Unmatched).

cards.name: The 'Honest' Lobbyist
cards.flavorText: I served three terms, lost my seat, and immediately doubled my salary by selling my contacts.
cards.learningGoal: Revolving Door: (Former member, Salary bump, Contacts).

cards.name: The Mayoral Scandal
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: A legendary, career-ending video just hit the news. The city is in shock, but somehow the mayor is still popular?
cards.learningGoal: Local Chaos: (Marion Barry legacy, Infamous, Resilient).

cards.name: The Navy Yard Revival
cards.flavorText: We turned a shipyard into a glass-and-steel playground. The locals are gone, but the tax revenue is beautiful.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Revitalization: (Navy Yard, Glass-and-steel, Revitalization).

cards.name: The 'Thank You for Your Service'
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You attacked a federal employee? In this city? The blowback is immediate and devastating.
cards.learningGoal: Civic Loyalty: (Blowback, Civil service, Salute).

cards.name: The District Motto
cards.flavorText: Justice for All! We will not be bullied by the states or the federal government!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Pride: (Motto, Justice for all, Unyielding).

cards.name: The Rats of Dupont Circle
cards.flavorText: The rats in the park are the size of small dogs. They are currently eating your opponent's campaign flyer.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Pests: (Rodent, Infestation, Size of dogs).

cards.name: The Bakken Roughneck
cards.flavorText: I work 14-hour shifts in the freezing mud to keep the rigs turning. I don't care about your urban bike lanes.
cards.learningGoal: Labor Identity: (Roughneck, Oil patch, Rig, Shift work).

cards.name: The Red River Valley Farmer
cards.flavorText: Our soil is the richest on earth. We grow the sugar beets and the wheat while the rest of the world sleeps.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Pride: (Glacial silt, Sugar beet, Red River, Bountiful).

cards.name: The Scandinavian Stoic
cards.flavorText: 'That's different' is a devastating insult here. We don't do drama; we do hard work and coffee.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Nuance: (Stoic, Lutheran, Understated, Reserved).

cards.name: The Bismarck Bureaucrat
cards.flavorText: We have the only skyscraper on the plains. From the 18th floor, you can see the budget surplus for miles.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Power: (Skyscraper, Surplus, High-rise, Capitol).

cards.name: The North Slope Pioneer
cards.flavorText: Out past Williston, we invented the modern oil boom. We are the economic engine of the state.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Success: (Maverick, Pioneer, Economic engine).

cards.name: The Bakken Boom
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The horizontal drilling is working! The state budget is so full we literally don't know how to spend it all.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Euphoria: (Fracking, Windfall, Surplus, Horizontal drilling).

cards.name: The Bank of North Dakota
cards.flavorText: We are the only state with a state-owned bank. We fund our own students and our own farmers. Take that, Wall Street.
cards.learningGoal: Unique Infrastructure: (State-owned, Sovereignty, Financial shield).

cards.name: The 40-Below Blizzard
cards.effect: Clears the board. Both players lose 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The wind chill just hit minus 60. The interstates are closed and the cattle are huddling. Politics are frozen.
cards.learningGoal: Extreme Meteorology: (Whiteout, Wind chill, Huddled, Sub-zero).

cards.name: Knoephla Soup Diplomacy
cards.flavorText: Nothing heals a political rift like a bowl of creamy chicken and dumpling soup. It’s heavy and heart-warming.
cards.learningGoal: Culinary Heritage: (Knoephla, German-Russian, Dumpling, Hearty).

cards.name: The Nickel Trophy
cards.flavorText: NDSU versus UND. The rivalry is so intense it literally splits families and legislative committees in half.
cards.learningGoal: Collegiate Rivalry: (Nickel Trophy, Bison, Sioux, Rivalry).

cards.name: The State Mill and Elevator
cards.flavorText: We own the mill! We process the grain! We keep the profits in the state! A century of populist success.
cards.learningGoal: Socialist Legacy: (State-owned, Elevator, Grain processing, Populist).

cards.name: Fargo Gentrification
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: The old downtown is full of tech startups and $6 lattes. The grain elevators are now luxury lofts.
cards.learningGoal: Urban Change: (Silicon Prairie, Startup, Gentrification, Lofts).

cards.name: The Badlands Retreat
cards.flavorText: Hiding in the jagged, colorful canyons where Teddy Roosevelt became a man. The press can't track you here.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Isolation: (Badlands, Scapegoat, Rugged, Serene).

cards.name: Sugar Beet Harvest
cards.flavorText: The trucks are running day and night. The piles of beets are the size of small mountains. The money is sweet.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Intensity: (Harvest, Haul, Processing, Mountainous).

cards.name: The Wind Turbine Wall
cards.flavorText: The wind never stops blowing, so we turned the horizon into a forest of spinning steel. It’s ugly but lucrative.
cards.learningGoal: Renewable Energy: (Turbine, Horizon, Lucrative, Forest of steel).

cards.name: Dot's Pretzels Bribe
cards.flavorText: A bag of these buttery, seasoned pretzels is the only bribe you need in a North Dakota campaign office.
cards.learningGoal: Local Favorites: (Seasoned, Buttery, Irresistible, Snack).

cards.name: The Enchanted Highway
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got distracted by a 110-foot-tall metal sculpture of geese in flight in the middle of a field.
cards.learningGoal: Roadside Kitsch: (Sculpture, Geese in flight, Enchanted, Oddity).

cards.name: The Lutheran Potluck
cards.flavorText: Eating gelatinous fish and potato flatbread in a church basement. It shows you respect the ancestors.
cards.learningGoal: Ancestral Cuisine: (Lutefisk, Lefse, Potluck, Gelatinous).

cards.name: The Great Plains Grid
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is driving a road so straight and flat they fell into a trance and missed their exit.
cards.learningGoal: Topographical Monotony: (Grid, Straight road, Trance, Vast).

cards.name: Medora Musical
cards.flavorText: A high-energy outdoor show featuring horses, history, and a lot of singing about the Rough Riders.
cards.learningGoal: Historical Pageantry: (Rough Riders, Medora, Outdoor theater).

cards.name: The Minuteman Silo
cards.flavorText: There are nuclear missiles in the ground under that wheat field. Don't tell us how to run our state.
cards.learningGoal: Military Posture: (Silo, Deterrent, Under the ground, Nuclear).

cards.name: The Canadian Border Run
cards.flavorText: Running to the border to buy cheap goods. The cross-border economy keeps the northern towns alive.
cards.learningGoal: Border Economics: (Duty-free, Cross-border, Smuggling, Dash).

cards.name: The Oil Tax Trust Fund
cards.flavorText: We put 30% of our oil taxes into a permanent savings account. We are richer than God and we know it.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Discipline: (Legacy Fund, Savings, Permanent, Interest).

cards.name: The Fargo Woodchipper
cards.flavorText: Your opponent made a joke about the movie. Locals are tired of being associated with fictional gore.
cards.learningGoal: Pop Culture Fatigue: (Woodchipper, Fictional, Stereotype, Gore).

cards.name: The Theodore Roosevelt National Park
cards.flavorText: A photo op with a wild bison and a wild horse. It shows you are rugged, outdoorsy, and presidential.
cards.learningGoal: Conservation Optics: (National Park, Bison, Wild horse, Presidential).

cards.name: The Dakota Access Pipeline
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from industry, lose 3 from activists.
cards.flavorText: The pipeline is in the ground. The protests are over, but the political scars are deep and permanent.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Conflict: (DAPL, Standoff, Infrastructure, Political scars).

cards.name: The Winter Grill-Out
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You are grilling steaks in a t-shirt while it's snowing. Your opponent's attacks can't touch your toughness.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Resilience: (Grill-out, Toughness, Unfazed, Sub-zero).

cards.name: The Small Town Disappearance
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: Another rural school closed. Another Main Street died. The isolation is winning.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Decay: (Ghost town, Main Street, Depopulation, Isolation).

cards.name: The State Fair in Minot
cards.flavorText: Eating a deep-fried taco while looking at a prize-winning Holstein cow. The essence of summer.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Fairs: (Minot, Holstein, Prize-winning, Deep-fried).

cards.name: The 'Nice' Defensive
cards.flavorText: A polite smile and a 'That's fine' that actually means 'I will never forgive you for this.'
cards.learningGoal: Weaponized Politeness: (Passive aggression, Understated, Polite smile).

cards.name: The UAS Hub
cards.flavorText: Grand Forks is the center of the drone universe. We are watching the horizon with high-tech eyes.
cards.learningGoal: Innovation Niches: (Unmanned Aerial Systems, Drone, Hub, Surveillance).

cards.name: The Big Edge
cards.flavorText: You can see your dog run away for three days. You saw this attack coming from a mile away.
cards.learningGoal: Visual Puns: (Horizon, Flat, Forewarning, Unobstructed).

cards.name: The Peace Garden
cards.flavorText: Hiding in a beautiful park that straddles the US-Canada border. Peace is our literal brand.
cards.learningGoal: Symbolic Shielding: (Peace Garden, Straddle, International, Brand).

cards.name: The NDSU Championship
cards.flavorText: The Bison won the national title again. Half the state just drove to Texas to celebrate. Go Bison!
cards.learningGoal: Sports Dominance: (FCS, Dynasty, Migration, National title).

cards.name: The Roughrider State
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We are the Roughriders! We are tough, we are resilient, and we will outwork everyone in the room!
cards.learningGoal: State Identity: (Roughrider, Resilient, Outwork, Momentum).

cards.name: The Trust Attorney
cards.flavorText: We have $500 billion in private wealth hidden in our server farms. We are the Switzerland of the plains.
cards.learningGoal: Financial Secrecy: (Trust fund, Asset protection, Privacy haven).

cards.name: The Black Hills Ranger
cards.flavorText: Between the granite peaks and the buffalo, we don't care much for how they do things in Pierre.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Independence: (West River, Granite, Buffalo, Disdain).

cards.name: The Glacial Lakes Farmer
cards.flavorText: The soil is dark, the corn is tall, and the pheasants are plentiful. This is the heart of the state.
cards.learningGoal: Agrarian Identity: (East River, Glacial lakes, Pheasant, Fertile).

cards.name: The Sturgis Organizer
cards.flavorText: Half a million motorcycles just rolled into a town of seven thousand. The sales tax is a religious experience.
cards.learningGoal: Event Economics: (Sturgis, Rally, Revving, Sales tax windfall).

cards.name: The Monument Sculptor
cards.effect: Arts and Culture cards grant +1 Support.
cards.flavorText: We carved four presidents into a mountain. We know a thing or two about large-scale political branding.
cards.learningGoal: Iconic Branding: (Sculpted, Granite, Monumental, Branding).

cards.name: The South Dakota Trust
cards.effect: Double your Capital generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: Our laws are so friendly to wealth that billionaires from London and Dubai are moving their money here.
cards.learningGoal: Economic Magnetism: (Asset protection, Perpetuity, Vault, Capital flight).

cards.name: Wall Drug Pandering
cards.flavorText: You put up 500 billboards between here and Amsterdam. Everyone in the world knows where to get free water.
cards.learningGoal: Marketing Genius: (Wall Drug, Billboard, Free ice water, Roadside kitsch).

cards.name: The Sturgis Rally
cards.flavorText: The roar of 500,000 V-twin engines has completely drowned out your opponent's policy speech.
cards.learningGoal: Sonic Chaos: (Biker rally, V-twin, Deafening, Swarm).

cards.name: Mount Rushmore Photo Op
cards.flavorText: Posing in front of the world's most famous granite heads. It's cheesy, it's classic, and it works every time.
cards.learningGoal: Patriotic Optics: (Shrine of Democracy, Granite, Photo op).

cards.name: The Corn Palace
cards.flavorText: We decorated an entire building with murals made of corn. It's weird, it's beautiful, and it's full of tourist cash.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Art: (Corn Palace, Mural, Maize, Kitsch).

cards.name: The Missouri River Divide
cards.flavorText: The river doesn't just divide the land; it divides the culture, the politics, and the weather.
cards.learningGoal: Cultural Schisms: (Divide, Missouri River, East vs West).

cards.name: Buffalo Jam
cards.flavorText: A herd of 1,000-pound bison is standing in the middle of the road. You are not moving until they decide you are.
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Gridlock: (Bison, Jam, Impassable, Massive).

cards.name: The Badlands Maze
cards.flavorText: Hiding in the spires and pinnacles of the Badlands. Your opponent's scandals can't find you in the dust.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Protection: (Badlands, Spires, Pinnacles, Eroded).

cards.name: The Crazy Horse Monument
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support now, lose 2 Capital later.
cards.flavorText: We've been carving this mountain for 70 years! It'll be done any day now! (Maybe).
cards.learningGoal: Historical Endurance: (Unfinished, Mountain carving, Visionary, Slower pace).

cards.name: Pheasant Season Opener
cards.flavorText: 100,000 hunters in blaze orange just arrived. The motels are full and the shotguns are loud.
cards.learningGoal: Hunting Culture: (Blaze orange, Flush, Rooster, Opener).

cards.name: Deadwood Gambling
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but risk a scandal.
cards.flavorText: Slot machines and black jack in a historic gold-mining town. It’s legal, it’s gritty, and it’s lucrative.
cards.learningGoal: Vice History: (Deadwood, Gaming, Slot machines, Gold rush).

cards.name: The Mitchell Billboard
cards.flavorText: Your opponent got so sick of seeing signs for the Corn Palace they lost their train of thought.
cards.learningGoal: Psychological Saturation: (Billboard, Inescapable, Teaser).

cards.name: Chislic Bribe
cards.flavorText: A plate of salted, deep-fried cubes of lamb or beef. The unofficial state food makes everyone agreeable.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Snacks: (Chislic, Cubed, Deep-fried, Agreeable).

cards.name: The Oahe Dam
cards.flavorText: We dammed the Missouri to create a massive lake and a lot of electricity. The scale is breathtaking.
cards.learningGoal: Infrastructure Grandeur: (Hydroelectric, Earth-fill dam, Reservoir).

cards.name: Pine Ridge Poverty
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from opponent per turn.
cards.flavorText: One of the poorest counties in America is in your backyard. The systemic failure is a constant political weight.
cards.learningGoal: Systemic Crisis: (Neglect, Poverty, Reservation, Heavy weight).

cards.name: The Black Hills Gold
cards.flavorText: Selling grape-leaf patterned jewelry to tourists. It’s 10-karat gold and 100% South Dakotan.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Exports: (Black Hills Gold, Grape-leaf, Tri-color).

cards.name: Wind Cave Filibuster
cards.flavorText: The third-longest cave in the world is right here. Your opponent is lost in a maze of boxwork formations.
cards.learningGoal: Subterranean Metaphors: (Boxwork, Maze, Cavernous, Echo).

cards.name: The Great Plains Blizzard
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: The snow is horizontal and the temperature is lethal. The state is officially closed for business.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Hazards: (Whiteout, Lethal, Horizontal snow).

cards.name: The 80 MPH Limit
cards.flavorText: Driving from Sioux Falls to Rapid City is 350 miles of nothing. Better do it at 90 mph.
cards.learningGoal: Rural Velocity: (Covering ground, Desolate, Speed limit).

cards.name: The Labor Laws
cards.flavorText: We are a right-to-work state with zero corporate income tax. The companies are flocking here for the 'freedom.'
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Policy: (Right-to-work, Tax haven, Flocking).

cards.name: Dignity Statue
cards.flavorText: Standing beneath the 50-foot stainless steel statue of a Native woman. It's a rare moment of cultural unity.
cards.learningGoal: Artistic Unity: (Dignity, Stainless steel, Star quilt, Unity).

cards.name: The 'Great Faces, Great Places'
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: We have the presidents and we have the prairies! We are welcoming, rugged, and ready to win!
cards.learningGoal: State Pride: (Great Faces, Great Places, Welcoming).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Pardon
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislative session is ending. The Governor is signing bills and settling scores before heading home.
cards.learningGoal: Executive Action: (Veto, Signature, Lame duck).

cards.name: The Artisanal Cheesemaker
cards.flavorText: I left a law firm in New York to make raw-milk cheddar in a barn. My cows have better healthcare than most people.
cards.learningGoal: Lifestyle Migration: (Artisanal, Raw-milk, High-standard, Off-the-grid).

cards.name: The Yankee Traditionalist
cards.flavorText: My family has lived on this ridge since before Vermont was a state. We don't like change, and we don't like you.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Stoicism: (Yankee, Ridge, Tradition, Guarded).

cards.name: The Burlington Progressive
cards.flavorText: We will ban plastic, cars, and bad vibes by next Tuesday. Everything is locally sourced, including our outrage.
cards.learningGoal: Urbanist Activism: (Locally sourced, Progressive, Activist, Pedestrian).

cards.name: The Ben & Jerry's Exec
cards.flavorText: We prove that you can be a global corporation while still caring about the environment and chunky fudge.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Ethics: (Socially conscious, Global footprint, Values-driven).

cards.name: The Independent Maverick
cards.flavorText: I am not a Democrat, but I will out-organize everyone in this room. I am once again asking for your support.
cards.learningGoal: Political Outliers: (Democratic Socialist, Out-organize, Grassroots).

cards.name: The Billboard Ban
cards.effect: Opponent cannot play Information War cards.
cards.flavorText: We banned billboards in 1968. If you want to advertise your campaign, you'll have to put a tiny sign in a field.
cards.learningGoal: Visual Regulations: (Preservation, Uncluttered, Aesthetic, Ban).

cards.name: Maple Syrup Grading
