cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support if you use 'Fake' syrup.
cards.flavorText: If it's not 100% pure maple, it's a crime. We grade it by color and we judge you by your taste.
cards.learningGoal: Agricultural Standards: (Grade A, Amber, Pure, Grading).

cards.name: The Town Meeting
cards.flavorText: Everyone in town gathered in the school gym to vote on whether to buy a new tractor. It took seven hours.
cards.learningGoal: Direct Democracy: (Floor vote, Town meeting, Consensus, Deliberative).

cards.name: The Green Mountain Boys
cards.effect: Double your Support generation for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: We were an independent republic before we joined the Union! We bow to no one!
cards.learningGoal: Historical Defiance: (Republic, Independent, Militia, Defiance).

cards.name: Mud Season
cards.flavorText: The snow melted and the roads turned to chocolate pudding. Your campaign bus is buried to the axle.
cards.learningGoal: Seasonal Vernacular: (Mud season, Axle, Unpaved, Quagmire).

cards.name: Ben & Jerry’s Flavor Retirement
cards.effect: All Active Buffs are disabled for 2 turns.
cards.flavorText: Your favorite policy was just sent to the Flavor Graveyard. It’s gone forever. Rest in peace, Cherry Garcia.
cards.learningGoal: Corporate Branding: (Graveyard, Retired, Discontinued, Flavor).

cards.name: Lake Champlain Monster
cards.flavorText: Your opponent spent all day looking at the water trying to find a mythical plesiosaur.
cards.learningGoal: Folklore: (Champie, Plesiosaur, Mythical, Sightings).

cards.name: The Covered Bridge
cards.flavorText: Hiding in a 150-year-old wooden bridge. Only one car can pass at a time, and you're not in it.
cards.learningGoal: Architectural Icons: (Covered bridge, Bottleneck, One-way, Historic).

cards.name: Leaf Peeping Traffic
cards.effect: Drain 1 Support from locals per turn.
cards.flavorText: Tourists from New Jersey are driving 5 mph to look at a red maple. The locals are losing their minds.
cards.learningGoal: Tourism Friction: (Leaf peepers, Foliage, Gridlock, Seasonal).

cards.name: The Co-op Member
cards.flavorText: Negotiating a merger while filling a reusable jar with organic almonds. The vibe is very earthy.
cards.learningGoal: Retail Culture: (Co-op, Bulk bin, Organic, Earthy).

cards.name: Flatlander Insult
cards.flavorText: You called it 'The Green Mountains' instead of just 'The Mountains.' You’ve been outed as a New Yorker.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Gatekeeping: (Flatlander, Scorn, Outsider, Identity).

cards.name: The Woodstove Circle
cards.flavorText: Sitting around a cast-iron stove at the general store. The wisdom shared here is more powerful than a poll.
cards.learningGoal: Communal Warmth: (Cast-iron, General store, Wisdom, Hearth).

cards.name: The Nordic Skier
cards.flavorText: You glided 20 miles before breakfast. Your endurance is terrifying. Your legislation is passed.
cards.learningGoal: Fitness Culture: (Endurance, Gliding, Nordic, High-performance).

cards.name: The Craft Beer Mecca
cards.flavorText: People are waiting in line at 6 AM for a 4-pack of IPA. The beer economy is the only economy.
cards.learningGoal: Micro-Brewery Success: (Mecca, Hype, IPA, Craft beer).

cards.name: The Small State Advantage
cards.flavorText: You met every single voter in the state personally. It only took you three weeks.
cards.learningGoal: Scale Efficiency: (Retail politics, Intimate, Personal touch).

cards.name: The Cabot Cooperative
cards.flavorText: Thousands of family farms owning the factory. It's the ultimate Vermont success story.
cards.learningGoal: Cooperative Business: (Cooperative, Family farms, Cheddar, Stakeholder).

cards.name: Mount Mansfield High
cards.flavorText: We are above the treeline. The federal regulations can't breathe up here. We do what we want.
cards.learningGoal: Geographic Resistance: (Treeline, Tundra, Peak, Thin air).

cards.name: The Flannel Uniform
cards.flavorText: You wore a red plaid shirt to a black-tie event. In Vermont, this makes you a hero of the people.
cards.learningGoal: Sartorial Norms: (Flannel, Plaid, Black-tie, Relatable).

cards.name: The Granite Quarry
cards.flavorText: We pull the gray stone out of the earth to build the monuments of the world. Solid and lucrative.
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Industry: (Granite, Quarry, Monumental, Solid).

cards.name: The Vermont Teddy Bear
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Who can stay angry at a candidate holding a handmade stuffed bear? The deal is signed.
cards.learningGoal: Niche Exports: (Handmade, Teddy bear, Disarming, Gift).

cards.name: The Long Trail Hike
cards.flavorText: Your opponent tried to hike the length of the state but forgot their bug spray. They are incapacitated.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Hardship: (Thru-hike, Long Trail, Bug spray, Incapacitated).

cards.name: The 'Secret' Swimming Hole
cards.flavorText: You jumped off a rock into a freezing river that isn't on any map. Your local credibility is untouchable.
cards.learningGoal: Local Secrets: (Swimming hole, Credibility, Untouchable, Unmapped).

cards.name: The State Motto
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Freedom and Unity! We are individualists who stand together! The Green Mountain momentum is unstoppable!
cards.learningGoal: State Motto: (Freedom and Unity, Individualism, Collective, Unstoppable).

cards.name: Sub-Zero Starting
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: Your car started at negative 20 degrees without a jump. Your opponent’s attack just stalled out in the cold.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Reliability: (Sub-zero, Block heater, Stalled, Reliability).

cards.name: The IBM/GlobalFoundries Plant
cards.flavorText: The only massive industrial plant in the woods. We build the chips, you buy the syrup.
cards.learningGoal: High-Tech Manufacturing: (Semiconductor, Silicon, Industrial, Microchip).

cards.name: The Powder River Coal Boss
cards.flavorText: We dig the coal that keeps the lights on in Chicago and LA. Don't talk to me about 'energy transitions.'
cards.learningGoal: Extractive Industry: (Open-pit, Black thunder, Thermal coal, Artery).

cards.name: The Jackson Hole Billionaire
cards.flavorText: I have a 'cabin' that cost $20 million and a private jet on standby. I moved here for the scenery and the lack of income tax.
cards.learningGoal: Gentrification Economics: (Jackson Hole, Teton, Income tax haven, Private jet).

cards.name: The Equality State Pioneer
cards.flavorText: We gave women the right to vote in 1869 while the rest of the world was still catching up. We lead, others follow.
cards.learningGoal: Civil Rights History: (Equality State, Suffrage, Ratified, Pioneer).

cards.name: The Lonesome Shepherd
cards.flavorText: I spend three months at a time in a sheep wagon. I don't care about your Twitter drama; I care about the wind.
cards.learningGoal: High Plains Stoicism: (Sheep wagon, Isolation, High plains, Self-reliant).

cards.name: The Fossil Fuel Firewall
cards.flavorText: Our state budget is a permanent mineral trust. Even when the world goes broke, Wyoming stays in the black.
cards.learningGoal: Fiscal Strategy: (Trust fund, Severance tax, In the black, Permanent).

cards.name: Yellowstone Supervolcano
cards.effect: Drain all opponent's Capital to 0 and discard their hand.
cards.flavorText: The ground is literally rising. If this thing blows, your tax policy won't matter. Neither will North America.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Dread: (Supervolcano, Caldera, Geothermal, Cataclysm).

cards.name: Steamboat the Bucking Bronco
cards.flavorText: The horse that could never be ridden. He's on our license plates and he's in our soul. You can't break us.
cards.learningGoal: Iconic Symbols: (Bucking bronco, Unconquerable, Silhouette, Spirit).

cards.name: Old Faithful Eruption
cards.flavorText: You can set your watch by it. It’s predictable, it’s majestic, and it brings a million tourists with wallets.
cards.learningGoal: Natural Predictability: (Geyser, Hydrothermal, Eruption, Clockwork).

cards.name: The Wind of Casper
cards.flavorText: The wind is blowing so hard your opponent’s campaign bus just blew over on I-80. Welcome to the plains.
cards.learningGoal: Weather Hazards: (Gale force, Sustained winds, Horizontal, Blown over).

cards.name: The Jackson Hole Airport
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital, but lose 1 Support from locals.
cards.flavorText: The only airport inside a National Park. It’s full of billionaires and noise complaints. The revenue is sky-high.
cards.learningGoal: Wealth Disparity: (Private jet, Scenic, Noise complaint, High-net-worth).

cards.name: Chugwater Chili Bribe
cards.flavorText: One bowl of this legendary small-town chili and your opponent is ready to spill all their legislative secrets.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Staples: (Chugwater, Dry rub, Winning over, Hearty).

cards.name: Devil’s Tower Legend
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is obsessed with a 1,200-foot-tall volcanic neck. They think they see lights in the sky.
cards.learningGoal: Geological Oddities: (Volcanic neck, Laccolith, Sacred, Cinematic).

cards.name: The Continental Divide
cards.flavorText: On one side, the water goes to the Atlantic. On the other, the Pacific. We are the roof of the continent.
cards.learningGoal: Topographical Divides: (Continental Divide, Watershed, Summit, Crest).

cards.name: Grizzly 399 Optics
cards.flavorText: You were photographed (from a safe distance) with the world's most famous bear. You are now the 'Grizzly Mama.'
cards.learningGoal: Wildlife Celebrity: (Grizzly, Cubs, Roadside, Icon).

cards.name: The Empty County
cards.effect: Swap your regional alignment and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: Niobrara County has 2,000 people. They have the same legislative weight as a city block in Denver. Use it.
cards.learningGoal: Electoral Disparity: (Least populous, Weight, Disproportionate, Clout).

cards.name: Grand Teton Peak
cards.flavorText: Standing in front of the most dramatic mountains in America. The optics are literally unbeatable.
cards.learningGoal: Scenic Grandeur: (Jagged, Rise, Breathtaking, Backdrop).

cards.name: The Coal Train
cards.effect: Both players cannot play Action cards this turn.
cards.flavorText: You are stuck at a rail crossing while 150 coal cars slowly rumble past. It takes 15 minutes. Wait it out.
cards.learningGoal: Industrial Logistics: (Unit train, Hopper car, Rumble, Crossing).

cards.name: The Snow Chi Minh Trail
cards.flavorText: The interstate is a sheet of ice and the wind is 60 mph. The road is closed until Tuesday. You are stuck in Rawlins.
cards.learningGoal: Winter Travel: (Black ice, Ground blizzard, Closed, Stranded).

cards.name: The Buffalo Roundup
cards.flavorText: Driving 1,000 buffalo into a corral. It’s dusty, it’s dangerous, and it makes for a great campaign ad.
cards.learningGoal: Western Heritage: (Roundup, Corral, Dust-up, Thundering).

cards.name: Federal Land Grab
cards.effect: Gain +4 Support from ranchers, lose 3 Capital.
cards.flavorText: The Bureau of Land Management wants to regulate your grazing. We are filing a lawsuit for state sovereignty.
cards.learningGoal: Federal Conflict: (Grazing rights, Sovereignty, Bureaucracy, Litigation).

cards.name: The Millionaire’s Ranch
cards.flavorText: A celebrity bought the ranch next door and built a 10-foot fence. No one can get in to audit your campaign.
cards.learningGoal: Privacy Enclaves: (Fenced off, Exclusive, High-security, No trespassing).

cards.name: The Cody Night Rodeo
cards.flavorText: You sat in the front row and ate a funnel cake while a guy got thrown off a bull. Real Wyoming energy.
cards.learningGoal: Western Entertainment: (Rodeo, Bucked off, Dust, Americana).

cards.name: The Wind River Reservation
cards.flavorText: The Eastern Shoshone and Northern Arapaho. You must respect the sovereign nations to win the central counties.
cards.learningGoal: Indigenous Sovereignty: (Reservation, Sovereign, Arapaho, Shoshone).

cards.name: The 'Nice' License Plate
cards.flavorText: You have a single-digit license plate. In Wyoming, this means you are royalty. Your attack is irrelevant.
cards.learningGoal: Status Symbols: (Single-digit, Prestige, Royalty, Legacy).

cards.name: The University of Wyoming
cards.flavorText: The only four-year university in the state. Every single person in the state bleeds brown and gold.
cards.learningGoal: Institutional Monopoly: (Brown and gold, Flagship, Monopoly, Unified).

cards.name: The State Motto
cards.flavorText: Equal Rights! We don't care about your status or your money; we care about the law!
cards.learningGoal: State Motto: (Equal rights, Fairness, Jurisprudence, Integrity).

cards.name: The Green River Formation
cards.effect: Gain +4 Capital now, lose 3 Support later.
cards.flavorText: There's a trillion barrels of oil in that rock! We just need to figure out how to get it out! (Again).
cards.learningGoal: Speculative Energy: (Oil shale, Untapped, Extraction, Hype).

cards.name: The Jackalope
cards.flavorText: Your opponent is trying to find a rabbit with antlers to take a selfie. They are wasting their time.
cards.learningGoal: Folklore: (Jackalope, Taxidermy, Antlers, Hoax).

cards.name: Banning Wind Power
cards.effect: Gain +3 Support from traditionalists, lose 2 Capital.
cards.flavorText: We are taxing wind turbines into oblivion to keep the horizon clear of blinking red lights!
cards.learningGoal: Aesthetic Protection: (Horizon, Blinking lights, Oblivion, Visual blight).

cards.name: The Great Divide Basin
cards.flavorText: A place where water never reaches the ocean. Your opponent's momentum just vanished into a dry lake bed.
cards.learningGoal: Hydrological Oddities: (Endorheic, Basin, Vanishing, Drainage).

cards.name: The 'Wyoming's Full' Bumper Sticker
cards.effect: Reflect an opponent's Attack back at them.
cards.flavorText: You tried to bring out-of-state ideas here. We pointed to the bumper sticker and showed you the exit.
cards.learningGoal: Nativist Gatekeeping: (Full, Unwelcoming, Exit, Protectionist).

cards.name: The Wyoming Whiskey
cards.effect: Swap one card with your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Distilled in Kirby with local corn and water. It’s 100-proof and makes the legislative session go much faster.
cards.learningGoal: Craft Spirits: (Small batch, 100-proof, Distilled, Local corn).

cards.name: The Bison Gaffe
cards.flavorText: Your out-of-state opponent tried to take a selfie with a bison. They got tossed 10 feet into the air.
cards.learningGoal: Tourist Ignorance: (Selfie, Tossed, Fluffy cow, Danger).

cards.name: The Carbon Capture Plant
cards.flavorText: We are burying the CO2 in the ground! Coal is green now! (Don't check the math too closely).
cards.learningGoal: Technological Optimism: (Carbon capture, Sequestration, Green coal, Innovation).

cards.name: The Flaming Gorge
cards.flavorText: Campaigning on a boat in a massive red-rock canyon. The water is cold and the donors are generous.
cards.learningGoal: Recreational Logistics: (Red-rock, Canyon, Reservoir, Generous).

cards.name: The 'Code of the West'
cards.flavorText: You broke a promise? In Wyoming? That’s a violation of the code. Your attack backfires immediately.
cards.learningGoal: Ethical Frameworks: (Code of the West, Integrity, Handshake deal, Backfire).

cards.name: The Lame Duck Session
cards.effect: Play a card from your deck immediately.
cards.flavorText: The legislature only meets for 20 days in even years! It's a mad dash to the finish line!
cards.learningGoal: Legislative Pacing: (Budget session, Mad dash, Sine die, Compressed).

cards.name: The Lone Star of the North?
cards.flavorText: Your opponent compared Wyoming to Texas. We are much bigger (mentally) and much colder. The voters are annoyed.
cards.learningGoal: Regional Identity: (Envy, Comparison, Annoyance, Superiority).

cards.name: The Frontier Days
cards.effect: Your Capital and Support generation is doubled for 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Ten days of rodeo, pancakes, and western pride in Cheyenne. The momentum is unstoppable!
cards.learningGoal: Civic Festivals: (Frontier Days, Daddy of 'em All, Momentum, Grandiosity).
